Punchline.Original: BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.
Punchline.Translated: BOCCHI 让你的新月岛之旅更加顺畅。

Description.Original:
BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.
- No more of that pesky 'walking' or 'finding chests'. That's for losers.
- A cute little Fate and CE panel that'll tell you what rewards it gives AND help you automatically path to it, wowee.
- An extra illegal 'illegal mode' for those of you that would rather be touching grass or playing a game with worthwhile content.

Command prefix: bocchi (alias: och)
  /bocchi → Opens the main window
  /bocchi config → Opens config (aliases: cfg, c)
  /bocchi config list → Lists config keys
  /bocchi config get <key> → Prints a config value
  /bocchi config set <key> <value> → Sets a config value
  /bocchi buff → Start/stop a buff run
  /bocchi tp [fate|ce|pot] → Teleport toward nearest matching activity
  /bocchi illegal [on|off|toggle] → Control Illegal Mode (no arg opens the window)
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-ce → Flag registering CE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-fate → Flag a FATE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-non-pot-fate → Flag a non-pot FATE
  /bocchi reload-translations → Reload translation files (alias: rt)
  /och … → Same as /bocchi (legacy alias; also /occultcrescenthelper)

Plugin from https://ffxiv.ohkannaduh.com/plugins.json
Description.Translated:
BOCCHI 让你的新月岛之旅更加顺畅。
- 告别烦人的“走路”和“找宝箱”。那些活儿就留给倒霉蛋吧。
- 小巧的危命任务与临界遭遇战面板，既能显示奖励，还能帮你自动寻路前往，厉害吧。
- 还有更加违规的“违规模式”，适合宁愿出门走走，或去玩真正有料的游戏的你。

命令前缀：bocchi（别名：och）
  /bocchi → 打开主窗口
  /bocchi config → 打开设置（别名：cfg、c）
  /bocchi config list → 列出配置项名称
  /bocchi config get <key> → 输出配置项的值
  /bocchi config set <key> <value> → 设置配置项的值
  /bocchi buff → 开始/停止增益获取流程
  /bocchi tp [fate|ce|pot] → 朝最近的对应活动传送
  /bocchi illegal [on|off|toggle] → 控制违规模式（不带参数则打开窗口）
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-ce → 在地图上标记正在报名的临界遭遇战
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-fate → 在地图上标记危命任务
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-non-pot-fate → 标记非魔法罐类危命任务
  /bocchi reload-translations → 重新加载翻译文件（别名：rt）
  /och … → 与 /bocchi 相同（旧别名；也可用 /occultcrescenthelper）

插件来源：https://ffxiv.ohkannaduh.com/plugins.json

Punchline.Original: Don't fail at raid mechanics anymore

Description.Original:
An unofficial fork of BossMod Reborn by The Combat Reborn Team: https://github.com/FFXIV-CombatReborn/BossmodReborn
All credit for the plugin goes to the original authors.

Why this fork exists: the official plugin only runs the boss modules built into it. This fork adds a single feature: it also loads boss module DLLs from the CustomModules folder in the plugin's config directory, which can add modules or replace built-in ones. That way custom versions of encounters can be maintained separately instead of in a full fork of the plugin.

Everything else is unchanged. It is rebuilt automatically from every official release.

Not affiliated with or supported by The Combat Reborn Team. Please don't report issues with this fork to them.
Description.Translated:
The Combat Reborn Team 制作的 BossMod Reborn 的非官方分支：https://github.com/FFXIV-CombatReborn/BossmodReborn
插件的全部功劳归原作者所有。

创建此分支的原因：官方插件只能运行内置的首领模块。此分支仅增加一项功能：从插件配置目录下的 CustomModules 文件夹加载首领模块 DLL，用于添加新模块或替换内置模块。这样就能独立维护自定义战斗模块，无须维护整个插件的分支。

其他内容均未更改。每次官方发布新版本后都会自动重新构建。

此分支与 The Combat Reborn Team 无关联，也不受其支持。请勿向他们反馈此分支的问题。

BossModReborn.Author: The Combat Reborn Team (fork by IndividualGather)

This final build under the old name does no questing. It opens a short guide, installs WigglyQuest from the same repository with one click, and then points you at the plugin installer to remove itself. WigglyQuest copies your settings and local quest files on its first start.
Description.Translated:
Questionable 现在以“WigglyQuest”的内部名称发布。更改内部名称后，它不再与 PunishXIV 的 Questionable 分支共用 Dalamud 安装和配置目录；插件安装器中显示的名称仍为 Questionable。

这个沿用旧名称的最终版本不再执行任务。它会打开简短指南，让你一键从同一仓库安装 WigglyQuest，再引导你前往插件安装器卸载本插件。WigglyQuest 会在首次启动时复制你的设置和本地任务文件。

Description.Original:
Splatoon is a scriptable telegraph and overlay engine for Final Fantasy XIV, built on the Dalamud plugin framework. It allows scripts to draw shapes, markers, labels, and indicators directly in the game world. These overlays can be attached to actors, positions, or events, and are rendered with precise positioning.

Splatoon does not include presets or encounter logic by default. If you want presets, you must create them yourself or import them from others.

In short, Splatoon draws things. What it draws is up to you!

Plugin from https://puni.sh/api/plugins
Description.Translated:
Splatoon 是基于 Dalamud 插件框架的 Final Fantasy XIV 脚本化机制提示与叠加绘制引擎。脚本可直接在游戏世界中绘制形状、标记、标签和指示器。这些叠加图形能绑定到角色、位置或事件，并以精确的位置呈现。

Splatoon 默认不附带预设或战斗逻辑。如需预设，你必须自行创建，或导入他人制作的预设。

简单来说，Splatoon 负责画东西；画什么，由你决定！

插件来源：https://puni.sh/api/plugins

An unofficial fork of Rotation Solver Reborn by The Combat Reborn Team: https://github.com/FFXIV-CombatReborn/RotationSolverReborn
All credit for the plugin goes to the original authors.

Why this fork exists: the official plugin only runs the rotations built into it. This fork adds a single feature: it also loads rotation DLLs from the CustomRotations folder in the plugin's config directory, so custom rotations can be maintained separately instead of in a full fork of the plugin.

Everything else is unchanged. It is rebuilt automatically from every official release, with a teal theme to tell it apart.

Not affiliated with or supported by The Combat Reborn Team. Please don't report issues with this fork to them.
Description.Translated:
The Combat Reborn Team 制作的 Rotation Solver Reborn 的非官方分支：https://github.com/FFXIV-CombatReborn/RotationSolverReborn
插件的全部功劳归原作者所有。

创建此分支的原因：官方插件只能运行内置的技能循环。此分支仅增加一项功能：从插件配置目录下的 CustomRotations 文件夹加载技能循环 DLL，让自定义循环可以独立维护，无须维护整个插件的分支。

其他内容均未更改。每次官方发布新版本后都会自动重新构建，并采用青绿色主题以便区分。

此分支与 The Combat Reborn Team 无关联，也不受其支持。请勿向他们反馈此分支的问题。

Description.Original:
Allows for a macro to continue onto the next macro by using '/nextmacro' on the last line of a macro.
Adding '/nextmacro' on the last line of Macro #01 will automatically execute Macro #02
Adding '/nextmacro down' on the last line of Macro #01 will automatically execute Macro #11
Also allows executing any macro from chat using '/runmacro'
You can repeat a macro by using /runmacro inside the macro followed by the number of the macro you're editing
Using '/macrocancel' will stop the currently running macro
Description.Translated:
在宏的最后一行加入 '/nextmacro'，即可接续执行下一个宏。
在宏 #01 的最后一行加入 '/nextmacro'，会自动执行宏 #02。
在宏 #01 的最后一行加入 '/nextmacro down'，会自动执行宏 #11。
也可在聊天中使用 '/runmacro' 执行任意宏。
在宏内使用 /runmacro 并跟上当前宏的编号，即可重复执行该宏。
使用 '/macrocancel' 可停止正在执行的宏。

While this is it's primary purpose, it has quite an exhaustive list of other features including:
	- Craft planning
	- Market board integration
	- Item highlighting in inventories when searching/sorting and picking ingredients for crafts
	- Item window that includes vendor and source information among other things
	- Duty/mob/airship/submarine windows that are fully searchable
	- A filtering system that lets you setup complex searches for specific items 
	- Tooltip integration that'll let you see where the items are on hover

除主要用途外，还提供丰富的功能：
	- 制作规划
	- 市场布告板联动
	- 搜索、整理或挑选制作材料时高亮背包物品
	- 提供商店与获取来源等信息的物品窗口
	- 可全面搜索的副本、怪物、飞空艇和潜水艇窗口

  - Blocks emote spam from other players
  - Condenses earned commendations into a single line
  - Shortens lengthy messages such as joining Novice Network or entering an instanced zone
  - Blocks repeated messages from appearing for a period of time
  - Automatically copies most 'with your chat mode in /say' quest dialogue to your clipboard
  - Write custom filters to Allow/Block messages!
  - And more!

  - 屏蔽其他玩家的情感动作刷屏
  - 将获得的最优队员推荐汇总为一行
  - 缩短加入新人频道、进入任务区域等冗长消息
  - 在指定时间内屏蔽重复消息
  - 自动将大多数要求在 /say 频道发言的任务台词复制到剪贴板
  - 支持自定义允许/屏蔽规则
  - 还有更多功能！

✔ Favorites & Sorting – Keep profiles organized by name, date, or importance.

✔ 角色专属设计——每个角色可保存多套穿搭、风格和外观。
✔ 收藏与排序——按名称、日期或重要程度整理配置。
✔ 快速切换栏！
✔ 一键执行宏——选择角色时立即运行预设命令。

无论你喜欢角色扮演、集体动作拍摄，还是快速更换外观，Character Select+ 都能让角色切换更快、更轻松、更流畅。

Punchline.Original: See every item you and your party pick up, as it drops.

Description.Original:
LootView is a live loot tracker for you and your party, with a permanent history and statistics behind it.

WHAT YOU GET

- Live overlay listing every drop with its icon, rarity, quantity, who received it and how long ago.
- Estimated market value of your haul, priced for your home world through Universalis.
- Need/Greed panel that appears while rolls are open: time left on every item, each Need, Greed and Pass, who is still deciding, and the winner.
- Loot tables for dungeons, trials and raids - the duty you are in, or any duty you search for.
- Searchable history you can filter by item name, rarity, zone, high quality and owner.
- Statistics: rarity breakdown, top zones, daily and hourly activity, play streaks and period-over-period comparisons.
- Duty tracker recording your runs, clear times, items per run and personal bests.
- Export to JSON or CSV whenever you want.

GETTING STARTED

Type /lv to open the tracker and /lv config for settings. You can also open it from the server info bar.
Right-click any row in the list to blacklist an item or copy its name.
Found a bug or have an idea? Settings > Diagnostics copies a report and opens a GitHub issue for you.

PRIVACY

Your history is stored locally in your Dalamud configuration folder and is never uploaded. Market prices are looked up from universalis.app and loot tables from garlandtools.org; both requests send only an item or duty ID. Price lookups can be turned off in the settings.
Description.Translated:
LootView 实时追踪你和队伍的战利品，并保留永久历史记录与统计数据。

功能

- 实时浮层列出每次掉落，包括图标、稀有度、数量、获得者和距今时间。
- 使用 Universalis 上本服价格估算战利品市场价值。
- 投点期间显示需求/贪婪面板：每件物品的剩余时间、各人的需求/贪婪/放弃选择、尚未决定的人和最终获得者。
- 查看迷宫、讨伐战及大型任务的掉落表，可查看当前任务或搜索任意任务。
- 可搜索的历史记录，支持按物品名称、稀有度、区域、是否高品质和获得者筛选。
- 统计稀有度分布、常去区域、每日及每小时活动量、连续游玩天数和不同时段对比。
- 副本记录器：记录挑战次数、通关时间、每次所得物品及个人最佳纪录。
- 随时导出 JSON 或 CSV。

开始使用

输入 /lv 打开追踪器，输入 /lv config 打开设置，也可从服务器信息栏打开。
右键点击列表中的任意一行，可将物品加入黑名单或复制名称。
发现问题或有建议？前往“设置 > 诊断（Settings > Diagnostics）”，即可复制报告并打开 GitHub 问题页面。

隐私

历史记录仅保存在本地 Dalamud 配置目录，绝不上传。市场价格来自 universalis.app，掉落表来自 garlandtools.org；两类请求仅发送物品或任务 ID。可在设置中关闭价格查询。

Start a countdown that sends fun facts to your chat!
"/ffcd" to open the settings.

"/ffcd <length> <interval1> <interval2> ..." to begin the fun fact countdown.

For example, "/ffcd 15 10 5 0" will start a 15 second countdown and share a fun fact to your chosen chat channel (Party by default) at the 10 second, 5 second, and 0 second marks!

***If no intervals are given, your party will enjoy a fun fact for every second of the countdown.
Description.Translated:
启动倒计时，并向聊天发送趣味冷知识！
输入“/ffcd”打开设置。

输入“/ffcd <length> <interval1> <interval2> ...”开始冷知识倒计时。

例如，“/ffcd 15 10 5 0”会启动 15 秒倒计时，并在剩余 10 秒、5 秒和 0 秒时，向你选择的聊天频道（默认为小队）各发送一条冷知识！

***如果没有指定播报时刻，倒计时的每一秒都会给队伍发送一条冷知识。

Description.Translated: 连接 Adventure Machine 服务器，管理角色、世界和实时角色扮演会话，并由 AI 地下城主主持。可根据当前 FFXIV 游戏状态自动填入角色数据。

Punchline.Original: View your in-game map in your web browser.
Punchline.Translated: 在网页浏览器中查看游戏地图。

Description.Original: Stream your FFXIV map to any web browser in real-time. See anything from the in-game map on a second screen or device.
Description.Translated: 将 FFXIV 地图实时传送到任意网页浏览器，在第二块屏幕或其他设备上查看游戏地图中的内容。

Punchline.Original: Hide FC login/logout spam.
Punchline.Translated: 屏蔽部队成员上下线刷屏。

Description.Original: Lil plugin to hide the login/logout for specific free company members who never speak yet logs in/out 20 times an hour
Description.Translated: 隐藏指定部队成员上下线通知的小插件，专治那些从不说话却一小时上下线 20 次的人。

Name.Translated: 部队隐藏指定登录/登出

Punchline.Original: Force Emperor on a ton of stuff
Punchline.Translated: 给各种角色强制换上皇帝的新衣

Description.Translated: 给各种玩家或 NPC 强制换上皇帝的新衣，图个乐子。

Punchline.Original: Selects the next loot item automatically.
Punchline.Translated: 自动选中下一件战利品。

Description.Original: I don't like how unstable VanillaPlus actually is... All credits to MidoriKami
Description.Translated: 我不喜欢 VanillaPlus 那么不稳定……全部功劳归 MidoriKami 所有。

Punchline.Original: Link any status from the game
Punchline.Translated: 发送游戏中任意状态的链接

Description.Original: Allows to link any <status> from the game
Description.Translated: 可发送游戏中任意 <status> 状态的链接

Description.Original:
One-Click Dance & Emote Mod Management

Create presets for your favorite dance and emote mods, then activate them instantly with a single click or custom chat commands. Automatically handles Penumbra mod priorities, conflict resolution, and mod option switching so your animations always show correctly.

Key Features: Custom chat commands, automatic priority management, smart emote detection, idle/sit/doze pose support, preset folders, icon picker, drag & drop organization, and align-to-target for group emotes. Perfect for anyone who uses multiple animation mods.
Description.Translated:
一键管理舞蹈与情感动作模组

为常用舞蹈和情感动作模组创建预设，通过单击或自定义聊天命令立即启用。自动处理 Penumbra 模组优先级、冲突和模组选项切换，确保动画正确显示。

主要功能：自定义聊天命令、自动优先级管理、智能识别情感动作、待机/坐姿/睡姿支持、预设文件夹、图标选择器、拖放整理，以及多人情感动作时对齐目标。适合使用多个动画模组的玩家。

Punchline.Original: Social interaction enhancements for FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: 增强 FFXIV 社交互动体验。

Description.Original: A plugin designed to enhance the social ecosystem in FFXIV.
Description.Translated: 旨在改善 FFXIV 社交生态的插件。

Punchline.Original: Toggle /afk or any status when the game loses focus.
Punchline.Translated: 游戏失去焦点时切换为 /afk 或其他状态。

Description.Original: Sets your status to /afk or any status of choice when the game isn't the foreground window, and reverts it when the game regains focus. Commands: /autostatus, /aus.
Description.Translated: 游戏不在前台时，将状态设为 /afk 或你指定的状态；游戏重新获得焦点时恢复原状态。命令：/autostatus、/aus。

Description.Translated: 无

Description.Translated: 实地巡查住宅区，寻找中型/大型房屋

Punchline.Original: Adblock for FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 广告拦截器。

Description.Original:
Customisable chat and Party Finder filtering. In addition to letting
you filter anything from chat and PF, it comes with built-in filters
for the following:

- RMT (both gil and content)
- FC ads
- RP ads
- Phishing messages
- Static recruitment
- Trade ads
- Community ads
- Any PF with an item level over the max
Description.Translated:
可自定义的聊天与队伍招募筛选工具。除了自行设置筛选内容，
还内置以下类别的过滤规则：

- 现实货币交易（金币和代打内容）
- 部队广告
- 角色扮演广告
- 钓鱼诈骗消息
- 固定队招募
- 交易广告
- 社区广告
- 装等要求超过游戏上限的队伍招募

Punchline.Original: Ever wanted to get notified when someone targets you or emotes at you? Now you can!
Punchline.Translated: 想在别人选中你或对你做情感动作时收到提醒？现在可以了！

Description.Original:
This plugin notifies you when someone targets you, or emotes at you.

Commands:
  /ohheyfork - Opens the main window
  /ohheyfork main - Opens the main window
  /ohheyfork [config|settings] - Opens the settings window
  /ohheyfork help - Displays the help message (will also display on invalid sub-commands)
Description.Translated:
有人选中你或对你做情感动作时，插件会通知你。

命令：
  /ohheyfork - 打开主窗口
  /ohheyfork main - 打开主窗口
  /ohheyfork [config|settings] - 打开设置窗口
  /ohheyfork help - 显示帮助消息（输入无效子命令时也会显示）

Punchline.Original: Reporting RMT PFs
Punchline.Translated: 举报现实货币交易的队伍招募

Description.Original: Report RMT PF's to gms for funsies
Description.Translated: 向 GM 举报现实货币交易的队伍招募，图个乐子

Punchline.Original: Upload combat logs to FFLogs directly from the game
Punchline.Translated: 直接从游戏中将战斗日志上传至 FFLogs

Description.Original: A plugin that allows you to upload ACT combat logs to FFLogs without leaving the game. Supports both live logging and manual log uploads.
Description.Translated: 无需离开游戏即可将 ACT 战斗日志上传至 FFLogs。支持实时记录上传和手动上传日志。

Punchline.Original: Native cast text with a configurable translated second line.
Punchline.Translated: 保留原生咏唱文字，并在第二行显示可配置的译文。

Description.Original: Displays the game's native cast name with a configurable translated second line on target and focus target cast bars. Choose English, Japanese, German, French, or Traditional Chinese for the plugin-rendered line.
Description.Translated: 在目标和焦点目标的咏唱条上保留游戏原生技能名，并以第二行显示可配置的译文。插件绘制的译文可选择英语、日语、德语、法语或繁体中文。

Punchline.Original: Good evening. I'm your BlackJack Buttler - quietly tracking the table and offering the right hint at the right time.
Punchline.Translated: 晚上好，我是你的 BlackJack Buttler，默默关注牌桌，在恰当时机给出合适提示。

Description.Original: /bjb - opens the blackjack buttler tool
Description.Translated: /bjb - 打开 BlackJack Buttler 工具

Punchline.Original: Track your daily and weekly FFXIV activities in one convenient overlay.
Punchline.Translated: 在一个便捷浮层中追踪每日和每周的 FFXIV 活动。

Description.Original:
A quality-of-life overlay that helps you track daily and weekly reset activities in Final Fantasy XIV. Features include:

- Categorized checklist for daily and weekly tasks
- Auto-detection for supported activities (roulettes, cactpot, beast tribes, etc.)
- Manual tracking for activities that cannot be auto-detected
- Automatic reset at daily/weekly reset times
- Persistent state across sessions
- Customizable task list and UI settings

Commands:
/dailies - Toggle the main checklist window
Description.Translated:
追踪 Final Fantasy XIV 每日和每周重置活动的便利性浮层。功能包括：

- 分类显示每日和每周任务清单
- 自动检测支持的活动（随机任务、仙人仙彩、友好部族等）
- 手动记录无法自动检测的活动
- 在每日/每周重置时自动清空进度
- 跨游戏会话保存状态
- 可自定义任务列表和界面设置

命令：
/dailies - 显示或隐藏主清单窗口

Description.Original: For the quest completionist, now updated
Description.Translated: 献给任务全清玩家，现已更新

Punchline.Original: Sends key chord on death.
Punchline.Translated: 死亡时发送组合键。

Description.Original: Sends key chord on death. Defaults to holding F24, but can be configured. Recommend to use with Push to Mute in Discord for silly reasons.
Description.Translated: 死亡时发送组合键。默认为按住 F24，也可自行配置。出于一些搞怪用途，建议搭配 Discord 的按键静音功能。

Punchline.Original: Next-gen animation lock compensation with adaptive RTT estimation.
Punchline.Translated: 采用自适应往返延迟估算的新一代动画锁补偿。

Description.Original: Reduces the effects of lag on animation locks, weaving, and cast actions. Features Jacobson/Karels RTT estimation, dynamic latency floor, cast lock prediction, context-aware lock database, and real-time diagnostics. An improved successor to NoClippy.
Description.Translated: 减轻网络延迟对动画锁、技能插入和咏唱技能的影响。支持 Jacobson/Karels 往返延迟估算、动态延迟下限、咏唱锁预测、结合情境的锁定时长数据库和实时诊断，是 NoClippy 的改进后继版本。

Punchline.Original: Companion plugin for enhanced functionality.
Punchline.Translated: 提供扩展功能的配套插件。

Description.Original: MeowMusic companion for enhanced functionality.
Description.Translated: 为 MeowMusic 提供扩展功能的配套插件。

Punchline.Translated: 开发用插件

Description.Original: This plugin is useless for most people.
Description.Translated: 对大多数人而言，这个插件没什么用。

Punchline.Original: EZ Shouts
Punchline.Translated: 轻松喊话

Description.Original: Automatically shout/yell a custom macro across all worlds and major cities using Lifestream and ECommons. Supports all regions (NA/EU/JP/OCE), auto-resume, zone detection, and comprehensive error handling.
Description.Translated: 借助 Lifestream 和 ECommons，自动在所有服务器和主要城市中喊话/呼喊自定义宏。支持全部地区（NA/EU/JP/OCE）、自动恢复、区域检测和全面的错误处理。

Punchline.Original: Animation mods now made easy!
Punchline.Translated: 动画模组管理变简单了！

Description.Original: Assign animations to a button and view them in a catalogue.
Description.Translated: 将动画绑定到按钮，并在目录中浏览。

Punchline.Original: Raid team gear distribution and BiS planning tool.
Punchline.Translated: 固定队装备分配与毕业配装规划工具。

Description.Original: Helps FFXIV raid teams plan gear distribution, track BiS gear, and manage alt gear.
Description.Translated: 帮助 FFXIV 固定队规划装备分配、追踪毕业配装，并管理副职装备。

Punchline.Original: Clean DPS display integrated in your server info bar
Punchline.Translated: 在服务器信息栏中简洁显示 DPS

Description.Original: Shows your real-time DPS, party DPS or FFLogs-style rDPS in the server info bar, with your rank, role comparison, boss HP and projected kill time. Includes a live breakdown window, graphs, pull history with comparisons, party DPS checks and an optional FFLogs percentile estimate. Works with ACT (OverlayPlugin WebSocket) or on its own with the built-in tracker.
Description.Translated: 在服务器信息栏显示实时个人 DPS、团队 DPS 或 FFLogs 风格的 rDPS，同时展示排名、同职能对比、首领生命值和预计击杀时间。提供实时明细窗口、图表、可对比的战斗历史、团队 DPS 检查，以及可选的 FFLogs 百分位估算。可连接 ACT（OverlayPlugin WebSocket），也可独立使用内置追踪器。

Punchline.Original: Displays your previously used battery gauge value.
Punchline.Translated: 显示上次使用蓄电时的量谱数值。

Description.Original: Tracks your Machinist battery usage. When using your battery, the value is saved onto an on-screen tracker. The previous two values are stored and displayed by this plugin
Description.Translated: 追踪机工士的蓄电消耗。使用蓄电时，将其数值记录到屏幕上的追踪器中。插件会保留并显示最近两次的数值。

Punchline.Original: Send party finder listings to Discord.
Punchline.Translated: 将队伍招募信息发送到 Discord。

Description.Original: A plugin that currently sends party finder listings to a Discord channel.
Description.Translated: 目前可将队伍招募信息发送到 Discord 频道的插件。

Punchline.Original: Turbo actions for your Gamepad
Punchline.Translated: 为手柄提供连发操作

Description.Original:
A plugin that allows you use Turbo Mode* for your gamepad and keyboard.
*You hold a button and keep firing it.
Description.Translated:
让手柄和键盘使用连发模式*的插件。
*按住按钮即可持续触发。

Punchline.Original: Browse FF14 icons by patch and category
Punchline.Translated: 按版本和类别浏览 FF14 图标

Description.Translated: 浏览全部 FF14 界面图标的插件，按版本号和类别整理。

Punchline.Translated: 将爆发药特效替换为嗷嗷有劲的 AoAoEnergy RGB 效果

将爆发药特效替换为嗷嗷有劲的 RGB 效果。
Replace tincture VFX with AoAoEnergy RGB effect.
Description.Translated: 将爆发药特效替换为嗷嗷有劲的 AoAoEnergy RGB 效果。

Punchline.Translated: 自动交纳收藏品并购买指定票据物品的插件

Description.Original: Automates collectable turn-ins and automatically purchases specified items when reaching scrip caps. Integrates with GatherBuddyReborn and Artisan, allowing you to create perfect loops of gathering, crafting, and turn-ins.
Description.Translated: 自动交纳收藏品，并在票据接近上限时自动购买指定物品。与 GatherBuddyReborn 和 Artisan 联动，形成采集、制作、交纳的完整循环。

Punchline.Original: Get notified about upcoming Gold Saucer GATEs.
Punchline.Translated: 接收金碟游乐场即将开始的机遇临门通知。

Description.Original: Alerts you before Gold Saucer GATE events with configurable per-GATE preferences, countdown overlay, DTR bar timer, and chat/toast notifications. Detects active GATEs via chat and GATE Keeper NPC dialogue for early reveals. Use /gate to toggle overlay, /gate config for settings.
Description.Translated: 在金碟游乐场机遇临门开始前提醒你，可分别设置各活动偏好，并提供倒计时浮层、服务器信息栏计时及聊天/弹出通知。通过聊天和活动引导员 NPC 对话检测当前活动，提前获知内容。输入 /gate 显示或隐藏浮层，输入 /gate config 打开设置。

Description.Original: Warns you when your inventory is full upon entering combat.
Description.Translated: 进入战斗时，若背包已满则发出警告。

Punchline.Translated: 通过 Discord 远程控制队伍招募

Description.Original: PFRemote allows you to browse, join, and create Party Finder listings remotely through a Discord bot. Perfect for managing parties from your phone or another device.
Description.Translated: PFRemote 让你通过 Discord 机器人远程浏览、加入和创建队伍招募，适合用手机或其他设备管理队伍。

Punchline.Original: Open Tomestone.gg profiles from the game
Punchline.Translated: 从游戏中打开 Tomestone.gg 角色档案

Description.Translated: 添加右键菜单选项和 /tome 命令，用于打开 Tomestone.gg 角色档案。

Punchline.Original: Fork of Visibility plugin. Allows you to hide players, pets, chocobos and minions. (FP-Edition)
Punchline.Translated: Visibility 插件的分支，可隐藏玩家、召唤物、陆行鸟和宠物。（FP 版）

Fork of Visibility plugin. Allows you to hide players, pets, chocobos and minions.
Includes VoidList, which is a better blacklist.
Accessible via /pvis
More information available via /xlhelp.
Description.Translated:
Visibility 插件的分支，可隐藏玩家、召唤物、陆行鸟和宠物。
包含更强大的黑名单 VoidList。
输入 /pvis 使用。
更多信息可通过 /xlhelp 查看。

Punchline.Translated: 一键为所有雇员的在售物品压价

HQ-aware pricing, a configurable undercut amount and re-pricing cooldown, and it skips your own listings so you never undercut yourself.
Description.Translated: 自动降低雇员在售物品的价格，可逐个雇员处理，也可通过“全部降价（Drop Prices for All）”一次处理所有符合条件的雇员。支持区分高品质物品、设置压价幅度和改价冷却，并跳过自己的在售物品，避免自己压自己的价。

Punchline.Original: Link your pishock to FFXIV
Punchline.Translated: 将你的 Pishock 与 FFXIV 联动

Description.Translated: 非常早期的版本，功能已就位，玩得开心

Punchline.Translated: HypnoToad 的图形界面。

An Ui for the HypnoToad. You need to install the HypnoToad too.

Plugin from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GiR-Zippo/PluginMaster/main/pluginmaster.json
Description.Translated:
HypnoToad 的图形界面，必须同时安装 HypnoToad。

Punchline.Translated: 为游戏添加更强大的宏系统。

为游戏添加更强大的宏系统。Macrology 支持无限长度的宏、循环、注释、暂停、同时运行多个宏，以及小数秒等待时间。

插件来源：https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GiR-Zippo/PluginMaster/main/pluginmaster.json

Description.Original:
-Fast Fire III marker on the bar.
-Autostarts the bar before combat starts.
-Countdown with time offset.
-Compatible with FFXIV Material UI.
Description.Translated:
- 在进度条上标记快速咏唱爆炎的时机。
- 战斗开始前自动启动进度条。
- 支持时间偏移的倒计时。

Description.Translated: 显示一些信息

Punchline.Translated: 按副本切换特效

Description.Original: Allows changing vfx settings on a per instance basis.
Description.Translated: 为每个副本单独调整特效设置。

Punchline.Original: The Only BDSM Plugin You'll Ever Need!
Punchline.Translated: 你唯一需要的 BDSM 插件！

Description.Translated: GagSpeak 2.0 正式发布。20+ 个模块、100+ 项功能、50+ 项配置。没有付费墙！

Punchline.Translated: 在人多的环境中筛选消息，让角色扮演聊天重新清晰有序。

Chat Tools was developed to cut through the cluttered chat that can happen at large RP events, or in crowded environments.

Just some of the things you can do with Chat Tools is:
- Filter messages in crowded environments
- Set up windows to watch specific characters of your choice
- Set up windows to watch for messages from a group of characters

- Search through your message history
- Preserve messages on logout

Chat Tools 用于整理大型角色扮演活动或拥挤场景中的杂乱聊天。

它能做到的事情包括：
- 在拥挤环境中筛选消息

- 设置窗口，查看一组角色的消息

- 搜索消息历史
- 登出后保留消息

Punchline.Original: Better Gearset Sorting

Description.Original: HealBot provides Off, Stand-alone, Helper and Newb roles. Stand-alone runs local automation; Helper pairs with an authenticated Newb for remote healing and chase, while Newb performs no local healing or attacking. Pairing traffic is authenticated but not encrypted, so names and coordinates remain visible on the network. Stand-alone provides guided setup for HealBot, Jacqueline of All Trades (JOAT), and PowerlevelBot. HealBot runs configurable WHM, SCH, AST, or SGE healing, raises, buffs, and pre-buffs for up to 20 watched friendly targets. Jacqueline of All Trades (JOAT) gives that healing absolute priority, then uses the equipped healer's highest available single-target filler spell only when the healing decision is idle and an eligible damaged enemy is already targeting FrenRider's configured visible Fren or the local healer. PowerlevelBot retains its BRD/MCH instant-action policy. Includes dependency/readiness checks, optional saved targets, and optional Rotation Solver Reborn isolation for HealBot and JOAT. Use /healbot to open.

Description.Original:
# I Am Ready

**I Am Ready** is a Dalamud plugin for Final Fantasy XIV that automatically accepts or declines Party and Alliance Ready Checks based on a customizable counter. 

Whether you are stepping away for a moment or just tired of clicking, this plugin handles ready checks for you while mimicking human reaction times.

## ✨ Features

* **Auto-Answer Ready Checks:** Automatically clicks "Yes" or "No" when a ready check appears.
* **Configurable "Yes" Counter:** Set a specific number of times you want to automatically answer "Yes". Once that limit is reached, the plugin will automatically start answering "No" to prevent pulling when you are actually away.
* **Natural Delay:** Enable a randomized delay (0.7 to 2.5 seconds) before the plugin answers, making it look like a natural human reaction.
* **Smart Chat Triggers (Regex):** Add custom text phrases to the plugin. If someone says one of these phrases in Party or Alliance chat (e.g., "reset", "pulling"), your counter will automatically reset back to zero.
* **Bilingual Support:** The user interface is available in both English and German.

## 🚀 Usage

1. Type `/iar` in the in-game chat to open the configuration window.
2. Click the **Inactive/Active** button at the top to turn the auto-responder on or off.
3. Adjust the **Yes Count** slider. For example, if set to `5`, the plugin will answer "Yes" to the next 5 ready checks, and "No" to any checks after that.
4. Click the **Start** button at any time to manually reset your current counter back to zero.

### Chat Triggers (Regex Patterns)
At the bottom of the window, you can expand the **Regex Patterns** section. Here you can add simple words or complex regex patterns. 
If the plugin reads a matching message in your Party or Cross-World Party chat, it will instantly reset your counter to zero, assuming a new pull or instance is starting!

/iar - opens the I Am Ready tool
Description.Translated:
# I Am Ready

**I Am Ready** 是一款 Final Fantasy XIV 的 Dalamud 插件，可根据自定义计数器，自动对小队和团队的准备确认回答是或否。

无论你只是暂时离开，还是厌倦了不断点击，本插件都能模拟人的反应时间，替你处理准备确认。

## ✨ 功能

* **自动回复准备确认：** 出现准备确认时，自动点击“是”或“否”。
* **可配置的“是”计数器：** 设置自动回答“是”的次数。达到上限后，插件会自动改为回答“否”，避免你不在时队伍开怪。
* **自然延迟：** 可在回答前随机延迟 0.7 至 2.5 秒，使其看起来像自然的人类反应。
* **智能聊天触发（正则表达式）：** 添加自定义短语。当有人在小队或团队频道发送这些短语（如 `reset`、`pulling`）时，计数器自动归零。
* **双语支持：** 界面提供英语与德语。

## 🚀 使用方法

1. 在游戏聊天中输入 `/iar` 打开设置窗口。
2. 点击顶部的 **Inactive/Active（停用/启用）** 按钮，开关自动回复。
3. 调整 **Yes Count（回答“是”的次数）** 滑块。例如设为 `5`，插件会对接下来的 5 次准备确认回答“是”，之后回答“否”。
4. 随时点击 **Start（开始）**，可手动将当前计数器归零。

### 聊天触发（正则表达式模式）
展开窗口底部的 **Regex Patterns（正则表达式模式）** 区域，即可添加简单词语或复杂的正则表达式。
插件在小队或跨服小队聊天中读到匹配消息时，会认为即将开始新一轮战斗或副本，并立即将计数器归零！

/iar - 打开 I Am Ready 工具

Punchline.Translated: 角色扮演活动的小帮手。

Description.Original: A tiny helper in your RP endeavours. You can read a "short" introduction with /rpbuddy.
Description.Translated: 角色扮演活动的小帮手。使用 /rpbuddy 可以阅读一份“简短”介绍。

Punchline.Original: Real-time Thai translation for FFXIV
Punchline.Translated: 为 FFXIV 提供实时泰语翻译。

Description.Original: แปลภาษา FFXIV เป็นไทยแบบ real-time ผ่าน Gemini AI - Real-time FFXIV translation with advanced character database and Netflix-quality localization. Features elegant UI with auto-show/hide, full customization (size, colors), and seamless gameplay integration.
Description.Translated: 通过 Gemini AI 将 FFXIV 实时翻译成泰语，具备先进的角色数据库与 Netflix 级别的本地化质量。提供优雅的界面、自动显示/隐藏、全面的大小与颜色自定义，以及无缝的游戏体验集成。

Description.Original: Sync Animations
Description.Translated: 同步动画。

Punchline.Original: In-game loot priority overlay and auto-logging for FFXIV Raid Planner.
Punchline.Translated: 为 FFXIV Raid Planner 提供游戏内战利品优先级浮层和自动记录。

Description.Original:
Displays loot priority rankings during savage raids and auto-logs loot drops to your FFXIV Raid Planner static. Requires an API key from the web app.

Commands:
/xrp - Toggle BiS gear viewer
/xrp priority - Toggle priority overlay
/xrp sync - Sync equipped gear to web app
/xrp config - Open configuration
Description.Translated:
在零式团队副本中显示战利品分配优先级，并将掉落自动记录到 FFXIV Raid Planner 的固定队中。需要从网页应用获取 API 密钥。

命令：
/xrp - 开关毕业配装（BiS）查看器
/xrp priority - 开关优先级浮层
/xrp sync - 将已装备物品同步至网页应用
/xrp config - 打开设置

Punchline.Original: For all your silly lizard needs!
Punchline.Translated: 满足你对傻乎乎蜥蜴的一切需求！

Description.Original: This is a test plugin for learning about custom repositories.
Description.Translated: 用于学习自定义仓库的测试插件。

Punchline.Original: Quickly switch between FFXIV characters.
Punchline.Translated: 快速切换 FFXIV 角色。

Description.Original: Detects your characters on login and lets you quickly switch between them with a single click. Supports both quick logout to character select and fully automated character switching. Features safety guards (cooldowns, confirmations, blocks during combat/duties/cutscenes/crafting/gathering), Discord bot integration for remote switching, and admin controls (whitelist/blacklist, force switch/logout, audit logging).
Description.Translated: 登录时检测你的角色，让你一键快速切换。支持快速退出至角色选择界面，以及全自动角色切换。提供安全保护（冷却、确认，以及战斗/副本/过场动画/制作/采集时阻止操作）、用于远程切换的 Discord 机器人集成，以及管理功能（白名单/黑名单、强制切换/退出和审计日志）。

Punchline.Original: Electric Boogaloo - ♪ A whole new chat, a new fantastic chat window ♪
Punchline.Translated: Electric Boogaloo——♪ 全新的聊天，全新的精彩聊天窗口 ♪

Description.Original:
Chat 2 is a complete rewrite of the in-game chat window as a plugin.
It supports:

- Unlimited tabs
- Tabs that always send to a certain channel
- More flexible filtering
- RGB channel colouring
- Completely variable font size
- Sidebar tabs
- Unread counts
- Emotes
- Screenshot mode (obfuscate names)
Description.Translated:
Chat 2 以插件形式彻底重写了游戏内聊天窗口。
支持：

- 不限数量的标签页
- 始终向指定频道发送的标签页
- 更灵活的筛选
- RGB 频道配色
- 完全自由的字号
- 侧边栏标签页
- 未读计数
- 表情动作
- 截图模式（混淆名字）

Punchline.Original: 藏宝图追踪与统计助手。

Description.Original: Map Party Features.
Description.Translated: 藏宝图队伍辅助功能。

Punchline.Original: Soft-wraps the chat input box.
Punchline.Translated: 让聊天输入框自动折行。

Description.Original: Soft-wraps the chat input box, growing it to fit.
Description.Translated: 让聊天输入框自动折行，并随内容增加高度。

Punchline.Original: Foot IK for FFXIV — feet stay on the ground.
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 足部逆向运动学（IK）——让双脚贴合地面。

Description.Original: Real-time foot IK for FFXIV characters. Keeps feet planted naturally on terrain (stairs, slopes, uneven ground) during normal gameplay.
Description.Translated: 为 FFXIV 角色提供实时足部逆向运动学（IK），让正常游玩时的双脚自然贴合楼梯、斜坡和不平整地面。

Punchline.Original: Use your tomestone to message, call, and manage friends in game.
Punchline.Translated: 用你的神典石在游戏内发消息、打电话和管理好友。

Description.Original: TomestonePhone adds a styled in-game phone UI with contacts, SMS, calls, group chat, and friend tools.
Description.Translated: TomestonePhone 添加了精心设计的游戏内手机界面，包含联系人、短信、通话、群聊及好友工具。

Punchline.Original: Clean automation for Occult Crescent farming.
Punchline.Translated: 简洁的新月岛刷取自动化工具。

Description.Original:
OC-Helper provides modular automation for Occult Crescent farming with a focus on code clarity and working configuration.

Features:
- Treasure hunting and tracking
- Combat automation with safety checks
- Performance metrics (gil/exp per hour)
- Configurable automation behaviors
- Over 500 lines of documentation

Unlike other farming plugins, OC-Helper prioritizes readable, maintainable code that you can understand and modify.
Description.Translated:
OC-Helper 为新月岛刷取提供模块化自动化，注重代码清晰和配置实用。

功能：
- 寻宝与追踪
- 带安全检查的战斗自动化
- 效率指标（每小时金币/经验）
- 可配置的自动化行为
- 超过 500 行文档

与其他刷取插件不同，OC-Helper 优先保证代码易读、易维护，让你能够理解并修改。

Description.Original: Custom item tagging and inventory management.
Description.Translated: 自定义物品标签与背包管理。

Punchline.Original: A parsing plugin.
Punchline.Translated: 战斗数据解析插件。

Description.Original: 方便查看buffid和bossid和技能id

Punchline.Original: A collection of QoL tweaks
Punchline.Translated: 一组便利性调整。

Description.Original: Some kind of mistake, I'm sure
Description.Translated: 我敢肯定，这准是哪里出了差错。

Description.Original: Furniture selection based on what you see, keybinds, and more.
Description.Translated: 按实际看到的位置选择家具，支持快捷键等功能。

Description.Original: Drag and and drop textured directly onto what you see!
Description.Translated: 直接将纹理拖放到眼前的对象上！

Description.Original: Player synced custom voices, Twitch playback integration, and more!
Description.Translated: 玩家间同步自定义语音、Twitch 播放集成等功能！

Punchline.Original: Native ImGui damage meter overlay powered by IINACT
Punchline.Translated: 由 IINACT 驱动的原生 ImGui 伤害统计浮层。

Description.Original: DM @mtvirux on discord for assistance or bug reports.
Description.Translated: 如需帮助或反馈问题，请在 Discord 私信 @mtvirux。

Punchline.Original: Basic plugin to detect if chocobo is summoned while trying to stable it.
Punchline.Translated: 在尝试将陆行鸟寄养到鸟房时，检测它是否正被召唤的简单插件。

Description.Original: This plugin will populate a window as soon as you open a stable if your chocobo is currently summoned. It asks if you want to unsummon it. Upon clicking yes, it closes the chocobo stable and withdraws your chocobo.
Description.Translated: 如果你的陆行鸟正在被召唤，打开鸟房时插件就会弹出窗口，询问是否撤销召唤。点击是后，它会关闭鸟房界面并撤回陆行鸟。

Punchline.Original: A plugin that will populate a window whenever maintenance is scheduled, advising you that there is maintenance
Punchline.Translated: 安排了维护时弹出窗口，提醒你即将进行维护。

Description.Original: This plugin will detect whenever FFXIV has maintenance scheduled, and it will cause a large window with large text advising the user of the maintenance and the day and time.
Description.Translated: 检测 FFXIV 的维护安排，并以大窗口和大字提醒玩家维护日期与时间。

Punchline.Original: SkiaSharp-powered UI rendering framework. Give your plugins what Sansflaire lacks.
Punchline.Translated: 由 SkiaSharp 驱动的 UI 渲染框架，为你的插件补上 Sansflaire 所缺的功能。

Description.Original: PanacheUI is a vector graphics UI framework for Dalamud plugins, backed by SkiaSharp (the same engine as Chrome and Flutter). Provides a node tree, CSS-like styling, layout engine, and smooth rendering — far beyond what vanilla ImGui can offer.
Description.Translated: PanacheUI 是面向 Dalamud 插件的矢量图形 UI 框架，由 SkiaSharp 驱动（与 Chrome 和 Flutter 使用相同的底层图形引擎）。提供节点树、类似 CSS 的样式、布局引擎和流畅渲染，能力远超原生 ImGui。

Punchline.Original: Real-time combat damage/healing meter for FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 实时战斗伤害/治疗统计。

Description.Original: Tracks damage dealt, healing done, DPS, HPS, overhealing, damage taken, and more in real time for you and your party. Stores up to 20 recent combat sessions with manual save slots. Fully configurable display, bar colors, and window styles.
Description.Translated: 实时统计你与队友的造成伤害、治疗量、DPS、HPS、过量治疗、承受伤害等数据。保存最近最多 20 场战斗，并提供手动保存槽位。显示内容、条形颜色和窗口样式均可自由配置。

Punchline.Original: Where mods
Punchline.Translated: 模组在哪里？

Description.Original: Peer-to-Peer Mod sharing
Description.Translated: 点对点模组共享。

Punchline.Original: Improved screenshots in and around GPose
Punchline.Translated: 改善集体动作（GPose）模式内外的截图体验。

Description.Original: Alpha - please be careful!
Description.Translated: Alpha 测试版，请谨慎使用！

Punchline.Original: Mini-games for Dalamud in one window.
Punchline.Translated: 在一个窗口中畅玩 Dalamud 小游戏。

Description.Original: Play Minesweeper, Hangman, and Sudoku from a single Arcade hub.
Description.Translated: 在统一的 Arcade 中玩扫雷、猜词游戏和数独。

Punchline.Original: Healing without targeting.
Punchline.Translated: 无需选定目标即可治疗。

Description.Original: Remove the need to target people for healing, instead assign actions to mouse buttons and use them by clicking player names.
Description.Translated: 治疗时无需先选中玩家：将动作分配给鼠标按键，点击玩家名字即可施放。

Punchline.Original: Bridges FFXIV chat with Discord via webhooks and slash commands.
Punchline.Translated: 通过 Webhook 和斜杠命令连接 FFXIV 聊天与 Discord。

Description.Original:
Forwards FFXIV chat channels to Discord via webhooks and allows sending messages back from Discord using slash commands.

Bugs & suggestions: https://github.com/havyrl/FFXIVDiscordChatBridge/issues
Description.Translated:
通过 Webhook 将 FFXIV 聊天频道转发到 Discord，并允许在 Discord 中使用斜杠命令向游戏发送消息。

问题与建议：https://github.com/havyrl/FFXIVDiscordChatBridge/issues

Punchline.Original: Quiet Penumbra mod-complete notifications.
Punchline.Translated: 让 Penumbra 的模组处理完成通知安静下来。

Description.Original: Suppress Penumbra mod-complete toasts and selected error notifications. The command to open the settings menu is /penumbraquiet.
Description.Translated: 屏蔽 Penumbra 的模组处理完成浮动通知及选定的错误通知。使用 /penumbraquiet 打开设置菜单。

Punchline.Original: A MakePlace shopping-list companion for market board runs.
Punchline.Translated: 配合市场布告板采购使用的 MakePlace 购物清单助手。

Description.Original: A MakePlace shopping-list companion for market board runs, inventory tracking, and Patch 7.5 consolidated dye handling.
Description.Translated: MakePlace 购物清单助手，支持市场布告板采购、背包追踪及 7.5 版本合并后的染料处理。

Punchline.Original: Refreshes your Party Finder listing on a timer.
Punchline.Translated: 按定时器刷新你的队员招募。

Description.Original: Automates refreshing a Party Finder listing.
Description.Translated: 自动刷新队员招募信息。

Punchline.Original: Liste de choses à tracker.
Punchline.Translated: 需要追踪的事项清单。

Description.Original: Liste de choses à tracker.
Description.Translated: 需要追踪的事项清单。

Punchline.Original: Stream internet radio stations while playing FFXIV
Punchline.Translated: 游玩 FFXIV 时收听网络电台。

Description.Original:
Listen to your favorite internet radio stations directly in-game. Browse stations and manage your favorites.
Use /cradio to open the radio player
Description.Translated:
直接在游戏内收听你喜爱的网络电台，浏览电台并管理收藏。
使用 /cradio 打开电台播放器。

Punchline.Original: Easily keep track of your Start/Final bank and results.
Punchline.Translated: 轻松记录起始资金、结束资金和盈亏结果。

Description.Original: Simple and fast way to know your night gamba results.
Description.Translated: 简单快速地了解当晚的赌局盈亏。

Description.Original: Outil de jets de dés pour le Système Très Simple.
Description.Translated: 适用于 Système Très Simple（极简系统）的掷骰工具。

Punchline.Original: Create your own custom slash commands.
Punchline.Translated: 创建自己的斜杠命令。

Description.Original: Lets players create custom slash command aliases from an in-game UI.
Description.Translated: 让玩家通过游戏内界面创建自定义斜杠命令别名。

Punchline.Original: Support for Ukrainian characters in chat input field.
Punchline.Translated: 让聊天输入框支持乌克兰语字符。

Description.Original: Support for Ukrainian characters in chat input field. When using the Ukrainian keyboard layout, this plugin remaps keys so that Ukrainian letters are correctly entered in the chat input. This plugin is supported on Windows only.
Description.Translated: 让聊天输入框支持乌克兰语字符。使用乌克兰语键盘布局时，插件会重映射按键，确保正确输入乌克兰语字母。仅支持 Windows。

Description.Original: Hooks into Penumbra via IPC and renders a scrollable image carousel above the tab bar whenever a mod with an "images" subfolder is selected.
Description.Translated: 通过 IPC 连接 Penumbra；选中带有 `images` 子文件夹的模组时，在标签栏上方显示可滚动的图片轮播。

Punchline.Original: Play casino games in XIV!
Punchline.Translated: 在 XIV 中玩赌场游戏！

Description.Original: A fully-featured casino dealer plugin for FFXIV including Blackjack, Roulette, Baccrat, Craps, Texas Hold'em, and Ultima (an Uno clone) Commands: /casino to open the GUI.
Description.Translated: 功能齐全的 FFXIV 赌场荷官插件，包含二十一点、轮盘、百家乐、双骰游戏 Craps、德州扑克，以及 Ultima（类似 Uno 的游戏）。命令：/casino 打开图形界面。

Punchline.Original: Checks boss health against time thresholds.
Punchline.Translated: 按时间阈值检查首领血量。

Description.Original: Helps track health targets based on time goals. Useful for when you need to check if you're ahead of a known enrage time or a set kill time.
Description.Translated: 根据目标时间追踪血量要求，便于判断进度是否领先于已知的狂暴时间或设定的击杀时间。

Punchline.Original: Tracks your Triple Triad Cards.
Punchline.Translated: 追踪你的九宫幻卡卡牌。

Description.Original: Tracks your Triple Triad collection with filters to show what you have uncollected and where you can find each card.
Description.Translated: 追踪九宫幻卡收集情况，通过筛选显示尚未收集的卡牌及每张卡牌的获取地点。

Punchline.Original: A toggleable helper to track real/fake debuffs for the monkes.
Punchline.Translated: 可开关的真假减益追踪助手，猴子们的好帮手。

Description.Original: A toggleable helper to track real/fake debuffs for the monkes.
Description.Translated: 可开关的真假减益追踪助手，猴子们的好帮手。

Punchline.Original: Player resizer with automatic nameplate adjustment.
Punchline.Translated: 调整玩家模型大小，并自动调整姓名板位置。

Description.Original: Lets you resize your character and automatically adjust the nameplate position. Contact: support@arzolath.com
Description.Translated: 调整角色大小，并自动调整姓名板位置。联系方式：support@arzolath.com

Punchline.Original: Render a live video screen anywhere in the game world.
Punchline.Translated: 在游戏世界的任意位置显示实时视频屏幕。

Description.Original:
Places a virtual screen in 3D world space that displays images and video with proper depth testing. Supports local files, direct URLs, YouTube (via yt-dlp), and multi-player sync so all players with the plugin see the same content simultaneously.

Note: yt-dlp.exe must be placed in the plugin folder for YouTube support (host only — sync clients receive a direct stream URL automatically).
Description.Translated:
在三维世界中放置虚拟屏幕，通过正确的深度测试显示图片和视频。支持本地文件、直链、YouTube（通过 yt-dlp），以及多人同步，让所有安装插件的玩家同时看到相同内容。

注意：要支持 YouTube，须将 yt-dlp.exe 放入插件文件夹（仅主持方需要；同步客户端会自动接收视频流直链）。

Punchline.Original: Custom status effects for players and companions alike!
Punchline.Translated: 为玩家与同伴提供自定义状态效果！

Description.Original: An inclusive and extensive custom status effect manager. Apply them to targets, group custom statuses with presets, or apply them under conditional events.
Description.Translated: 功能全面的自定义状态效果管理器。可将状态应用于目标、用预设组合自定义状态，或在满足事件条件时施加状态。

Punchline.Original: Marketboard analytics for FFXIV
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 市场布告板分析。

Description.Original: Advanced marketboard tools and cross-world arbitrage scanning.
Description.Translated: 高级市场布告板工具与跨服套利扫描。

Punchline.Original: Venue analytics and smart greetings in one window.
Punchline.Translated: 一个窗口整合场所经营分析与智能问候。

Description.Original: Tracks venue guests, greeting history, and nightly statistics with export support.
Description.Translated: 追踪场所访客、问候历史与每晚统计，并支持导出。

Punchline.Original: Auto-Guard against Marksman's Spite in PvP.
Punchline.Translated: 在 PvP 中自动使用防御应对魔弹射手。

Description.Original: Detects when an enemy Machinist uses Marksman's Spite on you and automatically uses Guard. Includes an Execute tab to coordinate your own Marksman's Spite with a teammate, with optional auto-Bravery sequencing.
Description.Translated: 检测敌方机工士是否对你使用魔弹射手，并自动施放防御。包含“执行”标签页，用于与队友协调你自己的魔弹射手，还可选择自动按顺序施放勇气。

Description.Original: You know :p
Description.Translated: 你懂的 :p

Punchline.Original: Telegram notifications for FFXIV events
Punchline.Translated: 通过 Telegram 接收 FFXIV 事件通知。

Description.Original: Send Telegram notifications for various in-game events like level ups, currency thresholds, duty completion, and more.
Description.Translated: 为升级、货币达到阈值、完成副本等各种游戏内事件发送 Telegram 通知。

Punchline.Original: 雨露霜雪

Description.Original: An advanced combat rotation platform for FFXIV high-end content.
Description.Translated: 面向 FFXIV 高难内容的高级战斗循环平台。

Punchline.Original: Keep your RP scenes organized, visible, and easy to follow.
Punchline.Translated: 让你的角色扮演场景井然有序、清晰可见、便于跟进。

Description.Original: A lightweight SFW roleplay scene assistant for tracking RP partners, organizing scene chat, keeping notes, drafting posts, and making active scenes easier to follow.
Description.Translated: 轻量的非成人向角色扮演场景助手，用于追踪 RP 伙伴、整理场景聊天、记录笔记、起草回复，让正在进行的场景更容易跟进。

Punchline.Original: Even more XIVCombo
Punchline.Translated: 更多 XIVCombo 功能。

Description.Original: Custom XIVCombo
Description.Translated: 定制版 XIVCombo。

Punchline.Original: Can't seem to find the right weapon for the job?  This may help!
Punchline.Translated: 找不到适合这个职业的武器？这也许能帮到你！

Description.Original: Adds a Clas/Job Icon Overlay in Armoury Chest.  Split from VIWI plugin's Kitchen Sink module.
Description.Translated: 在兵装库中叠加显示职业图标。由 VIWI 插件的 Kitchen Sink 模块拆分而来。

Punchline.Original: Browse FFXIV venues and teleport to them with one click.
Punchline.Translated: 浏览 FFXIV 玩家经营场所，并一键传送前往。

Description.Original:
Discover active FFXIV venues with data powered by the FFXIV Venues API. Browse currently open and upcoming venues in a sortable table featuring color-coded data centers, opening times, and a visual timeline. Filter by region, search by name, and adjust the lookahead window to find venues opening soon.

Save favorites, blacklist venues, and add your own custom venues with custom schedules and tags. Lifestream integration lets you teleport directly to any venue, while a compact popout window gives you a quick overview at a glance.

Use /avf to open.
Description.Translated:
利用 FFXIV Venues API 的数据发现正在营业的 FFXIV 场所。在可排序的表格中浏览当前开放和即将开放的场所，查看以颜色区分的数据中心、开放时间和可视化时间轴。可按地区筛选、按名称搜索，并调整预览时段，查找即将营业的场所。

支持收藏、拉黑场所，以及添加带自定义营业安排与标签的私人场所。集成 Lifestream，可直接传送到任意场所；紧凑的独立小窗口让信息一目了然。

使用 /avf 打开。

Description.Original: Build Questionable quest JSON files via UI.
Description.Translated: 通过图形界面创建 Questionable 任务 JSON 文件。

Punchline.Original: Blackjack dealer dashboard for FFXIV
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 二十一点荷官控制面板。

Description.Original: A dealer-side dashboard for running Blackjack games in FFXIV.
Description.Translated: 在 FFXIV 中主持二十一点游戏的荷官端控制面板。

Description.Original: Smart crafting profit calculator with market demand analysis.
Description.Translated: 带市场需求分析的智能制作利润计算器。

Punchline.Original: In-game companion for xivvenuemanager.com — log patron visits, sales, and services without leaving FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: xivvenuemanager.com 的游戏内助手，无需离开 FFXIV 即可记录顾客到访、销售与服务。

Description.Original: In-game companion for XIV Venue Manager, a venue-management platform for FFXIV player-run venues (xivvenuemanager.com). Tracks patron entry and exit at your venue, logs sales and services to your web dashboard in real time, and keeps guest lists in sync with the staff, roles, and services you configure on the website. Set up an account at xivvenuemanager.com, generate an API key from the dashboard, and paste it into this plugin's Settings tab to start syncing.
Description.Translated: XIV Venue Manager 的游戏内助手；该平台用于管理 FFXIV 玩家经营的场所（xivvenuemanager.com）。追踪顾客进出，实时向网页面板记录销售与服务，并依据网站上配置的员工、角色和服务同步访客列表。在 xivvenuemanager.com 注册账户，从面板生成 API 密钥，再粘贴到本插件的设置标签页，即可开始同步。

Punchline.Original: Export your chat and forward it to Discord.
Punchline.Translated: 导出聊天记录，并转发到 Discord。

Description.Original: Captures your in-game chat, exports it (txt/json/html/md) and optionally forwards it live to a Discord channel via webhook or bot. Type /easychatlog or /ecl to open the main window or /easychatlog config for settings.
Description.Translated: 捕获游戏内聊天，导出为 txt/json/html/md，并可通过 Webhook 或机器人实时转发到 Discord 频道。输入 /easychatlog 或 /ecl 打开主窗口，输入 /easychatlog config 打开设置。

Punchline.Original: A timeline viewer for FFXIV casts.
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 咏唱时间轴查看器。

Description.Original: Import cast logs and display them in a timeline view.
Description.Translated: 导入咏唱日志，并以时间轴形式显示。

Punchline.Original: Document Penumbra + Glamourer + Customize+ in one file.
Punchline.Translated: 用一个文件记录 Penumbra、Glamourer 和 Customize+ 的状态。

Description.Original: Exports the combined state of Penumbra, Glamourer and Customize+ for the local character as Markdown, HTML or JSON. Ships a selective re-import path, export history, a mod option template gallery with shareable codes, optional git auto-commit and auto-export on zone change. Type /glamdoc to open the window or /glamdoc export [md|html|json] for a headless export.
Description.Translated: 将本地角色的 Penumbra、Glamourer 和 Customize+ 综合状态导出为 Markdown、HTML 或 JSON。提供选择性重新导入、导出历史、带共享码的模组选项模板库、可选的 Git 自动提交，以及切换区域时自动导出。输入 /glamdoc 打开窗口，或使用 /glamdoc export [md|html|json] 无界面导出。

Punchline.Original: Narrates A Quest Reborn dialog into a separate window.
Punchline.Translated: 将 A Quest Reborn 对话显示在独立窗口中。

Description.Original: A companion plugin that forwards A Quest Reborn dialog text into a dedicated window for Chat2 users.
Description.Translated: 将 A Quest Reborn 对话文本转发到专用窗口的配套插件，适用于 Chat2 用户。

Punchline.Original: Highlights the final safe-move window while casting.
Punchline.Translated: 高亮显示咏唱末尾可安全移动的时间段。

Description.Original: Adds a cast-bar overlay that marks the slidecasting timeframe so you can start moving without interrupting the cast. Includes an optional audio cue when the safe window begins.
Description.Translated: 在咏唱栏上叠加标记滑步施法的时间段，让你开始移动而不打断咏唱。可选择在安全时间段开始时播放声音提示。

Punchline.Original: Rule-based inventory sorter with comprehensive filters.
Punchline.Translated: 基于规则的背包整理器，提供全面的筛选条件。

Description.Original: Define a stack of sorting rules and BagAssistant will route items to the right bag every time. Filter by item category, rarity, level range, item level, class/job, HQ, tradeable, name match, vendor price, item ID and more.
Description.Translated: 定义一组依次执行的整理规则，BagAssistant 就会将物品放到正确的背包中。可按物品类别、稀有度、等级范围、品级、职业、HQ、是否可交易、名称匹配、商店售价、物品 ID 等条件筛选。

Punchline.Original: Real-time DPS and HPS tracking with encounter history and an overlay.
Punchline.Translated: 实时追踪 DPS 和 HPS，提供战斗历史与浮层。

Description.Original: Tracks DPS, HPS, overheal, pet contribution, and encounter summaries with a compact overlay and detailed breakdowns.
Description.Translated: 通过紧凑浮层和详细明细，追踪 DPS、HPS、过量治疗、召唤物贡献和战斗摘要。

Punchline.Original: Configurable in-game minimap overlay with entity markers.
Punchline.Translated: 可配置的游戏内小地图浮层，支持实体标记。

Description.Original: Displays a resizable, zoomable minimap overlay using the current zone's game map texture. Shows player position, party members, aetherytes, FATEs, and more. Supports north-up and player-up rotation modes.
Description.Translated: 使用当前区域的游戏地图纹理，显示可调整大小、可缩放的小地图浮层。显示玩家位置、队友、以太之光、临危受命等。支持固定朝北和跟随玩家朝向的旋转模式。

Punchline.Original: Duty Recorder
Punchline.Translated: 副本录像器。

Description.Original: A plugin that helps you to record your duty.
Description.Translated: 帮助你录制副本的插件。

Punchline.Original: Draft or send AI replies in the chat channels you choose.
Punchline.Translated: 在你选择的聊天频道中起草或发送 AI 回复。

Description.Original: Personal dev plugin that watches the selected FFXIV chat channels, sends per-channel context to LM Studio or API models like Gemini, supports saved system prompt presets, and can print or send replies back into the same channel in game. Slash command: /xivaichat
Description.Translated: 个人开发插件，监听选定的 FFXIV 聊天频道，将各频道的上下文发送给 LM Studio 或 Gemini 等 API 模型。支持保存系统提示词预设，并可将回复打印出来或发送回游戏中的同一频道。斜杠命令：/xivaichat

Punchline.Original: Easily see who you have doted and who has doted you
Punchline.Translated: 轻松查看你向谁示爱过，以及谁向你示爱过。

Description.Original: Easily see who you have doted and who has doted you
Description.Translated: 轻松查看你向谁示爱过，以及谁向你示爱过。

Description.Original: Plugin to display ACT combat log data.
Description.Translated: 用于显示 ACT 战斗日志数据的插件。

Punchline.Original: Hit record. No alt-tab required.
Punchline.Translated: 点下录制，无需 Alt+Tab 切换窗口。

Description.Original: Record gameplay, UI, and moments without leaving the game.
Description.Translated: 无需离开游戏，即可录制游玩过程、界面和精彩瞬间。

Description.Original: GlamApply is a Dalamud plugin that lets you apply glamour plates with a chat command.
Description.Translated: GlamApply 是一款 Dalamud 插件，让你通过聊天命令应用投影模板。

Punchline.Original: Export your gear to XIVGear directly from the game!
Punchline.Translated: 直接从游戏中将装备导出至 XIVGear！

Description.Original: Use /xivgearexport to export current equipped gear to JSON in XIVGear format
Description.Translated: 使用 /xivgearexport 将当前穿戴的装备导出为 XIVGear 格式的 JSON。

Punchline.Original: Replaces your own character's displayed name.
Punchline.Translated: 替换自己角色显示的名字。

Description.Original: A client-only rename for your own character. Affects nameplate, party list, target info, and the sender label of your outgoing chat. This is client side only; other players still see your real name.
Description.Translated: 仅在客户端替换自己的角色名，影响姓名板、队伍列表、目标信息，以及自己发送的聊天中的发言者标签。仅在本地生效，其他玩家仍会看到你的真实名字。

Punchline.Original: Manual market intelligence and arbitrage scanner for FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 手动市场情报与套利扫描工具。

Description.Original: Analyzes market opportunities with Universalis data, watchlists, velocity filters, and manual undercut helpers. All actions are manual. Now includes real-time undercut notifications.
Description.Translated: 结合 Universalis 数据、关注列表、成交速度筛选和手动压价助手分析市场机会。所有操作均需手动执行。现已提供实时压价通知。

Punchline.Original: Filter and move unwanted gear out of your armoury chest.
Punchline.Translated: 筛选并移出兵装库中不需要的装备。

Description.Original: Define filters by job, minimum/maximum equip level, and item level. Armoury Cleaner scans each gear slot and moves only items that match all active filters into your inventory so you can discard them.
Description.Translated: 按职业、最低/最高装备等级和品级定义筛选条件。Armoury Cleaner 扫描每个装备栏位，只将符合所有启用条件的物品移入背包，方便你丢弃。

Punchline.Original: One-click teleport to the nearest aetheryte for each active quest.
Punchline.Translated: 一键传送到每个进行中任务附近最近的以太之光。

Description.Original: QuestNav lists all your active quests and adds a Teleport button next to each one. Clicking it teleports you to the nearest unlocked aetheryte to the quest's location ? no more hunting through the map.
Description.Translated: QuestNav 列出所有进行中的任务，并为每个任务添加传送按钮。点击即可前往距离任务地点最近且已解锁的以太之光，不必再在地图上到处寻找。

Punchline.Original: Tired of every mount with the same generic music? Set the music you want for any mount you want!
Punchline.Translated: 厌倦了每个坐骑都播放相同的通用音乐？为任意坐骑设置你想听的音乐！

Description.Original: A Plugin that allows the user to customize the mount music choosing a different BGM for it.
Description.Translated: 让用户为坐骑选择不同的背景音乐，自定义骑乘音乐的插件。

Punchline.Original: True Crafting Cost Analyzer for FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 实际制作成本分析器。

Description.Original: Calculates the raw material cost of crafted items using Universalis market data.
Description.Translated: 利用 Universalis 市场数据计算制作物品的原材料成本。

Punchline.Original: Define custom command aliases that execute multiple commands in sequence.
Punchline.Translated: 定义自定义命令别名，按顺序执行多个命令。

Description.Original: Silkstring lets you create custom command aliases that expand into one or more chat commands, executed in order. Use /silkstring to open the settings window.
Description.Translated: Silkstring 允许创建自定义命令别名，将其展开为一个或多个按顺序执行的聊天命令。使用 /silkstring 打开设置窗口。

Punchline.Original: Daily cross-server arbitrage route — flip items, make gil.
Punchline.Translated: 每日跨服套利路线——倒买倒卖，赚取金币。

Description.Original: Namazu Flippers connects to the Saddlebag Exchange API to find daily cross-server arbitrage opportunities. Get a route-optimized shopping list, travel between servers, buy low, sell high on your home world. One scan, one route, done in under 20 minutes.
Description.Translated: Namazu Flippers 连接 Saddlebag Exchange API，查找每日跨服套利机会。获取经过路线优化的购物清单，在各服务器之间旅行、低价买入，再回到所属世界高价卖出。扫描一次，跑一条路线，不到 20 分钟即可完成。

Punchline.Original: Truth or Dare Helper for FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 真心话大冒险助手。

Description.Original: Helps you manage and host Truth or Dare games.
Description.Translated: 帮助你管理和主持真心话大冒险游戏。

Punchline.Original: Plan and optimize your treasure hunt route.
Punchline.Translated: 规划并优化寻宝路线。

Description.Original: Import coordinates from selected channels and enjoy your treasure hunt. Optimize routes considering player location, aetheryte costs, and distances.
Description.Translated: 从选定的频道导入坐标，尽情享受寻宝。综合玩家位置、以太之光传送费用和距离优化路线。

Punchline.Original: Your PvP Limit Break, fired for you.
Punchline.Translated: 替你施放 PvP 极限技。

Description.Original: Fires your job's PvP Limit Break when an enemy's HP drops below a configurable threshold (percent of max HP, or absolute value). Optionally auto-selects the lowest-HP hostile in range when no manual target is set. Defensive/support LBs (e.g. Phalanx, Primal Scream) are recognized and skipped. Commands: /pvpautolb, /pvpautolb config, /palb.
Description.Translated: 敌人生命值低于可配置阈值（最大生命值百分比或固定数值）时，施放当前职业的 PvP 极限技。没有手动目标时，可自动选择范围内生命值最低的敌人。会识别并跳过防御/辅助型极限技（如列阵、原初的怒号）。命令：/pvpautolb、/pvpautolb config、/palb。

Punchline.Original: Scrolling skill timeline overlay powered by IINACT.
Punchline.Translated: 由 IINACT 驱动的滚动技能时间轴浮层。

Description.Original:
Real-time scrolling timeline showing skill usage with action icons, cast bars, and per-player tracking. Requires IINACT for network log data.

DM @mtvirux on discord for assistance or bug reports.
Description.Translated:
实时滚动时间轴，以动作图标、咏唱栏和逐玩家追踪显示技能使用情况。需要 IINACT 提供网络日志数据。

需要帮助或报告问题，请在 Discord 私信 @mtvirux。

Punchline.Original: 你开8服5A

Description.Original: 自动找A怪，依赖插件: LifeStream, Teleporter, Vnavmesh, HuntHelper
Scans inventory, armoury chest, saddlebag, retainers, glamour dresser, and armoire to show item set collection progress with job filters.
Description.Translated: 扫描背包、兵装库、陆行鸟鞍囊、雇员、投影台和收藏柜，显示装备套装收集进度，并支持按职业筛选。

Punchline.Original: Manage and grab preview/cover images for local Penumbra mods.
Punchline.Translated: 管理并获取本地 Penumbra 模组的预览图/封面图。

Description.Original: A helper tool to easily attach local, XIVModArchive, or direct URL preview/cover images to your Penumbra mods. Also supports local tags to easily filter mods that have preview/cover images inside Penumbra.
Description.Translated: 轻松将本地、XIVModArchive 或直链的预览图/封面图附加到 Penumbra 模组的辅助工具。还支持本地标签，便于在 Penumbra 中筛选带预览图/封面图的模组。

Punchline.Original: Manage and grab preview/cover images for local Glamourer designs.
Punchline.Translated: 管理并获取本地 Glamourer 设计的预览图/封面图。

Description.Original: A helper tool to easily attach local, XIVModArchive, direct URL preview/cover images, or take cropped screenshots of your characters to attach to your Glamourer designs.
Description.Translated: 轻松将本地、XIVModArchive 或直链的预览图/封面图附加到 Glamourer 设计；也可以截取并裁剪角色截图后附加。

Punchline.Original: Family Feud host helper for FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 的 Family Feud 问答游戏主持助手。

Description.Original: Allows hosting custom Family Feud games with point tracking and chat output.
Description.Translated: 支持主持自定义 Family Feud 问答游戏，记录分数并输出到聊天。

Punchline.Original: Organize, browse, and preview pose presets.
Punchline.Translated: 整理、浏览和预览姿势预设。

Description.Original: A manager solution for organizing pose presets inside FFXIV, with an interactive 3D skeleton mannequin and full-screen preview viewer.
Description.Translated: 在 FFXIV 内整理姿势预设的管理工具，包含可交互的三维骨架人偶和全屏预览查看器。

Punchline.Original: Optimize multi-item marketboard shopping with Universalis pricing and Lifestream navigation.
Punchline.Translated: 利用 Universalis 价格与 Lifestream 导航，优化多物品市场布告板采购。

Description.Original: Helps you organize shopping lists by fetching live prices from Universalis, grouping items by cheapest server based on customizable stinginess profiles, navigating via Lifestream IPC, and tracking purchases.
Description.Translated: 从 Universalis 获取实时价格，按可自定义的省钱策略将物品分组到最便宜的服务器，通过 Lifestream IPC 导航，并追踪采购进度，帮助你整理购物清单。

Punchline.Original: BiS planner, Materia Advisor, and round-trip optimizer for FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 毕业配装规划、魔晶石建议，以及支持往返导入导出的优化工具。

Description.Original: In-game half of Tonberry Tactics. Reads equipped gear and live character stats, audits materia, compares Etro/XIVGear targets, exports GG-EXPORT:v2 gear data to the web companion, and imports GG-PLAN:v1 recommendations. Shared optimizer and formula logic comes from GearGoblin.Core.
Description.Translated: Tonberry Tactics 的游戏内部分。读取已装备物品与实时角色属性，检查魔晶石，对比 Etro/XIVGear 目标配装，将 GG-EXPORT:v2 装备数据导出至网页助手，并导入 GG-PLAN:v1 建议。共享的优化器与公式逻辑来自 GearGoblin.Core。

Punchline.Original: Never lose your mouse cursor again!
Punchline.Translated: 再也不会找不到鼠标光标！

Description.Original: Configurable cursor trails and a cursor ring indicators.
Description.Translated: 可配置的光标轨迹与光标圆环指示器。

Punchline.Original: A native Dalamud DPS meter overlay for IINACT.
Punchline.Translated: 面向 IINACT 的原生 Dalamud DPS 统计浮层。

Description.Original: Native Dalamud DPS meter HUD for IINACT combat data. Especially useful for linux users who use tiling window managers!
Description.Translated: 用于显示 IINACT 战斗数据的原生 Dalamud DPS 统计 HUD，尤其适合使用平铺式窗口管理器的 Linux 用户！

Punchline.Original: Native IINACT-powered encounter callouts with a cute chocobo for moral support!
Punchline.Translated: 由 IINACT 驱动的原生战斗机制报点，还有可爱的陆行鸟为你加油！

Description.Original: A native Dalamud encounter callout engine powered by IINACT log events, with a cute chocobo for moral support!
Description.Translated: 由 IINACT 日志事件驱动的原生 Dalamud 战斗机制报点引擎，还有可爱的陆行鸟为你加油！

Punchline.Original: Review cutscene dialog while it is happening.
Punchline.Translated: 在过场动画播放期间回顾对话。

Description.Original: Records dialog boxes shown during cutscenes and adds an in-game transcript button so you can review missed lines and replay audio without leaving the cutscene.
Description.Translated: 记录过场动画中的对话框，并在游戏内添加对话记录按钮，让你无需离开过场动画即可回看错过的台词、重播语音。

Punchline.Original: What can I make right now, what's it worth, and what would it take to make the rest?
Punchline.Translated: 现在能制作什么、值多少钱，其他物品还缺哪些材料？

Description.Original: Catalogs every recipe you can craft, buckets them by how much effort the missing materials take, prices them with Universalis, and hands the missing-material work to Artisan / GBR / ARC / Lifestream.
Description.Translated: 整理所有可制作的配方，按补齐材料所需的工作量分类，使用 Universalis 估价，并将缺失材料的获取任务交给 Artisan / GBR / ARC / Lifestream。

Punchline.Original: Auto-lists your always-sell items and matches market board prices
Punchline.Translated: 自动上架你固定出售的物品，并匹配市场布告板价格。

Description.Original: Keep an Auto-Market list of items you always sell. The companion lists them through your retainers in the stack size you choose (keeping a reserve in your bags if you want), prices every listing by matching the lowest board price instead of undercutting, and can do all of it inside AutoRetainer's venture cycle. Also re-prices existing listings (Auto Pinch). Successor to Dagobert Price Matcher; your old settings are imported automatically.
Description.Translated: 维护一份固定出售物品的 Auto-Market 清单。助手会通过雇员按你选择的每组数量上架，可在背包中保留指定数量，并将每个挂单定价为当前最低价而非再压价。整个流程也可在 AutoRetainer 的雇员探险周期内完成。还可重新定价已有挂单（Auto Pinch）。这是 Dagobert Price Matcher 的后继版本，会自动导入旧设置。

Punchline.Original: Sits you down while you fish. That's it.
Punchline.Translated: 让你钓鱼时坐下来，仅此而已。

Description.Original: Checks every few seconds while you are fishing; if you are not sitting, it runs /sit for you. Leaves you alone once you are seated (ground sit, chair, or pose).
Description.Translated: 钓鱼时每隔数秒检查一次；如果你没有坐下，就替你执行 /sit。一旦坐下，无论是席地而坐、坐椅子还是坐姿，都不再打扰。

Punchline.Original: Real-time retainer venture countdowns for your dashboard.
Punchline.Translated: 为你的面板提供实时雇员探险倒计时。

Description.Original: Serves the logged-in character's live retainer and venture state on loopback HTTP (127.0.0.1:10504) so the ffxiv dashboard relay can show real-time venture countdowns instead of AutoRetainer's occasionally-stale file cache.
Description.Translated: 通过本机回环 HTTP（127.0.0.1:10504）提供当前登录角色的实时雇员与探险状态，让 FFXIV 面板中继显示实时探险倒计时，不再依赖 AutoRetainer 偶尔过期的文件缓存。

Punchline.Original: What to wear, what to dye, and what you'll score - before Masked Rose judges you.
Punchline.Translated: 在假面蔷薇评判之前，先知道该穿什么、染什么，以及能得多少分。

Description.Original: Fashion Report assistant for the Gold Saucer: shows the week's hints, the exact +2 dye and +1 shade for each left-side slot, and top candidate items from the crowdsourced database filtered to what you actually own - with a live score predictor as you assemble the outfit.
Description.Translated: 金碟游乐场时尚品鉴助手：显示本周提示、左侧每个装备栏位对应的精确 +2 分染料和 +1 分色系，并从众包数据库中按你实际拥有的物品筛选最佳候选；搭配服装时可实时预测得分。

Punchline.Original: PvP-only auto-rotation
Punchline.Translated: 仅用于 PvP 的自动战斗循环。

Description.Original: PvP-only auto-rotation for FFXIV. Activates in PvP zones.
Description.Translated: FFXIV 的 PvP 专用自动战斗循环，在 PvP 区域启用。

Punchline.Original: Per-job HP, MP, and deep dungeon potion automation.
Punchline.Translated: 按职业配置生命、魔力与深层迷宫药品的自动使用。

Description.Original: Auto-uses the highest-tier HP potion, MP potion (Ether), and the deep dungeon regen potion (Sustaining / Eurekan / Orthos / Pilgrim's) at configurable thresholds. Each potion's threshold and on/off state is stored per-job, so casters and tanks can have completely different setups.
Description.Translated: 达到可配置阈值时，自动使用最高等级的恢复生命药、恢复魔力药，以及深层迷宫持续恢复药（长效、天之、正统与 Pilgrim's 系列）。每种药品的阈值和开关均按职业保存，让法系与防护职业使用完全不同的配置。

Punchline.Original: Per-dungeon view of which armoire-eligible gear pieces you're still missing
Punchline.Translated: 按副本查看尚未收集的可存入收藏柜装备。

Description.Original: Lists every armoire-eligible dungeon drop in the game and shows whether each is in your inventory, in your armoire, or still missing. Sort by level, hide completed dungeons, toggle to show owned items too. Open the armoire UI at an inn once per session to populate the in-armoire state; in-inventory and equipped state is detected automatically.
Description.Translated: 列出游戏中所有可存入收藏柜的副本掉落，标明各件物品是在背包中、已存入收藏柜，还是尚未获得。支持按等级排序、隐藏已集齐副本，并可切换显示已拥有物品。每次游戏会话中，在旅馆打开一次收藏柜界面，即可读取柜内状态；背包与已装备状态会自动检测。

Punchline.Original: Lalalazy fork of Wrath Combo - XIVCombo for very lazy players.
Punchline.Translated: Wrath Combo 的 Lalalazy 分支——献给非常懒的玩家的 XIVCombo。

Description.Original: Gluttony Combo - lalalazy fork of Gluttony Combo. XIVCombo for very lazy players.
Description.Translated: Gluttony Combo——Gluttony Combo 的 lalalazy 分支，献给非常懒的玩家的 XIVCombo。

Punchline.Original: FFXIV Wondrous Tails probability calculator.
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 天书奇谈概率计算器。

Description.Original: Adds row probabilities to the Wondrous Tails display along with the average probability of what would happen if you shuffled. Upgraded for modern FFXIV.
Description.Translated: 在天书奇谈界面中显示连线概率，以及重新排列后的平均概率。已更新以适配新版 FFXIV。

Punchline.Original: Your character has a personality now.
Punchline.Translated: 你的角色现在有自己的个性了。

Description.Original: Mannerisms gives your character a life of their own. Set up gestures that react to what you say in chat — type 'bye' and your character waves, say 'WHAT' and they recoil in shock. Create idle profiles so your character reads, checks their phone, or paces around when you're AFK. Supports regex triggers, target-aware emotes, random emote pools with rarity controls, and fully customizable idle sequences.
Description.Translated: Mannerisms 让角色鲜活起来。为聊天内容设置响应动作：输入 `bye` 就挥手，说 `WHAT` 就惊讶后退。创建待机配置，让角色在你离开时读书、看手机或来回踱步。支持正则触发、根据目标执行表情动作、可调整稀有程度的随机动作池，以及完全自定义的待机序列。

Punchline.Original: Free your mouse and fingers from repetitive trading.
Punchline.Translated: 让鼠标和手指摆脱重复交易。

Description.Original: Free your mouse and fingers from repetitive trading
Description.Translated: 让鼠标和手指摆脱重复交易。

Description.Original: GW2-style action camera: hold a key to capture the mouse, rotate the camera freely, auto-face your character, and soft-target the nearest enemy in view.
Description.Translated: 激战 2 风格的动作镜头：按住一个键捕获鼠标，自由转动镜头、自动调整角色朝向，并临时选中视野内最近的敌人。

Punchline.Original: Straightforward character selection, no fluff or hassle
Punchline.Translated: 简单直接地选择角色，不繁琐、不折腾。

Description.Original: Simple Character Select
Description.Translated: 简易角色选择。

Punchline.Original: The daily word game for Eorzea.
Punchline.Translated: 艾欧泽亚的每日猜词游戏。

Description.Original: A word puzzle plugin for Final Fantasy XIV inspired by wordle. Features multiple themes and stat tracking.
Description.Translated: 受 Wordle 启发的 Final Fantasy XIV 猜词插件，提供多种主题和统计追踪。

Punchline.Original: TEST BUILD ONLY - zbee/ARC PR#3 IPC surface (separate instance)
Punchline.Translated: 仅供测试——zbee/ARC PR#3 的 IPC 接口（独立实例）。

Description.Original: TEMPORARY test build of zbee/ARC PR #3 (ipc-venture-work): adds ARC.AddItem / ARC.GetInProgress / ARC.GetListCount IPC used by LazyCrafter's ArcDispatch. Installs alongside your normal production ARControl (different InternalName, no config or IPC collision at rest) for in-game verification only. Pre-seeded with a copy of your existing ARControl venture setup so no re-setup is needed. Not maintained; remove after testing is done.
Description.Translated: zbee/ARC PR #3（ipc-venture-work）的临时测试构建：新增 LazyCrafter 的 ArcDispatch 使用的 ARC.AddItem / ARC.GetInProgress / ARC.GetListCount IPC。与正常使用的 ARControl 并存安装（InternalName 不同，闲置时不会发生配置或 IPC 冲突），仅用于游戏内验证。预先复制现有 ARControl 的雇员探险配置，无需重新设置。本构建不作持续维护；测试后请移除。

ARControlPRTest2.Author: zbee, Liza Carvelli (upstream PR by dajoey)

Punchline.Original: PvP match history and stats tracker — Dalamud API 15 fork.
Punchline.Translated: PvP 对战历史与统计追踪——Dalamud API 15 分支。

Description.Original: Record, browse and filter your Crystalline Conflict, Frontline and Rival Wings match history, view match scoreboards and view aggregated statistics like win rate and average damage dealt per match. Community fork of wrath16/PvpStats restoring compatibility with Dalamud API 15 (FFXIV patch 7.5).
Description.Translated: 记录、浏览和筛选水晶冲突、纷争前线和烈羽争锋的对战历史，查看对战记分板，以及胜率、场均伤害等汇总统计。此社区分支基于 wrath16/PvpStats，恢复了对 Dalamud API 15（FFXIV 7.5 版本）的兼容性。

Punchline.Original: The Habitat Nightclub Plugin
Punchline.Translated: Habitat Nightclub 夜店插件。

Description.Original: The official companion plugin for Habitat Nightclub
Description.Translated: Habitat Nightclub 夜店的官方配套插件。

Punchline.Original: In-game meld optimizer with BisBuddy export and overcap awareness.
Punchline.Translated: 游戏内魔晶石镶嵌优化器，支持导出到 BisBuddy，并考虑属性上限溢出。

Description.Original: FFXIV in-game meld optimizer. Pick a job, load your equipped gear, click Auto-Optimize: the plugin picks the best food and places materia to match the BiS target while respecting per-piece stat caps. Auto-detects job changes, preloads equipped gear, and exports to BisBuddy in one click, with proper HQ flag handling.
Description.Translated: FFXIV 游戏内魔晶石镶嵌优化器。选择职业、加载当前装备，然后点击自动优化：插件会选择最佳食物并安排魔晶石，使属性接近毕业配装目标，同时遵守每件装备的属性上限。自动检测职业切换、预加载已装备物品，并可一键导出到 BisBuddy，正确处理 HQ 标记。

Punchline.Original: Custom ImGui Emote Grid
Punchline.Translated: 自定义 ImGui 表情动作网格。

Description.Original: A standalone plugin providing a scalable ImGui grid for emotes.
Description.Translated: 提供可缩放 ImGui 表情动作网格的独立插件。

Punchline.Original: Find the absolute best way to spend all your FFXIV currencies.
Punchline.Translated: 找出使用各种 FFXIV 货币的最佳方式。

Description.Original: Fork of CurrencySpender by Blackcatz1911. Never wonder 'What should I do with this?' again. Access real-time prices from Universalis, identify missing collectibles tied to your currencies, and unlock new possibilities for utilizing your in-game resources effectively.
Description.Translated: Blackcatz1911 的 CurrencySpender 分支。再也不必疑惑“这个该怎么用？”获取 Universalis 实时价格，找出可用现有货币兑换但尚未收集的物品，发掘更有效利用游戏资源的新途径。

Punchline.Original: Fully automated FATE grinding utilizing vnavmesh, lifestream, and Gluttony Combo.
Punchline.Translated: 借助 vnavmesh、Lifestream 和 Gluttony Combo 全自动刷临危受命。

Description.Original: Automates FATE grinding, including Zodiac Atma, Anima Luminous Crystals, Resistance Memories, Phantom Demiatmas, Yo-kai Watch Medals, and Bicolor Gemstones. Seamlessly integrates with vnavmesh for pathing and flight, lifestream for zone swapping, TextAdvance for dialogue skipping, and Gluttony Combo/BossMod for combat. Use /lazyfate to open.
Description.Translated: 自动刷临危受命，支持黄道武器魂晶、元灵武器发光水晶、义军武器记忆结晶、幻影武器半魂晶、妖怪手表妖怪奖章及双色宝石。无缝集成 vnavmesh 寻路与飞行、Lifestream 切换区域、TextAdvance 跳过对话，以及 Gluttony Combo/BossMod 战斗。使用 /lazyfate 打开。

Punchline.Original: Track your Skyward points for all jobs toward the Pteranodon mount
Punchline.Translated: 追踪所有职业的技巧点，向无齿翼龙坐骑迈进。

Description.Original: Tracks all jobs' Skyward points for the Pteranodon mount achievement. Scans your inventory for Skybuilders turn-in items and projects how many points they'll add, shown as a cyan bar extension on each job's progress bar. Use /lazysky to open.
Description.Translated: 追踪所有职业用于无齿翼龙坐骑成就的技巧点。扫描背包中的重建用上交物品，预测它们可增加的点数，并在各职业进度条末尾以青色延伸条显示。使用 /lazysky 打开。

Punchline.Original: Never forget to eat your food again.
Punchline.Translated: 再也不会忘记吃食物。

Description.Original: Auto-eats food in combat duties with per-job selection, auto-select based on best stats, and a low-food warning.
Description.Translated: 在战斗副本中自动使用食物，支持按职业选择、根据最佳属性自动选择，以及食物不足警告。

Punchline.Original: Track upgradable gear sets and what it costs to finish them
Punchline.Translated: 追踪可升级装备套装，以及集齐它们所需的成本。

Description.Original: Tracks upgradable gear collections piece by piece. Starts with Occult Crescent: North Horn's Phantom Vision sets - all 7 roles, 5 slots, 4 tiers. Shows which pieces you own and at what tier, what the next upgrade costs, and the exact obol/fixative shortfall to finish a role or the whole collection. Every item ID and price is read from the game's own shop data at runtime, so it stays correct across patches. Also flags Arcanaut's gear you can trade up for free. Use /lazygear to open.
Description.Translated: 逐件追踪可升级的装备收藏。首批支持新月岛北部的 Phantom Vision 套装，涵盖全部 7 种装备职能、5 个栏位和 4 个阶段。显示你拥有的部件及阶段、下次升级费用，以及完成某个职能或全部收藏所缺的精确古钱和定着剂数量。所有物品 ID 与价格都在运行时读取游戏商店数据，因而能够随版本保持准确。也会标出可免费换成更高级装备的 Arcanaut's 装备。使用 /lazygear 打开。

Punchline.Original: Tracks duties
Punchline.Translated: 追踪副本。

Description.Original: Tracks duties done.
Description.Translated: 追踪已完成的副本。

Punchline.Original: Market board price alerts via Universalis.
Punchline.Translated: 通过 Universalis 提供市场布告板价格提醒。

Description.Original: Monitors the Universalis market board and fires in-game chat and toast alerts when items on your watchlist hit a target price. Supports per-item scoping to a world, data center, or full region.
Description.Translated: 监控 Universalis 市场布告板数据，关注列表中的物品达到目标价时，发送游戏内聊天与浮动提醒。每件物品可分别限定到单个世界、数据中心或整个大区。

Punchline.Original: WIP, 18+ plz
Punchline.Translated: 开发中，请仅限 18 岁以上使用。

Description.Original: Welcome to kinklink, the kinky plugin with aimed to help you connect and play with other kinksters around the world!
Description.Translated: 欢迎使用 kinklink，这款面向特殊性偏好爱好者的插件，旨在帮助你与世界各地的同好建立联系并一起游玩！

Punchline.Original: Real-time skin decal compositor for FFXIV
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 实时皮肤贴花合成器。

Description.Original: Composites image decals onto character skin textures (diffuse + normal) in real time via Penumbra. No game file modification. Supports per-layer emissive, iris glow, ColorTable PBR, and Mod (.pmp) export. Under active development - feedback welcome via Issues or Discord. Type /skintattoo to open.
Description.Translated: 通过 Penumbra 实时将图像贴花合成到角色皮肤纹理（漫反射与法线贴图）上，不修改游戏文件。支持逐图层自发光、虹膜发光、ColorTable PBR，以及导出模组（.pmp）。正在积极开发中，欢迎通过 Issues 或 Discord 反馈。输入 /skintattoo 打开。

Punchline.Original: Live FFXIV DJ and venue tracker
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 实时 DJ 与场所追踪。

Description.Original: Track live DJs and venues across Eorzea with real-time updates from XIV Rolladeck.
Description.Translated: 通过 XIV Rolladeck 的实时更新，追踪艾欧泽亚各处正在演出的 DJ 与营业场所。

Punchline.Original: Transform Lalafells into other races
Punchline.Translated: 将拉拉菲尔变成其他种族。

Description.Original:
Transforms all Lalafell characters and NPCs around you into your chosen race.
/polala on = enable
/polala off = disable
Description.Translated:
将周围所有拉拉菲尔角色与 NPC 变为你选择的种族。
/polala on = 启用
/polala off = 停用

Punchline.Original: Plans the optimal treasure-map route for your party.
Punchline.Translated: 为队伍规划最佳藏宝图路线。

Description.Original: Listens for treasure-map coordinates posted in party chat, groups them by zone, and shows the shortest aetheryte-rooted route per map. Use /troute to open the window.
Description.Translated: 监听小队聊天中发布的藏宝图坐标，按区域分组，并显示每张地图从以太之光出发的最短路线。使用 /troute 打开窗口。

Punchline.Original: Never hunt aether currents blind again.
Punchline.Translated: 再也不用盲目寻找风脉泉。

Description.Original: Shows aether current locations as markers on the in-game World Map for all expansion zones.
Description.Translated: 在游戏内世界地图上标记所有资料片区域的风脉泉位置。

Punchline.Original: Repeat-buy items from NPC shops with stop conditions.
Punchline.Translated: 按停止条件从 NPC 商店重复购买物品。

Description.Original: Embeds a small overlay next to the standard NPC Shop window. Pick an item from the mirrored shop list, choose a stop condition (fixed count >99 OK, until owned, gil floor, inventory full), and the plugin handles the repeat purchases for you. Shows an estimated total cost popup before starting and warns in red if you cannot afford it. Six-language UI (EN/JA/DE/FR/ZH/KO).
Description.Translated: 在标准 NPC 商店窗口旁嵌入小型浮层。从同步显示的商店列表中选择物品，再设置停止条件（固定数量，支持超过 99；达到持有数量；金币降至下限；背包已满），插件就会替你重复购买。开始前弹窗显示预估总价，资金不足时以红色警告。界面支持英语、日语、德语、法语、中文和韩语。

Punchline.Original: Bulk reprice and split-list retainer market listings across all retainers.
Punchline.Translated: 跨所有雇员批量调整市场售价，并拆分堆叠上架。

Description.Original: Cross-retainer market workbench with a plan-then-apply flow. Reprice tab: per-retainer 'lowest -N g' / 'lowest exact' buttons walk each listing, fetch live market data via Dalamud's IMarketBoard.OfferingsReceived (skipping your own retainers, deduplicated per item/HQ), stage every change in a queue, then commit them all via a single Apply that calls SetRetainerMarketPrice directly. New listing tab: per-row qty x slots, target retainer combo, auto stack-splitting (e.g. 990 / 99 → ten listings of 99), and direct listing from character bag / Chocobo Saddlebag with no entrust step (saddle items are bulk-staged to the bag in one phase, then listed). Live progress dialog shows the current step (selecting retainer, fetching market data, listing, …) so long runs don't look frozen. Six-language UI (EN/JA/DE/FR/ZH/KO). Warns once at startup if AutoRetainer is also loaded since both drive retainer summoning.
Description.Translated: 采用“先规划、后应用”流程的跨雇员市场工作台。重新定价页：各雇员的“最低价减 N 金币”和“与最低价相同”按钮依次检查挂单，通过 Dalamud 的 IMarketBoard.OfferingsReceived 获取实时市场数据（排除自己的雇员，按物品/HQ 去重），将改价暂存到队列，再通过一个应用按钮直接调用 SetRetainerMarketPrice 全部提交。新上架页：每行可设数量×挂单数、目标雇员，自动拆堆（例如 990 / 99 拆为十组各 99），并从角色背包/陆行鸟鞍囊直接上架，无需先交给雇员（鞍囊物品先一次性批量移入背包，再上架）。实时进度框显示选择雇员、获取市场数据、上架等当前步骤，避免长任务看起来像卡死。界面支持英语、日语、德语、法语、中文和韩语。若同时加载 AutoRetainer，启动时会警告一次，因为二者都会召唤雇员。

Description.Original: Search the wiki effortlessly
Description.Translated: 轻松搜索 Wiki。

Punchline.Original: RP tools for FFXIV - custom inventory, dice rolls, and more.
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 角色扮演工具——自定义物品栏、掷骰等功能。

Description.Original: RPFramework provides roleplay helpers including a custom item inventory (/rpinv or /rpinventory), a synced BGM player (/rpbgm), inventory trading and shared bags over a relay server, and more modules coming soon.
