Description.Translated: 将 ffxiv-bundleoftweaks 的 Date With Destiny / Fate Tool Kit 模块重制为独立插件。战斗循环由 Rotation Solver Reborn 负责，范围攻击躲避和目标选择由 BossMod（Reborn）负责，寻路由 vnavmesh 负责。需要 vnavmesh、BossMod Reborn、Rotation Solver Reborn 和 TextAdvance。

Punchline.Original: Automated hunt bill orchestration.
Punchline.Translated: 自动协调完成怪物通缉令。

Description.Original: Automates FFXIV hunt bills using Lifestream, vnavmesh, RotationSolverReborn, and optional HuntHelper integration.
Description.Translated: 通过 Lifestream、vnavmesh、RotationSolverReborn 以及可选的 HuntHelper 集成，自动完成 FFXIV 怪物通缉令。

Punchline.Original: Autonomous ordinary monster-drop farming.
Punchline.Translated: 自动刷取普通怪物掉落物。

Description.Original: Create loot lists with target quantities, resolve monster spawns, validate level safety, teleport, mount, navigate, fight, and continue until the list is complete.
Description.Translated: 创建带目标数量的掉落物清单，查找怪物刷新点、检查等级是否安全，随后传送、骑乘、导航和战斗，直到清单完成。

Punchline.Original: Automatically updates your gearset portrait when glamour changes.
Punchline.Translated: 投影外观变化时，自动更新套装肖像。

Description.Original: Detects when your character's glamour changes and automatically updates the associated gearset portrait, so you never have to manually re-save it again.
Description.Translated: 检测角色投影外观的变化，并自动更新关联套装的肖像，让你不必再手动重新保存。

Punchline.Original: Run a Blackjack table in your FFXIV venue.
Punchline.Translated: 在 FFXIV 场所中主持二十一点牌桌。

Description.Original: Run a blackjack table in your FFXIV venue. Narrates each beat to chat, draws cards from /random rolls, tracks every player's bank, and reconciles the night's gil against your wallet. Type /twentyone to open the table.
Description.Translated: 在 FFXIV 场所中主持二十一点牌桌。通过聊天播报每个环节，以 /random 骰点抽牌，追踪每位玩家的筹码账户，并将当晚金币收支与实际钱包对账。输入 /twentyone 打开牌桌。

Punchline.Original: Condenses combos and mutually exclusive abilities onto a single button.
Punchline.Translated: 将连击和互斥技能合并到同一按钮。

Description.Original: 粗制滥造AI翻译

Punchline.Original: Auto-travels between worlds and capitals, shouting your message at each stop.
Punchline.Translated: 自动在各服务器及主城之间移动，并在每一站喊话。

Description.Original: Automatically travels world to world via Lifestream and shouts a message at each capital city.
Description.Translated: 通过 Lifestream 自动跨服，并在各主城喊话发送消息。

Punchline.Original: Your character on Linkshell, updated while you play. Minion count included.
Punchline.Translated: 游玩时更新你在 Linkshell 上的角色资料，连宠物数量也不漏。

Description.Original:
Reads your own character in game (jobs, gear, collections, achievements, progress) and keeps your linkshell.me profile up to date while you play. Nothing is read or sent until you claim one. Settings has a switch for each thing it reads, and one for all of it.

Glamours: /lss glam shows the plates you have set up. Save one and it goes in your own library on this PC, where you name it, try it on, and wear it again from any character. Send it to Linkshell and it lands as a draft, where you add a picture and publish it. Nothing about your plates is sent unless you send it. The same window puts an outfit into the plate you have open when you ask; the game's own Save is still yours to press.

Five extras, off until you turn them on. Linkshell chat puts your Free Company's Linkshell room in your chat log, tagged, and you answer from our own window or with /lss say; it never reads the game's chat. Mark on map lets your own profile drop a flag on your in-game map. Discord status gives the Discord app on your PC your character, job, zone and profile link. Save Glamour puts an entry on the game's right-click menu that copies what a character is visibly wearing into your library on this PC; it stays there and can never be sent to Linkshell. People you group with tells Linkshell that you and somebody shared a party, as a scrambled pair with no name, no place and no time, forgotten after a week. The last two are the only ones here that involve anybody but you.

To start, mint a claim code on https://linkshell.me and run /lss claim <code> in game.
Description.Translated:
读取你自己的游戏角色数据，包括职业、装备、收藏、成就和进度，并在游玩时持续更新 linkshell.me 资料。完成角色认领之前，不会读取或发送任何内容。设置中提供各项读取内容的独立开关及总开关。

投影：/lss glam 显示已设置的投影模板。保存后会进入本机收藏库，可为其命名、试穿，并让任意角色再次穿上。发送到 Linkshell 后会成为草稿，你可以添加图片再发布。除非主动发送，否则不会上传投影模板信息。此窗口还可按你的要求将服装填入当前打开的投影模板，但游戏自身的保存按钮仍需你亲自点击。

五项附加功能默认关闭。Linkshell 聊天会把部队在 Linkshell 上的聊天室消息带标签显示在聊天记录中，你可从插件窗口或通过 /lss say 回复；它绝不读取游戏聊天。地图标记允许你自己的个人资料在游戏地图上放置标记。Discord 状态会向本机 Discord 应用提供角色、职业、区域和个人资料链接。保存投影会在游戏右键菜单添加项目，将某角色当前可见的穿着复制到本机收藏库；这类记录只保留在本地，永远不能发送到 Linkshell。“与你组过队的人”会向 Linkshell 报告你与某人曾同队，以混淆后的成对标识发送，不包含姓名、地点或时间，一周后删除。最后两项是此处唯一涉及他人的功能。

开始使用时，请在 https://linkshell.me 生成认领码，然后在游戏中运行 /lss claim <code>。

Punchline.Original: Automatically switches ReShade presets based on zone, weather, and time of day.
Punchline.Translated: 根据区域、天气和一天中的时间自动切换 ReShade 预设。

Description.Original: Reads the current zone, weather, and time of day and publishes them over a Sharingway IPC channel so a companion ReShade addon can switch presets automatically. Use /pway to open the window, /pway status for a text summary, /pway config for settings.
Description.Translated: 读取当前区域、天气和时间，通过 Sharingway IPC 通道发布，让配套 ReShade 附加组件自动切换预设。使用 /pway 打开窗口，/pway status 查看文字摘要，/pway config 打开设置。

Punchline.Original: Track FFXIV duties, time, Gil, characters and party members.
Punchline.Translated: 追踪 FFXIV 副本、时间、金币、角色和队友。

Description.Original: Tracks FFXIV duties, time spent, clears, wipes, Gil changes, multiple characters and encountered party/alliance members. Includes persistent local storage and Excel export.
Description.Translated: 追踪 FFXIV 副本、耗时、通关、团灭、金币变化、多个角色，以及遇到的小队和团队成员。支持本地持久保存及 Excel 导出。

Punchline.Original: Finish your sightseeing log.
Punchline.Translated: 完成你的探索笔记。

Description.Original:
Tourist adds a window to assist with the sightseeing log.

- ! Added vnavmesh features
- Show when sightseeing log vistas are available
- Add markers for ARR vistas
- Open vista locations on your map
- Hide already completed or unavailable vistas
- Show the command needed for each vista

"sightseeing" icon by muhammad, from thenounproject.com CC BY 3.0
Description.Translated:
Tourist 添加一个辅助完成探索笔记的窗口。

- 新增 vnavmesh 功能！
- 显示各探索地点何时可完成
- 为 ARR 探索地点添加标记
- 在地图中打开探索地点
- 隐藏已完成或当前不可完成的地点
- 显示每个地点所需的命令

“sightseeing”图标由 muhammad 制作，来自 thenounproject.com，采用 CC BY 3.0 许可。

Punchline.Original: Keep track of players you meet.
Punchline.Translated: 记录你遇见的玩家。

Description.Original:
PlayerTrack helps you keep a record of who you meet and the content you played together.
Organize players into categories, keep notes, and track them across name/world changes.
Customization options include colors, icons, nameplates, and alerts.
Description.Translated:
PlayerTrack 帮助记录你遇见的人，以及共同游玩的内容。
可将玩家分类、记录备注，并在其改名或转服后继续追踪。
可自定义颜色、图标、姓名牌和提醒。

Punchline.Original: Orchestrate Critical Engagements on the Bozjan Southern Front and Zadnor
Punchline.Translated: 协调南方博兹雅战线和扎杜诺尔高原的临界遭遇战。

Description.Original: Reads live Bozja/Zadnor field-operation state (mettle, resistance rank, Lost Action holster, Critical Engagement phases) and orchestrates vnavmesh for movement, BossMod Reborn for AoE avoidance and Rotation Solver Reborn for rotations. Includes multibox coordination across game clients and Resistance relic progress tracking.
Description.Translated: 读取博兹雅和扎杜诺尔高原的实时战场状态，包括战果、抗争等级、失传技能携带情况和临界遭遇战阶段；协调 vnavmesh 移动、BossMod Reborn 躲避范围攻击，以及 Rotation Solver Reborn 执行循环。支持多个游戏客户端之间的多开协调，并追踪抗争武器进度。

Punchline.Original: Walk onto your target's spot and match the way they're facing.
Punchline.Translated: 走到目标脚下，并与目标保持相同朝向。

Description.Original: Walks your character onto the spot a target is standing on, then turns you to face the same way they do. Movement is real: your character walks there under its own power, easing off speed on the final approach so it settles on the mark rather than overshooting it. Supports a target-relative offset, a facing offset, and a continuous follow mode that keeps you on their mark as they move. Built for lining up at close quarters - there is no pathfinding.
Description.Translated: 让角色走到目标站立的位置，再转向与对方相同的方向。通过实际步行移动，最后接近时减速，以准确停在目标点而不越过。支持相对目标的位置偏移、朝向偏移，以及随目标移动持续保持相对位置的跟随模式。适合近距离对齐，不包含寻路功能。

Punchline.Original: One click to clear vendor-replaceable clutter out of your bags
Punchline.Translated: 一键清理背包中可向商店重新购买的杂物。

Description.Original: Flags inventory items as junk when they are re-buyable from an NPC vendor under a gil threshold AND are either low-level/untimed gathering node drops or only used in below-max-level crafts. Sells them to any open shop on a single confirmed click, and retrieves matching junk out of your retainers at a summoning bell.
Description.Translated: 当背包物品可在设定金币价格上限内向 NPC 商店重新购买，且属于低等级或非限时采集点产物，或仅用于未满级配方时，将其标记为杂物。一次确认点击即可将它们卖给当前打开的任意商店，也可在传唤铃处从雇员取回符合条件的杂物。

Punchline.Original: See what's up in North Horn, then click once to get there.
Punchline.Translated: 查看新月岛北部正在发生什么，再点击一次前往。

Description.Original: Lists the Critical Encounters and FATEs running in Occult Crescent: North Horn and walks you to any of them with a single click, choosing between walking, an aetheryte hop and Occult Return. Also tracks the pot cycle, keeps your knowledge-crystal buffs topped up, and can step around monsters and pick up coffers on the way. Does nothing outside North Horn.
Description.Translated: 列出新月岛北部正在进行的临界遭遇战和危命任务，一键前往，并自动在步行、以太之光传送和亚返回之间选择路线。还会追踪魔法罐周期、补充知见水晶增益，并可在途中绕开怪物、拾取宝箱。新月岛北部以外不执行任何操作。

Punchline.Original: Build a glamour, share it, and wear anyone else's.
Punchline.Translated: 搭配投影、分享外观，也能穿上别人的搭配。

Description.Original: Dress your character in any item in the game from a searchable in-game wardrobe, dye every slot, edit full appearance and save named outfits. Then publish the look to a community catalogue you can browse, filter, vote on and favourite without leaving the game - and put anyone else's glamour on with one click, with a revert that is always one click away. No other plugins required.
Description.Translated: 通过可搜索的游戏内衣柜，为角色试穿游戏中的任意装备，为每个部位染色、编辑完整外貌，并保存有名称的套装。随后可发布到社区目录，无需离开游戏即可浏览、筛选、投票和收藏；点击一次便可应用他人的投影，也始终能一键还原。不需要其他插件。

Punchline.Original: A roleplay profile for your character, readable at a glance.
Punchline.Translated: 为角色建立一眼可读的角色扮演档案。

Description.Original: Write a full roleplay profile for your character - name, appearance, backstory, hooks and rumours - and read anyone else's by hovering them. Set statuses that hang under your character for others to read at a glance, and keep private notes on everyone you have met.
Description.Translated: 为角色撰写完整的角色扮演档案，包括姓名、外貌、背景故事、互动线索和传闻；鼠标悬停于他人即可阅读其档案。可设置显示在角色下方、供他人一眼看到的状态，并为遇过的每个人保留私人备注。

Punchline.Original: Auto-press a keyboard key a set number of times, or forever.
Punchline.Translated: 按指定次数或无限次数自动按键。

Description.Original: A simple auto-presser. Add one or more keys, each set to tap repeatedly (N times or unlimited, at a delay you choose) or hold down (timed or until stopped) - they all run at once, so you can e.g. hold one key while tapping another. Sends keys to FFXIV only and keeps working while tabbed out. Open with /autoclick.
Description.Translated: 简单的自动按键工具。添加一个或多个按键，每个可设为重复点击（N 次或无限次，间隔自定）或持续按住（指定时长或直到停止）。各按键同时运行，例如按住一键时连按另一键。仅向 FFXIV 发送按键，切出游戏后仍可运行。使用 /autoclick 打开。

Punchline.Original: Right-click any item to copy its cross-DC undercut price.
Punchline.Translated: 右键任意物品，复制跨大区最低价再低 1 金币的报价。

Description.Original: Right-click a marketable item in your inventory and pick "Undercut price (copy)" to query Universalis across your world, data center, or entire region, and copy the lowest-minus-1 gil price straight to your clipboard. "Load in Undercutter" opens a window with the full listing breakdown. A /undercut window is also available for manual lookups.
Description.Translated: 右键背包中可交易的物品，选择“Undercut price (copy)”（复制压价报价），即可通过 Universalis 查询当前服务器、大区或整个区域的价格，并将最低价减 1 金币的结果复制到剪贴板。“Load in Undercutter”会打开包含完整出售明细的窗口，也可通过 /undercut 打开窗口进行手动查询。

Punchline.Original: Unite. Learn. Mimic.
Punchline.Translated: 携手，学习，模仿。

Description.Original: Compares learned Blue Mage spells across a party, shows where to find missing ones, and helps plan what to learn next together - multilingual (DE/EN/FR/JA), syncs via export/import codes or opt-in Live-Sync (optionally shares your online status with listed Group Finder entries). Clicking a location opens the Duty Finder (never queues) or teleports you once to the nearest aetheryte (one action per click, can be turned off) - no other gameplay automation.
Description.Translated: 比较队伍成员已学会的青魔法，显示缺失技能的学习地点，并帮助共同规划接下来要学的技能。支持德语、英语、法语和日语，通过导出/导入码或主动开启的实时同步交换数据；还可选择向招募列表中的条目分享在线状态。点击地点可打开任务搜索器但不会报名，或向最近的以太之光执行一次传送，每次点击只执行一个动作且可关闭。没有其他游戏自动化功能。

Punchline.Original: Your quest step and the way there, under the game's own Main Scenario Guide.
Punchline.Translated: 在游戏主线向导下方，显示当前任务步骤和前往路线。

Description.Original: Adds two lines under the Main Scenario Guide: the step you are on, and how to get to it, with a compass and the distance beside them. The route understands teleports, building entrances and city aethernet, and says so. The words that name what to do are the control: press them to cast the teleport, open the Duty Finder, use the key item, perform the emote, or put the phrase in your chat box. Follow any accepted quest from your journal, not only the main scenario. Mouse and controller both reach everything.
Description.Translated: 在主线向导下添加两行：当前步骤，以及如何抵达，旁边配有方向指示和距离。路线能识别传送、建筑入口和城内以太之网，并作出说明。行动文字本身就是按钮：点击可传送、打开任务搜索器、使用任务道具、执行情感动作，或将所需短语填入聊天框。不限于主线，可从任务日志中追踪任意已接受任务。鼠标和手柄均可操作所有功能。

Description.Original: Farms FATEs for you: tick the zones, and the plugin teleports in, finds active FATEs, and runs them in a loop, with Lifestream support for instance, world, and local crystal navigation.
Description.Translated: 为你自动刷危命任务：勾选区域后，插件会传送前往，寻找正在进行的危命任务并循环完成；支持通过 Lifestream 切换场景分区、服务器及使用当地以太之网。

Punchline.Original: The official mechanic simulator of UMADcorp. Go to an inn and start practice. No, seriously, go do it!
Punchline.Translated: UMADcorp 官方机制模拟器。去旅馆开始练习吧。不，真的，现在就去！

Description.Original: Spawns fake party members and bosses client-side so you can practice raid mechanics using the official UMADcorp approved strats.
Description.Translated: 在客户端本地生成模拟队友和首领，让你按照 UMADcorp 官方认可的打法练习团队副本机制。

Punchline.Original: Apply an imported FFXIV materia plan to your equipped gear.
Punchline.Translated: 将导入的 FFXIV 魔晶石镶嵌方案应用到当前装备。

Description.Original: Imports xivgear exports, validates slot plans, and provides a one-click meld workflow.
Description.Translated: 导入 xivgear 导出数据，验证各部位镶嵌计划，并提供一键镶嵌流程。

Punchline.Original: Every plugin. One orbit.
Punchline.Translated: 所有插件，一处汇聚。

Description.Original: Unified storefront for official and community Dalamud plugins. Browse, compare sources, review findings, install, update, and manage your library.
Description.Translated: 统一展示官方和社区 Dalamud 插件的平台。浏览插件、比较来源、查看检查结果、安装、更新并管理你的插件库。

Punchline.Original: Party game helpers for FFXIV hosts, starting with blackjack.
Punchline.Translated: 为 FFXIV 派对主持者提供游戏辅助，首个支持的游戏是二十一点。

Description.Original: GamesNook is a growing toolbox for FFXIV party hosts. It currently features a full blackjack table, with bingo, truth or dare, and more on the way. Use /gnook to open the window.
Description.Translated: GamesNook 是持续扩充的 FFXIV 派对主持工具箱。目前提供完整的二十一点牌桌，未来将加入宾果、真心话大冒险等。使用 /gnook 打开窗口。

Punchline.Original: Select inventory gear and safely queue pentamelds.
Punchline.Translated: 选择背包装备，安全排队执行五禁断。

Description.Original: Inventory picker and guarded pentameld queue. Defaults to Critical Hit > Direct Hit > Determination with strict no-overcap behavior.
Description.Translated: 提供背包装备选择器和带保护措施的五禁断队列。默认属性优先级为暴击 > 直击 > 信念，严格避免属性溢出。

Punchline.Original: A fully custom, tab-based replacement for the in-game chat window.
Punchline.Translated: 完全自定义、基于标签页的游戏聊天窗口替代品。

Description.Original: Replaces the default FFXIV chat log with a custom ImGui interface: unlimited freely-configurable tabs (any mix of channels), any tab can be popped out into its own floating window, whispers get their own per-partner tab or window, clickable links, BTTV/7TV emote rendering, AI-assisted replies/rephrasing (optional Gemini key), auto-reply, and disk-backed history capped at 1 GiB. Not affiliated with Square Enix, Twitch, BetterTTV, 7TV or Google.
Description.Translated: 以自定义 ImGui 界面替换 FFXIV 默认聊天记录：不限数量且可自由配置频道组合的标签页；任意标签页可弹出为独立悬浮窗口；按私聊对象建立独立标签页或窗口；可点击链接；BTTV/7TV 表情渲染；AI 辅助回复与改写（可选 Gemini 密钥）；自动回复；以及最大 1 GiB 的磁盘历史记录。与 Square Enix、Twitch、BetterTTV、7TV 或 Google 无隶属关系。

Punchline.Original: One-click repeat leve delivery (Deliver All).
Punchline.Translated: 一键重复交纳理符任务（全部交纳）。

Description.Original: Automates repeat levequest delivery: accept a leve, turn it in, repeat until leve allowances run out — with one click. Pairs with Pandora's Box 'Auto-select Turn-ins' when installed, and falls back to its own built-in slot filler otherwise. No navigation: you stand at the levemete and delivery NPC.
Description.Translated: 自动重复交纳理符任务：一键接受、交纳并重复，直到理符额度用尽。若安装了 Pandora's Box，则配合其“Auto-select Turn-ins”功能；否则使用内置交纳栏位填充。没有导航功能，需要自行站在理符发布员和交纳 NPC 附近。

Punchline.Original: Runs the Main Scenario unattended — and remembers where it stopped.
Punchline.Translated: 无人值守推进主线，并记住上次停在哪儿。

Description.Original: Automated Main Scenario questing. Walks each quest from accept to complete, travels between zones, resolves dialogue, and hands solo instances to BossMod Reborn and dungeons to Theseus. Progress is read back from the game's own quest state, so a crash, logout or reload resumes exactly where it stopped. Every character quests independently; a fleet dashboard shows where each one is. Companion to Daedalus and Theseus.
Description.Translated: 自动执行主线任务。从接受到完成推进各任务、跨区域旅行、处理对话，将单人战斗交给 BossMod Reborn，将迷宫交给 Theseus。进度从游戏自身的任务状态读取，因此崩溃、登出或重载后能准确接续。每个角色独立执行任务，队伍仪表盘显示各角色的位置。Daedalus 和 Theseus 的配套工具。

Punchline.Original: Render words between Common and Vieran.
Punchline.Translated: 在通用语与维埃拉语之间转换词句。

Description.Original: A focused roleplay translation tool for Common and Vieran, with optional local detection of Vieran in explicitly selected chat channels. Open it with /woodword. Woodword never changes or posts chat.
Description.Translated: 专门用于通用语和维埃拉语的角色扮演翻译工具，可选在明确指定的聊天频道中本地检测维埃拉语。使用 /woodword 打开。Woodword 绝不会修改或发送聊天消息。

Punchline.Original: Zeigt woher Glams und Mounts kommen.
Punchline.Translated: 显示投影装备和坐骑的来源。

Description.Original: Hover über ein Item oder Mount und sieh sofort die Quelle — Dungeon, Shop, Craft, Event. Kein Wiki mehr nötig. Befehle: /glamsource
Description.Translated: 将鼠标悬停在物品或坐骑上，即可查看其来源——迷宫、商店、制作或活动，无需再查百科。命令：/glamsource

Punchline.Original: Save an examined character's glamour to Discord with one explicit click.
Punchline.Translated: 主动点击一次，即可将查看中的角色投影保存到 Discord。

Description.Original: Adds a SendDiscord button beside the Examine window. Only when pressed, it posts a cropped image, target character name, appearance item names, and Eorzea Database search links to the configured Discord Webhook. The UI supports Japanese, English, German, French, Korean, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.
Description.Translated: 在查看装备窗口旁添加 SendDiscord 按钮。只有按下时，才会向配置好的 Discord Webhook 发送裁剪图片、目标角色姓名、外观装备名称及艾欧泽亚数据库搜索链接。界面支持日语、英语、德语、法语、韩语、简体中文和繁体中文。

Punchline.Original: Manage characters, jobs, playtime, Lodestone profiles, and configuration folders.
Punchline.Translated: 管理角色、职业、游玩时间、Lodestone 资料和配置文件夹。

Description.Original: Stores logged-in character details, jobs, playtime, Lodestone IDs, and configuration-folder mappings locally, then presents them in a searchable UI and CSV export. Optional external lookup and login-time playtime acquisition require explicit settings.
Description.Translated: 在本地保存已登录角色的信息、职业、游玩时间、Lodestone ID 及配置文件夹对应关系，并提供可搜索界面和 CSV 导出。可选的外部查询及登录时获取游玩时间，都需要明确启用。

Punchline.Original: Visualize and unlock Aether Currents across every expansion.
Punchline.Translated: 可视化查看并解锁各资料片的风脉泉。

Description.Original: Shows field Aether Current and quest progress by expansion and area. It can process the current area or a selected expansion, using vnavmesh for field travel and Questionable for quests. Includes a map view, individual actions, route recalculation, and UI in Japanese, English, German, French, Korean, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.
Description.Translated: 按资料片和区域显示野外风脉泉及任务进度。可处理当前区域或选定资料片，使用 vnavmesh 在野外移动、使用 Questionable 完成任务。提供地图视图、单项操作、路线重新计算，界面支持日语、英语、德语、法语、韩语、简体中文和繁体中文。

Punchline.Original: Item and action names in several languages at once.
Punchline.Translated: 同时显示多种语言的物品和技能名称。

Description.Original:
Adds the item and action name in the languages you pick to the game's own tooltips and cast bars, read from the client's own data.

DM @mtvirux on discord for assistance or bug reports.
Description.Translated:
从客户端自身数据中读取所选语言的物品及技能名称，添加到游戏原生提示和施法条中。

如需帮助或报告问题，请在 Discord 私信 @mtvirux。

Punchline.Original: PlayerSync first; Lightless only as fallback.
Punchline.Translated: 优先使用 PlayerSync，仅在必要时回退到 Lightless。

Description.Original: PlayerSync-first ownership with verified active-overlap diagnostics. /syncbridge
Description.Translated: 以 PlayerSync 优先分配同步控制权，提供经验证的同时生效重叠诊断。/syncbridge

Punchline.Original: Add damage type, source, and calculated mitigation to native flytext.
Punchline.Translated: 在原生飘字中添加伤害类型、来源和计算出的减伤信息。

Description.Original: GPL-3.0 Damage Info derivative that annotates local incoming damage with calculated active mitigation.
Description.Translated: 采用 GPL-3.0 许可的 Damage Info 衍生插件，为自身受到的伤害标注计算出的当前减伤效果。

DamageInfoExtended.Author: Rika Kagurasaka; derived from Damage Info by perchbird

Punchline.Original: Removes skill-name labels from floating combat text, with an optional speed slider.
Punchline.Translated: 移除战斗飘字中的技能名称，并可调节动画速度。

Description.Original: Removes the skill/ability name label from floating combat text, leaving only the number, color, size, and crit/direct-hit bounce animation. Also adds an optional speed slider (/plainflytext) that slows or speeds up native flytext's animation - lower makes numbers linger and float up more slowly.
Description.Translated: 移除战斗飘字中的技能和能力名称，只保留数字、颜色、大小以及暴击/直击弹跳动画。另提供可选速度滑块（/plainflytext），调整原生飘字动画的快慢；调低会让数字停留更久、上浮更慢。

Punchline.Original: Shows which emotes your mods change, and plays them.
Punchline.Translated: 列出模组改动的情感动作，并播放它们。

Description.Original: Lists emotes, dances, expressions and idle poses altered by Penumbra mods and plays them with one click. Keep favourites at hand, filter by mod, jump straight to an idle pose, and use the compact view to keep it open while you play. Requires Penumbra.
Description.Translated: 列出被 Penumbra 模组更改的表情动作、舞蹈、表情和待机姿势，并可一键播放。将收藏放在手边，按模组筛选，直接跳转到待机姿势，并使用紧凑视图在游玩时保持打开。需要 Penumbra。

Punchline.Original: Your glamour, Glamourer and Penumbra outfit workspace.
Punchline.Translated: 管理投影、Glamourer 和 Penumbra 服装的工作区。

Description.Original: Use your character as the viewer for a live complete-look dresser, reuse Glamourer designs, keep a local wardrobe, manage equipment-affecting Penumbra mods, and cache openly attributed public glamour recipes from supported sources.
Description.Translated: 直接用角色实时预览完整搭配，复用 Glamourer 设计、维护本地衣柜、管理影响装备外观的 Penumbra 模组，并缓存受支持来源中公开且标明作者的投影搭配方案。

Punchline.Original: Sort your inventory across retainers automatically.
Punchline.Translated: 自动在多个雇员之间整理物品。

Description.Original: Assign item categories to retainers, choose a priority order, protect items with Never Deposit, preview assignments, and automatically sort matching inventory stacks from a nearby Summoning Bell.
Description.Translated: 为雇员分配物品类别、设置优先级，用“Never Deposit”保护不应寄存的物品，预览分配结果，并在附近的传唤铃自动整理背包中符合条件的物品堆叠。

Punchline.Original: Know what to sell, buy, craft, gather — and what to do next.
Punchline.Translated: 知道该卖、该买、该做、该采什么，以及接下来做什么。

Description.Original: FFXIV economy decision support for Dalamud. Ranks selling, buying, crafting and gathering opportunities using Universalis, inventory/Market Board observations, vendor economics and your own trading history. Includes native item-tooltip insights, inventory right-click lookups, unified Opportunities, cashflow/FIFO analytics and personal sales/listing history. No automated buying, selling, repricing or queued native Market Board scanning. The plugin icon was created with AI assistance.
Description.Translated: 面向 Dalamud 的 FFXIV 经济决策辅助。结合 Universalis、背包与市场布告板观察数据、商店价格及个人交易历史，对出售、购买、制作和采集机会排序。提供原生物品提示分析、背包右键查询、统一商机视图、现金流和先进先出分析，以及个人销售与上架历史。不会自动购买、出售、调价或排队扫描原生市场布告板。插件图标由 AI 辅助制作。

Punchline.Original: Send Penumbra model files to Blender and back with a single click.
Punchline.Translated: 一键将 Penumbra 模型文件送入 Blender，并传回游戏。

Description.Original: Enables easy importing of Penumbra model files in Blender and exporting them back to the game with just a single click. Provides various utilities and settings to make mod creation and editing easier and faster.
Description.Translated: 轻松将 Penumbra 模型文件导入 Blender，再一键导出回游戏。提供多种工具和设置，让模组创建和编辑更简便、更快速。

Punchline.Original: Assistant Logos bilingue FR/EN pour Eureka, consultable partout.
Punchline.Translated: 随处可查的优雷卡文理技能助手，支持法语和英语。

Description.Original: Conserve les fonctions originales de Logogram Helper, ajoute /logo, mémorise le dernier stock de logogrammes, indique de quel éclat vient chaque logogramme et permet de basculer toute l'interface entre français et anglais.
Description.Translated: 保留 Logogram Helper 原有功能，新增 /logo 命令，记住上次的文理记忆库存，显示每种记忆来自哪类文理结晶，并可将整个界面切换为法语或英语。

Punchline.Original: Undercut automatique des ventes de servant.
Punchline.Translated: 自动压低雇员出售物品的价格。

Description.Original: Automatise le repricing des ventes d'un servant avec les données live du Market Board, en respectant HQ/NQ, les propres servants et le délai configuré.
Description.Translated: 依据市场布告板实时数据，自动调整雇员出售价格，区分 HQ/NQ、避开自己的雇员，并遵循设置的延迟。

Punchline.Original: Indique clairement la direction regardée par un mob.
Punchline.Translated: 清晰显示怪物的面向方向。

Description.Original: Affiche une flèche 3D configurable au-dessus d'un mob sélectionné et continue de le suivre lorsque la cible du joueur change.
Description.Translated: 在选定怪物上方显示可配置的三维箭头，即使玩家切换目标，也会继续跟踪该怪物。

Punchline.Original: Spin tracks and let the party sync in.
Punchline.Translated: 播放音乐，让大家同步加入派对。

Description.Original: An interactive DJ deck with live mixing tools, custom playlists, and a synced listener mode with an audio visualizer.
Description.Translated: 交互式 DJ 控制台，提供实时混音工具、自定义播放列表，以及带音频可视化的同步收听模式。

Punchline.Original: Simulate your rotation, then see how your real kills measure up.
Punchline.Translated: 先模拟技能循环，再看看实战通关表现如何。

Description.Original: Simulates a full-length fight for your job using your own gear or a best-in-slot preset, then reports the DPS and shows exactly where it came from. Compares gear, melds and consumables, checks your openers and burst windows, and analyses an FFLogs report against the simulated ceiling. Kills on supported encounters can be scored and submitted to per-job leaderboards.
Description.Translated: 使用你的现有装备或毕业配装预设，为当前职业模拟完整战斗，随后报告 DPS 并详解伤害来源。可比较装备、镶嵌和消耗品，检查起手与爆发窗口，并将 FFLogs 记录与模拟上限对比分析。受支持战斗的通关记录可评分，并提交至各职业排行榜。

Punchline.Original: ペットと自分を、マップ座標または相対座標へ移動させる
Punchline.Translated: 将召唤物和自身移动到地图坐标或相对坐标。

Description.Original: ペットは「移動」、自分は vnavmesh で歩きます。/cmove pet|player と、cursor / cursorrel / offset に対応します。
Description.Translated: 召唤物使用“移动”指令，自身通过 vnavmesh 步行。支持 /cmove pet|player，以及 cursor / cursorrel / offset。

Punchline.Original: Zeigt die ausgelosten Jobs und den Live-Jobstatus deiner Party.
Punchline.Translated: 显示随机分配的职业及队伍当前职业状态。

Description.Original: Verbindet sich über deine PlayerID mit Funny Duty Roulette, zeigt alle Job-Zuweisungen der aktuellen Session und prüft live, ob die Party bereits auf diese Jobs gewechselt ist.
Description.Translated: 通过 PlayerID 连接 Funny Duty Roulette，显示当前活动中所有职业分配，并实时检查队伍是否已切换到分配的职业。

Punchline.Original: 戦闘系プラグインの設定を一括管理。JOB・ロール・プリセット切替に対応。
Punchline.Translated: 统一管理战斗插件设置，支持按职业、职能和预设切换。

Description.Original: BossMod / BossMod Reborn / Rotation Solver Reborn / Wrath Combo の主要戦闘設定をまとめて確認・変更し、JOB・ロール・名前付きプリセットとして保存できます。
Description.Translated: 集中查看和修改 BossMod、BossMod Reborn、Rotation Solver Reborn 及 Wrath Combo 的主要战斗设置，并按职业、职能或命名预设保存。

Punchline.Original: A DPS meter that shows what you are doing right now.
Punchline.Translated: 显示当前输出表现的 DPS 统计工具。

Description.Original: Shows the damage you are actually dealing right now as a real-time value instead of the whole-fight average, and keeps encounters together across cutscenes and downtime. Fight graph, details on hover and the last ten fights. Requires IINACT.
Description.Translated: 以实时数值显示你当前实际造成的伤害，而不是整场战斗的平均值，并在过场动画和停机期间保持战斗连续。战斗图表、悬停详情和最近十场战斗。需要 IINACT。

Punchline.Original: Counts what others do to you and shows it above your head.
Punchline.Translated: 统计别人对你做了什么，并显示在你的头顶。

Description.Original: Counts emotes and chat messages directed at you and briefly displays the tally as your title. Rules define which emotes, which trigger words and which channels count, what the message says and in which colours. Requires Honorific. Counts are stored locally and never leave your machine.
Description.Translated: 统计以你为对象的情感动作和聊天消息，并将累计次数短暂显示为称号。可通过规则指定计数的动作、触发词和频道，以及显示文字和颜色。需要 Honorific。计数仅存于本地，不会离开本机。

Punchline.Original: INZONE Budsの左右・ケース残量をゲーム内に表示します。
Punchline.Translated: 在游戏内显示 INZONE Buds 左右耳机和充电盒电量。

Description.Original: Sony INZONE Buds（WF-G700N）のUSBトランシッターからバッテリー残量を取得し、オーバーレイとDTRバーへ表示します。
Description.Translated: 通过 Sony INZONE Buds（WF-G700N）的 USB 发射器获取电量，并在悬浮层和 DTR 栏中显示。

Punchline.Original: Browse and install mods from the comfort of your FFXIV house
Punchline.Translated: 舒舒服服待在 FFXIV 家里，浏览并安装模组。

Description.Original: Browse xivmodarchive.com from inside the game and install mods into Penumbra in one click. Fork of Noevain/ModArchiveBrowser, updated for Dalamud API 15.
Description.Translated: 在游戏内浏览 xivmodarchive.com，并一键将模组安装至 Penumbra。这是 Noevain/ModArchiveBrowser 的分支，已更新适配 Dalamud API 15。

Punchline.Original: Watch together without making FFXIV download or launch media tools.
Punchline.Translated: 一起观看媒体，无需让 FFXIV 下载或启动媒体工具。

Description.Original: Safety-focused in-game media playback with an independent companion for prebuffered public media.
Description.Translated: 注重安全的游戏内媒体播放工具，配备独立辅助程序，用于预缓冲公开媒体内容。

DreamTV.Author: Kamen; based on XivMediaPlayer by Sebastina (Sebane1)

Punchline.Original: Custom nameplate titles with colours and animated effects.
Punchline.Translated: 自定义姓名牌称号，支持颜色和动画效果。

Description.Original: Create your own nameplate titles, save them into a personal list, and dress them up with full RGB colours, glow, and animated effects such as rainbow waves, fades, pulses, typewriter, glitch and more. Inspired by Honorific.
Description.Translated: 创建自定义姓名牌称号，保存到个人列表，并添加完整 RGB 配色、发光，以及彩虹波浪、渐变、脉冲、打字机、故障等动画效果。灵感来自 Honorific。

Punchline.Original: Browse and preview all game items on your character.
Punchline.Translated: 浏览游戏所有装备，并在角色身上预览。

Description.Original: Every equippable item in the game, in a categorized grid with icons. Hover to preview, apply to your character to see how it looks, and manage or remove what you are wearing.
Description.Translated: 以带图标的分类网格展示游戏中的所有可装备物品。悬停预览，应用到角色查看效果，并管理或移除当前穿着。

Punchline.Original: Your friends are worth it.
Punchline.Translated: 你的朋友值得更好的对待。

Description.Original: An improved, responsive, and feature-rich friend list for Final Fantasy XIV.
Description.Translated: 为《最终幻想14》提供更完善、响应迅速、功能丰富的好友列表。

Punchline.Original: Empower your RP with dynamic emotes and infinite custom hotbars.
Punchline.Translated: 通过动态情感动作和不限数量的自定义快捷栏，让角色扮演更精彩。

Description.Original: An advanced emote manager and RP hotbar suite for Final Fantasy XIV. Features dynamic emote tracking based on active Penumbra mods, unlock source lookups, custom tagging/grouping, and responsive floating hotbars.
Description.Translated: 《最终幻想14》的高级情感动作管理器和角色扮演快捷栏套件。支持根据已启用 Penumbra 模组动态追踪动作、查询解锁来源、自定义标签和分组，以及响应式悬浮快捷栏。

Punchline.Original: Recommended Gear across everything you own.
Punchline.Translated: 从你拥有的全部装备中寻找推荐装备。

Description.Original: Find recommended gear across your inventory, Armoury Chest, chocobo saddlebag, retainers, glamour dresser and armoire, then build a persistent retrieve-to-equip checklist.
Description.Translated: 从背包、兵装库、陆行鸟鞍囊、雇员、投影台和收藏柜中查找推荐装备，并生成持久保存的“取回并穿戴”清单。

Punchline.Original: Call anything in any loaded plugin, directly.
Punchline.Translated: 直接调用任意已加载插件中的功能。

Description.Original: Resolves live plugin instances through Dalamud's plugin manager and invokes their internals by reflection, bypassing IPC surfaces and their gates. Includes a task engine for sequencing multi-step automation across plugins, SND-compatible event triggers, and a file bridge for driving a client from outside the game.
Description.Translated: 通过 Dalamud 插件管理器获取正在运行的插件实例，以反射调用内部功能，绕过 IPC 接口及其限制。包含跨插件编排多步自动化的任务引擎、兼容 SND 的事件触发器，以及从游戏外驱动客户端的文件桥接。

Punchline.Original: A screen in the world, showing whatever is live.
Punchline.Translated: 在游戏世界中放一块屏幕，播放实时内容。

Description.Original: Puts a live stream on a screen anchored in the world: place it on a wall, size it, and watch while you play. Plays Twitch, YouTube, Plex, direct streams and thousands of live TV channels, painted onto a real in-game surface so the game lights and occludes it properly. Party groups let a room watch the same thing together from a six-character code.
Description.Translated: 将直播显示在固定于游戏世界的屏幕上：放到墙上、调整大小，边玩边看。支持 Twitch、YouTube、Plex、直连直播流及数千个电视直播频道，内容绘制在真实游戏表面上，正确接受游戏光照和遮挡。观看群组可通过六位字符代码，让整个房间同步收看相同内容。

Punchline.Original: Google Translate, but for dragonspeak.
Punchline.Translated: 龙语版的 Google 翻译。

Description.Original: A scratchpad translator for the FFXIV dragon tongue. Type English, get dragonspeak with proper Verb-Object-Subject grammar, and copy it out in one click. Translates both directions, and ships the full 'A Lesson in Dragonspeak' text plus the canon dictionary as an in-game reader.
Description.Translated: FFXIV 龙语便笺翻译器。输入英语，即可得到遵循正确“动词—宾语—主语”语序的龙语，并一键复制。支持双向翻译，附带完整的“A Lesson in Dragonspeak”文本及官方设定词典，可在游戏内阅读。

Punchline.Original: Log-trigger rules with tags, commands, waits, and Lua. EN/JA UI.
Punchline.Translated: 基于日志的触发规则，支持标签、命令、等待和 Lua，提供英日双语界面。

Description.Original: All collected logs are evaluated against every enabled rule. Rules are organized with tags. Flow steps are Wait, Command, and Lua. UI language follows Dalamud, or can be switched between English and Japanese in Settings.
Description.Translated: 所有收集到的日志都会与每条已启用规则进行匹配。规则通过标签整理，流程步骤包括等待、命令和 Lua。界面语言默认跟随 Dalamud，也可在设置中切换英语或日语。

Punchline.Original: Retrieve materia and meld from an exdreams share URL.
Punchline.Translated: 回收魔晶石，并按 exdreams 分享链接进行镶嵌。

Description.Original: CTRL+Right-click retrieves materia once (auto-accepts the confirm dialog). /mex parses an exdreams gear share URL for inventory check, dry-run, and auto-meld.
Description.Translated: CTRL+右键执行一次魔晶石回收，并自动接受确认对话框。/mex 可解析 exdreams 配装分享 URL，进行背包检查、预演和自动镶嵌。

Punchline.Original: Mortal / Akochan suggestions and auto-play. Mortal installs on first launch.
Punchline.Translated: 提供 Mortal / Akochan 建议与自动对局，首次启动自动安装 Mortal。

Description.Original: Reads Doman Mahjong and uses Mortal or Akochan for discard, riichi, pass, chi, pon, kan, ron, and tsumo. Mortal is installed automatically on first launch. Akochan can run in realtime or precision mode.
Description.Translated: 读取多玛方城，使用 Mortal 或 Akochan 决定打牌、立直、跳过、吃、碰、杠、荣和及自摸。首次启动自动安装 Mortal。Akochan 可运行于实时模式或精确模式。

Name.Translated: 多玛方城战求解器调试

Punchline.Original: Withdraw missing recipe materials from each retainer.
Punchline.Translated: 从各雇员处取回配方缺少的材料。

Description.Original: Reads the open crafting recipe and withdraws missing materials from each retainer. SND is not required. Allagan Tools is optional for stock lookup.
Description.Translated: 读取当前打开的制作配方，并从各雇员处取回缺失材料。不需要 SND；可选用 Allagan Tools 查询库存。

Punchline.Original: Buys a shopping list off the market board.
Punchline.Translated: 按购物清单从市场布告板采购。

Description.Original: Works a list of items, quantities and per-item price ceilings against the market board, buying the cheapest acceptable listings for you. Walks to a board, searches, and buys with human-variable timing. Exposes a Dalamud IPC API so other plugins can submit buy orders and read back what was purchased and at what price.
Description.Translated: 依据包含物品、数量和单价上限的清单，在市场布告板购买符合条件的最便宜商品。自动走到布告板、搜索，并以带随机变化的操作间隔购买。提供 Dalamud IPC API，让其他插件提交采购订单，并读取实际购得物品及价格。

Punchline.Original: Jump/Emote Block (JEBlock) compliments Gagspeak. Lock your partner into an emote without forcing HARDCORE mode.
Punchline.Translated: Jump/Emote Block（JEBlock）是 Gagspeak 的补充工具，无需强制开启 HARDCORE 模式，就能让搭档保持在指定情感动作中。

Description.Original: When using Triggers or Puppeteer for emotes, your partner may escape by tapping jump or performing a new /emote. This plugin blocks those requests if a user configured 'Loci' effect is detected.
Description.Translated: 通过 Triggers 或 Puppeteer 使用情感动作时，搭档可能通过跳跃或执行新的 /emote 脱离动作。本插件在检测到用户配置的“Loci”效果时，会阻止这些请求。

Punchline.Original: Turns your combat actions into a chest-scaling mini-game.
Punchline.Translated: 将战斗动作变成调整胸部大小的小游戏。

Description.Original: Drives Customize+ chest scale from your choice of source: a Food Buff timer, Mana percentage, or an in-combat Job Actions mode built around GCD usage, tracked job abilities, jumping, and damage taken. Displayed as an animated baby-bottle HUD gauge with configurable fill zones, a pause toggle, and an optional high-scale threshold effect (vignette, glow, heartbeat sound). Fully configurable in-game via a settings window. Requires Customize+. Local only: nobody else sees it.
Description.Translated: 根据所选数据源调整 Customize+ 胸部缩放：食物增益计时、魔力百分比，或基于公共冷却技能使用、指定职业能力、跳跃和承受伤害的战斗职业技能模式。以动态奶瓶 HUD 量表显示，可设置填充区间、暂停开关，以及达到高缩放阈值时的可选效果（暗角、发光、心跳音）。所有功能都可在游戏设置窗口中配置。需要 Customize+。仅本地显示，其他人看不到。

Punchline.Original: A clickable list of nearby targetable players.
Punchline.Translated: 可点击选中附近玩家的列表。

Description.Original: Shows a compact, clickable list of player characters you can actually target, so you can heal or raise people in The Hunt, Diadem, Eureka, Bozja and the Occult Crescent without fighting the mouse.
Description.Translated: 以紧凑、可点击的列表显示当前确实可选中的玩家，让你在怪物狩猎、云冠群岛、优雷卡、博兹雅和新月岛中轻松治疗或复活他人，不必费力点击角色。

Punchline.Original: A one click menu for your installed plugins.
Punchline.Translated: 一键访问已安装插件的菜单。

Description.Original: Adds a small floating button that opens a searchable, scrollable list of every installed and enabled plugin, each with its Open and Settings windows one click away. Plugins can be hidden from the list and brought back later.
Description.Translated: 添加小型悬浮按钮，打开可搜索、可滚动的列表，列出所有已安装且已启用的插件。点击一次即可打开各插件主窗口或设置。可从列表隐藏插件，之后也可恢复显示。

Punchline.Original: Mods are like onions, they have layers!
Punchline.Translated: 模组就像洋葱，它们都有层次！

Description.Original: Install skin mods as layers and not as skin replacements. Designed to work across female bodies, works with OMP files and Proteus mods.
Description.Translated: 将皮肤模组作为图层安装，而不是直接替换皮肤。设计为兼容不同女性体型，支持 OMP 文件和 Proteus 模组。

Punchline.Original: Poses are like onions--- err wrong notebook
Punchline.Translated: 姿势就像洋葱——呃，拿错笔记本了。

Description.Original: Turn your current pose into an idle pose with a single click in no time.
Description.Translated: 轻点一下，立刻将当前姿势转为待机姿势。

Punchline.Original: Your chest tracks your mana bar.
Punchline.Translated: 让胸部大小随着魔力条变化。

Description.Original: Drives the breast bones from how much mana you have left, through Customize+. Full at 100%, smaller as you spend - or the other way round. Your own Customize+ profile is read and carried along, so nothing else you have scaled is lost while it runs. Requires Customize+. Local only: nobody else sees it.
Description.Translated: 通过 Customize+ 根据剩余魔力调整胸部骨骼。魔力为 100% 时最丰满，消耗魔力后缩小，也可以反过来。运行时会读取并保留你自己的 Customize+ 配置，不会丢失其他部位的缩放。需要 Customize+。仅本地显示，其他人看不到。

Punchline.Original: Transform your minions into familiar NPCs.
Punchline.Translated: 将宠物变为熟悉的 NPC。

Description.Original:
Replaces selected minions with NPCs.
Command: /minionmirage
Description.Translated:
将选定宠物替换为 NPC。
命令：/minionmirage

Punchline.Original: Capture inspected glamours and keep a searchable Glamour Library.
Punchline.Translated: 保存查看过的投影，建立可搜索的投影收藏库。

Description.Original: Capture inspected character glamours into a searchable local Library with previews, gear and dye recipes, ownership tracking, personal previews, and sharing tools.
Description.Translated: 将查看过的角色投影保存到可搜索的本地收藏库，支持预览、装备和染色方案、拥有情况追踪、自身试穿及分享工具。

Punchline.Original: Removes the sun while you're indoors.
Punchline.Translated: 身处室内时移除太阳。

Description.Original: Gets rid of the void sun — the sun that shines through the walls while you are inside a housing interior. Everything is back to normal the moment you step outside.
Description.Translated: 去除虚空中的太阳——也就是住宅室内仍会穿墙照进来的阳光。一踏出室外，所有效果便恢复正常。

Punchline.Original: Two buttons. Your whole DPS rotation. You still throw the punches.
Punchline.Translated: 两个按钮，完整输出循环，但每一击仍由你亲手打出。

Description.Original:
Collapses each supported job into a single-target button and an AoE button. The button shows the action that is correct right now given your cooldowns, gauge, buffs, target count and whether you are moving. It never presses anything for you: one keypress is always exactly one action.

Built for players who cannot sustain a full hotbar - limited hand mobility, chronic pain, tremor, fatigue, one-handed play - who want to keep playing themselves rather than hand the fight to an automation plugin.
Description.Translated:
将每个受支持职业的技能整合为一个单体按钮和一个群攻按钮。根据冷却、量谱、增益、目标数量及是否移动，按钮显示此刻合适的技能。绝不会替你按键：每次按键始终只执行一个动作。

为难以持续操作整套快捷栏的玩家设计，例如手部活动受限、慢性疼痛、震颤、疲劳或单手游玩的玩家，让他们继续亲自战斗，而不是交给自动化插件。

Punchline.Original: Build, share and call raid strategies without leaving the game.
Punchline.Translated: 无需离开游戏，即可制作、分享和指挥团队副本战术。

Description.Original: Build, share and call raid strategies without leaving the game. Slide-based arena diagrams, per-player cooldown assignments, and shotcall reminders anchored to real boss casts or to timings the plugin learns from your own pulls.
Description.Translated: 无需离开游戏，即可制作、分享和指挥团队副本战术。提供幻灯片式场地示意图、按玩家分配的冷却技能，以及基于实际首领读条或从历次尝试中学习的时序进行指挥提醒。

Punchline.Original: Posing, lighting and whole-scene staging for group pose. Beta.
Punchline.Translated: 为集体动作提供姿势、灯光和整场景布置工具。测试版。

Description.Original:
Poser is a posing and scene tool for FINAL FANTASY XIV's group pose.

- Pose actors bone by bone: overlay handles, a graphical body map, and numeric transforms
- IK on any bone with a parent, plus mirror, link and named bone-visibility presets
- Spawn actors and objects, or click a world handle to bring what is already there into the scene
- Borrow the map's own objects by reference and give them back untouched on release
- Save and restore the whole shot — actors, objects, lights, camera and environment — with load options
- Custom lights, camera control and a free camera; snapping, group pivot and group moves
- Gaze control and one-click expressions
- A pose library with tags, authors and search; import and export poses, and MCDF appearance files
- Time, weather and festival control
- On-screen dialogue panels, chat bubbles and status lines drawn with the game's own UI
- Reference pictures as floating, aspect-locked windows
- Twenty-five rebindable actions with Poser, Brio and Ktisis presets

This is a beta. It is not stable and it is not finished. Poser is derivative of Anamnesis, Ktisis and Brio, and those three are the mature tools.

Poser was coded with the use of artificial intelligence. The plugin says so on first launch and asks you to confirm you have read the notice.
Description.Translated:
Poser 是《最终幻想14》集体动作模式的姿势与场景工具。

- 逐骨骼摆姿势：悬浮操作柄、图形化身体示意图和数值变换
- 为任何有父骨骼的骨骼使用 IK，并支持镜像、联动和命名的骨骼可见性预设
- 生成角色对象和物体，或点击世界操作柄将现有对象带入场景
- 通过引用借用地图原有物体，释放时原样归还
- 保存和恢复整个镜头，包括角色、物体、灯光、相机和环境，并提供加载选项
- 自定义灯光、相机控制和自由相机；吸附、组枢轴和成组移动
- 视线控制和一键表情
- 带标签、作者和搜索的姿势库；导入导出姿势及 MCDF 外观文件
- 时间、天气和节庆控制
- 使用游戏原生界面绘制屏幕对话面板、聊天气泡和状态行
- 以锁定宽高比的悬浮窗口显示参考图片
- 25 个可重新绑定的操作，提供 Poser、Brio 和 Ktisis 预设

这是测试版，既不稳定，也未完成。Poser 衍生自 Anamnesis、Ktisis 和 Brio，这三者才是成熟工具。

Poser 使用人工智能辅助编写。插件会在首次启动时说明这一点，并要求确认已阅读提示。

Punchline.Original: Export your collections to FFXIV Collect.
Punchline.Translated: 将收藏数据导出至 FFXIV Collect。

Description.Original: Creates FFXIV Collect import data from your character's collections.
Description.Translated: 根据角色收藏生成 FFXIV Collect 导入数据。

Punchline.Original: AutoRetainer ventures plus built-in market board pinch
Punchline.Translated: AutoRetainer 雇员探险，加上内置市场布告板调价功能。

Description.Original: After AutoRetainer collects a venture and assigns a quick venture, Custom MB Plugin pinches that retainer's market listings (embedded Dagobert engine) before moving to the next retainer. Requires AutoRetainer Multi-Mode. Disable the separate Dagobert plugin. Slash command: /custommb (use '/custommb config' for settings)
Description.Translated: AutoRetainer 收取探险成果并分配快速探险后，Custom MB Plugin 会使用内置 Dagobert 引擎调整该雇员的出售价格，然后再处理下一个雇员。需要 AutoRetainer 多角色模式。请禁用独立 Dagobert 插件。命令：/custommb，设置请使用 /custommb config。

Punchline.Original: Manage a party-based Hot Potato dice game.
Punchline.Translated: 管理小队内的烫手山芋掷骰游戏。

Description.Original: A Dalamud plugin for managing a party-based Hot Potato dice game. Tracks players, rounds, Hot Potato numbers, eliminations, turn order, and party announcements.
Description.Translated: 用于管理小队烫手山芋掷骰游戏的 Dalamud 插件。追踪玩家、轮次、烫手山芋数字、淘汰情况、行动顺序和小队公告。

Punchline.Original: Bind your own slash commands to your animation mods.
Punchline.Translated: 为动画模组绑定自定义斜杠命令。

Description.Original: Bind your own slash command to a Penumbra preset and a vanilla emote. Typing the command applies the mod options, redraws, and performs the emote - so your custom animation plays without opening Penumbra mid-scene. Other players see it through the sync service they already use.
Description.Translated: 将自定义斜杠命令绑定到 Penumbra 预设和原生情感动作。输入命令即可应用模组选项、重绘角色并执行动作，让自定义动画直接播放，无需中途打开 Penumbra。其他玩家可通过他们已有的同步服务看到效果。

Punchline.Original: Lifetime hunt mark kill counter.
Punchline.Translated: 永久累计狩猎怪物击杀次数。

Description.Original: Keeps a permanent, per-mark count of every hunt mark you get credit for killing, broken down by rank and expansion. Seeds pre-existing totals from your achievements, and keeps counting after the achievement is complete.
Description.Translated: 为每种被你有效击杀的狩猎怪物永久计数，并按等级和资料片分类。根据成就初始化已有累计数量，成就完成后仍会继续统计。

Punchline.Original: Show your Spotify track as an Honorific title.
Punchline.Translated: 将 Spotify 正在播放的歌曲显示为 Honorific 称号。

Description.Original: Shows your current Spotify track as an Honorific title, including local files, formatting, cleanup, styling, supporter effects, reliability handling, content filtering, saved profiles, portable settings, and optional combat auto-hide.
Description.Translated: 将当前 Spotify 歌曲显示为 Honorific 称号，支持本地文件、格式设置、文字清理、样式、支持者特效、可靠性处理、内容过滤、保存配置、可迁移设置，以及可选的战斗时自动隐藏。

Punchline.Original: Dice, initiative and encounter tracking for in-game tabletop sessions.
Punchline.Translated: 为游戏内桌面角色扮演提供掷骰、先攻和战斗追踪。

Description.Original:
Dice, initiative and encounter tracking for tabletop roleplay sessions run inside FFXIV.

This does nothing on its own. Everyone playing needs this plugin installed, and it needs a connection to a relay — one person hosts a session and admits the others individually with a code. There is nothing to try alone, and anyone without the plugin cannot take part.

Rolls are made in the plugin rather than by the game, so 4d6+2 works where /dice cannot. Campaign history is stored on the host's machine.

What the relay can see and what it stores: https://github.com/ruminabottle/dungeonmasterxiv/blob/main/RELAY-SERVICE-POLICY.md
Description.Translated:
为在 FFXIV 内进行的桌面角色扮演提供掷骰、先攻和战斗追踪。

插件单独使用不会产生任何效果。所有参与者都必须安装插件，并连接中继；其中一人主持会话，通过代码逐个接纳其他人。无法单人体验，未装插件者也无法参与。

掷骰由插件而非游戏执行，因此支持 /dice 无法处理的 4d6+2 等表达式。战役历史保存在主持者电脑上。

中继可查看和保存哪些数据：https://github.com/ruminabottle/dungeonmasterxiv/blob/main/RELAY-SERVICE-POLICY.md

Punchline.Original: Venue profiles, VIP arrival alerts, and privacy-first shift reporting.
Punchline.Translated: 场所资料、VIP 到场提醒，以及隐私优先的值班报告。

Description.Original: A privacy-first venue door and VIP management plugin for FFXIV. Includes venue-specific VIP and staff relationships, tier benefits, Add Target, right-click tools, native nameplate markers, UI packs, and anonymous aggregate shift reports.
Description.Translated: 面向 FFXIV、注重隐私的场所门迎及 VIP 管理插件。提供各场所独立的 VIP 和员工关系、等级权益、添加目标、右键工具、原生姓名牌标记、界面包，以及匿名汇总值班报告。

Punchline.Original: Watch together on a TV in your house: YouTube, Twitch, or any app.
Punchline.Translated: 在家里的电视上一起看 YouTube、Twitch 或任意应用。

Description.Original: Put a TV on your wall and watch with friends. Start a watch party in one click and everyone sees the same YouTube video, in sync, with the sound coming from the screen. Or put a Twitch channel on the TV, or show any app from your PC. Search, queue and control it all without leaving the game. Needs Windows 10 or 11 and the free Brave browser. Open with /matinee.
Description.Translated: 把电视放到墙上，与朋友一起看。一键开启观看派对，所有人同步看到同一 YouTube 视频，声音从屏幕所在位置传来。也可播放 Twitch 频道，或显示本机任意应用。搜索、排队和控制都无需离开游戏。需要 Windows 10 或 11 以及免费的 Brave 浏览器。使用 /matinee 打开。

Punchline.Original: Revisa Forsaken, Limit Cut y el timing de las acciones locales.
Punchline.Translated: 复盘遗弃末世、限制器减档及本地技能时序。

Description.Original: Midnight Timeline registra un timeline de acciones local ligero y proporciona evidencia retrospectiva de Forsaken y P3 Limit Cut en Dancing Mad.
Description.Translated: Midnight Timeline 记录轻量级本地技能时间轴，为妖星乱舞绝境战中的遗弃末世及 P3 限制器减档提供事后复盘依据。

Punchline.Original: Empty your retainer without emptying your patience.
Punchline.Translated: 清空雇员背包，不耗尽你的耐心。

Description.Original:
A panel that clips onto the retainer windows and does the fetching, stowing and pricing in bulk.

- Lists what is in the open retainer and what is in your own bags, with a search and a category filter
- Type an amount per item, or take everything the filters are showing, press OK, and the batch is carried across
- Works both ways: retrieve from the retainer, or stow into it
- Saved lists, either as an exact amount or as a 'top me up to N' target
- Build a list straight from a crafting recipe: pick the craft and the number of runs
- Put items up for sale undercutting the competition, with prices from universalis.app
- Reprice every listing of an item at once, which matters for things that can only be listed one at a time

You open the retainer yourself; the plugin never walks anywhere or clicks through NPC menus.

Every request is throttled and verified before the next is sent, and everything that changes game state goes through a single checked gateway: nothing is sent that the game's own interface would refuse. The first time you reprice or list something it changes one and stops, so you can confirm it took before the rest follows.
Description.Translated:
附在雇员窗口旁的面板，用于批量取物、存物和调价。

- 列出当前雇员和自身背包中的物品，支持搜索及分类筛选
- 为每件物品输入数量，或选择筛选后显示的全部内容，按下确认即可批量转移
- 支持双向操作：从雇员取出或存入雇员
- 保存清单，既可指定准确数量，也可设置“补足至 N 个”的目标
- 直接按制作配方生成清单：选择配方及制作次数
- 依据 universalis.app 价格，以低于竞争者的报价上架物品
- 一次调整同种物品的所有出售记录，对只能单件上架的物品尤其有用

雇员由你自行打开；插件不会自动走路，也不会替你点击 NPC 菜单。

每次请求均限速，并在验证完成后才发送下一次。所有改变游戏状态的操作都经过同一受检入口，不会发送游戏自身界面会拒绝的请求。首次调价或上架时，只处理一件便停止，让你确认生效后再继续其余操作。

Punchline.Original: Confirm before leaving Phantom Freelancer in Occult Crescent.
Punchline.Translated: 在新月岛切离辅助自由人前要求确认。

Description.Original: Asks for confirmation before leaving Phantom Freelancer in Occult Crescent
Description.Translated: 在新月岛从辅助自由人切换为其他辅助职业前，弹出确认提示。

Punchline.Original: Turns D-Pad and face buttons into configurable turbo (auto-repeat) buttons.
Punchline.Translated: 将方向键和手柄正面按钮设为可配置的连发按钮。

Description.Original: Lets you enable turbo (rapid-fire) behavior on the D-Pad and the four face buttons (North/South/West/East - Triangle/Cross/Square/Circle or Y/A/X/B) of your gamepad. While a turbo-enabled button is held, it pulses on/off at a per-button configurable press/release interval, so whatever action it's bound to in-game repeats automatically for as long as you hold it.
Description.Translated: 为手柄方向键及四个正面按钮（上/下/左/右，即 Triangle/Cross/Square/Circle 或 Y/A/X/B）启用连发。按住已启用连发的按钮时，会按该键单独设置的按下/松开间隔反复触发，使其绑定的游戏操作持续重复，直到松手。

Punchline.Original: Colorize your macro chat text.
Punchline.Translated: 为宏发送的聊天文字着色。

Description.Original: A private development plugin that recolors chat lines sent by your macros using <white>, <green>, <red>, <blue>, <yellow>, <purple>, <orange> and <#RRGGBB> tags. Coloring is local to your client. Use /prism to open the settings window.
Description.Translated: 私用开发插件，可用 <white>、<green>、<red>、<blue>、<yellow>、<purple>、<orange> 和 <#RRGGBB> 标签，为宏发送的聊天行着色。颜色仅在本地客户端显示。使用 /prism 打开设置窗口。

Punchline.Original: Aモブハントツアーの探索・記録・MAP共有を補助します。
Punchline.Translated: 辅助 A 级狩猎车的寻找、记录和地图分享。

Description.Original: Aモブハントツアーを補助するツール。Aモブ候補地点巡回、探索・討伐記録、MOBハント用リスト、MAPリンク共有、インスタンス記録・巡回に対応します。
Description.Translated: A 级狩猎车辅助工具。支持巡回检查 A 级怪物候选地点、记录寻找及击杀情况、狩猎目标列表、地图链接分享，以及场景分区记录和巡回。

Punchline.Original: 2台のDalamudをLANで双方向接続する汎用ブリッジ
Punchline.Translated: 通过局域网双向连接两台 Dalamud 的通用桥接工具。

Description.Original: 同じLAN内の2台のPC上のDalamud間で、任意メッセージを双方向送受信する汎用LANブリッジ。SND、ECHO、COMMAND、Dalamud IPCに対応。
Description.Translated: 在同一局域网内两台电脑的 Dalamud 之间双向收发任意消息。支持 SND、ECHO、COMMAND 和 Dalamud IPC。

Punchline.Original: Discontinued - replaced by SpotifyTrackHonorific.
Punchline.Translated: 已停止维护，已由 SpotifyTrackHonorific 取代。

Description.Original: Discontinued Discord Activity Honorific fork with Spotify Web API fallback for local files. Replaced by the standalone SpotifyTrackHonorific plugin.
Description.Translated: 已停止维护的 Discord Activity Honorific 分支，曾为本地文件提供 Spotify Web API 回退支持。现由独立插件 SpotifyTrackHonorific 取代。

Punchline.Original: Scan Free Companies on your PC, manage the list in-game.
Punchline.Translated: 在电脑上扫描部队，在游戏内管理列表。

Description.Original: Receives Free Company scan results from the FCGoblin desktop app and lists them in-game.
Description.Translated: 接收 FCGoblin 桌面应用的部队扫描结果，并在游戏内列出。

Punchline.Original: Show enemy spawn areas on the native map.
Punchline.Translated: 在原生地图上显示敌人刷新区域。

Description.Original: Click an enemy name in the hunting log, relic book, or other enemy lists to show its spawn area on the map. Relic book FATE clicks are optional and show FATE spawn areas, including prerequisite chains. Hunting log: click the name, not the icon. /efind opens settings; /efind Name looks up an enemy.
Description.Translated: 点击讨伐笔记、黄道文书或其他敌人列表中的名称，即可在地图上显示其刷新区域。可选启用黄道文书危命任务点击，显示任务刷新区域及前置链。讨伐笔记中请点击名称，而非图标。/efind 打开设置；/efind Name 查询敌人。

Punchline.Original: Instance guides, current-boss mechanics and observed combat guidance.
Punchline.Translated: 副本指南、当前首领机制，以及基于现场观察的战斗指引。

Description.Original: Automatic instance guides, concise boss mechanics and central combat alerts. Combines community sources with live observations, a 2D radar and a 3D overlay. Customizable layout and local AI model selection.
Description.Translated: 自动显示副本指南、精简首领机制和屏幕中央战斗警报。结合社区资料、实时观察、二维雷达和三维悬浮层。支持自定义布局及选择本地 AI 模型。

Punchline.Original: DMU P4 assignment helper.
Punchline.Translated: DMU P4 分工助手。

Description.Original: DMU P4 assignment helper with manual and automatic mechanic detection.
Description.Translated: DMU P4 分工助手，支持手动及自动机制识别。

Punchline.Original: Hear an orchestrion roll before you go and earn it.
Punchline.Translated: 先试听管弦乐谱，再决定是否去获取。

Description.Original: Preview any orchestrion roll before you go and earn it. Right-click a roll in your bags for a small player, or open the browser and search every track in the game — including the ones you do not own yet. The zone music steps aside while you listen and comes back when you stop.
Description.Translated: 获取之前即可试听任意管弦乐谱。右键背包中的乐谱打开小播放器，或打开浏览器搜索游戏全部曲目，包括尚未拥有的曲目。试听时暂停区域音乐，结束后恢复。

Punchline.Original: A rotation coach that is trying to become unnecessary.
Punchline.Translated: 一位努力让你不再需要它的循环教练。

Description.Original: Learn your rotation instead of following a highlight. Start a practice run on a striking dummy and Miyagi walks you through the opener a button at a time, lighting up the next key on your own hotbar. Then it fades: it waits for you to hesitate, then only corrects you, then goes quiet and tells you afterwards what the run actually cost — uptime, casts you cancelled by moving, cooldowns you sat on. Black Mage at level 100.
Description.Translated: 学会自己的循环，而不是只跟着高亮按键。对木人开始练习后，Miyagi 会逐个亮起你快捷栏上的下一个技能，引导完成起手。随后逐渐减少帮助：先等你犹豫时才提示，再变为只纠正错误，最后完全安静，并在结束后告诉你这一轮实际损失在哪里——有效输出时间、因移动而取消的施法，以及迟迟没用的冷却技能。适用于 100 级黑魔法师。

Punchline.Original: Shows what you're watching on Plex, in-game.
Punchline.Translated: 在游戏内显示你正在 Plex 观看的内容。

Description.Original: Polls your Plex Media Server and displays the currently playing movie or episode, with play state and progress, in your own nameplate and the server info bar. Sharing this with other players requires the separate Honorific plugin.
Description.Translated: 轮询 Plex Media Server，在你自己的姓名牌和服务器信息栏中显示正在播放的电影或剧集，以及播放状态和进度。若要让其他玩家看到，需要另装 Honorific 插件。

Punchline.Original: Your duty diary - history, stats, loot and queue times in one window.
Punchline.Translated: 你的副本日记——一个窗口查看历史、统计、掉落和排队时间。

Description.Original: Logs the duty instances you complete, plus rare loot, queue times, and roulette bonuses.
Description.Translated: 记录已完成的副本，以及稀有掉落、排队时间和随机任务奖励。

Punchline.Original: Community translations for Wrath Combo, as a separate plugin.
Punchline.Translated: 以独立插件形式提供 Wrath Combo 社区翻译。

Description.Original: Overlays translated strings onto Wrath Combo's UI without modifying Wrath Combo itself. Translations live in loose JSON files, so they can be edited and reloaded in-game.
Description.Translated: 将译文叠加在 Wrath Combo 界面上，而不修改 Wrath Combo 本身。译文存放在独立 JSON 文件中，可直接编辑并在游戏内重新加载。

Punchline.Original: Text-to-speech callouts for boss abilities in duties and open-world encounters.
Punchline.Translated: 为副本及野外战斗中的首领技能提供语音合成提示。

Description.Original:
Listens for dangerous enemy abiltiies and announces it via Text to Speech (TTS). Allows creation of custom warnings on a per ability basis

Commands:
/vcallouts - Toggles the main status window.
/vcallouts custom - Opens the Custom Warnings window to browse, filter, and edit your warnings.
/vcallouts newcustom - Quickly adds a warning for the most recently heard ability.
/vcallouts blacklistlast - Silences the most recently heard ability for good.
Description.Translated:
监听敌人的危险技能，并通过文本转语音（TTS）播报。可按技能创建自定义警告。

命令：
/vcallouts - 打开或关闭主状态窗口。
/vcallouts custom - 打开自定义警告窗口，浏览、筛选和编辑警告。
/vcallouts newcustom - 为最近检测到的技能快速添加警告。
/vcallouts blacklistlast - 永久静音最近检测到的技能。

Punchline.Original: Track Deep Dungeons, including Pilgrim’s Traverse and duo estimates.
Punchline.Translated: 追踪深层迷宫，支持 Pilgrim’s Traverse 及双人评分估算。

Description.Original: Track solo and party runs, floor statistics, and score estimates. Independent community preview. Pilgrim’s Traverse scoring is provisional. Open settings with /ddtp.
Description.Translated: 追踪单人和组队挑战、楼层统计及分数估算。独立社区预览版，Pilgrim’s Traverse 的评分规则仍为暂定。使用 /ddtp 打开设置。

Name.Translated: 深层迷宫追踪 — Pilgrim & Party

Punchline.Original: Multi-venue operations console.
Punchline.Translated: 多场所运营控制台。

Description.Original: Venue-scoped operations, promotion, and backend-compatible venue games. Working modules: Attendance, Greeter, VIP, ShoutRunner, Party Finder, Mair's Trivia, Mair's Editor. Raffle, Bingo, and TournamentControl are included but disabled by default — see the README for status.
Description.Translated: 提供按场所独立管理的运营、推广，以及兼容后端的场所游戏。已可用模块包括签到、迎宾、VIP、ShoutRunner、招募队员、Mair's Trivia 和 Mair's Editor。抽奖、宾果和 TournamentControl 已包含但默认禁用，具体状态请参阅 README。

Punchline.Original: Automatic friendly mouseover casting with no spell lists.
Punchline.Translated: 无需技能列表的自动友方鼠标指向施法。

Description.Original: Automatic friendly casting through native unit frames, with no spell lists or macros. Includes strict invalid-recipient protection, self-cast and bypass modifiers, useful cast history, checked recovery, and optional ground placement at hovered allies. Keeps your selected target and native action queue.
Description.Translated: 通过原生单位框体自动选择鼠标指向的友方施法，无需技能列表或宏。提供严格的无效目标保护、自身施法及绕过修饰键、实用施法历史、经过检查的恢复机制，以及可选的在悬停队友位置施放地面技能。保留当前选中目标及原生技能队列。

Punchline.Original: Browse FFXIV's wardrobe like a boutique.
Punchline.Translated: 像逛精品店一样浏览 FFXIV 衣装。

Description.Original: Browse FFXIV equipment like a boutique, preview items and dyes instantly, organize Favorites and Designs, use the Crystal Wardrobe, and view offline acquisition information.
Description.Translated: 像逛精品店一样浏览 FFXIV 装备，即时预览物品和染色，整理收藏与设计，使用 Crystal Wardrobe，并离线查看获取途径。

Punchline.Original: Offset, save, and replay poses; auto-discover Penumbra animation mods.
Punchline.Translated: 调整姿势偏移、保存并重放，自动发现 Penumbra 动画模组。

Description.Original: Animation Assistance Plugin, offset your character's pose, save named presets and replay them, auto-discover Penumbra pose mods, and manually resync emote timing with a partner.
Description.Translated: 动画辅助插件，可调整角色姿势偏移、保存命名预设并重放，自动发现 Penumbra 姿势模组，并手动与搭档重新同步情感动作时序。

Punchline.Original: Consent-based Owner/Sub control: outfit, title, gesture, and leash.
Punchline.Translated: 基于双方同意的 Owner/Sub 控制：服装、称号、动作和牵引。

Description.Original: A consent-based collar control plugin. An Owner sends outfit, title, gesture, and follow/leash commands as ordinary in-game tells - no server, no hosting; the Sub's own client watches for them and applies them locally via Glamourer, Honorific, and Penumbra, and existing sync tooling propagates the result to everyone paired with the Sub.
Description.Translated: 基于双方同意的项圈控制插件。Owner 通过普通游戏私聊发送服装、称号、动作和跟随/牵引命令，无需服务器或托管；Sub 自己的客户端检测这些命令，并通过 Glamourer、Honorific 和 Penumbra 在本地应用，现有同步工具再将结果传播给与 Sub 配对的玩家。

Punchline.Original: What to flip right now.
Punchline.Translated: 现在倒卖什么最合适。

Description.Original: TSM-inspired FFXIV market flip ranker: auto-logged journal, Universalis-powered FlipScore, and a minimal price DSL. Read-only + user-clicks only.
Description.Translated: 受 TSM 启发的 FFXIV 市场倒卖机会排行工具：自动交易日志、基于 Universalis 的 FlipScore，以及精简价格表达式语言。仅提供只读功能和用户主动点击的操作。

Description.Original: Automate the Gil sending process to send amounts over the maximum using /giltrade <amount>. Fork maintained by kuchris for Dalamud API 15.
Description.Translated: 通过 /giltrade <amount> 自动执行金币交付流程，分批发送超过单次上限的金额。由 kuchris 维护的 Dalamud API 15 分支。

Punchline.Original: Trading Gil quickly because time is money.
Punchline.Translated: 快速交易金币，毕竟时间就是金钱。

Punchline.Original: A polished, temporary gear-set launcher.
Punchline.Translated: 精致、按需弹出的套装启动面板。

Description.Original: Opens a compact native-icon launcher with R3, captures only its D-pad and action buttons while active, supports multiple exact gear sets per job, and keeps controller focus distinct from data-driven role hues.
Description.Translated: 按 R3 打开带原生图标的紧凑启动面板；激活期间只接管其方向键和操作按钮。支持每个职业的多套独立套装，并将手柄焦点提示与按数据决定的职能配色清晰区分。

Punchline.Original: Keep your plugin installs in sync across all your systems.
Punchline.Translated: 在所有设备之间同步已安装插件。

Description.Original: Have you ever logged in on another machine and realized half your plugins are missing? PluginSync compares the plugins installed on this machine with the plugin list you synced from your other setup, shows exactly what's missing (and what's extra), and lets you install the missing ones with one click — including plugins from third-party repos, which are added automatically (AutoDuty-style). Sync your plugin list via a local file, any raw-text URL, or catbox.moe (no account needed).
Description.Translated: 是否在另一台电脑登录后才发现一半插件不见了？PluginSync 将本机已安装插件与另一套环境同步来的列表比较，清楚显示缺少和多出的插件，并可一键安装缺项，包括自动添加第三方仓库的插件，方式类似 AutoDuty。可通过本地文件、任意纯文本 URL 或 catbox.moe 同步插件列表，无需账户。

Punchline.Original: Standalone S-rank travel, parking, tagging, and recovery.
Punchline.Translated: 独立的 S 级狩猎移动、停驻、摸怪和异常恢复工具。

Description.Original: Consumes HuntAlerts and Sonar S-rank reports, travels safely through normal World Visit and vnavmesh, retries missing entities and routes without false-clearing, requires positive kill evidence, queues later hunts, and performs one gated ranged tag.
Description.Translated: 接收 HuntAlerts 和 Sonar 的 S 级报告，通过普通跨服系统和 vnavmesh 安全移动；对象或路线暂缺时重试，不会误判已完成；要求明确的击杀证据，支持后续狩猎排队，并在条件检查通过后执行一次远程攻击以取得击杀贡献。

Punchline.Original: A clean, safety-first S-rank hunting beta.
Punchline.Translated: 简洁、安全优先的 S 级狩猎测试版。

Description.Original: Independent Sentinel hunt plugin with Sonar and HuntAlerts intake, expansion filters, a persistent FIFO queue, Ul'dah world travel through Lifestream, vnavmesh flight and protected 25-yalm parking, WAR Tomahawk tagging at 95% HP, incidental-aggro handling, and death recovery. Automation is off by default; direct Faloop input is planned.
Description.Translated: 独立的 Sentinel 狩猎插件，接收 Sonar 和 HuntAlerts 信息，支持资料片筛选、持久化先进先出队列、通过 Lifestream 在乌尔达哈跨服、vnavmesh 飞行及带保护措施的 25 星码外停驻，在目标 HP 达到 95% 时使用战士飞斧摸怪，处理意外仇恨和死亡恢复。自动化默认关闭，计划加入 Faloop 直连输入。

Punchline.Original: Automatically strips a character's gear to Smallclothes or the Emperor's Set when a specified emote or action is used.
Punchline.Translated: 使用指定情感动作或技能时，自动将角色装备变为内衣或皇帝的新装。

Description.Original: Automatically changes a character's gear via Glamourer to Smallclothes or the Emperor's New Set when specified emotes or combat actions are used, with per-slot control, delay, and duration options, then reverts back to normal gear.
Description.Translated: 使用指定情感动作或战斗技能时，通过 Glamourer 自动将角色装备替换为内衣或皇帝的新装，可按部位控制，并设置延迟和持续时间，之后恢复正常装备。

Punchline.Original: Temporary groups for locked instances!
Punchline.Translated: 在封闭副本中也能使用临时群聊！

Description.Original: Create a temporary chats for you and your friends, that are working inside a duty or locked instances. Add how many people u want, and manage it from there.
Description.Translated: 为你和朋友创建在副本或封闭场景中仍可使用的临时聊天群。按需添加成员并管理群聊。

Punchline.Original: Automation utilities for FFXIV
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 自动化实用工具。

Description.Original: Quality of life automation features including auto Priority Aetheryte Pass usage (/passauto) and auto-cancel Jog buff after Sprint expires (/nojog).
Description.Translated: 提供便利性自动化功能，包括自动使用传送优惠（/passauto），以及冲刺结束后自动取消慢跑增益（/nojog）。

Punchline.Original: Highlights the items and gear you no longer need.
Punchline.Translated: 高亮显示不再需要的物品和装备。

Description.Original: Paste Teamcraft's inventory-cleanup list and Cratools fades the inventory slots you need to keep, so the removable items stand out. The armory cleanup scan marks gear no class you play can wear, or that you already own something better than, and tints it in the Armoury Chest. Read-only: it never moves or discards anything.
Description.Translated: 粘贴 Teamcraft 的背包清理清单后，Cratools 会淡化需要保留的格子，使可清理物品更醒目。兵装库清理扫描会标记你所玩职业均无法装备、或已有更好替代品的装备，并在兵装库中着色。仅读取，绝不移动或丢弃物品。

Punchline.Original: Soft Safety Lock to prevent accidental in-game interactions
Punchline.Translated: 防止误触游戏交互的软安全锁。

Description.Original: Blocks vendor windows, duty finder interactions, and quest acceptance dialogs when enabled. Use /safetylock to toggle. Features enable-on-startup and individual feature toggles.
Description.Translated: 启用时阻止商店窗口、任务搜索器交互和接受任务对话框。使用 /safetylock 切换。支持启动时启用，以及各项功能独立开关。

Punchline.Original: Drive FFXIV from a Stream Deck.
Punchline.Translated: 通过 Stream Deck 控制 FFXIV。

Description.Original: Exposes a local API that a companion Elgato Stream Deck plugin talks to. Provides auto-populated browsers for every emote, mount and minion you own, plus live status readouts on deck keys. Open /ttd for a link to download that companion plugin.
Description.Translated: 提供本地 API，供配套 Elgato Stream Deck 插件连接。自动列出已拥有的全部情感动作、坐骑和宠物，并在 Stream Deck 按键上显示实时状态。使用 /ttd 获取配套插件下载链接。

Punchline.Original: Change 3rd person camera angle depending on camera zoom.
Punchline.Translated: 根据镜头缩放调整第三人称镜头角度。

Description.Original:
Change the 3rd person camera angle character config setting depending how zoomed in you are.
Zoom out, and you will be able to see more of the world. Zoom in, the camera will be focused on your character.
Description.Translated:
根据镜头拉近程度，调整角色设置中的第三人称镜头角度。
拉远时能看到更多周围世界，拉近时则聚焦角色。

Punchline.Original: Parece que va a llover.
Punchline.Translated: 看起来要下雨了。

Description.Original: It just a LunoBox
Description.Translated: 这只是一个 LunoBox。

Punchline.Original: The next Aetherphone, before everyone else.
Punchline.Translated: 抢先体验下一代 Aetherphone。

Description.Original: The beta channel for Aetherphone: builds straight off the development branch, installed side by side with the stable plugin so you can test what is coming next without giving up the phone you use every day.
Description.Translated: Aetherphone 测试通道：直接由开发分支构建，可与稳定版并列安装，让你测试即将到来的功能，同时保留日常使用的版本。

Punchline.Original: Create and track personalized timers in FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: 在 FFXIV 中创建并追踪个人计时器。

Description.Original: Create persistent manual and game-linked countdown timers with configurable alerts, snooze controls, and an in-game overlay.
Description.Translated: 创建可持久保存的手动或游戏联动倒计时，支持可配置提醒、稍后提醒，以及游戏内悬浮层。

Punchline.Original: Clears out your junk and puts the rest away.
Punchline.Translated: 清理杂物，把其余物品归位。

Description.Original:
Gleam cleans and organizes your inventory, and does the walking itself.

Clean: it finds junk in your bags, armoury chest, saddlebag, retainers and glamour dresser and shows it in one list. You choose whether to sell on the market board, sell to vendors or discard, then press one button.

Organize: layouts move the items you keep to where you want them. For example, materia to the saddlebag, spare gear to a retainer and gear-set pieces to the armoury chest.

Nothing is changed until you press the button. Items that will be cleaned or moved are highlighted in the game's bag windows. Gleam then opens the saddlebag, travels to an inn for your retainers and the dresser, and visits your Grand Company when something is to be turned in.

Please note: Gleam moves your character and clicks through the game's menus for you. Square Enix's terms of service do not allow third-party tools, and automation is what they act against most. Use it at your own risk. Organizing is still a preview and has not had a full test in game.

Commands: /gleam or /gl. Sub-commands: organize, history, settings, stop, selftest, report.

Plugins Gleam needs:
vnavmesh walks your character from place to place. Gleam needs it.
Lifestream teleports between aetherytes and into inns. Without it, start a run while you are already in an inn.

Optional:
AutoRetainer lets Gleam discard junk after each retainer's ventures.
Allagan Tools shows retainer contents without summoning them.
Market prices come from Universalis and need an internet connection.
Description.Translated:
Gleam 清理并整理物品，还会自行走到所需地点。

清理：从背包、兵装库、陆行鸟鞍囊、雇员和投影台中找出杂物，并集中列出。你选择在市场布告板出售、卖给商店或丢弃，再按一次按钮执行。

整理：按布局将保留物品移动到指定位置，例如魔晶石放鞍囊、备用装备放雇员、套装装备放兵装库。

按下按钮前不会改变任何内容。待清理或移动的物品会在游戏背包窗口中高亮。随后 Gleam 打开鞍囊，前往旅馆处理雇员及投影台，需交纳物品时还会前往大国防联军。

请注意：Gleam 会代你移动角色和点击游戏菜单。Square Enix 服务条款不允许第三方工具，而自动化尤其容易受到处罚。使用风险自负。整理功能仍为预览版，尚未经过完整的游戏内测试。

命令：/gleam 或 /gl。子命令：organize、history、settings、stop、selftest、report。

所需插件：
vnavmesh 负责在各地点间步行，为必需依赖。
Lifestream 负责以太之光传送及进入旅馆；没有它时，需先身处旅馆再开始运行。

可选：
AutoRetainer 允许在每名雇员完成探险后由 Gleam 丢弃杂物。
Allagan Tools 可在不召唤雇员时显示其物品。
市场价格来自 Universalis，需要联网。

Punchline.Original: Quietly updates old Penumbra mods to Dawntrail when you import them.
Punchline.Translated: 导入旧 Penumbra 模组时，静默更新以适配《金曦之遗辉》。

Description.Original:
Updates mods made before Dawntrail (7.0) the same way TexTools does, without TexTools. Requires Penumbra.

- Import a mod in Penumbra as usual: if it was made before Dawntrail, its models, materials and textures are updated in the background and Penumbra reloads it. Nothing to click.
- Scan your whole Penumbra library, see which mods are pre-Dawntrail, and update them all at once.
- Convert a .pmp or .ttmp2 file: the updated copy is saved next to it as "(Dawntrail).pmp" and imported into Penumbra.

Mods that already work in Dawntrail are never touched. Files are changed in place and no backup is kept.

Commands: /dtready (window), /dtready scan, /dtready convert <file>

The conversion is ported from TexTools' xivModdingFramework. Dawntrail Ready is free software under the GPL-3.0, like TexTools.
Description.Translated:
无需安装 TexTools，即可按与其相同的方法更新《金曦之遗辉》（7.0）之前制作的模组。需要 Penumbra。

- 像往常一样在 Penumbra 导入模组：若模组来自 7.0 以前，便会在后台更新模型、材质和纹理，然后由 Penumbra 重新加载，无需点击。
- 扫描整个 Penumbra 模组库，查看哪些模组来自 7.0 以前，并一次性全部更新。
- 转换 .pmp 或 .ttmp2 文件：更新副本以“(Dawntrail).pmp”保存到原文件旁，并导入 Penumbra。

已经兼容《金曦之遗辉》的模组绝不修改。文件会原地改写，不保留备份。

命令：/dtready（窗口）、/dtready scan、/dtready convert <file>

转换功能移植自 TexTools 的 xivModdingFramework。Dawntrail Ready 与 TexTools 一样，采用 GPL-3.0 许可的自由软件。

Punchline.Original: Tracks equipment spiritbond growth during duties.
Punchline.Translated: 追踪副本中的装备精炼度增长。

Description.Original: Tracks equipment spiritbond increases during duties, groups them by instance, and monitors active spiritbond buffs. Use /spiritbond to open the menu.
Description.Translated: 追踪副本中装备精炼度的增加，按副本分组，并监测生效中的精炼度增益。使用 /spiritbond 打开菜单。

Punchline.Original: Roleplay chat assistance powered by AI.
Punchline.Translated: 由 AI 驱动的角色扮演聊天辅助。

Description.Original:
AIRoleplay helps draft in-character game chat replies using recent chat context and a configurable character prompt.

Commands:
/airp - Open AIRoleplay.
/airp [message] - Generate in the selected mode.
/airp r [name] [instruction] - Switch to reply assist and draft a reply.
/airp status - Show the current mode and auto response settings.
/airp help - Show this command list.
Description.Translated:
AIRoleplay 根据近期聊天上下文和可配置的角色提示词，帮助起草符合角色设定的游戏聊天回复。

命令：
/airp - 打开 AIRoleplay。
/airp [message] - 以所选模式生成内容。
/airp r [name] [instruction] - 切换至回复辅助并起草回复。
/airp status - 显示当前模式和自动回复设置。
/airp help - 显示此命令列表。

Punchline.Original: 妖怪武器の取得状況とレジェンドメダル対象地域を一覧表示します。
Punchline.Translated: 列出妖怪武器获取情况，以及对应传奇徽章的可获取区域。

Description.Original: 妖怪ウォッチコラボの全17武器について、取得済みチェックを保存し、対応する妖怪レジェンドメダルが入手できるF.A.T.E.地域を表示します。
Description.Translated: 为妖怪手表联动的全部 17 把武器保存已获取勾选状态，并显示可获得对应妖怪传奇徽章的危命任务区域。

Name.Original: 妖怪ウォッチ 武器進捗
Name.Translated: 妖怪ウォッチ 武器進捗

Punchline.Original: Your media. Your friends. One screen. Watch together anywhere in Eorzea.
Punchline.Translated: 你的媒体、你的朋友、一块屏幕。在艾欧泽亚任何地方一起观看。

Description.Original: Synchronized local, web, Plex, and live screen-sharing watch parties for FFXIV.
Description.Translated: 为 FFXIV 提供同步观看本地媒体、网页、Plex 及实时屏幕分享的观看派对。

Punchline.Original: Walk or run depending on how far you press.
Punchline.Translated: 根据按键按下的深度，决定步行还是奔跑。

Description.Original: Analog movement for keyboards with analog keys (Wooting, Razer Analog, DrunkDeer, NuPhy, Keychron HE and others). Press a movement key lightly to walk, fully to run.
Description.Translated: 为支持模拟输入的键盘提供模拟移动，包括 Wooting、Razer Analog、DrunkDeer、NuPhy、Keychron HE 等。轻按移动键步行，按到底奔跑。

Punchline.Original: Correctly places your character's feet on the ground in real time.
Punchline.Translated: 实时让角色双脚正确贴合地面。

Description.Original: Real-time inverse kinematics for your character. Bends the legs against the game's world so the feet rest on slopes and steps instead of clipping through or floating, lean into slopes while running, and many other features.
Description.Translated: 为角色提供实时逆向运动学。根据游戏地形调整腿部，使双脚落在斜坡和台阶上，而不是穿模或悬空；奔跑时可顺坡倾斜，并提供多种其他功能。

Punchline.Original: A personal collection of quality of life tweaks.
Punchline.Translated: 个人常用的便利性调整合集。

Description.Original: Small quality of life tweaks, each one individually toggleable. Configured through a native game window.
Description.Translated: 一组便利性小调整，每项均可独立开关，通过原生游戏窗口配置。

Punchline.Original: Play your own voicelines when you use an action.
Punchline.Translated: 使用技能时播放自定义语音。

Description.Original: Plays user-supplied audio clips in 3D space when you use actions. Clips are mapped per action and per character voice type from an in-game editor.
Description.Translated: 使用技能时，在三维空间中播放用户提供的音频片段。可在游戏内编辑器中按技能和角色声音类型分别设置音频。

Punchline.Original: Watch a Kosmi room together, in-game.
Punchline.Translated: 在游戏内一起观看 Kosmi 房间。

Description.Original:
Puts a Kosmi room on a screen inside FFXIV, joining as a real Kosmi guest via a
sandboxed out-of-process browser, so playback stays perfectly synced with the rest of the room.

Commands:
/wa - toggle the main viewer/control window
/wa view - open the main window
/wa join <kosmi url or WA1: invite> - join a room, or accept an invite (with confirmation)
/wa settings - open Settings (identity, volume/mute, join/leave, invite, screen placement)
/wa invite - copy a shareable invite for your current room and screen
/wa sync <WA1P: message> - apply a shared screen position (with confirmation)
/wa place - open the screen placement window
/wa focus - snap the camera to a fullscreen view of your placed screen (move to exit)
/wa forgetvenues - forget every remembered watch-along room (stops auto-rejoining any of them)
/wa vol <0-150> - set volume
/wa mute - toggle mute
/wa snapshot - save a debug screenshot + DOM outline
Description.Translated:
将 Kosmi 房间显示在 FFXIV 内的屏幕上，通过沙盒化的独立进程浏览器以真正的 Kosmi 访客身份加入，确保与房间其他观众保持同步播放。

命令：
/wa - 打开或关闭主观看/控制窗口
/wa view - 打开主窗口
/wa join <kosmi url or WA1: invite> - 加入房间或接受邀请，需要确认
/wa settings - 打开设置，包括身份、音量/静音、加入/离开、邀请和屏幕摆放
/wa invite - 复制可分享的当前房间及屏幕邀请
/wa sync <WA1P: message> - 应用共享屏幕位置，需要确认
/wa place - 打开屏幕摆放窗口
/wa focus - 将相机切至已摆放屏幕的全屏视角，移动即可退出
/wa forgetvenues - 忘记所有记住的共看房间，停止自动重连它们
/wa vol <0-150> - 设置音量
/wa mute - 切换静音
/wa snapshot - 保存调试截图及 DOM 概览

Punchline.Original: Reacts to emotes performed on you with a temporary Glamourer design and Moodle.
Punchline.Translated: 别人对你使用情感动作时，以临时 Glamourer 设计和 Moodle 状态作出回应。

Description.Original: Listens for emotes targeted at you and applies a configured Glamourer design and Moodles status in response, automatically reverting the Glamourer design after a set duration.
Description.Translated: 监听以你为目标的情感动作，应用配置好的 Glamourer 设计及 Moodles 状态作为回应，并在指定时间后自动还原 Glamourer 设计。

Punchline.Original: Shift search comment and online status by zone, activity, and schedule.
Punchline.Translated: 根据区域、活动和时间安排切换搜索备注及在线状态。

Description.Original: Rules change your search comment, online status, and optional commands from zone, duty, activity, job, world, and schedule.
Description.Translated: 通过规则，根据区域、副本、活动、职业、服务器和时间安排，修改搜索备注、在线状态，并可执行指定命令。

Punchline.Original: Browse the Eorzean mod archive without leaving the game.
Punchline.Translated: 无需离开游戏，即可浏览艾欧泽亚模组档案库。

Description.Original: A polished, provider-based in-game catalog for discovering Final Fantasy XIV mods.
Description.Translated: 精致的游戏内模组目录，支持不同内容来源，帮助发现《最终幻想14》模组。

Punchline.Original: FFXIV connection diagnostics with ping history and endpoint detection.
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 连接诊断，支持延迟历史和服务器端点检测。

Description.Original: A local FFXIV network diagnostics plugin. It monitors a configured or detected endpoint, stores session history, provides manual route testing, and can experimentally detect the active game endpoint.
Description.Translated: 本地 FFXIV 网络诊断插件。监控配置或检测到的服务器端点、保存会话历史、提供手动路由测试，并实验性支持检测当前游戏连接端点。

Punchline.Original: Formes, bordures, taille précise et disposition de vos dix barres d'actions.
Punchline.Translated: 调整十条快捷栏的形状、边框、精确尺寸和布局。

Description.Original: 12 formes, 15 bordures réglables, zoom des illustrations, taille précise et disposition libre. Presets, édition groupée, profils par job ou personnage, visibilité contextuelle et partage avec aperçu. Fenêtre fermée au chargement ; application automatique optionnelle. Version expérimentale à valider en jeu. /hotbaratelier pour les réglages ; /hotbaratelier off pour restaurer. Version expérimentale ; essais en jeu encore à confirmer.
Description.Translated: 提供 12 种形状、15 种可调边框、图标缩放、精确尺寸及自由布局。支持预设、批量编辑、按职业或角色保存配置、按场景控制可见性，以及带预览的分享。加载时窗口默认关闭，可选择自动应用。使用 /hotbaratelier 打开设置，/hotbaratelier off 还原。实验版本，游戏内测试仍待确认。

Punchline.Original: Vos tâches Codex, directement dans FF14.
Punchline.Translated: 直接在 FF14 中查看 Codex 任务。

Description.Original: Affiche les tâches Codex du PC, leurs états et les demandes d'intervention. Nécessite le relais local Codex Monitor. Version expérimentale ; essais en jeu encore à confirmer. Node.js 22.22.2 minimum et Codex sont nécessaires ; le quota utilise le CLI Codex connecté. Aucune relance nécessaire avec le relais 0.11.0 déjà actif. Si votre relais est plus ancien, relancez le relais intégré depuis Réglages → Connexion ; un relais externe se met à jour et se relance depuis son dossier.
