Your inventory, your way — a Baldur's Gate-style inventory window for FFXIV.

• Multiselect: click, Ctrl+Click, Shift+Click ranges, Ctrl+A — then move everything in one click.
• Your own layout: drag-arranged custom order that ignores the game's slot shuffle, plus sort by type, name, item level, rarity, and more, with search and category filters.
• Rarity-colored tiles, rich tooltips, gearset badges, HQ marks.
• Ctrl+Click instant move to the open retainer or saddlebag; send gear to its correct armoury slot.
• Wares: mark your to-sell pile (with live market-vs-vendor comparison via universalis.app).
• Utilities: reviewable bulk actions — clean out your armoury chest, auto-mark vendor trash — every step previewed before it runs.
• Use items and assign hotbar slots from the window.

Every action maps to a normal player click, validated by the game — BladUI saves clicks, never automates.
Description.Translated:
背包由你做主——FFXIV 的《博德之门》风格背包窗口。

• 多选：单击、Ctrl+Click、Shift+Click 范围选择、Ctrl+A，选好后一键移动。
• 自定义布局：拖动排列的顺序不受游戏槽位变化影响；也可按类型、名称、品级、稀有度等排序，支持搜索与分类筛选。
• 按稀有度着色的物品格、详细提示、装备套装徽标和 HQ 标记。
• Ctrl+Click 立即移入已打开的雇员背包或陆行鸟鞍囊；装备可送入兵装库的对应部位。
• 待售物品：标记要出售的物品，并通过 universalis.app 实时比较市场价与 NPC 收购价。
• 实用工具：可审查的批量操作，包括清理兵装库、自动标记适合卖给 NPC 的杂物，每一步执行前都有预览。
• 可直接在窗口内使用物品或将其放到热键栏。

每项操作都对应正常玩家点击，由游戏验证。BladUI 只是减少点击，不会自动操作。

Punchline.Original: Say hello and thank your party with one command, or automatically in duties.
Punchline.Translated: 一条命令向队友问好或致谢，也可在副本中自动发送。

Description.Original:
Polite Eorzea sends a greeting or a farewell to your party (or alliance) from your own list of messages.

• /hi and /bye send a random greeting or farewell right away.
• Auto mode greets when you enter an instanced duty and says thanks when it completes.
• Picks party or alliance chat automatically; skips solo duties.
• Fully editable message lists, delays and triggers in /polite.
Description.Translated:
Polite Eorzea 从你自己的消息列表中选取问候或道别语，发送给小队或团队。

• /hi 和 /bye 立即发送随机问候或道别。
• 自动模式在进入副本时问好，完成副本时致谢。
• 自动选择小队或团队聊天，跳过单人副本。
• 在 /polite 中可完整编辑消息列表、延迟和触发条件。

Punchline.Original: Play Final Fantasy XIV in your language with community translations.
Punchline.Translated: 借助社区翻译，用你的语言游玩《最终幻想14》。

Description.Original: Shows Final Fantasy XIV in another language using community translations. Add a translation from the link or file its author gives you, turn it on, and restart the game. Translations update themselves. Characters the game's own fonts don't have, such as Cyrillic in window titles, need Penumbra.
Description.Translated: 使用社区翻译，将《最终幻想14》显示为另一种语言。通过作者提供的链接或文件添加翻译，启用后重启游戏。译文会自动更新。游戏自带字体缺少的字符，例如窗口标题中的西里尔字母，需要 Penumbra 支持。

Name.Original: Blue Mage & Beastmaster Helper（国服维护版）

Punchline.Original: Share your screen, a window, or your audio with others in a public or private room.
Punchline.Translated: 在公开或私人房间中与他人共享屏幕、窗口或音频。

Description.Original: Create or join a public or private room (optionally password protected) to share a monitor or a specific window - plus system or per-application audio - with other players, rendered directly in-game.
Description.Translated: 创建或加入公开/私人房间（可设密码），与其他玩家共享整块显示器或指定窗口，以及系统音频或单个应用的音频，内容直接在游戏内显示。

Punchline.Original: Fill the party lead checklist from your party and alliance.
Punchline.Translated: 根据小队和团队成员自动填写领队检查清单。

Description.Original: Party leads: pick a run and roster from lfg.0xc4.net, and the plugin ticks Joined on the party lead checklist as roster members join your party or alliance. Needs a plugin token from your profile page on lfg.0xc4.net.
Description.Translated: 领队从 lfg.0xc4.net 选择活动与名单后，名单成员加入你的小队或团队时，插件会在领队清单中勾选 Joined。需要从 lfg.0xc4.net 个人资料页获取插件令牌。

Punchline.Original: A shopping list and retainer tracker for crafters.
Punchline.Translated: 生产职业的采购清单与雇员库存追踪工具。

Description.Original: Know what you need, what you have, and where it's cheapest. Bagcheck keeps count; you do the shopping.
Description.Translated: 知道缺什么、有什么、哪里买最便宜。Bagcheck 负责统计，你负责购物。

Punchline.Original: Save and restore your adventurer plate.
Punchline.Translated: 保存并恢复冒险者铭牌。

Description.Original: Save your adventurer plate's portrait and design, and put them back in one click.
Description.Translated: 保存冒险者铭牌的肖像与设计，一键恢复。

Punchline.Original: Turns FFXIV chat invites into a month calendar you accept yourself.
Punchline.Translated: 将 FFXIV 聊天中的活动邀请整理为月历，由你亲自接受。

Description.Original:
Shout Calendar listens to the chats you choose and keeps event invites on a month calendar until you accept them. Nothing is accepted for you, and nothing is sent to other players.

It understands clocks, dates, today, tonight, tomorrow, next Tuesday, the Tuesday after next, every Tuesday, every other week, and the 1st and last Wednesday of a month. Places include wards, plots such as W3P26, coordinates, worlds, and names from the game's own data. A ward heard in a city guesses that city's housing district.

Save accepts a pending invite. Click a block to edit it under the month, or click the day number for that day's full list. Coordinates open the map with a flag. Known quest givers do the same, and quest names drop a quest link into chat.

The Resets tab adds Jumbo Cactpot, the weekly reset, and limited events such as A Nocturne for Heroes. Resets that share a clock share one line. Alarms play a chat sound from se.1 to se.16, or a WAV you choose. Colors are yours to set.

/shoutcalendar opens the calendar. /shoutcalendar test checks a line on your machine and does not send chat.
Description.Translated:
Shout Calendar 监听你选定的聊天频道，将活动邀请保留在月历中，等待你接受。不会替你接受任何邀请，也不会向其他玩家发送消息。

支持识别时间、日期、今天、今晚、明天、下周二、下下周二、每周二、隔周，以及每月第一个和最后一个周三。地点可包含住宅区分区、W3P26 这样的房屋编号、坐标、服务器及游戏数据中的地名。在城市中听到分区信息时，会推测为该城市的住宅区。

点击保存即可接受待处理邀请。点击日历块可在月历下方编辑，点击日期数字可查看当天完整列表。坐标会打开地图并插旗；已知任务发布者也支持此操作，任务名则会在聊天中插入任务链接。

重置标签页可添加仙人仙彩、每周重置，以及英雄挽歌等限时活动。重置时间相同的项目合并为一行。提醒音可使用 se.1 至 se.16 聊天音效，或你选择的 WAV 文件。颜色可以自行设置。

/shoutcalendar 打开日历。/shoutcalendar test 在本机测试一行文字，不会发送聊天。

Punchline.Original: Optional sharing companion. Requires Shout Calendar.
Punchline.Translated: 可选的共享配套插件，需要 Shout Calendar。

Description.Original:
Requires Shout Calendar to be installed and enabled. Shout Calendar Sync is an optional companion and does not provide a standalone calendar. It adds sharing of public Shout and Yell invites to Shout Calendar. Say, tells, party, alliance, free company, linkshells, and novice network are not shared.

Install Shout Calendar first, then this plugin. Open Shout Calendar to view shared invites and Sync settings.

When Sync is attached, the world you are on replaces Local Calendar. Check another world to fetch it, then select it. The public relay is the default. Public relay is also the default backup. Matching primary and backup endpoints use one connection. Choose Backup > Off to keep a custom private group on its primary only.

Download and upload are capped separately, in megabits per second. Upload starts at 1 Mb/s. Removing this plugin removes shared events and leaves the invites you heard yourself.
Description.Translated:
需要已安装并启用 Shout Calendar。Shout Calendar Sync 是可选配套插件，不提供独立日历。它为 Shout Calendar 添加公开喊话和呼喊邀请的共享功能。说话、悄悄话、小队、团队、部队、通讯贝及新人频道均不会共享。

先安装 Shout Calendar，再安装本插件。打开 Shout Calendar 查看共享邀请和同步设置。

连接 Sync 后，当前所在服务器会取代本地日历。勾选其他服务器以获取数据，然后选中它。默认使用公共中继，备用中继也默认为公共中继；主备用地址相同时只使用一个连接。如需自定义私人群组只使用主服务器，请选择 Backup > Off。

下载和上传分别限速，单位为每秒兆比特。上传初始上限为 1 Mb/s。移除此插件会删除共享事件，但保留你自己从聊天中收到的邀请。

Punchline.Original: In-game DPS meter and fight history.
Punchline.Translated: 游戏内 DPS 统计与战斗历史。

Description.Original: Live DPS/tank/heal meter with persistent, browsable fight history. /studium or /dps to open.
Description.Translated: 实时 DPS、承伤和治疗统计器，提供可持久保存、浏览的战斗历史。使用 /studium 或 /dps 打开。

Punchline.Original: Inspect regular and cross hotbars for slot-based synchronization.
Punchline.Translated: 检查普通热键栏与十字热键栏，以按槽位同步。

Description.Original: Configurable two-way regular/cross hotbar synchronization with shared slots, backups and capture.
Description.Translated: 可配置的普通/十字热键栏双向同步，支持共享槽位、备份和快照采集。

Punchline.Original: Apply curated job hotbars and Wrath settings.
Punchline.Translated: 应用预设职业热键栏和 Wrath 设置。

Description.Original: Preview and apply current-class or all-class hotbar layouts and Wrath presets, with backups. Wrath must be disabled for configuration writes.
Description.Translated: 预览并应用当前职业或全部职业的热键栏布局及 Wrath 预设，并提供备份。写入配置前必须停用 Wrath。

Name.Original: MahjongSolver · 多玛方城战求解器（国服优化版）

Punchline.Original: FFXIV Bartending, drink recipes, macros, and venue advertisement manager.
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 调酒、饮品配方、宏与场所广告管理器。

Description.Original: Manage bar drink menus, execute timed RP macros with drag-and-drop step ordering, track drink sales counters, broadcast venue announcements, and share portable drink packages.
Description.Translated: 管理酒吧饮品菜单，执行定时角色扮演宏并拖动调整步骤顺序，记录饮品销量，广播场所公告，以及分享便于导入的饮品包。

Punchline.Original: Relic weapons and tools, every job, every next step.
Punchline.Translated: 各职业的历代成长武器与工具，每一步进度尽在掌握。

Description.Original: In-game relic progression from Zodiac to Phantom. Overview shows every eligible job and expansion, completion totals and next stages. Open a relic's checklist, track objectives and materials, and keep separate character profiles. Automatic detection plus manual corrections. Open with /relicatlas. Shopping list compares carried stock with optional Allagan Tools storage. /relicatlas atma shows an experimental ST farming schedule with optional Teleporter travel; automatic travel is opt-in for each session.
Description.Translated: 在游戏内追踪从黄道武器到幻境武器的成长进度。概览显示所有符合条件的职业和资料片、完成总数及下一阶段。可打开每把武器的检查清单，追踪目标与材料，并为不同角色保留独立档案。支持自动检测和手动修正。使用 /relicatlas 打开。采购清单会对比随身库存，也可结合 Allagan Tools 的存储数据。/relicatlas atma 显示实验性的 ST 刷取计划，可选择通过 Teleporter 移动；每次会话都需主动启用自动移动。

Punchline.Original: Shows your AoE reach and which enemies it would hit right now.
Punchline.Translated: 显示群攻技能的覆盖范围，以及当前能命中哪些敌人。

Description.Original: Draws a ring at your feet and a circle around each enemy's hitbox, green when your circle or cone AoE would hit that enemy and red when it would not. Drawn under other plugin windows.
Description.Translated: 在脚下绘制范围环，并在各敌人的碰撞箱周围画圈；圆形或扇形群攻能命中的敌人为绿色，无法命中的为红色。绘制层位于其他插件窗口下方。

Punchline.Original: Mouse and key bindings that focus and mark what you hover; nameplate signs sit neatly by the name.
Punchline.Translated: 通过鼠标和键盘绑定聚焦并标记悬停目标；姓名板标记整齐显示在名字旁。

Description.Original: Shift+right-click a nameplate, unit frame or model to make it your focus target and put a sign on it, or set up your own mouse and key bindings for any sign, the next free attack sign or sign removal, with or without changing focus. Nameplate signs are shrunk and placed next to the name, in the style of Plater/NaowhUI raid icons, and follow Plate Stack's stacking.
Description.Translated: 按 Shift 并右键点击姓名板、单位框体或模型，即可设为焦点目标并添加标记。也可自定义鼠标和按键绑定，设置任意标记、下一个空闲攻击标记或移除标记，并选择是否同时改变焦点。姓名板标记会缩小后置于名字旁，风格参考 Plater/NaowhUI 团队标记，并跟随 Plate Stack 的堆叠布局。

Punchline.Original: Hotbars and HUD elements stay hidden until the mouse is over them.
Punchline.Translated: 热键栏和 HUD 元素仅在鼠标悬停时显示。

Description.Original: Chosen hotbars (default 4, 7 and 10) and the Main Menu bar are shown only while the mouse is over them. Keybinds keep working while they are hidden.
Description.Translated: 所选热键栏（默认第 4、7、10 栏）和主菜单栏仅在鼠标悬停时显示。隐藏时快捷键仍然有效。

Punchline.Original: Keeps a copy of your cursor where you pressed while a mouse button turns the camera.
Punchline.Translated: 按住鼠标转动镜头时，在按下的位置保留一个光标副本。

Description.Original: While a mouse button turns the camera the game hides the cursor. This draws a copy of your current cursor, custom cursors included, at the spot you pressed until you let go. On Windows the cursor also comes back to exactly that spot.
Description.Translated: 按住鼠标键转动镜头时，游戏会隐藏光标。本插件在按下位置绘制当前光标的副本，包括自定义光标，直到松开鼠标。在 Windows 上，光标也会准确返回原位置。

Punchline.Original: Party interrupt and stun cooldowns as compact bars.
Punchline.Translated: 以紧凑条形显示队员打断与眩晕技能的冷却。

Description.Original: One row per party member and interrupt or off-GCD stun, with the icon, name, a thin cooldown bar and the time left. Look based on NaowhUI and EXBoss interrupt bars; job colours from DelvUI.
Description.Translated: 按队员和打断或非 GCD 眩晕技能逐行显示图标、名称、细冷却条及剩余时间。外观参考 NaowhUI 和 EXBoss 的打断条，职业颜色采用 DelvUI 配色。

Punchline.Original: Stacks overlapping nameplates upward, Plater-style, so none cover each other.
Punchline.Translated: 像 Plater 一样将重叠姓名板向上堆叠，避免互相遮挡。

Description.Original: Pushes overlapping enemy nameplates up, nearest first, with a smooth glide; defaults come from the NaowhUI Plater profile. Made for DelvUI nameplates, which follow every frame; the game's own plates stack only while they stand still.
Description.Translated: 将重叠的敌方姓名板平滑向上推开，优先保留最近目标的位置；默认设置来自 NaowhUI 的 Plater 配置。为逐帧跟随的 DelvUI 姓名板设计；游戏原生姓名板仅在静止时能够堆叠。

Punchline.Original: Shows low-condition gear and repairs your selection with your own dark matter in one press.
Punchline.Translated: 显示低耐久装备，并用自己的暗物质一键修理所选装备。

Description.Original: Lists gear at or below a condition threshold with the dark matter grade each self-repair needs, and repairs one item or a whole selection with your own dark matter after a confirm naming the dark matter used and left. Shows dark matter held per grade and notifications for low gear, missing dark matter, gear you can't self-repair and failed repairs; can repair automatically (off by default).
Description.Translated: 列出耐久不高于设定阈值的装备及自行修理所需的暗物质等级。确认所用暗物质和剩余数量后，可用自己的暗物质修理单件或整批所选装备。显示各级暗物质持有量，并对低耐久、暗物质不足、无法自行修理或修理失败发出通知；支持自动修理，默认关闭。

Punchline.Original: Main Scenario Guide drawn as Duty List rows, with the Duty List pinned under it.
Punchline.Translated: 将主线任务指引绘制成任务列表行，并将任务列表固定在其下方。

Description.Original: Restyles the Main Scenario Guide into plain quest-marker and title rows in the Duty List's quest-title style, hides rows the Duty List already shows, and keeps the Duty List directly under the guide.
Description.Translated: 将主线任务指引改为任务列表标题样式的简洁任务标记与标题行，隐藏任务列表中已显示的重复项目，并让任务列表始终紧贴在指引下方。

Punchline.Original: An editable note pinned to the screen; click it to edit in place.
Punchline.Translated: 固定在屏幕上的可编辑便签，点击即可原地修改。

Description.Original: Shows a short note at the top left of the screen. Click it to edit, Ctrl+Enter or click away to save, Esc to cancel; the lock in its corner makes it click-through. Uses NaowhUI's Naowh font when you provide the file.
Description.Translated: 在屏幕左上角显示简短便签。点击编辑，按 Ctrl+Enter 或点击其他位置保存，Esc 取消；角落的锁形按钮可启用点击穿透。提供字体文件后，可使用 NaowhUI 的 Naowh 字体。

Punchline.Original: Arrows beside your target's DelvUI nameplate bar.
Punchline.Translated: 在当前目标的 DelvUI 姓名板血条两侧显示箭头。

Description.Original: Draws a pair of arrows beside your hard target's DelvUI enemy nameplate bar, styled after the NaowhUI target arrows. The arrows hide with the bar as long as the plate settings match your DelvUI profile. Requires DelvUI.
Description.Translated: 在正式选中目标的 DelvUI 敌方姓名板血条两侧绘制箭头，风格参考 NaowhUI 目标箭头。姓名板设置与 DelvUI 配置匹配时，箭头会随血条一同隐藏。需要 DelvUI。

Punchline.Original: Reports your in-game activity to the Lost Focus website.
Punchline.Translated: 向 Lost Focus 网站报告你的游戏活动。

Description.Original: Sends online status, playtime, zone/duty, deaths, floor time, wipes, job/gear, PvP record and emote counts to the Lost Focus meme site. Every category can be turned off in /lostfocus.
Description.Translated: 将在线状态、游戏时长、区域/副本、死亡次数、倒地时间、团灭次数、职业/装备、PvP 战绩和情感动作次数发送到 Lost Focus 趣味网站。每个类别均可在 /lostfocus 中关闭。

Punchline.Original: Extra macro pages beside Individual and Shared.
Punchline.Translated: 在个人宏和共通宏之外添加更多宏页面。

Description.Original: Extra pages of 100 macros beside Individual and Shared, with native hotbar links, auto-translate, and macro command icons. English interface for the international client.
Description.Translated: 在个人宏和共通宏之外添加每页 100 个宏的额外页面，支持原生热键栏链接、自动翻译词条和宏命令图标。为国际服客户端提供英文界面。

Punchline.Original: See your friends' mods, with no server in between.
Punchline.Translated: 查看朋友的模组，无需服务器中转。

Description.Original: Synchronise votre apparence moddée avec les personnes que vous avez explicitement appairées, en pair à pair. Les fichiers passent directement d'un joueur à l'autre, chiffrés de bout en bout : aucun serveur ne les stocke ni ne les redistribue.
Description.Translated: 通过点对点方式，与明确配对的人同步你的模组外观。文件在玩家之间直接传输，并采用端到端加密；没有服务器存储或转发这些文件。

Punchline.Original: Step through cross hotbar sets by any number, not just one.
Punchline.Translated: 按任意步长切换十字热键栏组，不再只能逐组切换。

Description.Original: The game can only switch to a cross hotbar set by name, so a macro cannot say “go up two”. This steps relative to whichever set you are on — up, down, by any amount, wrapping at the ends — so two keys or two buttons can walk all eight sets.
Description.Translated: 游戏只能按指定组名切换十字热键栏，因此宏无法表达“向后切两组”。本插件相对当前组向前或向后切换任意步数，到达两端时循环回绕，让两个按键或按钮即可遍历全部八组。

Punchline.Original: Announces the selected duty in party chat when you start a ready check.
Punchline.Translated: 发起准备确认时，在小队聊天中公布所选副本。

Description.Original: Hooks the game's own ready check so that clicking Ready Check — or typing /readycheck — first posts the duty you have selected in the Duty Finder to party chat. Announcement only: it never answers a ready check for you.
Description.Translated: 接入游戏自身的准备确认功能：点击准备确认或输入 /readycheck 时，先在小队聊天中发送你在任务搜索器中选定的副本。仅发送通知，绝不会替你回应准备确认。

Punchline.Original: Pushes a notification when your retainers get back, even with the game closed.
Punchline.Translated: 雇员归来时推送通知，即使游戏已关闭也能收到。

Description.Original: Sends your retainers' venture completion times to a small self-hosted server, which holds the countdown and pushes a notification when they finish — including when the game is shut down. Reads the timers the game already has; it never assigns, collects or interacts with a retainer. Nothing is sent anywhere until you configure your own server address.
Description.Translated: 将雇员探险完成时间发送到你自行托管的小型服务器，由服务器负责倒计时并在完成时推送通知，包括游戏关闭后。只读取游戏已有的计时器，不会分配任务、领取奖励或与雇员交互。在配置自己的服务器地址前，不会向任何地方发送数据。

Punchline.Original: Adds a fuzzy search box to the Duty Finder and the Teleport window.
Punchline.Translated: 为任务搜索器和传送窗口添加模糊搜索框。

Description.Original: Docks a search field under the game's own Duty Finder and Teleport windows. Type part of a name — "aurum", "arum", "vale", "alex", "radz" — and pick from ranked results; the game's own window then does the selecting, queueing and teleporting exactly as if you had clicked the row yourself. Search and filter only: no automation, no queueing for you, no bypassing unlocks, level requirements or gil costs.
Description.Translated: 在游戏原生任务搜索器和传送窗口下方附加搜索框。输入部分名称，例如“aurum”“arum”“vale”“alex”“radz”，从排序结果中选择；随后由游戏原生窗口完成选中、排队和传送，效果与自己点击对应行完全相同。仅提供搜索和筛选，不自动操作、不替你排队，也不绕过解锁、等级或金币要求。

Punchline.Original: Modular HUD panels, PvP threat awareness, and camera controls.
Punchline.Translated: 模块化 HUD 面板、PvP 威胁提示与镜头控制。

Description.Original: Adds configurable actor panels, PvP targeting-me awareness, HP/MP/shield/cast bars, native actor interactions, exact-position awareness, optional encounter danger providers, and extended camera zoom. Anti-AFK and Quest Convenience settings are available in Sentinel Hub.
Description.Translated: 添加可配置的角色面板、PvP 中被选中提示、HP/MP/护盾/咏唱条、原生角色交互、精确位置提示、可选的战斗危险信息来源，以及扩展镜头缩放。防暂离和任务便利功能可在 Sentinel Hub 中设置。

Punchline.Original: A browsable gallery of every armor set, applied through Glamourer.
Punchline.Translated: 浏览所有装备套装的图鉴，并通过 Glamourer 应用。

Description.Original: Browse every armor set in the game as a gallery. Preview any set on your own character and apply it with Glamourer. Requires Glamourer.
Description.Translated: 以图鉴形式浏览游戏中的全部装备套装。在自己的角色上预览任意套装，并通过 Glamourer 应用。需要 Glamourer。

Punchline.Original: Hunt trains, ridden for you.
Punchline.Translated: 替你跟随狩猎车队。

Description.Original:
Rides hunt trains for you: hears a train being called anywhere in your region, travels to the start aetheryte on that world, follows the conductor's flags from mark to mark, and lands a hit on every A rank before the crowd deletes it.

Plugin from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeldarAlz/DalamudPlugins/main/repo.json
Description.Translated:
替你跟狩猎车：监听你所在区域内发布的车队通知，前往相应服务器的起点以太之光，跟随车头的地图标记逐个赶场，并在大部队击杀前命中每一只 A 级怪物。

插件来自 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeldarAlz/DalamudPlugins/main/repo.json

Punchline.Original: Every NPC card, collected for you.
Punchline.Translated: 替你收集 NPC 可掉落的每一张幻卡。

Description.Original:
Collects every Triple Triad card NPCs can give you: pick the cards you are missing, and the plugin travels to each NPC, builds a deck for its rules, plays until your cards drop, registers them, and moves on.

Plugin from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeldarAlz/DalamudPlugins/main/repo.json
Description.Translated:
收集 NPC 能给你的全部九宫幻卡：选择缺少的卡牌后，插件会前往各 NPC，按其规则构建牌组，持续对战直到掉落所需卡牌，使用卡牌收录后继续前往下一处。

插件来自 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeldarAlz/DalamudPlugins/main/repo.json

Punchline.Original: Staggered, safe plugin updates.
Punchline.Translated: 错峰、安全地更新插件。

Description.Original: Lists every plugin with an available update and installs them one at a time, with safety gates and a debug log. Command: /bub
Description.Translated: 列出所有有可用更新的插件，并逐个安装，带有安全检查与调试日志。命令：/bub

Punchline.Original: Walk the moon's path: every quest, every requirement, every unique reward.
Punchline.Translated: 循月而行：每项任务、每个前置条件、每份独特奖励。

Description.Original:
A quest catalog for every journal type, with completed and available filters and a per-requirement breakdown of what still blocks a quest.
Moonlit treasures collects quests with unique rewards, and per-character snapshots keep the whole account in view.
Description.Translated:
涵盖所有任务日志类型的任务目录，支持按已完成、可接取筛选，并逐项列出仍阻碍任务解锁的条件。
“月下宝藏”汇集具有独特奖励的任务，每个角色的快照让整个账号的进度一目了然。

Punchline.Original: Open housing plots on the real district maps, with lottery tracking.
Punchline.Translated: 在实际住宅区地图上显示可购买地块，并追踪抽签状态。

Description.Original:
Placard shows every open housing plot on the in-game district maps for Mist, The Lavender Beds, The Goblet, Shirogane and Empyreum, on any world.

Switch between the district map and a list of every open plot across the whole world at once. Markers carry size, lottery phase, price and eligibility. Filter by size, phase, eligibility, division and entry count, sort by fewest entries or scan age, keep a watchlist, and get reminded before a lottery phase closes.
Description.Translated:
Placard 在游戏内的住宅区地图上显示任意服务器的所有可购买地块，覆盖海雾村、薰衣草苗圃、高脚孤丘、白银乡和穹顶皓天。

可在住宅区地图与该服务器全部空地列表之间切换。标记包含大小、抽签阶段、价格和购买资格。可按大小、阶段、资格、分区和报名人数筛选，按报名人数最少或扫描时间排序，维护关注列表，并在抽签阶段结束前收到提醒。

Punchline.Original: When conditions match, apply settings and run commands.
Punchline.Translated: 条件满足时，应用设置并运行命令。

Description.Original: Folders of rules. AND, OR, and NOT chips. When a rule becomes true it sets game options, online status, slash commands, and Penumbra mod settings. Rules do not revert — write another rule for the other state.
Description.Translated: 用文件夹管理规则，以 AND、OR、NOT 条件块组合判断。规则变为满足时，可修改游戏选项、在线状态、执行斜杠命令或调整 Penumbra 模组设置。规则不会自动恢复原状；另一种状态需要另写一条规则。

Punchline.Original: Brio-based GPose tools with advanced facial and tongue posing.
Punchline.Translated: 基于 Brio 的集体动作工具，提供进阶面部和舌头姿势调整。

Description.Original: A community GPose posing toolkit based on Brio, with expanded facial-expression controls, facial presets, and advanced tongue posing tools adapted from and inspired by Ktisis.
Description.Translated: 基于 Brio 的社区集体动作姿势工具箱，扩展面部表情控制、表情预设，并提供改编自 Ktisis、受其启发的高级舌头姿势调整工具。

Punchline.Original: Native gameplay depth of field — experimental local prototype.
Punchline.Translated: 常规游玩中的原生景深——实验性本地原型。

Description.Original: Experimental native gameplay depth of field, with native camera focus or manual focus and aperture controls. Locked to the verified September 15, 2026 game executable. Optional saved activation and separate combat profiles. Use /nativedof.
Description.Translated: 实验性的常规游玩原生景深，支持原生摄像机对焦或手动焦点与光圈控制。仅支持已验证的 2026 年 9 月 15 日游戏可执行文件。可选择保存启用状态，并使用独立战斗配置。命令：/nativedof。

Punchline.Original: Native nameplate data for OptiScaler.
Punchline.Translated: 为 OptiScaler 提供原生姓名板数据。

Description.Original: Supplies native nameplate positions and gameplay readiness to a matching OptiScaler build. Supports persistent HUD replacement and optional 2x position interpolation with OptiFG DLSS-G or XeFG. Update both components together. /opticompanion opens connection status.
Description.Translated: 向匹配版本的 OptiScaler 提供原生姓名板位置及游戏就绪状态。支持持久 HUD 替换，以及配合 OptiFG DLSS-G 或 XeFG 使用的可选 2 倍位置插值。两个组件需同步更新。/opticompanion 打开连接状态。

Punchline.Original: Talk to a local AI model in game, with XivMcp's tools.
Punchline.Translated: 在游戏中与本地 AI 模型交谈，并使用 XivMcp 工具。

Description.Original: Connects a model running on your own PC (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp or any OpenAI-compatible server) to the game through XivMcp. Setup wizard with GPU-aware model recommendations, an in-game chat with threads and streaming, and a benchmark you can share with the community leaderboard. No cloud, no Python. Requires the XivMcp plugin for game tools.
Description.Translated: 通过 XivMcp 将自己电脑上运行的模型（Ollama、LM Studio、llama.cpp 或任意兼容 OpenAI 接口的服务器）连接到游戏。提供根据显卡推荐模型的设置向导、支持会话与流式输出的游戏内聊天，以及可分享到社区排行榜的性能测试。不使用云端，也不需要 Python。游戏工具需要 XivMcp 插件。

Punchline.Original: Eorzea is a terminal multiplexer.
Punchline.Translated: 艾欧泽亚也是终端复用器。

Description.Original: Quake-style dropdown, floating windows and terminals pinned in the world, connected to shells on your own machine through ghostty-agent. /term to toggle. Works with or without Umbra; with Umbra, the Ghostty toolbar widget shows its status and a popup terminal.
Description.Translated: 提供 Quake 风格下拉终端、浮动窗口及固定在游戏世界中的终端，通过 ghostty-agent 连接本机 Shell。使用 /term 开关。可独立使用，也可搭配 Umbra；搭配时，Ghostty 工具栏组件会显示状态并提供弹出终端。

Punchline.Original: Your own classic games as game panels, with saves kept in step across your machines.
Punchline.Translated: 把自己拥有的经典游戏放进游戏面板，存档在多台电脑间保持同步。

Description.Original: A library for the classic games you own, for FINAL FANTASY XIV running under Wine on Linux. /arcade lists the game files in folders you choose, starts them in RetroArch on the Linux host, and shows them as world panels through Ghostty when it is installed. Every save and save state lives in one folder that Syncthing copies between your machines. It downloads no games, BIOS files or artwork.
Description.Translated: 面向 Linux Wine 环境下《最终幻想14》的自有经典游戏库。/arcade 列出你指定文件夹中的游戏文件，在 Linux 主机上通过 RetroArch 启动；安装 Ghostty 后，还可将画面显示为游戏世界中的面板。所有存档和即时存档均放在同一个文件夹，由 Syncthing 在电脑之间同步。不会下载游戏、BIOS 文件或美术资源。

Punchline.Original: Launch Linux desktop apps into the game world.
Punchline.Translated: 将 Linux 桌面应用启动到游戏世界中。

Description.Original: An app launcher for FINAL FANTASY XIV running under Wine on Linux. Lists the host's freedesktop applications and opens them as world panels through Ghostty's remote windows. Optional Umbra toolbar widget.
Description.Translated: 面向 Linux Wine 环境下《最终幻想14》的应用启动器。列出主机上符合 freedesktop 标准的应用，并通过 Ghostty 远程窗口将其显示为游戏世界中的面板。可选用 Umbra 工具栏组件。

Punchline.Original: Light a lantern for your friends: a friend list, 1:1 chat and channels of your own, peer to peer.
Punchline.Translated: 为朋友亮一盏灯：点对点好友列表、一对一聊天，以及你自己的频道。

Description.Original: Friends light a lantern to say they are here. Add friends with a one-time invite, see whose lantern is lit, chat 1:1 and in channels you make, and hear from the mod's author in a channel only they can post to. Peer to peer over iroh: no Lantern server, and nothing from the game is ever sent — not your character's name, world or chat; your friends see the name you type. Off until you turn it on in settings, where it says exactly who can see what (including that relays see your IP address, and how to turn them off). Blocking, rate limits and no auto-accept.
Description.Translated: 朋友亮起灯笼，表示自己在线。通过一次性邀请添加好友，查看谁的灯亮着，进行一对一聊天或在自建频道交流；也可在仅作者能发言的频道中接收模组作者消息。基于 iroh 点对点通信，没有 Lantern 服务器，也绝不会发送游戏数据，包括角色名、服务器和游戏聊天；好友看到的是你自行填写的名字。默认关闭，需在设置中启用；设置会明确说明谁能看到哪些信息，包括中继能看到你的 IP 地址，以及如何关闭中继。支持屏蔽和限速，不会自动接受请求。

Punchline.Original: Uplink AI assistants to Final Fantasy XIV through the Model Context Protocol.
Punchline.Translated: 通过模型上下文协议，将 AI 助手连接到《最终幻想14》。

Description.Original:
XIV MCP runs a local MCP server (only reachable from your own PC, protected by an access token) so any AI assistant that supports the Model Context Protocol (Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, LM Studio and others) can see your game and help with it.

Read your character live: stats and jobs, gear, inventory, currencies, quests, achievements and unlocks, party, targets, nearby objects, FATEs and the game's data sheets. Retainers and submersibles are remembered between visits.

Optional modules, each behind its own switch in /xivmcp: game interaction and navigation, inventory and retainers, market and purchases (every non-gil purchase asks you in game), crafting and gathering, quests, custom deliveries, fishing, submersibles, plugin management, and background jobs that run for hours on their own.

Documentation: https://individualgather.github.io/xiv-mcp/
Description.Translated:
XIV MCP 运行一个本地 MCP 服务器，仅本机可访问，并由访问令牌保护，让支持模型上下文协议的 AI 助手（Claude、ChatGPT、Codex、LM Studio 等）能够查看游戏并提供帮助。

实时读取角色信息：属性与职业、装备、背包、货币、任务、成就与解锁、小队、目标、附近对象、危命任务及游戏数据表。雇员与潜水艇信息会在访问间保留。

可选模块各自在 /xivmcp 中独立开关：游戏交互与导航、背包与雇员、市场与购买（每次非金币购买都会在游戏内询问）、制作与采集、任务、老主顾交易、钓鱼、潜水艇、插件管理，以及可独立持续数小时的后台任务。

文档：https://individualgather.github.io/xiv-mcp/

Punchline.Original: A softly glowing bead and the classic pointing glove show which way to go.
Punchline.Translated: 柔光珠与经典指向手套告诉你该往哪走。

Description.Original: XivWayfinder points the way in FINAL FANTASY XIV: a softly pulsing bead floats a couple of yalms ahead of you in the direction to go, and the game's own white pointing glove points there too, sliding to the edge of the screen when the way is behind you. It follows, in order, a target you set with /wayfinder X Y or another plugin sets over IPC, your map flag, and your tracked quest's next step; in another zone it names the nearest aetheryte instead. With vnavmesh installed it points along the walkable path. It only points and never moves your character.
Description.Translated: XivWayfinder 在《最终幻想14》中指引方向：一颗柔和闪烁的光珠浮在前方约数星码处，游戏自带的白色指向手套也会指向目的地；方向在身后时，手套会移到屏幕边缘。目标优先级依次为：用 /wayfinder X Y 设置或由其他插件通过 IPC 设置的目标、地图标旗、追踪任务的下一步。若目标在其他区域，会改为显示最近的以太之光名称。安装 vnavmesh 后，可沿可行走路径指引。仅提供方向，不会移动角色。

Punchline.Original: Helper for catching Big Fish
Punchline.Translated: 鱼王钓获助手。

Description.Original: Helps you catch Big Fish, working together with AutoHook.
Description.Translated: 与 AutoHook 配合，帮助你钓获鱼王。

Punchline.Original: Timeline and job reactions that drive your rotation plugins.
Punchline.Translated: 用战斗时间轴和职业触发规则驱动循环插件。

Description.Original: Load a fight timeline (cactbot format) or a per-job profile, and attach reactions to mechanics: conditions on you, your target and your party, and actions that press a skill, flip a MachinistHelper or BeastMasterHelper toggle, hold an action, or show an alert.
Description.Translated: 加载战斗时间轴（cactbot 格式）或职业配置，为机制绑定响应：检查自身、目标和小队的条件，并执行释放技能、切换 MachinistHelper 或 BeastMasterHelper 开关、暂缓技能或显示提醒等操作。

Punchline.Original: Locally shrink Chaos and Exdeath in Dancing Mad (Ultimate).
Punchline.Translated: 仅在本地缩小妖星乱舞绝境战中的卡奥斯和艾克斯迪司模型。

Description.Original: Applies independent visual model scale factors to Chaos and Exdeath in territory 1363, with an optional floating lifebar adjustment. Does not edit hitboxes, positions, targeting, or combat data.
Description.Translated: 在区域 1363 中，分别调整卡奥斯与艾克斯迪司的视觉模型缩放，可选同步调整悬浮血条。不修改碰撞箱、位置、目标选择或战斗数据。

Punchline.Original: Armoire items in the glamour dresser.
Punchline.Translated: 在投影台中显示收藏柜物品。

Description.Original: Lists your armoire items in the glamour dresser while editing glamour plates, so you can build plates without switching to the armoire.
Description.Translated: 编辑投影模板时，在投影台中列出收藏柜物品，无需切换至收藏柜即可搭配模板。

Punchline.Original: Know what to sell, where, and for how much.
Punchline.Translated: 知道该卖什么、在哪里卖，以及卖多少钱。

Description.Original: Scans your bags, saddlebags and retainers, pulls live prices from Universalis, and recommends what to list, relist, vendor or hold, with suggested prices. Finds profitable crafts you can make and hands them to GatherBuddy Reborn or Artisan to gather and craft.
Description.Translated: 扫描背包、陆行鸟鞍囊和雇员库存，从 Universalis 获取实时价格，建议哪些物品应上架、重新定价、卖给 NPC 或保留，并给出参考价格。还能找出你可制作的盈利配方，交给 GatherBuddy Reborn 或 Artisan 采集和制作。

Punchline.Original: The cursed smallclothes really do lock onto you. Companion to the Cursed Identify (/study) emote mod.
Punchline.Translated: 受诅咒的贴身衣物真的会锁在身上。Cursed Identify（/study）情感动作模组的配套插件。

Description.Original:
Companion plugin for the 'Cursed Identify (/study)' Penumbra emote mod.

During the /study skit, at the moment of the magical-girl transformation, it asks Glamourer to equip the cursed neon-pink leotard (Yakaku Dogi, which the mod replaces with the Succubi Leotard) and to strip head/hands/legs/feet. When the skit resets, or you stop the emote, your previous outfit is restored exactly.

Requires: Glamourer, and the Cursed Identify (/study) mod enabled in Penumbra.
Commands: /cursed opens the window (enable toggle + test buttons); /cursed on | off apply or restore by hand; /cursed toggle enables/disables the swap.
Description.Translated:
Penumbra 情感动作模组“Cursed Identify（/study）”的配套插件。

在 /study 短剧的魔法少女变身时刻，它会请求 Glamourer 穿上受诅咒的荧光粉连体衣（以夜鹤道服为基础，由模组替换为 Succubi Leotard），并卸下头部、手部、腿部和脚部装备。短剧重置或停止情感动作时，完整恢复之前的搭配。

需要：Glamourer，以及在 Penumbra 中启用的 Cursed Identify（/study）模组。
命令：/cursed 打开窗口（启用开关与测试按钮）；/cursed on | off 手动应用或恢复；/cursed toggle 启用或禁用替换。

Punchline.Original: Live audio broadcasts and listening.
Punchline.Translated: 实时音频广播与收听。

Description.Original: Broadcast live rekordbox audio or listen to a broadcast using continuous Opus audio. Open /airwave to connect. Capture and playback start only when you choose them.
Description.Translated: 通过连续 Opus 音频流直播 rekordbox 音频，或收听广播。打开 /airwave 连接。只有你主动选择后才会开始采集或播放。

Punchline.Original: Locally replace loaded Hrothgar with another race.
Punchline.Translated: 仅在本地将已加载的硌狮族替换为其他种族。

Description.Original: Changes loaded Hrothgar player and human NPC appearances locally. Supports a fixed target race or per-actor random race selection.
Description.Translated: 在本地修改已加载的硌狮族玩家与人形 NPC 外观。支持固定目标种族，或为每个角色随机选择种族。

Punchline.Original: Fill your cross hotbars for any job in one click, following a layout bias you choose.
Punchline.Translated: 按你选择的布局偏好，一键填充任意职业的十字热键栏。

Description.Original:
XMapper maps the current class's actions onto Cross Hotbar sets according to a "bias": a preset that says which kind of action lands on which pad.

â€¢ Single-target attacks on the right face buttons, AoE on the left, abilities on the d-pads.
â€¢ Role actions on set 2's right half, rare long-cooldown actions on set 2's left half.
â€¢ Overflow continues onto later sets with the same layout.
â€¢ Works for combat jobs, crafters and gatherers. Ships with editable biases; make your own.
â€¢ Preview the whole layout before writing a single slot.
Description.Translated:
XMapper 根据“布局偏好”将当前职业技能映射到十字热键栏组；这种预设规定各类技能应放在哪组按键上。

• 单体攻击放右侧正面按键，群攻放左侧，能力技放方向键。
• 职能技能放第 2 组右半边，低频使用的长冷却技能放第 2 组左半边。
• 超出容量的技能按同样布局继续放到后续组。
• 支持战斗、生产和采集职业。内置可编辑预设，也可自行创建。
• 写入任何槽位前，可预览完整布局。

Punchline.Original: Cross-data-centre linkshells with unlimited members.
Punchline.Translated: 跨大区、成员人数不限的通讯贝。

Description.Original: ExtraChat adds end-to-end encrypted, cross-data-centre, unlimited linkshells to the game. This is a patched fork of Anna's ExtraChat for current Dalamud. On first run it copies your settings from the original ExtraChat; disable the original while using this one.
Description.Translated: ExtraChat 为游戏添加端到端加密、跨数据中心且数量不限的通讯贝。此版本是为当前 Dalamud 修复的 Anna's ExtraChat 分支。首次运行会复制原版 ExtraChat 的设置；使用本版时请停用原版。

Punchline.Original: Help yourself and your retainers !
Punchline.Translated: 帮帮自己，也帮帮雇员！

Description.Original: An all-in-one market board, inventory, and retainer management plugin. Features market watch, automated competitor undercutting, comprehensive sales history, cross-character inventory management, and a crafting profit evaluator.
Description.Translated: 集市场布告板、背包和雇员管理于一体的插件。提供市场监控、自动压价、完整销售历史、跨角色库存管理和制作利润评估。

Punchline.Original: Consensual pet/master roleplay, messages, and shared routines.
Punchline.Translated: 双方自愿的宠物/主人角色扮演、消息与共同日程。

Description.Original: A private FFXIV tool for consensual pet/master roleplay and power dynamics. Masters manage messages and reminders through Discord or a private portal, while pets receive interactive prompts in game. Includes replies, snoozing, shared status and location, and a local kill switch controlled by the pet.
Description.Translated: 用于双方自愿的宠物/主人角色扮演及权力关系互动的私密 FFXIV 工具。主人通过 Discord 或私人门户管理消息和提醒，宠物方在游戏内接收互动提示。包含回复、延后提醒、共享状态与位置，以及由宠物方控制的本地紧急停止开关。

Punchline.Original: Automatically turns your tank stance on or off.
Punchline.Translated: 自动开启或关闭坦克姿态。

Description.Original:
Keeps your tank stance in the state you choose (on or off) on every tank: Paladin/Gladiator, Warrior/Marauder, Dark Knight and Gunbreaker.
Apply it always, or only at specific moments: zone or job change, countdown, pull (bosses only), duty recommence after a wipe.
Available in English and French. Command: /autostance
Description.Translated:
让所有防护职业的坦克姿态保持你指定的开启或关闭状态：骑士/剑术师、战士/斧术师、暗黑骑士与绝枪战士。
可始终生效，也可仅在特定时机应用：切换区域或职业、倒计时、开战（仅首领），或团灭后重新开始副本。
支持英语和法语。命令：/autostance

Punchline.Original: The loot sheet of every duty: rare rewards, tomestones and coffers.
Punchline.Translated: 每个副本的掉落清单：稀有奖励、神典石与宝箱。

Description.Original: Shows a database-style loot sheet for each duty: rare rewards (minions, mounts, orchestrion rolls) obtained or not, tomestones and gil per boss, and the content of every coffer with what you already own. Opens next to the Duty Finder or from the server info bar. Interface in English and French.
Description.Translated: 为每个副本显示数据库式掉落清单：稀有奖励（宠物、坐骑、管弦乐琴乐谱）是否已获得、每个首领的神典石和金币奖励，以及各宝箱内容和你已拥有的物品。可在任务搜索器旁或通过服务器信息栏打开。界面支持英语和法语。

Punchline.Original: Your shared characters, estates, collections and timers.
Punchline.Translated: 共享角色、房产、收藏与计时信息。

Description.Original: Records house entries and confirmed tending locally, with optional paired sync to Equinox Journal. English garden menus supported.
Description.Translated: 在本地记录进入房屋和已确认的园艺照料，可选与配对的 Equinox Journal 同步。支持英文园艺菜单。

Punchline.Original: Your mount's internet radio.
Punchline.Translated: 坐骑上的网络电台。

Description.Original: Open a radio panel on mounting and listen to saved internet stations inside the plugin, following game music settings.
Description.Translated: 骑乘时打开电台面板，在插件内收听已保存的网络电台，并跟随游戏音乐设置。

Punchline.Original: Two-pane JP/EN chat translation for English players on Japanese data centers.
Punchline.Translated: 面向日服数据中心英语玩家的日英双栏聊天翻译。

Description.Original:
Shows chat in a two-pane window with the original Japanese on the left and a streamed English translation on the right, aligned row by row.
Type English into the input box to get a Japanese translation with a word-by-word breakdown and back-translation, confirm, and send.
Translation uses your own OpenRouter API key (chat lines in the channels you enable are sent to OpenRouter). Early release.
Description.Translated:
以双栏窗口显示聊天，左侧为日文原文，右侧为流式生成的英文译文，逐行对齐。
在输入框输入英文，可获得日文翻译、逐词解析及回译，确认后发送。
翻译使用你自己的 OpenRouter API 密钥；你启用的频道中的聊天行会发送至 OpenRouter。早期版本。

Punchline.Original: Utilidades para cada ocasión: mapa, animaciones, trajes y misiones.
Punchline.Translated: 应对各种场景的工具：地图、动画、服装与任务。

Description.Original: Mapa con aplicaciones, animaciones de Penumbra, emotes, conjuntos de Glamourer, traducción con ChatTranslated y Quest Share. Usa /zetrom para abrirlo; las misiones se comparten desde Misiones o Zetrom Quest Share.
Description.Translated: 提供带应用功能的地图、Penumbra 动画、情感动作、Glamourer 搭配、ChatTranslated 翻译及 Quest Share。使用 /zetrom 打开；可从任务页面或 Zetrom Quest Share 分享任务。

Punchline.Original: WoW-style chat window.
Punchline.Translated: 《魔兽世界》风格的聊天窗口。

Description.Original: Replaces the chat log with a themeable window: tabs, filters, whisper tabs. Works like WoW chat with Prat. KittyUI and Naowh looks included.
Description.Translated: 用支持主题的窗口替换聊天记录，提供标签页、筛选和私聊标签。使用方式类似搭配 Prat 的《魔兽世界》聊天界面。内置 KittyUI 和 Naowh 风格。

Punchline.Original: KittyUI inside the game: a live layout studio, plugin settings, themes, profiles, backups, macros and a plugin browser.
Punchline.Translated: 游戏内 KittyUI：实时布局编辑器、插件设置、主题、配置、备份、宏与插件浏览器。

Description.Original: The in-game half of KittyUI. Move and resize the plugins' elements and the game's own HUD over the real HUD, edit every plugin's settings in one place, recolour them with one palette, install UI themes, switch and save kitty collections, write macros, browse and update plugins by reading their repositories directly, and keep backups. Changes reach the plugins without a restart; the desktop app shares the same data. Does nothing on its own: KittyUI asks, the companion does, never in combat.
Description.Translated: KittyUI 的游戏内配套组件。可在真实 HUD 上移动、缩放插件元素与游戏原生 HUD，在一处编辑所有插件设置，用统一调色板修改颜色，安装界面主题，切换和保存 kitty 配置集合，编写宏，直接读取仓库以浏览和更新插件，并保留备份。修改无需重启即可传递到插件；桌面应用共享同一份数据。不会自行执行操作：由 KittyUI 发出请求，配套组件执行，且绝不在战斗中执行。

Punchline.Original: Details!-style damage meter.
Punchline.Translated: Details! 风格的伤害统计器。

Description.Original: Bars, breakdowns, deaths, interrupts, a timeline and a replay from IINACT's log lines. Naowh look after NaowhUI.
Description.Translated: 基于 IINACT 日志生成统计条、明细、死亡记录、打断记录、时间轴和回放。Naowh 外观参考 NaowhUI。

Punchline.Original: Stop re-picking your Beastmaster familiars before every Crucible battle.
Punchline.Translated: 无需在每场斗兽奇弈前重新选择驯兽师魔兽。

Description.Original: picks the first 3 beasts / remembers your beast selection and sets it by default, as it should have been
Description.Translated: 选择前三只魔兽，或记住你选定的魔兽并设为默认，就该这么方便。

Description.Original: Aggro and danger radius visualizer for Eureka (Anemos, Pagos, Pyros, Hydatos). Vision cones, sleeping dragon sound aggro detection (walk!), low HP blood aggro, sprite magic aggro, and cast alerts.
Description.Translated: 可视化优雷卡（常风、恒冰、涌火、丰水之地）的仇恨与危险范围。显示视野锥形、沉睡巨龙的声音感知（请步行！）、低血量生命感知、元素精灵的魔法感知，以及咏唱警报。

Punchline.Original: Never miss an aether current again!
Punchline.Translated: 再也不错过风脉泉！

Description.Original: Simple overlay showing nearby aether currents with distance and direction
Description.Translated: 用简洁悬浮界面显示附近风脉泉的距离与方向。

Punchline.Original: Track your duty unlock progress!
Punchline.Translated: 追踪副本解锁进度！

Description.Original: Shows a checklist of all duties and which ones you have unlocked
Description.Translated: 显示全部副本的检查清单及各项是否已解锁。

Punchline.Original: Tells the king his prices are on backwards
Punchline.Translated: 告诉国王，他把价签贴反了。

Description.Original: Automates market board penny pinching. Fork of Dagobert by SHOEGAZEssb with extra options; imports your existing Dagobert settings on first run.
Description.Translated: 自动执行市场布告板上的精打细算操作。基于 SHOEGAZEssb 的 Dagobert 分支，提供额外选项；首次运行会导入已有 Dagobert 设置。

Punchline.Original: Your loyal companions, always by your side
Punchline.Translated: 忠实的小伙伴，始终陪在你身边。

Description.Original: Associates minion lists with gearsets and auto-summons a random minion
Description.Translated: 将宠物列表关联到装备套装，并自动随机召唤宠物。

Punchline.Original: Separately we are tweaks, but together we form a mighty YABOT!
Punchline.Translated: 分开是小功能，合体就是强大的 YABOT！

Description.Original: YABOT - Yet Another Bundle of Tweaks. A collection of small quality-of-life tweaks.
Description.Translated: YABOT——又一套小功能合集，汇集各种提升游戏便利性的小调整。

Punchline.Original: Fades the chat log out when nobody has said anything for a while.
Punchline.Translated: 一段时间没人说话时，让聊天记录淡出。

Description.Original: The chat log sits there whether or not it has anything to show. Chat Fade dims it away after a quiet stretch and brings it back the moment someone talks, you start typing, or a situation you chose to keep it up for begins. Combat spam does not count as conversation unless you say it does.
Description.Translated: 无论有没有新内容，聊天记录总占在那里。Chat Fade 会在安静一段时间后让它淡出；有人说话、你开始输入，或进入你指定需要保持显示的情境时，立即恢复。除非你主动设置，否则战斗刷屏不算聊天。

Punchline.Original: Equips recommended gear and saves it back to your gear sets.
Punchline.Translated: 装备推荐装备，并将结果保存回装备套装。

Description.Original: Refresh the current job or one gear set per unlocked job with the game's recommended equipment.
Description.Translated: 用游戏推荐装备更新当前职业，或为每个已解锁职业更新一套装备套装。

Punchline.Original: Makes the minimap square and strips away unwanted decoration.
Punchline.Translated: 将小地图变成方形，去掉不需要的装饰。

Description.Original: Reframes the native minimap as a clean square and provides controls for its border, ornaments, compass, coordinates, weather, and zoom controls.
Description.Translated: 将原生小地图改为简洁方形，并提供边框、装饰、罗盘、坐标、天气与缩放控件的显示设置。

Punchline.Original: The best gear for your level, at a glance
Punchline.Translated: 当前等级的最佳装备，一目了然。

Description.Original: A native character-window-style panel showing the best gear for your current class and level, filtered by what you own, what's on the market board, vendor gear, crafted gear and more. Every slot has the game's own item tooltip and context menu, and the Recommended Gear button equips the picks you own.
Description.Translated: 以原生角色窗口风格的面板显示当前职业和等级的最佳装备，可按已拥有、市场布告板、NPC 商店、制作装备等来源筛选。每个部位都支持游戏原生物品提示与右键菜单，推荐装备按钮会穿上推荐方案中你已拥有的装备。

Punchline.Original: The right outfit for every job and every place
Punchline.Translated: 每个职业、每个地方，都有合适的搭配。

Description.Original: Applies your glamour plates automatically. Make rules like "Red Mage in Ishgard wears plate 4": pick jobs, then places sorted by expansion (whole regions, cities, single zones or the exact area you're standing in), your house or FC house, Eorzea time and weather. The first matching rule wins, each job can have its own fallback, and if you're outside a resting area the plate goes on as soon as you reach one.
Description.Translated: 自动应用投影模板。可建立“赤魔法师在伊修加德使用第 4 套模板”这样的规则：选择职业，再选择按资料片分类的地点（整片地区、城市、单张地图或当前所在的精确区域）、个人房屋或部队房屋，以及艾欧泽亚时间和天气。第一条匹配规则生效，各职业可设置默认备选；若身处非休息区，会在进入休息区后立即应用模板。

Punchline.Original: Never lose a tell again
Punchline.Translated: 再也不漏看悄悄话。

Description.Original: Puts every tell in one messenger window. Each person gets their own conversation with saved history, unread badges, online status and location, replies and drafts. Linkshell chat (and optionally party, alliance and Free Company chat) goes in a Linkshells tab, and tells from strangers can wait in a Requests tab. Based on the WoW addon WhisperMessenger.
Description.Translated: 把所有悄悄话集中到即时通讯窗口。每人拥有独立会话，支持保存历史、未读标记、在线状态和位置、回复及草稿。通讯贝聊天，以及可选的小队、团队和部队聊天，归入通讯贝标签页；陌生人的悄悄话可先放在请求标签页。基于《魔兽世界》插件 WhisperMessenger。

Punchline.Original: Mark it, sell it
Punchline.Translated: 标记好，卖出去。

Description.Original: Mark inventory items as vendor wares or market listings with native badges, multi-select with Ctrl+click, and sell every marked ware in one click at vendors and retainers.
Description.Translated: 用原生徽标将背包物品标记为卖给 NPC 或上架市场，支持 Ctrl+click 多选，并可在商人和雇员处一键出售所有已标记的待售物品。

Punchline.Original: Compact nameplates for A/S rank hunt marks.
Punchline.Translated: A/S 级恶名精英的紧凑姓名板。

Description.Original: Compact NameId-based A/S and SS hunt nameplates, SS minion tracking, detection alerts and announced ET countdowns.
Description.Translated: 基于 NameId 显示 A/S 级及 SS 狩猎目标的紧凑姓名板，支持追踪 SS 随从、发现提醒和艾欧泽亚时间倒计时播报。

Punchline.Original: Read and send FFXIV chat from your phone, end-to-end encrypted.
Punchline.Translated: 在手机上读写 FFXIV 聊天，采用端到端加密。

Description.Original:
Relays chat to paired phones through an end-to-end encrypted relay and lets you reply from the phone.

DM @mtvirux on discord for assistance or bug reports.
Description.Translated:
通过端到端加密的中继，将聊天转发到配对手机，并允许从手机回复。

如需帮助或报告问题，请在 Discord 私信 @mtvirux。

Punchline.Original: A tabbed messenger for tells, your free company, linkshells and cross-world linkshells.
Punchline.Translated: 带标签页的通讯窗口，管理悄悄话、部队、通讯贝与跨服通讯贝。

Description.Original: Keeps every tell, your free company, and each linkshell and cross-world linkshell in its own conversation, grouped under tabs with a sidebar to switch between them. Remembers history per character, counts what you have not read, shows which tells are with friends and whether they are online, busy or in a duty, and plays a sound of your choosing for each kind of chat. Clickable links, item tooltips, search, symbols and pop-out windows included. Can follow Dalamud's style, the game's UI theme or your Umbra colour profile, and an optional Umbra companion adds a toolbar widget that shows unread messages.
Description.Translated: 将每位玩家的悄悄话、部队、各通讯贝和跨服通讯贝保留为独立会话，按标签页分组，并通过侧边栏切换。按角色保存历史、统计未读消息，显示悄悄话对象是否为好友及其在线、忙碌或副本状态，并可为各类聊天选择提示音。支持可点击链接、物品提示、搜索、符号与独立弹出窗口。外观可跟随 Dalamud 风格、游戏界面主题或 Umbra 配色；可选 Umbra 配套组件还能在工具栏显示未读消息。

Punchline.Original: マクロとかUIとかいろいろコピーします。
Punchline.Translated: 复制宏、界面等各种设置。

Description.Original: マクロとかUIとかいろいろコピーします。
Description.Translated: 复制宏、界面等各种设置。

Punchline.Original: ゲーム内のBGMを選んで再生できます。
Punchline.Translated: 选择并播放游戏内背景音乐。

Description.Original:
拡張・ジャンルのタブとコンテンツ名で曲を探せるBGMプレイヤーです。お気に入り、マイリスト、ランダム再生に対応しています。ミニプレイヤーは上部をドラッグして移動できます。

/bgmplayer で開く
/bgmplayer stop で通常のBGMに戻す
Description.Translated:
通过资料片、曲风标签和游戏内容名称查找曲目的背景音乐播放器。支持收藏、自建列表与随机播放。拖动迷你播放器顶部即可移动。

/bgmplayer 打开
/bgmplayer stop 恢复正常背景音乐

Description.Original: Spawn and place custom characters, NPCs, and monsters locally on the map with customizable animations, expressions, gizmos, and presets.
Description.Translated: 在本地地图中生成并摆放自定义角色、NPC 和怪物，支持自定义动画、表情、操作手柄与预设。

Punchline.Original: Doman Mahjong, solved for you.
Punchline.Translated: 替你打好多玛方城战。

Description.Original: Reads your Doman Mahjong hand and tells you the best discard, or plays the match for you. Fork of XeldarAlz/FFXIV-AutoMahjongSolver adding Korean-client support.
Description.Translated: 读取你的多玛方城战手牌，推荐最佳舍牌，或代你完成对局。基于 XeldarAlz/FFXIV-AutoMahjongSolver 的分支，新增韩文客户端支持。

Punchline.Original: MIDI player and band manager for FFXIV bards: play, sync your party, and keep the ensemble in time.
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 吟游诗人的 MIDI 播放器与乐队管理器：播放乐曲、同步队伍，让合奏保持节拍一致。

Description.Original:
Play MIDI files on any instrument with a playlist, per-track controls and auto instrument switching. Host your party as a band: the leader plays songs for everyone, swaps instruments, assigns tracks, and starts the ensemble in sync. The leader can also send songs straight to members, so they don't need any MIDI files of their own. The song is held in memory only, never saved to their disk. Includes formations with a follow mode, a compact overlay, emotes, and optional member extras (camera and render tweaks, auto-accept for listed friends, restart or close clients). Everything is encrypted and direct, with no outside server, and members opt in to anything that controls their character or game.

Use /bph to open it. Formations need vnavmesh.
Description.Translated:
使用任意乐器播放 MIDI 文件，支持播放列表、逐轨控制与自动切换乐器。将小队组织为乐队：队长为所有人播放歌曲、切换乐器、分配音轨并同步开始合奏。队长还能直接发送歌曲给成员，无需成员自行准备 MIDI 文件；歌曲只保留在内存中，不会写入成员硬盘。包含带跟随模式的队形、紧凑悬浮界面、情感动作，以及可选的成员附加功能（摄像机和渲染调整、自动接受名单好友请求、重启或关闭客户端）。所有通信均加密并直接传输，无需外部服务器；任何控制成员角色或游戏的功能都需要成员主动同意。

使用 /bph 打开。队形功能需要 vnavmesh。

Punchline.Original: Old consoles in a window inside FFXIV. Named for the place made of memories.
Punchline.Translated: 在 FFXIV 窗口里玩经典主机游戏，以那片由回忆构成的地方命名。

Description.Original: A place built from memories: plays NES, Game Boy, Game Boy Advance and Super Nintendo games in a window styled after a Final Fantasy menu. Master System, PlayStation and PlayStation 2 are in progress. Rebindable controls, gamepad support, battery saves and save states. Bring your own games.
Description.Translated: 由回忆构筑的地方：在《最终幻想》菜单风格的窗口中游玩 NES、Game Boy、Game Boy Advance 和 Super Nintendo 游戏。Master System、PlayStation 与 PlayStation 2 支持正在开发。提供可重绑按键、手柄支持、游戏存档与即时存档。请自行准备游戏。

Punchline.Original: Dice and bluffing games to play with other players in-game.
Punchline.Translated: 在游戏内与其他玩家一起玩骰子与诈唬游戏。

Description.Original: A collection of tavern games (Liar's Dice, Pig, Mia, Blackjack, Hold'em, Roulette and more). Create or join a room with a short code, fill seats with bots, and let onlookers spectate. Open with /tavern.
Description.Translated: 酒馆游戏合集，包括吹牛骰、Pig、Mia、二十一点、德州扑克、轮盘等。通过短码创建或加入房间，可用机器人补齐座位，也允许旁人观战。使用 /tavern 打开。

Punchline.Original: Crafting, gathering, and market automation
Punchline.Translated: 制作、采集与市场自动化。

Description.Original: A plugin to automate crafting, gathering, and market board functions. Drakos allows you to construct orders and automate gathering, crafting, and undercutting on the market board.
Description.Translated: 自动执行制作、采集及市场布告板操作。Drakos 允许创建订单，并自动采集、制作和调整市场售价以低于竞争者。

Punchline.Original: Small quality of life tweaks, one toggle at a time.
Punchline.Translated: 一个开关一项功能，轻松改善游戏体验。

Description.Original:
A growing collection of small quality of life tweaks.
Open /goblintweaks to turn them on and configure them.
Description.Translated:
持续扩充的便利小功能合集。
打开 /goblintweaks 启用并配置各项功能。

Punchline.Original: Plugin context menu entries, off the game menu.
Punchline.Translated: 将插件右键菜单项从游戏菜单中独立出来。

Description.Original: Moves context menu entries added through Dalamud into a panel beside the game menu.
Description.Translated: 将通过 Dalamud 添加的右键菜单项移到游戏菜单旁的独立面板中。

Punchline.Original: Target an NPC and follow them around.
Punchline.Translated: 选中 NPC，跟着它走。

Description.Original: Target an overworld NPC and automatically follow it using vnavmesh.
Description.Translated: 选中野外 NPC，通过 vnavmesh 自动跟随。

Punchline.Original: Make and apply a portrait in one click.
Punchline.Translated: 一键制作并应用肖像。

Description.Original: Find curated portrait looks, generate variations from your own portrait, and preview them in the game's editor.
Description.Translated: 查找精选肖像风格，根据自己的肖像生成变体，并在游戏编辑器中预览。

Punchline.Original: Automatically price new and existing retainer listings.
Punchline.Translated: 自动为雇员新上架和已有商品定价。

Description.Original: Automatically price eligible inventory and reprice existing listings one gil below matching competition using live local marketboard data. Persistent item exclusions remain user controlled.
Description.Translated: 利用当前服务器市场布告板的实时数据，为符合条件的背包物品定价，并将已有商品售价调整为比同类竞争商品低 1 金币。持久排除的物品始终由用户控制。

Punchline.Original: 製作・採集のジョブクエ（Lv1〜70）を素材集めから報告まで自動で進める
Punchline.Translated: 自动完成生产、采集职业 Lv1～70 的职业任务，从收集材料到交付一并处理。

Description.Original:
木工〜調理の8職と採掘・園芸・漁師のジョブクエ（Lv1〜70）を自動で進めます。足りない素材をリテイナー・マーケットボード・NPC 購入・戦闘・採集・精選・釣りで集め、未読の秘伝書は収集品の納品で得た紫貨で交換し、グリダニアの宿屋で製作・マテリア装着をして、Questionable でクエストを受注・報告します。

選んだ職が Lv70 以上、製作職の装備が Lv68 以上であることなどが開始の条件です。マーケットボードの自動購入でギルを使います。

Artisan・GatherBuddyReborn・vnavmesh・AutoHook・Lifestream・Questionable・RotationSolverReborn・TextAdvance・BossModReborn・Allagan Tools（または Allagan Item Search）が必要です。
Description.Translated:
自动完成从刻木匠到烹调师的 8 个生产职业，以及采矿工、园艺工、捕鱼人的 Lv1～70 职业任务。通过雇员、市场布告板、NPC 购买、战斗、采集、精选和钓鱼补齐材料；用交付收藏品获得的紫票兑换尚未学习的秘籍，在格里达尼亚旅馆制作并镶嵌魔晶石，再通过 Questionable 接取和交付任务。

启动条件包括所选职业至少 Lv70、生产职业装备至少 Lv68 等。市场布告板自动购买会消耗金币。

需要 Artisan、GatherBuddyReborn、vnavmesh、AutoHook、Lifestream、Questionable、RotationSolverReborn、TextAdvance、BossModReborn，以及 Allagan Tools（或 Allagan Item Search）。

Punchline.Original: Levels a crafter to a target level by itself: plans, fetches, buys, crafts and does the class quests.
Punchline.Translated: 自动将生产职业练到目标等级：规划、取物、采购、制作并完成职业任务。

Description.Original: Pick a crafter and a target level and press Go. It plans from your bags, retainers and the game data, then fetches from retainers (Artisan), buys vendor items (GatherBuddy Reborn) and, only if you tick it, market board items within your price caps, crafts each step with Artisan, does the class quests with Questionable, sells what it crafts (AutoRetainer) and re-plans at every checkpoint. A Quests tab plans and runs quest chains. Needs Artisan, vnavmesh, Lifestream and Allagan Tools; the window lists the rest. English client only for market board buying.
Description.Translated: 选择生产职业和目标等级，按下 Go 即可。插件根据背包、雇员和游戏数据规划，随后通过 Artisan 从雇员取物、通过 GatherBuddy Reborn 购买 NPC 商品；只有你勾选后，才会在限价内购买市场布告板物品。每步由 Artisan 制作，用 Questionable 完成职业任务，通过 AutoRetainer 出售成品，并在每个检查点重新规划。任务标签页可规划并执行任务链。需要 Artisan、vnavmesh、Lifestream 和 Allagan Tools；其余依赖会在窗口中列出。市场布告板购买仅支持英文客户端。

Punchline.Original: Camera controls for house interiors only.
Punchline.Translated: 仅供住宅室内使用的摄像机控制。

Description.Original: Open /cam inside a player house to adjust zoom, field of view, camera height and collision.
Description.Translated: 在玩家房屋内打开 /cam，调整镜头缩放、视野角度、高度和碰撞。

Punchline.Original: Back up and copy complete character settings.
Punchline.Translated: 备份并复制完整角色设置。

Description.Original: Open /cc to copy character settings, import into one character, undo the latest transfer or restore a backup.
Description.Translated: 打开 /cc，可复制角色设置、导入到指定角色、撤销最近一次转移或恢复备份。

Punchline.Original: Adjust your lift and stay still inside a house.
Punchline.Translated: 在房屋内调整抬升高度，并固定位置。

Description.Original: Open /zlock inside a player house, choose a lift, and press Lock Height & Movement. Press Unlock to release it.
Description.Translated: 在玩家房屋内打开 /zlock，选择抬升高度，然后按“Lock Height & Movement”（锁定高度与移动）。按“Unlock”（解锁）解除。

Punchline.Original: Troubleshoot and manually reload plugins.
Punchline.Translated: 排查问题并手动重载插件。

Description.Original: General plugin diagnostics and owner-controlled support. Open /syncfix.
Description.Translated: 通用插件诊断与由使用者控制的支持工具。使用 /syncfix 打开。

Punchline.Original: Update gearsets with Recommended Gear and organize the Armoury Chest.
Punchline.Translated: 使用推荐装备更新装备套装，并整理兵装库。

Description.Original: Updates saved gearsets using FFXIV's Recommended Gear calculation. Includes background and traditional updaters, Armoury Chest organization, displaced-gear cleanup, and a clickable server-info-bar status shortcut for starting Background Update.
Description.Translated: 利用 FFXIV 的推荐装备计算更新已保存的装备套装。包含后台和传统更新方式、兵装库整理、替换下来的装备清理，以及可点击启动后台更新的服务器信息栏状态入口。

Punchline.Original: Queue selected roulettes when your role is in need.
Punchline.Translated: 当你的职能成为稀缺职能时，排入所选随机任务。

Description.Original: Role-based roulette monitoring with priorities, random queue delay, daily reward filtering, and five-minute presence checks.
Description.Translated: 按职能监控随机任务，支持优先级、随机排队延迟、每日奖励筛选及每五分钟的在场确认。

Punchline.Original: Distribute the gear in your inventory across all your retainers: highest item level for combat, best Gathering and Perception for gatherers.
Punchline.Translated: 将背包装备分配给所有雇员：战斗雇员追求最高品级，采集雇员追求更高的获得力和鉴别力。

Description.Original:
Cycles through every retainer at a summoning bell and distributes gear from your main inventory (Inventory 1-4) across all combat (DoW/DoM) retainers to maximize their total item level. Gear a retainer drops when it's upgraded can be passed down to another retainer in the same run, and no retainer ever loses item level in any slot. The armoury chest is ignored and gathering retainers are skipped for now.

Open a summoning bell, then use /rgo start or the Start button in /rgo. Enable Dry run in /rgo to preview the plan without moving anything.
Description.Translated:
在传唤铃处遍历所有雇员，将主背包（Inventory 1-4）的装备分配给战斗雇员（战斗精英/魔法导师），尽量提高其总装备品级。同一轮中，某雇员换下的装备可继续转交其他雇员，且不会降低任何雇员任一部位的品级。忽略兵装库，暂时跳过采集雇员。

打开传唤铃后，使用 /rgo start 或 /rgo 中的 Start 按钮。启用 /rgo 中的 Dry run，可仅预览计划而不移动物品。

Punchline.Original: 만사가 귀찮은 공주님들을 위한 자동 정리 집사님!
Punchline.Translated: 献给嫌麻烦的公主们——自动整理的贴心管家！

Description.Original: 1단계에서 장비칸의 추억의 보관함 가능 장비를 안전 검사 후 보관하고, 2단계에서 Dungeon Drip 기반 환상의 옷장 후보를 순차 복원합니다. 제작직 전용 장비 포함 여부와 AutoRetainer 연동을 설정할 수 있습니다.
Description.Translated: 第 1 阶段经过安全检查后，将装备栏中可放入收藏柜的装备存入；第 2 阶段依照 Dungeon Drip 数据，依次恢复投影台候选装备。可设置是否包含生产职业专用装备，以及与 AutoRetainer 联动。

Punchline.Original: Turns the screen black while you're away.
Punchline.Translated: 离开时让屏幕变黑。

Description.Original: Fades the screen to black when the game is in the background or when you are away. You can change the behavior for duties, crafting, and other situations. A timer shows that the game is still running. This plugin helps to prevent burn-in on OLED monitors.
Description.Translated: 游戏位于后台或你暂离时，将画面淡出至黑色。可针对副本、制作等情境调整行为。计时器会提示游戏仍在运行。此插件有助于防止 OLED 显示器烧屏。

Punchline.Original: Live Odyssey Trials table for fates and gods.
Punchline.Translated: 面向命运与诸神的 Odyssey Trials 实时桌面。

Description.Original: Use /odyssey to open. Shares trial sessions, registration, threads, and god dice boards.
Description.Translated: 使用 /odyssey 打开。共享试炼会话、报名、讨论串及神明骰盘。

Punchline.Original: A live portrait camera following your character's bones.
Punchline.Translated: 跟随角色骨骼的实时肖像摄像机。

Description.Original: Experimental second-view portrait window. Select a character and bone, adjust the camera, and resize the portrait. Offers a legacy dual-tick backend and an experimental render-only backend. Run /dportrait to configure; rendering starts disabled.
Description.Translated: 实验性的第二视角肖像窗口。选择角色和骨骼，调整摄像机并缩放肖像窗口。提供传统双更新后端和实验性纯渲染后端。使用 /dportrait 配置，渲染默认关闭。

Punchline.Original: Finds the plugin behind your stutter.
Punchline.Translated: 找出让游戏卡顿的插件。

Description.Original: Watches every other plugin's draw and update time and error output. When one of them stalls a frame, eats frame time steadily, or throws repeatedly, Culprit names it in a notification so you know which plugin to look at.
Description.Translated: 监测其他所有插件的绘制、更新耗时和错误输出。当某个插件阻塞一帧、持续占用大量帧时间或反复抛出异常时，Culprit 会在通知中指出其名称，让你知道该检查哪个插件。

Punchline.Original: One window for every lalalazy plugin.
Punchline.Translated: 一个窗口管理所有 lalalazy 插件。

Description.Original: One in-game window for the whole lalalazy suite. Turn plugins on and off, change their common settings and open their windows from one place, with Gluttony Combo's Auto-Rotation switch and drag-to-hotbar action buttons up front, plus a server info bar entry. Open it with /lazy.
Description.Translated: 为整套 lalalazy 插件提供统一游戏内窗口。在一处启用/停用插件、修改共用设置和打开各插件窗口；显著位置提供 Gluttony Combo 自动循环开关，以及可拖到热键栏的动作按钮，另有服务器信息栏入口。使用 /lazy 打开。

Punchline.Original: End-to-end encrypted, cross-world linkshells.
Punchline.Translated: 端到端加密的跨服通讯贝。

Description.Original: LookingGlass adds extra linkshells that work across worlds and data centres. Channel names and messages are end-to-end encrypted: the server only relays ciphertext. Use /lookingglass (or /lg) to set up, and /lgc1 to /lgc50, or /lgc followed by a channel nickname, to talk. In testing: you need a server address from the server's operator.
Description.Translated: LookingGlass 添加可跨服务器和数据中心使用的额外通讯贝。频道名与消息均端到端加密，服务器仅转发密文。使用 /lookingglass（或 /lg）设置，通过 /lgc1 至 /lgc50，或 /lgc 后接频道昵称发言。当前处于测试阶段，需要向服务器运营者获取服务器地址。

Punchline.Original: Search and import strategy board share codes.
Punchline.Translated: 搜索并导入战术板分享代码。

Description.Original: A searchable local library for FFXIV Strategy Board share codes, with quick copy and FFXIVStrats link intake.
Description.Translated: 可搜索的 FFXIV 战术板分享代码本地资料库，支持快速复制和导入 FFXIVStrats 链接。

Punchline.Original: Comparte misiones con selección de destinos y marcado automático.
Punchline.Translated: 分享任务，支持目的地选择和自动标记。

Description.Original: Variante experimental de QuestShare. Usa secuencias reales de misión, selector de destinos cuando hay varios objetivos y marcado automático al cambiar de fase. /zquests abre la ventana. Basado en QuestShare de Era, AGPL-3.0-or-later.
Description.Translated: QuestShare 的实验性变体。使用真实任务阶段序列，在有多个目标时提供目的地选择器，并在阶段改变时自动标记。/zquests 打开窗口。基于 Era 的 QuestShare，许可证为 AGPL-3.0-or-later。

ZetromQuestShare.Author: Zetrom; based on QuestShare by Era

Punchline.Original: Chat 3 re-worked for me! - ♪ A slightly new chat, forked and reworked ♪
Punchline.Translated: 为我重新改造的 Chat 3！——♪ 稍微焕新的聊天，分支改造而来 ♪

Description.Original: Chat 3 is a trimmed fork of ChatTwo for personal use. It is trimmed and made to be a lite runner. No upstream maintaining will be kept and will feature the same IPC.
Description.Translated: Chat 3 是精简后的 ChatTwo 个人使用分支，旨在轻量运行。不会持续跟进上游维护，保留相同 IPC。

Punchline.Original: Wakey Wakey Rime.
Punchline.Translated: 醒醒啦，Rime。

Description.Original: Changes ready check notification to something more appropriate
Description.Translated: 将准备确认通知改为更合适的提示。

Punchline.Original: Color, find and organize your items.
Punchline.Translated: 给物品着色，查找并整理它们。

Description.Original: Right-click an item and choose ColorCode to assign a color. Open /colorcode to search items and sort by color.
Description.Translated: 右键物品并选择 ColorCode 设置颜色。打开 /colorcode 搜索物品，并按颜色排序。

Punchline.Original: Assigns the best venture to every retainer, for loot or for EXP.
Punchline.Translated: 根据收益或经验，为每名雇员分配最佳探险任务。

Description.Original: Open the retainer list at a summoning bell and let the plugin pick and assign the optimal venture for each retainer. Rewards mode maximizes expected item value (Universalis prices with vendor-price fallback); EXP mode maximizes retainer experience. Use /rva to open the window.
Description.Translated: 在传唤铃处打开雇员列表，让插件为每名雇员选择并分配最优探险任务。收益模式最大化物品预期价值，优先使用 Universalis 价格，无数据时回退至 NPC 收购价；经验模式最大化雇员经验。使用 /rva 打开窗口。

Punchline.Original: Remembers what every character has done, so you don't have to.
Punchline.Translated: 记住每个角色完成过什么，让你省心。

Description.Original: A progress checklist for all your characters. Each character appears after you log into it once with the plugin running: its story, jobs, events, dailies and weeklies, content, collections and money, and your own tasks. See what is left on every character in one list, compare them side by side, add up their gil and currencies with gil over time, and give each character a role that decides what counts for it. Mnemosyne stores character data only on this PC. It is never uploaded anywhere. It reads the game and never writes to it; its optional switch button asks Lifestream to change character.
Description.Translated: 所有角色的进度清单。插件运行时登录过一次的角色便会加入，记录剧情、职业、活动、日常与周常、游戏内容、收藏、资金及自定义任务。在一张列表中查看每个角色待办，横向比较，汇总金币和其他货币并查看金币变化；还能给角色指定定位，决定哪些项目计入其目标。Mnemosyne 仅在本机存储角色数据，绝不上传。只读取游戏，不写入游戏；可选的切换按钮会请求 Lifestream 更换角色。

Punchline.Original: Draw ants when things are off cooldown.
Punchline.Translated: 技能冷却结束时绘制流动高亮边框。

Description.Original: For the WoW player who can't live without WeakAuras lighting up a button when it's off CD. /pants to configure.
Description.Translated: 献给离不开 WeakAuras 冷却完成按钮高亮的《魔兽世界》玩家。使用 /pants 配置。

Punchline.Original: A plugin for creating profiles, groups and soon stat sheets, quests and events!
Punchline.Translated: 创建角色资料、群组，并将很快支持属性表、任务与活动的插件！

Description.Original: Allows users to create, manage, view and bookmark roleplay profiles with FF.
Description.Translated: 让用户在 FF 中创建、管理、查看并收藏角色扮演资料。

Punchline.Original: Shows the date when you acquired something.
Punchline.Translated: 显示你获得各类内容的日期。

Description.Original:
Shows the date when you acquired:
- Achievements
- Quests
- Duties
- Levels
- Fish
- Sightseeing Log Entries
- Glasses
- Minions
- Mounts
- Orchestrion Rolls
- Fashion Accessories
And More!
Description.Translated:
显示以下内容的获得或完成日期：
- 成就
- 任务
- 副本
- 等级
- 鱼类
- 探索笔记条目
- 眼镜
- 宠物
- 坐骑
- 管弦乐琴乐谱
- 时尚配饰
以及更多！

Punchline.Original: Give your UI that premium, acrylic look upgrade. Because Eorzea looks better with some blur.
Punchline.Translated: 让界面升级为高级的亚克力质感。艾欧泽亚，添点模糊更好看。

Description.Original: Blur the background behind native UI like acrylic or frosted glass, making it more elegant and readable. Customize your effects with acrylic styling, distortion, tints, and full control over brightness, saturation, and contrast.
Description.Translated: 将原生界面背后的背景模糊为亚克力或磨砂玻璃效果，使其更优雅、易读。可自定义亚克力样式、扭曲、染色，并完全控制亮度、饱和度与对比度。

Punchline.Original: Show your actions in real-time.
Punchline.Translated: 实时显示你使用的技能。

Description.Original: Configurable timeline display of all the actions you use.
Description.Translated: 以可配置的时间轴显示你使用的所有技能。

Punchline.Original: Switches your /hudlayout when your game switches from windowed to fullscreen.
Punchline.Translated: 游戏在窗口与全屏模式间切换时，自动切换 /hudlayout。

Description.Original:
Useful for ultrawide users, swapping from windowed/fullscreen will automatically switch your hudlayout.

/pah to configure
Description.Translated:
适合超宽屏用户，切换窗口/全屏时会自动切换 HUD 布局。

使用 /pah 配置。

Punchline.Original: Receive a notification when a duty roulette is in need of a role.
Punchline.Translated: 随机任务出现指定稀缺职能时收到通知。

Description.Original: Recieve a notification when a duty roulette is in need of a role. /pbonus to setup
Description.Translated: 随机任务出现指定稀缺职能时收到通知。使用 /pbonus 设置。

Punchline.Original: Adds a teleport link to the nearest aetheryte on every map link in chat.
Punchline.Translated: 为聊天中的每个地图链接添加传送到最近以太之光的链接。

Description.Original:
Display a teleport link to the nearest aetheryte for the map link from the in-game chat.

ゲーム内チャットのマップリンクに、最寄りのエーテライトへのテレポリンクを表示します。

Zeigt zu jedem Kartenlink im Spielchat einen Teleport-Link zum nächstgelegenen Ätheryten an.

Affiche un lien de téléportation vers l'éthérite la plus proche pour les liens de carte du chat en jeu.
Description.Translated: 为游戏聊天中的地图链接显示传送至最近以太之光的链接。

Punchline.Original: Mutes your game when you're AFK.
Punchline.Translated: 暂离时将游戏静音。

Description.Original: Mutes your game when you're AFK. /afkmute to toggle.
Description.Translated: 暂离时将游戏静音。使用 /afkmute 开关。

Punchline.Original: Trying to find that item you don't know the name of? Maybe Allagan Item Search can help.
Punchline.Translated: 想找某件物品却不知道名字？Allagan Item Search 也许能帮上忙。

Description.Original: Allagan Item Search is a dalamud plugin designed to help you search and filter all the items available in the game.
Description.Translated: Allagan Item Search 是用于搜索和筛选游戏中所有可用物品的 Dalamud 插件。

Punchline.Original: Get your retainer sales organized, track active sales, historical sales and undercutting!
Punchline.Translated: 整理雇员销售，追踪当前上架、历史成交与被压价情况！

Description.Original:
Allagan Market's primary purpose is to provide a list of all retainer listings/sales across all characters.

It'll do it's best to track your sales but it works best when it's always on!
Description.Translated:
Allagan Market 的主要用途，是汇总所有角色的雇员上架与销售记录。

它会尽力追踪你的销售情况，但持续保持启用时效果最好！

Punchline.Original: Even the Allags had time to burn!
Punchline.Translated: 就连亚拉戈人也需要打发时间！

Description.Original: A not so faithful recreation of the legendary game.
Description.Translated: 对那款传奇游戏不太忠实的复刻。

Punchline.Original: Informations about your alts
Punchline.Translated: 查看小号的信息。

Description.Original: Get informations (gils, currencies,  items, inventory, retainers, etc) and progress from all your characters
Description.Translated: 汇总所有角色的信息与进度，包括金币、货币、物品、背包和雇员等。

Punchline.Original: Even the Ascians needed some tunes.
Punchline.Translated: 就连无影也需要来点音乐。

Description.Original: A music player to play your own music files from within the game.
Description.Translated: 在游戏内播放你自己的音乐文件。

Punchline.Original: You like annoying low HP sounds? This is great for you!
Punchline.Translated: 喜欢烦人的低血量提示音？这个正适合你！

Description.Original:
Plays a sound for certain statuses of the player. Such as low HP or MP.
You will need to provide your own sound files.
Description.Translated:
在玩家处于特定状态时播放声音，例如 HP 或 MP 过低。
需要自行提供音频文件。

Punchline.Original: Like /bgm but automatic
Punchline.Translated: 像 /bgm 一样，不过是自动的。

Description.Original: Enables automatic BGM switching based Client Conditions.
Description.Translated: 根据客户端状态自动切换背景音乐。

Punchline.Original: Automatically control mount BGM for individual mounts!
Punchline.Translated: 按坐骑分别自动控制骑乘背景音乐！

Description.Original: Some mounts have really cool BGM tracks (Cruise Chaser FTW) while others are almost sickening in how much you hear them. It's annoying to keep needing to use /mountbgm, but now you won't have to - just let the plugin do it for you!
Description.Translated: 有些坐骑音乐特别带劲（巡航驱逐者万岁），另一些却听得让人发腻。总是手动输入 /mountbgm 很烦，现在不必了——交给插件处理！

Punchline.Original: Crowdsourced housing alerts and lottery tracking for all.
Punchline.Translated: 面向所有人的众包房屋出售通知与抽签追踪。

Description.Original:
Looking for that perfect house? PaissaHouse lets you receive notifications when a new plot of land is up for sale on your home world.

Want to contribute? Check out the repository (globe icon below) for instructions.
Description.Translated:
正在寻找理想房屋？当你所属服务器有新地块出售时，PaissaHouse 可以通知你。

想参与贡献？请前往代码仓库（下方地球图标）查看说明。

Punchline.Original: Auto-Attack Timer Bar.
Punchline.Translated: 自动攻击计时条。

Description.Original: Auto-Attack Timer Bar based on the Triggernometry trigger by aya liz.
Description.Translated: 基于 aya liz 的 Triggernometry 触发器制作的自动攻击计时条。

Punchline.Original: Displays a list of valid gear pieces beside hints in the Fashion Report minigame.
Punchline.Translated: 在时尚品鉴提示旁显示符合条件的装备列表。

Description.Original:
This plugin is a crowdsourced project, aiming to provide a comprehensive list for all hint categories.
See the github page for information on how you can contribute.
Open the Fashion Report window to get started!
Description.Translated:
这是一个众包项目，旨在为全部提示类别提供完整装备清单。
请查看 GitHub 页面，了解如何贡献。
打开时尚品鉴窗口即可开始！

Punchline.Original: Keep track of your FFXIV device's battery.
Punchline.Translated: 追踪游玩 FFXIV 的设备电量。

Description.Original:
Hey, you! Yes, you! Do you play FFXIV on your laptop or Steam Deck? Or are you so addicted to FFXIV that you have a UPS on your desktop just so you can keep playing through power outages? Then this is the plugin for you!

BatteryGauge adds a battery indicator to your server info bar showing your current battery percentage and expected remaining lifespan (as reported by Windows).
Description.Translated:
嘿，就是你！你用笔记本或 Steam Deck 玩 FFXIV 吗？还是沉迷到给台式机配了 UPS，只为停电也能继续玩？那这个插件正适合你！

BatteryGauge 在服务器信息栏中添加电池指示器，显示当前电量百分比及 Windows 报告的预计剩余续航。

Punchline.Original: That sure is a beeg dinosaur eat window.
Punchline.Translated: 这窗口可真是大到恐龙都能啃上一口。

Description.Original: Ensures that the game window is maximized when launching in windowed mode.
Description.Translated: 确保以窗口模式启动时，游戏窗口处于最大化状态。

Punchline.Original: SE friend list sucks.
Punchline.Translated: SE 的好友列表太难用了。

Description.Original:
Friend list but with better sorting, can search by name, refresh with a button, color names..
Right click for context menu.
Description.Translated:
更好用的好友列表：改善排序，支持按姓名搜索、一键刷新、姓名着色等。
右键打开菜单。

Punchline.Original: Choose which mounts show up in the mount roulette.
Punchline.Translated: 选择哪些坐骑参与随机坐骑召唤。

Description.Original: Allows any number of mounts to be enabled for the mount roulette, instead of having to choose between the "up to 30" and "EVERYTHING" modes supported by the game.
Description.Translated: 可让任意数量的坐骑参与随机坐骑召唤，不必再从游戏提供的“最多 30 只”和“全部”两种模式中二选一。

Punchline.Original: Use advanced Party Finder filter presets.
Punchline.Translated: 使用高级队伍招募筛选预设。

Description.Original:
Filter the party finder better.

All vanilla filtering is available, plus:

- Create filter presets to easily switch between
- Whitelist/blacklist specific duties and categories
- Add character names to hide PFs from
- Remove PFs above maximum item level
- Filter on item level range
- Filter on multiple jobs and slots (ex. MCH + GNB available)
Description.Translated:
更完善地筛选队伍招募。

保留全部原生筛选功能，并增加：

- 创建可快速切换的筛选预设
- 将指定副本和类别加入白名单或黑名单
- 按角色姓名隐藏其发布的招募
- 隐藏要求超过品级上限的招募
- 按品级范围筛选
- 按多个职业及空位筛选，例如同时有机工士与绝枪战士空位。

Punchline.Original: Ever wanted detailed information on your playtime all the way down to the second?
Punchline.Translated: 想查看精确到秒的游戏时长详情吗？

Description.Original:
Provides expanded functionality to seamlessly track total playtime.
      Use /btime once on each character to add them.

      - Supports multiple characters,
      - Customisable output formats such as hours or minutes
      - Automatic playtime tracking after character got registered
      - Simple window to see current session playtime
      - Server Info Bar integration
Description.Translated:
扩展游戏时长统计功能，自动持续记录总时长。
      每个角色使用一次 /btime 即可加入。

      - 支持多个角色
      - 可自定义为小时、分钟等输出格式
      - 角色登记后自动追踪游戏时长
      - 简洁窗口显示本次会话时长
      - 集成服务器信息栏

Punchline.Original: Take control of your shadows!
Punchline.Translated: 自己掌控阴影效果！

Description.Original: Directly adjust the distance of each shadow cascade! Now introducing 4k shadowmap!
Description.Translated: 直接调整每一级级联阴影的距离！现已加入 4K 阴影贴图！

Punchline.Original: A more intelligent targeting system for the game.
Punchline.Translated: 更智能的游戏目标选择系统。

Description.Original: A more intelligent targeting system for the game which also includes new keybinds.
Description.Translated: 更智能的游戏目标选择系统，还提供新的快捷键绑定。

Punchline.Original: Makes Nael quotes more visible.
Punchline.Translated: 让奈尔台词更醒目。

Description.Original: Displays Nael quotes using the Dawntrail gimmick-text so they're easier to read.
Description.Translated: 使用《金曦之遗辉》引入的机制提示文字样式显示奈尔台词，让它们更容易阅读。

Punchline.Original: Larger personal debuffs
Punchline.Translated: 放大你施加的减益状态。

Description.Original: Scales up buffs/debuffs applied by you on Target Status frames
Description.Translated: 在目标状态栏中放大由你施加的增益和减益图标。

Punchline.Original: In case the WoL speaks more than one language
Punchline.Translated: 假如光之战士不止会一种语言。

Description.Original:
Yes, we have tooltips displayed in two languages now. You paid SE for 4 languages so make very good use of it.

- Interested in localised item descriptions in different languages?
- Got fed up of transliterated カタカナ and would rather read just the original words?

We've got you! See plugin config to customise your own experience.
Description.Translated:
没错，现在提示信息可以同时显示两种语言。你付钱给 SE 买到了四种语言，当然要好好利用。

- 想了解不同语言的本地化物品说明？
- 受够了片假名音译，更想直接阅读原词？

交给我们！在插件设置中自定义你的使用体验。

Punchline.Original: Gearing, simplified.
Punchline.Translated: 配装，更简单。

Description.Original:
Highlights gear, coffers, and materia needed for all your gearsets
Import from from Etro, Xivgear, or Teamcraft for easy setup
            
Highlights items needed for gearsets on:
    - Need/Greed Loot Windows
    - NPC Shops and Exchanges
    - Marketboard
    - Player Inventories
    - Item Tooltips
           
When melding materia, highlights:
    - Items to meld
    - Materia to meld to item
            
Automatically syncs gearsets with player inventory
Description.Translated:
高亮所有装备套装需要的装备、装备箱和魔晶石。
可从 Etro、Xivgear 或 Teamcraft 导入，轻松完成设置。

在以下位置高亮套装所需物品：
    - 需求/贪婪分配窗口
    - NPC 商店和兑换处
    - 市场布告板
    - 玩家背包
    - 物品提示

镶嵌魔晶石时，高亮：
    - 需要镶嵌的装备
    - 该装备应镶嵌的魔晶石

自动将装备套装进度与玩家背包同步。

Punchline.Original: Helps you fill our your Blue Mage Spellbook
Punchline.Translated: 帮助你补全青魔法书。

Description.Original: Adds monster names and coordinates to the "Where to Learn" section of your blue mage spellbook.
Description.Translated: 在青魔法书的学习地点部分补充怪物名称与坐标。

Name.Translated: 更好的无边框窗口模式

Punchline.Original: Make borderless window mode work well with aero shortcuts
Punchline.Translated: 让无边框窗口模式正确配合 Aero 快捷键。

Description.Original: Borderless window can now be properly minimized (by clicking on taskbar or by win+down shortcut); when moved between monitors (win+shift+left/right), resolution is updated automatically.
Description.Translated: 无边框窗口现在可以正确最小化，支持点击任务栏或使用 win+down；使用 win+shift+left/right 将窗口移动到其他显示器时，会自动更新分辨率。

Punchline.Original: Improve your Bozja suffering. Maybe.
Punchline.Translated: 改善你的博兹雅受苦体验。也许吧。

Description.Original:
Features:
• Resistance relic guide and tracking.
• Info about Lost Actions, Fragments, FATEs/CE, Field Notes e.g. location, drops, marketboard price, fate chains, mettle rewards, exp rewards, etc.
• Node graph viewer.
• Weather forecast.
• Alarms based on time, weather, and FATE/CE.
• Custom loadouts planning, saving, and sharing. Featuring recommended loadouts from many communities.
• Overlay for Lost Find Cache. Filterable by name, role, fragment, weight, and Custom Loadout of choice.
• View Bozja stats and Cache from anywhere. Customisable alert for actions that are running low.
• Delubrum Reginae (Savage) resources and communities.
Description.Translated:
功能：
• 义军武器指南与进度追踪。
• 失传技能、未鉴定的遗忘碎晶、危命任务/临界遭遇战（FATE/CE）及战果记录的信息，包括位置、掉落、市场价格、任务链、战果和经验奖励等。
• 节点关系图查看器。
• 天气预报。
• 基于时间、天气和 FATE/CE 的提醒。
• 自定义技能配置的规划、保存与分享，内含多个社区的推荐配置。
• 失传碎晶保管箱悬浮界面，可按名称、职能、碎晶、重量及选定配置筛选。
• 在任何地点查看博兹雅统计与保管箱，为数量不足的技能设置提醒。
• 零式女王古殿的资料与社区链接。

Punchline.Original: Hides toast notifications you don't want to see.
Punchline.Translated: 隐藏你不想看到的浮动提示通知。

Description.Original: Hides toast notifications you don't want to see.
Description.Translated: 隐藏你不想看到的浮动提示通知。

Punchline.Original: Save and load unlimited camera and lighting presets in Group Pose
Punchline.Translated: 在集体动作中保存和加载不限数量的摄像机与光照预设。

Description.Original: This plugin lets you save unlimited camera & lighting configurations/presets in Group Pose at a time, vastly improving over the vanilla feature which lets you save only one of each.
Description.Translated: 在集体动作中保存不限数量的摄像机和光照配置，远胜于原生各只能保存一套的功能。

Punchline.Original: CashFlow is a plugin that will log your trades, sales and purchases.
Punchline.Translated: CashFlow 记录你的交易、销售与购买。

Description.Original: CashFlow is a plugin that will log your trades, sales and purchases.
Description.Translated: CashFlow 记录你的交易、销售与购买。
