Punchline.Original: Play sounds and highlight text based on defined filters.
Punchline.Translated: 根据设定的筛选条件播放提示音并高亮文字。

Description.Original: Play sounds and highlight text based on defined filters.
Description.Translated: 根据设定的筛选条件播放提示音并高亮文字。

Punchline.Original: Add sender target name in chat messages.
Punchline.Translated: 在聊天消息中添加发送者的目标名称。

Description.Original: Add sender target name in chat messages and displays nearly player targets
Description.Translated: 在聊天消息中添加发送者的目标名称，并显示附近玩家所选目标。

Punchline.Original: Places flag marker on map from coordinates in chat.
Punchline.Translated: 根据聊天中的坐标在地图上插旗。

Description.Original: Places flag marker on map from coordinates in chat. "/coord help" or "/ctp help" for more info.
Description.Translated: 根据聊天中的坐标在地图上插旗。使用“/coord help”或“/ctp help”查看详情。

Punchline.Original: Know how far they talk from.
Punchline.Translated: 知道说话的人离你有多远。

Description.Original: This plugin will change message in the chat within the "say" channel (or other ranged channels), darkening people when they're far from you.
Description.Translated: 调整说话频道及其他有距离范围的频道中的消息显示，发言者离你越远，文字越暗。

Punchline.Original: Saves and filters chats.
Punchline.Translated: 保存并筛选聊天记录。

Description.Original: Allows for saving chat conversations, separated by groups of people and chat types.
Description.Translated: 按聊天对象分组及聊天类型，分别保存对话记录。

Punchline.Original: Ingame chat translator.
Punchline.Translated: 游戏内聊天翻译器。

Description.Original: Ingame chat translator.
Description.Translated: 游戏内聊天翻译器。

Punchline.Original: Dynamic Framerate Limiter, changes fps limit depend on what you are doing
Punchline.Translated: 动态帧率限制器，根据当前活动调整 FPS 上限。

Description.Original: Tired of your GPU melting your face off while just running around? Why render at 240 FPS when you're just staring at that gathering node? Fret no more! Chill Frames allows you dynamically limit your framerate when doing unimportant tasks!
Description.Translated: 只是跑跑图，显卡却烫得像要把脸融化了？盯着采集点时何必还跑 240 FPS？不用愁！Chill Frames 能在你进行不重要的活动时动态限制帧率！

Punchline.Original: Customizable, Source Engine-styled position info
Punchline.Translated: 可自定义的 Source 引擎风格位置显示。

Description.Original: Shows your exact position, rotation, and velocity on screen. Based off of the cl_showpos command from the Source Engine.
Description.Translated: 在屏幕上显示精确位置、朝向和速度，参考 Source 引擎的 cl_showpos 命令。

Punchline.Original: Seek visual serenity in the midst of Chaos
Punchline.Translated: 在混乱中寻得清爽视野。

Description.Original: Automatically adjusts the Battle Effects settings according to Party size.
Description.Translated: 根据小队人数自动调整战斗特效设置。

Punchline.Original: Shows how many scrips and items you would receive if you turn in your current inventory.
Punchline.Translated: 显示交付当前背包中的收藏品可获得多少工票和物品。

Description.Original: Shows how many scrips and items you would receive if you turn in your current inventory.
Description.Translated: 显示交付当前背包中的收藏品可获得多少工票和物品。

Punchline.Original: Track, Discover and Interact with your Collections in game
Punchline.Translated: 在游戏内追踪、发现并使用你的收藏。

Description.Original:
Collections provides an interface to track, discover and interact with your Collections in game.
Integrates with Glamour systems (Preview, Create Sets, Glamour Plates).
Supports: Glamour, Mounts, Minions, Emotes, Hairstyles, Triple Triad, Blue Mage, Bardings, Framer Kits, Orchestrions, Outfits, Fashion Accessories, Facewear.
Description.Translated:
Collections 提供游戏内收藏追踪、发现与交互界面。
集成幻化系统，包括预览、创建搭配与投影模板。
支持：幻化、坐骑、宠物、情感动作、发型、九宫幻卡、青魔法、陆行鸟装甲、肖像教材、管弦乐琴乐谱、套装、时尚配饰及面部配饰。

Punchline.Original: Keep your mouse cursor contained during combat!
Punchline.Translated: 战斗时让鼠标留在游戏窗口内！

Description.Original: Automatically changes the 'limit mouse operation to game window' setting when entering/exiting combat.
Description.Translated: 进入或退出战斗时，自动切换“将鼠标操作限制在游戏窗口内”的设置。

Punchline.Original: Monodimensional compass for your adventures.
Punchline.Translated: 为冒险提供一维方向罗盘。

Description.Original: Monodimensional compass for your adventures.
Description.Translated: 为冒险提供一维方向罗盘。

Punchline.Original: Automatically rearrange party list for TOP.
Punchline.Translated: 为欧米茄绝境验证战自动重排小队列表。

Description.Original: Rearrange party list from left to right: /conga
Description.Translated: 按从左到右的顺序重排小队列表：/conga

Punchline.Original: Get aurally rewarded when you get commended on duties.
Punchline.Translated: 在副本中获得最优队员推荐时，用声音奖励你。

Description.Original:
Get aurally rewarded when you get commended on duties.

Comes with default sounds for when you get commended by 1/3, 2/3, 3/3 or all seven members of the duty you were in, but you can set custom sounds for each type of trigger by opening /congratsconfig.

The fractioned values are in relation to how many of those members could commend you (i.e. excluding those that were in your party before joining the duty).
Description.Translated:
在副本中获得最优队员推荐时，用声音奖励你。

内置获得可推荐队员中 1/3、2/3、3/3 或全部七人推荐时的默认音效，也可通过 /congratsconfig 为每种触发条件设置自定义声音。

比例以能给你推荐的成员人数计算，不包括进入副本前已与你组队的成员。

Punchline.Original: Help you record duty and who you met.
Punchline.Translated: 帮助记录参加过的副本和遇见过的玩家。

Description.Original:
Remember to change setting according to your need.
Use the Settings button to enter analyze window.
Description.Translated:
记得按需要调整设置。
使用 Settings 按钮进入分析窗口。

Punchline.Original: Import map coordinates to echo chat.
Punchline.Translated: 导入地图坐标并输出至回显频道。

Description.Original: Import map coordinates from various sources (e.g. Siren Hunts or Bear Toolkit) and dump them into echo chat. Use /ci to open the dialog box.
Description.Translated: 从 Siren Hunts、Bear Toolkit 等来源导入地图坐标，并输出到回显频道。使用 /ci 打开对话框。

Punchline.Original: Simulate crafts, create computer-assisted macros, and get mid-craft suggestions from the comfort of your own game!
Punchline.Translated: 直接在游戏里模拟制作、创建计算机辅助宏，并获取制作过程中的操作建议！

Description.Original: Allows you to generate macros and simulate all sorts of crafts without having to open another app. Open your crafting log to get started!
Description.Translated: 无需打开其他应用，即可生成宏并模拟各种制作。打开制作笔记即可开始！

Punchline.Original: Customize the Cross Hotbar!
Punchline.Translated: 自定义十字热键栏！

Description.Original:
This plugin provides various customizations for the look and feel of the Cross Hotbar.

-Split up the left/right hotbars
-Display Expanded Hold Controls Separately
-Customize colors and element positions
-Greater control over which sets your extra bars are mapped to
Description.Translated:
提供十字热键栏外观与操作体验的多种自定义选项。

- 分离左右热键栏
- 单独显示扩展按住操作栏
- 自定义颜色和元素位置
- 更细致地控制附加热键栏映射到哪一组

Punchline.Original: Stream internet radio stations while playing FFXIV
Punchline.Translated: 游玩 FFXIV 时收听网络电台。

Description.Original: Listen to your favorite internet radio stations directly in-game. Browse stations and manage your favorites. Use /cradio to open the radio player
Description.Translated: 直接在游戏内收听喜爱的网络电台，浏览电台并管理收藏。使用 /cradio 打开播放器。

Punchline.Original: Discover how to use all the in-game currencies.
Punchline.Translated: 了解游戏内各种货币的用途。

Description.Original: Never wonder 'What should I do with this?' again. Access real-time prices from Universalis, identify missing collectibles tied to your currencies, and unlock new possibilities for utilizing your in-game resources effectively.
Description.Translated: 再也不用发愁“这东西能拿来干什么”。获取 Universalis 实时价格，找出可用所持货币兑换但尚未收集的物品，更有效地利用游戏资源。

Punchline.Original: Shows an overlay and/or sends alerts when your held currency items (or non-currency items) match configurable rules. A spiritual successor to CurrencyAlert.
Punchline.Translated: 当持有的货币物品或非货币物品符合可配置规则时，显示悬浮界面或发送提醒。是 CurrencyAlert 的精神续作。

Description.Original: Provides a configurable overlay, configurable alerts, and a powerful rule system for displaying how many currency (or non-currency) items you have (or don't have). A spiritual successor to CurrencyAlert.
Description.Translated: 提供可配置的悬浮界面、提醒及强大的规则系统，显示你拥有或缺少多少货币或非货币物品。是 CurrencyAlert 的精神续作。

Punchline.Original: Tweak the built-in 4-band EQ with custom presets.
Punchline.Translated: 用自定义预设调整内置四段均衡器。

Description.Original: Did you know that the EQ presets in the system settings are powered by a 4-band EQ? Let's make our own presets!
Description.Translated: 你知道系统设置里的均衡器预设其实由四段 EQ 驱动吗？来制作自己的预设吧！

Punchline.Original: Enforces a custom resolution for the game, similar to NVIDIA DSR.
Punchline.Translated: 为游戏强制设置自定义分辨率，类似 NVIDIA DSR。

Description.Original: Basic plugin that allows you to specify a custom resolution.
Description.Translated: 允许指定自定义分辨率的基础插件。

Punchline.Original: Tools to make managing Linkshells and Cross-world Linkshells easier.
Punchline.Translated: 让通讯贝与跨服通讯贝管理更轻松的工具。

Description.Original: Formerly CWLSLastSeenTool. Tools to make managing Linkshells and Cross-world Linkshells easier. Primarily for keeping track of when you last see memebrs online but more functionality may be added as requested/when I am able. /shelltools to open.
Description.Translated: 原名 CWLSLastSeenTool。帮助管理通讯贝和跨服通讯贝，主要记录上次看到成员在线的时间；之后可能根据需求和作者时间增加更多功能。使用 /shelltools 打开。

Punchline.Original: Easily Track Daily and Weekly tasks
Punchline.Translated: 轻松追踪日常与周常任务。

Description.Original: Automatically track and complete many daily and weekly tasks
Description.Translated: 自动追踪并完成多种日常与周常任务。

Punchline.Original: Sync your character data from your main character to all others
Punchline.Translated: 将主角色的角色数据同步到其他所有角色。

Description.Original: This plugin allows you to use your character data from your main character on all others.
Description.Translated: 让其他所有角色都能使用主角色的角色数据。

Punchline.Original: Receive your chat messages via Discord.
Punchline.Translated: 通过 Discord 接收游戏聊天消息。

Description.Original: This plugin allows you to receive your chat messages inside of discord.
Description.Translated: 让你在 Discord 中接收游戏聊天消息。

Punchline.Original: Find anything, go anywhere, in style.
Punchline.Translated: 潇洒地找到一切，去往任何地方。

Description.Original:
Adds a convenient quick search akin to Spotlight that lets you open game windows, teleport, find wiki articles, and more.
Press Control + T to open the search window. This can be changed by searching for "Wotsit Settings".
Description.Translated:
添加类似 Spotlight 的便捷快速搜索，可打开游戏窗口、传送、查找 Wiki 文章等。
按 Control + T 打开搜索窗口。搜索“Wotsit Settings”即可修改此快捷键。

Punchline.Original: Show your character's job, level, name, and other details in your Discord status.
Punchline.Translated: 在 Discord 状态中显示角色职业、等级、姓名及其他详情。

Description.Original: This plugin allows you display your character and current zone in your Discord profile.
Description.Translated: 在 Discord 个人资料中显示角色及当前所在区域。

Punchline.Original: Classic puzzle game.
Punchline.Translated: 经典益智游戏。

Description.Original:
Logic puzzle in which you find and flag hidden mines.

Left click to uncover a square, right click to place a flag.
The game ends when all safe squares have been uncovered.
Click the smiley face to start a new game.
Description.Translated:
找出并标记隐藏地雷的逻辑益智游戏。

左键揭开格子，右键插旗。
揭开所有安全格子后游戏结束。
点击笑脸开始新游戏。

Punchline.Original: Modifies in-game fly-text for more (or less) damage information.
Punchline.Translated: 修改游戏内飘字，显示更多或更少的伤害信息。

Description.Original: Configurable UI options for extra damage information. /dmginfo displays the config.
Description.Translated: 通过可配置的界面选项显示额外伤害信息。使用 /dmginfo 打开设置。

Punchline.Original: Plugin to help with a number of dice games. Also offers games like Tic-Tac-Toe, Minesweeper and Bahamood.
Punchline.Translated: 辅助多种骰子游戏，也提供井字棋、扫雷和 Bahamood 等小游戏。

Description.Original:
## Modes
### Venue:
- Concise display of all concurrent players in a list-based format
- Supports multiple sorting types (min, max, nearest to)
- Highlight numbers based on regex matching

### DeathRoll:
- Supports multiple players
- Automatic checks to prevent number skipping

### Tournament (1v1 DeathRoll):
- Automatic bracket generation with byes to fill uneven
- Forfeit functionality if a player needs to leave

### Blackjack:
- Automatic reward calculation based on common rules
- Simplistic, or visual view of cards in play
- Automatic or manual player-based draw for cards

### Extra Features:
- Block or prevent players from partaking in any game
- Accept only /random or /dice commands

## Games
### Tic-Tac-Toe
- Play against your friends, or AI
- Easy, Medium, Hard
- 3x3, 4x4, 5x5

### Minesweeper
- Easy, Medium, Hard
- 8x8, 9x9, 16x16, 18x30
- Custom Games (planned)

More features are planned, following user feedback.
Description.Translated:
## 模式
### 场所：
- 以简洁列表显示所有同时参与的玩家
- 支持多种排序：最小、最大、最接近指定值
- 按正则表达式匹配高亮数字

### DeathRoll：
- 支持多人
- 自动检查，防止跳过应有的数字

### 锦标赛（1 对 1 DeathRoll）：
- 自动生成对阵表，人数不齐时安排轮空
- 玩家需要离开时可弃权

### 二十一点：
- 按常见规则自动计算奖励
- 提供简洁或可视化的手牌显示
- 支持按玩家自动或手动抽牌

### 附加功能：
- 屏蔽或禁止玩家参与任意游戏
- 仅接受 /random 或 /dice 命令

## 游戏
### 井字棋
- 与朋友或 AI 对战
- 简单、中等、困难
- 3x3、4x4、5x5

### 扫雷
- 简单、中等、困难
- 8x8、9x9、16x16、18x30
- 自定义对局（计划中）

将根据用户反馈继续添加更多功能。

Punchline.Original: Live monster data.
Punchline.Translated: 实时怪物资料。

Description.Original:
A live bestiary for Deep Dungeon. Shows target mob aggro type, a subjective threat level, vulnerability to stun, and a general overview of notable mechanics. Threat level is meant to be taken with a grain of salt, is aimed towards solo players, and assumes a general familiarity with
deep dungeon mechanics and the class being played. Information is accurate to the best of my knowledge based on crowdsourced information, but please open an issue on the GitHub or ping me in either the Deep Dungeons or QuickLauncher Discord servers if anything is found to be inaccurate or if you'd like to make a report on untested data.
Description.Translated:
深层迷宫的实时怪物图鉴。显示目标怪物的仇恨感知类型、主观危险评级、能否眩晕，以及重要机制概览。危险评级仅供参考，面向单刷玩家，并假定你已基本熟悉
深层迷宫机制和当前职业。资料基于众包信息，我会尽力保证准确；如发现错误或想报告尚未测试的数据，请在 GitHub 提交 issue，或在 Deep Dungeons、QuickLauncher 的 Discord 服务器联系我。

Punchline.Original: Track things inside Deep Dungeons (Solo only).
Punchline.Translated: 追踪深层迷宫内的各项数据，仅限单人模式。

Description.Original:
-Keep track of the number of kills, coffers opened, regeneration potions consumed, potsherds obtained, total time and more.
-Examine the collected data.
-Scoring.
Description.Translated:
- 记录击杀数、开启宝箱数、使用再生药数量、获得陶片数、总耗时等。
- 查看已收集的数据。
- 评分。

Punchline.Original: Customizable UI elements to track cooldowns, status and more.
Punchline.Translated: 可自定义的界面元素，用于追踪冷却、状态等信息。

Description.Original: DelvCD provides highly customizable UI elements that can be used to track cooldows, status and more with configurable conditions.
Description.Translated: DelvCD 提供高度可自定义的界面元素，可根据设定条件追踪冷却、状态及更多信息。

Punchline.Original: A modern HUD replacement built for customization.
Punchline.Translated: 以自定义为核心的现代 HUD 替代界面。

Description.Original: DelvUI provides a highly configurable HUD replacement and is highly inspired by ElvUI from WoW
Description.Translated: DelvUI 提供高度可配置的 HUD 替代界面，主要灵感来自《魔兽世界》的 ElvUI。

Punchline.Original: Stops controller input from freezing randomly.
Punchline.Translated: 防止手柄输入随机卡住。

Description.Original:
Stops controller input from freezing randomly by ensuring FFXIV only polls for controllers when one is actually connected or disconnected. Doesn't require any configuration.

Original plugin by PGGB, icon from Mutant Standard.
Description.Translated:
确保 FFXIV 只在手柄实际连接或断开时轮询设备，从而防止手柄输入随机卡住。无需任何配置。

原插件作者 PGGB，图标来自 Mutant Standard。

Punchline.Original: Yet another useful calculator~
Punchline.Translated: 又一个实用计算器～

Description.Original: Calculates your current sessions points and scrip reward
Description.Translated: 计算本次活动获得的积分与工票奖励。

Punchline.Original: Draw the compass directionals around the target for easier callouts
Punchline.Translated: 在目标周围绘制方位，方便报点。

Description.Original: Draw the compass directionals around the target (boss relative or true north)
Description.Translated: 在目标周围绘制罗盘方位，支持以首领朝向或地图正北为基准。

Punchline.Original: Send message to friends from discord
Punchline.Translated: 从 Discord 给朋友发送消息。

Description.Original: Discord / FFXIV bot to send msg from discord to the game
Description.Translated: 将 Discord 消息发送到游戏的 Discord/FFXIV 机器人。

Punchline.Original: The ultimate Ocean Fishing plugin.
Punchline.Translated: 终极出海垂钓插件。

Description.Original:
The ultimate Ocean Fishing plugin. Automatically suggests baits, logs each boat you're on, tracks progress to achievements, adds a global point leaderboard, and more!

Icon from the Mutant Standard project.
Description.Translated:
功能全面的出海垂钓插件。自动推荐鱼饵，记录每次出航，追踪成就进度，提供全球积分排行榜，还有更多功能！

图标来自 Mutant Standard 项目。

Punchline.Original: Play a chime when someone comes into a house.
Punchline.Translated: 有人进入房屋时播放门铃声。

Description.Original:
Play a chime when someone comes into a house, when they leave or when entering a house people are already inside.

Icon by Flaticon
Description.Translated:
有人进入或离开房屋，或你进入已有人的房屋时播放提示音。

图标由 Flaticon 提供。

Punchline.Original: A plugin that ranks your performance based on your fundamentals in combat
Punchline.Translated: 根据战斗基本功为你的表现评级。

Description.Original: A plugin that tries to add flavour to combat. You score by dealing damage and keeping your GCD rolling, and lose points if you are not greeding correctly. Now with dynamic BGM.
Description.Translated: 试着为战斗增添趣味。造成伤害并保持 GCD 运转可得分，不恰当地贪输出会扣分。现已支持动态背景音乐。

Punchline.Original: Preview duty loot before it drops.
Punchline.Translated: 掉落前先预览副本战利品。

Description.Original: Preview duty loot before it drops.
Description.Translated: 掉落前先预览副本战利品。

Punchline.Original: Push notify to your device when your duty is ready
Punchline.Translated: 副本匹配成功时向你的设备推送通知。

Description.Original: You can use this plugin to push notify to your device when your duty is ready
Description.Translated: 副本匹配成功时，可用此插件向你的设备推送通知。

Punchline.Original: Track your duty completion speeds with ease.
Punchline.Translated: 轻松追踪副本通关速度。

Description.Original: A simple speedrun timer for FFXIV duties.
Description.Translated: FFXIV 副本的简易速通计时器。

Punchline.Original: Automatically finely scales the game UI by resolution.
Punchline.Translated: 根据分辨率自动精细调整游戏界面缩放。

Description.Original: Automatically finely scales the game UI by resolution.
Description.Translated: 根据分辨率自动精细调整游戏界面缩放。

Punchline.Original: Hide annoying or distracting VFXs
Punchline.Translated: 隐藏烦人或分散注意力的视觉特效。

Description.Original: Hides VFXs which are too bright or distracting
Description.Translated: 隐藏过亮或干扰视线的视觉特效。

Punchline.Original: Translate anything!
Punchline.Translated: 翻译任何内容！

Description.Original:
Search anything and get the translations in other languages.
Use /et to open the ui or /et <search term> to search directly!
Description.Translated:
搜索任何内容，并获取其他语言的译文。
使用 /et 打开界面，或使用 /et <search term> 直接搜索！

Punchline.Original:
Dialogue and other in-game text translations? Yes we have!
Known Issues at: https://github.com/lokinmodar/Echoglossian/issues/12
Punchline.Translated:
想翻译对话和其他游戏内文字？我们有！
已知问题：https://github.com/lokinmodar/Echoglossian/issues/12

Description.Original: Realtime game text translator
Description.Translated: 实时游戏文本翻译器。

Echoglossian.Author: Dante Souza e Souza - aka lokinmodar

Punchline.Original: Recreation of the Elden Ring April Fools joke.
Punchline.Translated: 复刻《艾尔登法环》愚人节玩笑效果。

Description.Original: Currently under development with extra features, should currently function as the April Fools joke did.
Description.Translated: 正在开发并加入额外功能，目前应能实现原愚人节玩笑的效果。

EldenRing.Author: Fools by Goat, taken over by Roselyn, on life support by Franz, maintained by khayle

Punchline.Original: Track who used what emotes on you.
Punchline.Translated: 记录谁对你使用了什么情感动作。

Description.Original: Adds a window logging all emotes used on you, so you never miss a sneaky dote again.
Description.Translated: 在窗口中记录所有对你使用的情感动作，再也不会错过偷偷送来的倾慕。

Punchline.Original: Because tracking your DoTs shouldn't be difficult.
Punchline.Translated: 追踪自己的持续伤害，不该这么难。

Description.Original: Displays your debuffs on the enemy list.
Description.Translated: 在敌对列表中显示你施加的减益状态。

Punchline.Original: Complete combat countdown, pull timer and OBS overlay
Punchline.Translated: 完整的战斗倒计时、开怪计时与 OBS 叠加层。

Description.Original:
Combat Timer for OBS and ingame overlay with some benefits like a big nice countdown in the middle of the screen in the style of the original one.
Please consult the repository link for OBS setup instructions.
Description.Translated:
面向 OBS 和游戏内叠加显示的战斗计时器，还提供屏幕中央的大型倒计时，风格与游戏原生一致。
OBS 设置方法请参阅仓库链接。

Punchline.Original: Displays enemies hp in enemy list.
Punchline.Translated: 在敌对列表中显示敌人 HP。

Description.Original: Displays enemies hp in enemy list. Just does that, nothing else.
Description.Translated: 在敌对列表中显示敌人 HP。就这一个功能，没有别的。

Punchline.Original: We All Love Eureka And Occult
Punchline.Translated: 我们都爱优雷卡和新月岛。

Description.Original:
A simple tracker for Eureka, and Occult.
Other Features:
- Fairy Finder
- Bunny Timer Window
- Bunny Coffer Helper
- Stats
- Quest Guide (clickable coords)
- Localized (DE, FR, JA)

Occult:
- Random Treasure Proximity Notification
- Bunny Carrot Proximity Notification
- Pot Coffer Helper
- Pot Timer Window
- Map Markers For Treasure, Bunny, Pot, Survey Points
- Occult Tracker

Website (https://tracker.xivstats.com):
- A simple tracker for occult
- Players don't need the plugin to enjoy the benefits
Description.Translated:
优雷卡与新月岛的简易追踪器。
其他功能：
- 元素精灵查找
- 幸福兔计时窗口
- 幸福兔宝箱助手
- 统计
- 任务指南，支持点击坐标
- 德语、法语和日语本地化

新月岛：
- 附近随机宝箱提醒
- 附近兔子胡萝卜提醒
- 魔法罐宝箱助手
- 魔法罐计时窗口
- 宝物、兔子、魔法罐与调查点地图标记
- 新月岛追踪器

网站（https://tracker.xivstats.com）：
- 简易新月岛追踪器
- 无需安装插件也能使用相关服务

Punchline.Original: Never forget a seasonal event ever again
Punchline.Translated: 再也不会忘记季节活动。

Description.Original:
Simple but useful calender
- Current events displayed within a server bar entry for quick viewing
- Browse through current, upcoming and previously held events
- Special dates for Liveletters and other important occasions are highlighted
Description.Translated:
简单实用的日历。
- 在服务器信息栏中显示当前活动，方便快速查看
- 浏览正在进行、即将开始和过去举办的活动
- 高亮制作人来信直播及其他重要活动日期

Punchline.Original: Displays extra information pulled from search info when examining.
Punchline.Translated: 查看玩家装备时，显示从搜索信息中读取的额外资料。

Description.Original:
Displays extra information pulled from search info when examining.

Support for:
- Any plain text URL
- Pastebin.com
- carrd.co/crd.co
- F-List
- Refsheet

Simply examine someone with a search info containing pointers to one of
these locations and the plugin will display information automatically.
Description.Translated:
查看玩家装备时，显示从搜索信息中读取的额外资料。

支持：
- 任意纯文本网址
- Pastebin.com
- carrd.co/crd.co
- F-List
- Refsheet

只需查看搜索信息中包含上述任一链接的玩家，
插件就会自动显示相关资料。

Punchline.Original: Cross-data-centre linkshells with unlimited members.
Punchline.Translated: 跨大区、成员人数不限的通讯贝。

Description.Original:
ExtraChat adds end-to-end encrypted, cross-data-centre, unlimited linkshells
to the game.
Description.Translated: ExtraChat 为游戏添加端到端加密、跨数据中心且数量不限的通讯贝。

Punchline.Original: Change your neighbours' housing exterior appearance.
Punchline.Translated: 改变邻居房屋的外观。

Description.Original: Visually change the exterior appearance of any house so it's no longer an eyesore. (Note: Changes reset upon entering the plot to restore intended collission)
Description.Translated: 仅在视觉上修改任意房屋的外墙外观，让它不再碍眼。（注意：进入地块时会重置修改，以恢复正确的碰撞效果。）

Punchline.Original: Automatically hides UI elements.
Punchline.Translated: 自动隐藏界面元素。

Description.Original: Lets you automatically hide certain game UI elements based on number of conditions.
Description.Translated: 根据多种条件自动隐藏指定游戏界面元素。

Punchline.Original: Like you'd ever be sick of the in game music right?
Punchline.Translated: 你怎么可能听腻游戏音乐呢，对吧？

Description.Original:
Control Spotify playback from within FFX|V
Use the button below to open settings or use the '/pfp settings' command.
Originally by BiscuitUmU
Localization by Dormanil
Description.Translated:
在 FFXIV 内控制 Spotify 播放。
点击下方按钮打开设置，或使用“/pfp settings”命令。
原作者：BiscuitUmU
本地化：Dormanil

Punchline.Original: Always five* keystrokes away from any job
Punchline.Translated: 切换任何职业，始终只需五*次按键。

Description.Original: Enables the player to switch jobs using their three letter acronyms as commands. (*: five or more)
Description.Translated: 将职业的三个字母缩写作为命令来切换职业。（*：五次或更多。）

Punchline.Original: Makes FATEs suck slightly less, guaranteed! Disclaimer: atma drop rates will continue to suck.
Punchline.Translated: 保证让危命任务没那么难受！免责声明：魂晶掉率还是一样难受。

Description.Original: Displays a list of all FATEs in the current area with: time remaining, percent completed, and bonus marker. Clicking on FATE name will flag it and teleport you, if flying isn't faster. Works with Eureka and Occult FATEs, and Bozja skirmishes.
Description.Translated: 列出当前区域所有危命任务的剩余时间、完成百分比和奖励加成标记。点击任务名可在地图插旗；若飞行不是更快的方式，还会进行传送。支持优雷卡和新月岛的危命任务，以及博兹雅的临时遭遇战。

Punchline.Original: Highlights recommended tiles in Faux Hollows for your next move.
Punchline.Translated: 高亮幻巧拼图下一步推荐翻开的格子。

Description.Original: Highlights recommended tiles in Faux Hollows for your next move.
Description.Translated: 高亮幻巧拼图下一步推荐翻开的格子。

Punchline.Original: Color your FC member’s FC tags
Punchline.Translated: 为同部队成员的部队简称着色。

Description.Original: Color your FC's tag or the entire nameplate if they are in your FC. Use /fcnc to open up the config.
Description.Translated: 为同部队玩家的部队简称或整块姓名板着色。使用 /fcnc 打开设置。

Punchline.Original: Send game info over MQTT
Punchline.Translated: 通过 MQTT 发送游戏信息。

Description.Original: Send data to an MQTT broker to do all sorts of things. Change your lights with a macro, turn on the heater when you use Overheat, or start playing Rules of Nature when you switch to Gunbreaker. Requires an MQTTv5 compatible broker.
Description.Translated: 向 MQTT 消息代理发送数据，实现各种功能：用宏改变灯光，进入过热时打开暖气，或切换绝枪战士时播放《Rules of Nature》。需要兼容 MQTTv5 的消息代理。

Punchline.Original: Want to know what's going on in roleplay today?
Punchline.Translated: 想知道今天有哪些角色扮演活动吗？

Description.Original: An in game portal to the FFXIV RP Event Calendar (https://ffxiv-rp.org).  Use /events to bring up the list of roleplay events happening this week.
Description.Translated: FFXIV 角色扮演活动日历（https://ffxiv-rp.org）的游戏内入口。使用 /events 查看本周举行的角色扮演活动。

Punchline.Original: Flash FFXIV's program on the taskbar when you receive a /tell
Punchline.Translated: 收到 /tell 悄悄话时，让任务栏中的 FFXIV 图标闪烁。

Description.Original: Flash FFXIV's program on the taskbar when you receive a /tell. This plugin has no configurable settings at this time.
Description.Translated: 收到 /tell 悄悄话时，让任务栏中的 FFXIV 图标闪烁。目前没有可配置选项。

Punchline.Original: Filter fly texts and pop-ups texts based on multiple criteria and allow the adjustment of their positions.
Punchline.Translated: 按多种条件筛选飘字和弹出文字，并调整它们的位置。

Description.Original: Filter fly text by type.
Description.Translated: 按类型筛选飘字。

Punchline.Original: Someone in our group wouldn't eat their food. I got tired of telling them to. Now the plugin does.
Punchline.Translated: 队里总有人不吃食物，提醒得我都烦了。现在让插件去提醒。

Description.Original: See who is missing food buff at countdown start and optionally post to party/echo chat with a customizable message.
Description.Translated: 倒计时开始时检查谁缺少食物增益，并可选择向小队或回显频道发送自定义消息。

Punchline.Original: Display game FPS.
Punchline.Translated: 显示游戏帧率。

Description.Original: Display game FPS.
Description.Translated: 显示游戏帧率。

Punchline.Original: A simple plugin to add notes to your friends.
Punchline.Translated: 为好友添加备注的简单插件。

Description.Original: Add personal notes to friends from the friend list context menu. Right-click a friend's name to set a note, which will then be shown in the friend list.
Description.Translated: 通过好友列表右键菜单添加私人备注。右键好友姓名设置备注，之后会显示在好友列表中。

Punchline.Original: south spot best spot
Punchline.Translated: 南边的点才是最佳位置。

Description.Original:
Guaranteed to be safe, unless it isn't. No refunds. 

[ Any Way the Wind Blows (Fungah) is a Gold Saucer Gate 
  There are variations of AOE patterns that can occur 
  There is no real 'safe spot', but there are spaces where there is less overlap by these potential AOEs 
  One of these spots is marked by this plugin when you are in the GATE ]
Description.Translated:
保证安全，除非它不安全。概不退款。

[ 鼻息风暴是金碟游乐场的一项机遇临门活动。
  其范围攻击可能采用多种分布模式。
  没有真正绝对安全的位置，但某些地方与这些潜在攻击范围重叠较少。
  参与该活动时，本插件会标出其中一个位置。 ]

Punchline.Original: Break your UI out of gaol.
Punchline.Translated: 让你的界面挣脱囚笼。

Description.Original: Layer game windows with plugin windows, enable 3D overlay plugins to draw under UI, and stop ReShade affecting your UI.
Description.Translated: 让游戏窗口和插件窗口交错分层，允许 3D 叠加插件在界面下方绘制，并防止 ReShade 影响界面。

Punchline.Original: Save and swap your glamour plates.
Punchline.Translated: 保存并切换投影模板。

Description.Original:
Create and save as many glamour plates as you want. Activate up to 15 of them
at once at the Glamour Dresser. Supports exporting and importing plates for
easy sharing.
Description.Translated:
创建并保存任意数量的投影模板。在投影台中可一次启用最多 15 套。
支持导出和导入模板，方便分享。

Punchline.Original: Picks a random outfit!
Punchline.Translated: 随机选择一套搭配！

Description.Original: Uses the command /glamourroulette to randomly apply a saved Glamour Plate.
Description.Translated: 使用 /glamourroulette 随机应用一套已保存的投影模板。

Punchline.Original: Swap glams to your currently selected gearset!
Punchline.Translated: 为当前选中的装备套装切换幻化！

Description.Original: Adds a command to swap glamours without needing to specify which gearset. Why this isn't in the base game, I don't know. Usage: /cgs <glamNumber>
Description.Translated: 添加无需指定装备套装便可切换幻化的命令。不知道游戏本体为什么没有这个功能。用法：/cgs <glamNumber>

Punchline.Original: Improvements to the in-game friend system, including login and logout notifications for your friends, and more.
Punchline.Translated: 改进游戏内好友系统，包括好友上线、下线通知等功能。

Description.Original:
Key Features:
- Receive notifications when friends using GoodFriend log in or out.
- Chat messages show how many of your friends are online when you log in.

Developer's Note on Using This Plugin After Patch 7.0:
As of Patch 7.0, some of the data that GoodFriend uses to identify players during login/logout events is now visible to anyone nearby your character in-game (not just your friends or party members). GoodFriend itself will still only show notifications for people you've added to your in-game friends list - however, please use this plugin only if you're comfortable with your login/logout activity being theoretically visible to nearby players (note: GoodFriend never sends data for users who don't have the plugin installed).

If you ever want to stop sending login/logout events, simply disable or uninstall the plugin. The server does not store any data about you.

For added privacy, you can now set a 'group key' in the plugin settings. This allows events to be shared only with people using the same key (for example, everyone in your raid group). When a group key is active, your events are never visible to anyone outside your group no matter what.
Description.Translated:
主要功能：
- 使用 GoodFriend 的好友上线或下线时收到通知。
- 登录时通过聊天消息显示在线好友数量。

开发者关于 7.0 后使用本插件的说明：
从 7.0 起，GoodFriend 在上下线事件中用于识别玩家的部分数据，已对游戏中角色附近的所有玩家可见，不再仅限好友或队员。GoodFriend 本身仍只通知你游戏好友列表中的玩家，但只有在你能接受上下线活动理论上可被附近玩家识别的情况下，才建议使用本插件。注意：GoodFriend 绝不发送未安装本插件用户的数据。

如需停止发送上下线事件，停用或卸载插件即可。服务器不保存任何关于你的数据。

为进一步保护隐私，现在可在设置中添加“群组密钥”，让事件仅与使用相同密钥的人共享，例如固定队全员。启用群组密钥后，群组之外的人在任何情况下都无法看到你的事件。

Punchline.Original: View the remaining XP on Crafter's/Gatherer's Grace
Punchline.Translated: 查看巧手之工/大地之恩的剩余经验额度。

Description.Original: An overlay plugin that displays the remaining XP for your Crafter's/Gatherer's Grace buffs.
Description.Translated: 通过悬浮界面显示巧手之工和大地之恩增益的剩余经验额度。

Punchline.Original: Save/load shareable graphics setting presets at any time or auto-load them during specified conditions like where you are or what content you are doing.
Punchline.Translated: 随时保存、加载和分享图形设置预设，或根据所在地点、正在进行的内容等条件自动加载。

Description.Original: Allows you to save/load/share graphics setting presets (based on your System Configuration menu) at any time, including when triggered by events like entering a battle, cutscene, duty, gpose, and more. Also supports conditions like loading into a city or foray areas.
Description.Translated: 随时保存、加载和分享基于系统设置菜单的图形预设，也可在进入战斗、过场动画、副本、集体动作等事件发生时自动触发。还支持进入城市或特殊探索区域等条件。

Punchline.Original: Helps show what actions are missing from your hotbars.
Punchline.Translated: 帮助找出热键栏上缺少哪些技能。

Description.Original: Shows a window next to the Actions & Traits menu when your hotbars are missing actions.
Description.Translated: 热键栏缺少技能时，在技能与特性菜单旁显示提示窗口。

Punchline.Original: Bard performance assistant
Punchline.Translated: 吟游诗人演奏助手。

Description.Original:
Assist mode for bards who want to play music but don't know how to.
- does NOT play anything automatically
- needs MIDI files to work
- adapts MIDI tracks to fit in game limitations for you
- you will be scored :O
Description.Translated:
为想演奏却不知如何下手的吟游诗人提供辅助模式。
- 不会自动演奏任何内容
- 需要 MIDI 文件
- 自动调整 MIDI 音轨以适应游戏限制

Punchline.Original: Reduces the refresh rate of movement physics, "fixing" it at high fps.
Punchline.Translated: 降低运动物理的刷新频率，修正高帧率下的物理表现。

Description.Original:
Causes the game's physics to work at higher FPS by making it update every few frames. 
Toggle with '/physics t', or use on/off instead of t. 
May cause excessive jiggling at lower FPS values. 
Disabling the entire plugin after turning on/off with /physics requires reboot to reenable.

让游戏物理每隔几帧更新一次，从而在高 FPS 下正常工作。
使用“/physics t”切换，也可将 t 替换为 on/off。

通过 /physics 开关后，若再停用整个插件，需要重启游戏才能重新启用。

Punchline.Original: All you need for Raiding
Punchline.Translated: 团队副本所需工具，一应俱全。

Description.Original: A collection of useful tools for raid groups, including loot management
Description.Translated: 面向固定队的实用工具合集，包含战利品管理。

Punchline.Original: Customized titles for you and yours.
Punchline.Translated: 为你和朋友定制称号。

Description.Original: Assign custom titles to players.
Description.Translated: 为玩家设置自定义称号。

Punchline.Original: Exports your current class hotbar into text. Allows imports too!
Punchline.Translated: 将当前职业的热键栏导出为文本，也支持导入！

Punchline.Original: Displays information about housing fixtures and objects.

/housemate opens the UI.

显示房屋固定装修和摆放物的信息。

Description.Translated: 移除烦人的 400 件家具显示上限。

Punchline.Original: Take total control over your HUD.
Punchline.Translated: 全面掌控你的 HUD。

Description.Original:
- Save infinite HUD layouts
- Edit your HUD with precision
- Automatically swap between HUD layouts based on conditions
- Make child layouts that only affect desired HUD elements

- 根据条件自动切换布局

Punchline.Original: Total control of your User Interface

Description.Translated: 允许分别修改界面的所有元素，按自己的喜好自由定制。

Description.Original: A daily hunt bill tracker
Description.Translated: 每日狩猎通缉令追踪器。

Punchline.Original: Time to finish your log?

Punchline.Translated: 传统与标准移动模式合二为一，自由移动！

Punchline.Original: Out of sight, still in mind.

Punchline.Original: Don't you hate CAPS LOCK so much?
Punchline.Translated: 你是不是也特别讨厌大写锁定？

Description.Original:
SORRY CAPS
Remove caps lock when pressing any of the configured keys.
Description.Translated:
抱歉，忘关大写了！
按下任一配置的按键时，关闭大写锁定。

Punchline.Original: Improves the native text inputs by restoring common text-editing behaviors.
Punchline.Translated: 为原生文本输入恢复常见编辑行为。

Description.Original:
Improves the native text inputs by restoring common text-editing shortcuts. Works in all game text inputs: chat, macros, search, etc.

Supported shortcuts:
    - Ctrl + Left/Right: Jump between words
    - Ctrl + Shift + Left/Right: Select word by word
    - Ctrl + Backspace/Delete: Delete words
    - Ctrl + Insert: Copy
    - Shift + Insert: Paste
    - Shift + Delete: Cut

Changes:
    - Pressing Left/Right with the cursor at the start/end of an input properly clears the selection instead of doing nothing.
    - Clearing an active selection with Left/Right moves the cursor to the beginning/end of the selection.

Setting:
    - Configurable word boundary: Choose whether Ctrl + Right jumps to word ends (Discord, IDEs) or word starts (Windows, Notepad++, ImGui).
Description.Translated:
为原生文本输入恢复常见编辑快捷键。适用于聊天、宏、搜索等所有游戏文本输入框。

支持的快捷键：
    - Ctrl + Left/Right：按单词跳转
    - Ctrl + Shift + Left/Right：逐词选择
    - Ctrl + Backspace/Delete：删除单词
    - Ctrl + Insert：复制
    - Shift + Insert：粘贴
    - Shift + Delete：剪切

行为调整：
    - 光标位于输入内容开头或结尾时，按 Left/Right 会正确清除选区，不再毫无反应。
    - 使用 Left/Right 清除选区时，光标移动至选区开头或结尾。

设置：
    - 可配置单词边界：选择 Ctrl + Right 跳到词尾（Discord、IDE 风格）或词首（Windows、Notepad++、ImGui 风格）。

Punchline.Original: Look back at that cute search comment even hours later~
Punchline.Translated: 几个小时后，也能回看那条可爱的搜索留言～

Description.Original: A simple plugin that keeps a history of people you inspected.
Description.Translated: 保存你查看过的玩家历史记录的简单插件。

Punchline.Original: Adds a search bar directly in the inventory window to filter items.
Punchline.Translated: 直接在背包窗口中添加搜索栏，用来筛选物品。

Description.Original:
Supports different types of filters to be able to find items by name, type, supported job or level requirements.

Supported Inventories:
	- Character Inventory
	- Chocobo Saddlebags
	- Retainer Inventory
	- Armoury

支持按名称、类型、适用职业或等级要求等条件筛选物品。

支持的库存：
	- 角色背包
	- 陆行鸟鞍囊
	- 雇员背包
	- 兵装库

Punchline.Original: Helps highlight relevant workshops items
Punchline.Translated: 帮助高亮相关无人岛工坊产品。

Description.Original:
Search items by splitting search terms with | 
     Example: papri|shark|ink 

Step-by-step search by splitting terms with a comma [ , ] 
     Example: poti,garn,horn 
     Will search for 'poti' first, then after adding and reopening window, will search for 'garn' 

 Or just copy and paste the entire Overseas Casuals Squawkbox recommendations. 

Works with every game client language.
Description.Translated:
用 | 分隔搜索词，可同时搜索多个物品。
     示例：papri|shark|ink

用逗号 [ , ] 分隔，可按顺序逐步搜索。
     示例：poti,garn,horn
     先搜索“poti”，添加后重新打开窗口，再搜索“garn”。

也可以直接复制粘贴 Overseas Casuals Squawkbox 的整段推荐。

支持所有游戏客户端语言。

Punchline.Original: Search and link items, even if you don't have them.
Punchline.Translated: 搜索并发送物品链接，即使你并未持有它。

Description.Original: Search for items. Type /xlitem to open search window.
Description.Translated: 搜索物品。输入 /xlitem 打开搜索窗口。

Punchline.Original: Easily see common item uses.
Punchline.Translated: 轻松查看物品的常见用途。

Description.Original: Displays indicators in the item help popup for when an item is used by leves, GC dailies, etc. to help you decide what is worth keeping, selling, or taking as a reward.
Description.Translated: 在物品提示中标明该物品是否用于理符、大国防联军每日筹备等，帮助你决定保留、出售，或将其选为奖励。

Punchline.Original: Yes. Still up. Press it.
Punchline.Translated: 对，还能用。快按吧。

Description.Original:
Doing your rotation is hard enough without having to stare at your hotbars. This plugin helps you know exactly when an ability you actually care about is back up.

We don't want to clutter your screen with a massive status board. This won't show you everything that's currently available—instead, it stays completely empty until you use an ability in combat. Once you spend it and it comes off cooldown, the icon pops up to remind you. Press it, and it's gone again.

Because it only reminds you about things you've already used, it won't spam your screen before a pull. And for abilities with charges, it only pings when you go from 0 to 1—if you're sitting on a charge, it stays out of your way since you can already press it.

It's perfect for those key rotational abilities you really don't want to drift. You can also configure each ability so the reminder stays on screen until you press it, or quietly disappears after a few seconds.
Description.Translated:
打好循环已经够费神，不必再一直盯着热键栏。本插件让你准确知道真正关心的技能何时冷却完成。

我们不想用巨大的状态面板塞满屏幕。它不会列出当前所有可用技能，而是在你于战斗中使用技能之前保持空白。用过的技能冷却完成后，图标才会出现提醒你；再次使用，图标便消失。

因为只提醒已经用过的技能，开怪前不会挤满屏幕。对于充能技能，仅在从 0 层恢复到 1 层时提醒；已有一层可用时，就不会打扰你。

特别适合那些不希望延后使用的关键循环技能。还可逐技能设置：提醒一直保留到你按下，或几秒后安静消失。

Punchline.Original: Customized mount roulette per job.
Punchline.Translated: 按职业自定义随机坐骑。

Description.Original: Enhance your mount roulette experience by customizing which mounts may appear for each job individually.
Description.Translated: 为各职业分别指定随机坐骑可能召出的坐骑，改善随机召唤体验。

Punchline.Original: Picks a random job!
Punchline.Translated: 随机选择一个职业！

Description.Original: Uses the command /jobroulette to randomly pick a job and switch to the saved gearset. Can be configured to include or exclude certain jobs.
Description.Translated: 使用 /jobroulette 随机选择职业，并切换到其已保存的装备套装。可设置包含或排除哪些职业。

Punchline.Original: No longer will you be an Archmage Monk, set a different title per job!
Punchline.Translated: 不必再当挂着大魔法师称号的武僧，为各职业设置不同称号！

Description.Original: Changes your title based on the current job, with per-character settings.
Description.Translated: 根据当前职业切换称号，支持按角色分别设置。

Punchline.Original: Give yourself a heart attack (inspired by joemkdd's Isaac mod).
Punchline.Translated: 给自己来一次心跳骤停般的惊吓，灵感来自 joemkdd 的《以撒的结合》模组。

Description.Original:
/jumpscare or /js : Start/stop jumpscare timer.
/jumpscareconfig or /jscfg: Open the jumpscare configuration window
Description.Translated:
/jumpscare 或 /js：开始/停止突发惊吓计时器。
/jumpscareconfig 或 /jscfg：打开惊吓设置窗口。

Punchline.Original: HP bar, MP bar, EXP bar, oh my!
Punchline.Translated: HP 条、MP 条、经验条，哇哦！

Description.Original: A plugin that makes Kingdom Hearts UI stuff, such as a health bar for the player.
Description.Translated: 制作《王国之心》风格界面元素，例如玩家生命条。

Punchline.Original: Counts both sides of every shared lap :3
Punchline.Translated: 每次共享膝上时光，双方都记一笔 :3

Description.Original: Tracks the laps you sit in, the LapCats who sit in yours, time spent together, streaks, personal stats, and 60 local achievements.
Description.Translated: 记录你坐过谁的腿、哪些 LapCat 坐过你的腿、相伴时长、连续记录、个人统计，以及 60 项本地成就。

Punchline.Original: Optimize your GP.
Punchline.Translated: 更有效地利用采集力。

Description.Original: Display the optimal rotation for maximum yield with your current GP.
Description.Translated: 根据当前采集力，显示获得最大产量的最优技能循环。

Punchline.Original: Helper plugin for Eureka's Logos Actions.
Punchline.Translated: 优雷卡文理技能辅助插件。

Description.Original: Shows amounts of possible combinations for Eureka's Logos Actions upon entering the Logos Manipulator.
Description.Translated: 打开文理融合器时，显示现有材料可组合出的各类优雷卡文理技能数量。

Punchline.Original: Run multiple macros one after the other.
Punchline.Translated: 让多个宏依次执行。

Description.Original:
Allows for a macro to continue onto the next macro by using '/nextmacro' on the last line of a macro.
Adding '/nextmacro' on the last line of Macro #01 will automatically execute Macro #02
Adding '/nextmacro down' on the last line of Macro #01 will automatically execute Macro #11
Also allows executing any macro from chat using '/runmacro' but this command cannot be used while macros are running.
Description.Translated:
在宏最后一行加入“/nextmacro”，即可继续执行下一个宏。
在第 01 号宏最后一行加入“/nextmacro”，会自动执行第 02 号宏。
在第 01 号宏最后一行加入“/nextmacro down”，会自动执行第 11 号宏。
也可通过聊天命令“/runmacro”执行任意宏，但宏正在运行时无法使用该命令。

Punchline.Original: Records a crafting rotation and export it as a macro.
Punchline.Translated: 记录制作循环并导出为宏。

Description.Original: Records a crafting rotation you start and provides a way to export it to a macro so you can reutilize it.
Description.Translated: 记录你执行的制作循环，支持导出为宏，方便重复使用。

Punchline.Original: Tobii and Eyeware Eye and Opentrack tracker support for FFXIV
Punchline.Translated: 为 FFXIV 提供 Tobii、Eyeware Eye 和 Opentrack 追踪器支持。

Description.Original: Developed by the ingenious Garlean engineer Tobiias, this revolutionary Magitek device empowers adventurers by enabling hands-free enemy targeting with unparalleled precision.
Description.Translated: 由天才加雷马工程师 Tobiias 研发的革命性魔导装置，让冒险者无需双手也能以无与伦比的精度选择敌人目标。

Punchline.Original: Keep tabs on how much more PVP you have to play before unlocking your next Series Malmstone reward!
Punchline.Translated: 追踪解锁下一份系列赛奖励之前，还需要打多少 PvP！

Description.Original:
Calculates the number of wins/losses needed in different modes of PVP before achieving your target Series Level

Use /pmalm to get started
Description.Translated:
计算达到目标系列赛等级前，各种 PvP 模式所需的胜场/负场数量。
- 对局结束后通知距离下一级的进度
- 追踪并显示 30 级以上的系列赛等级
- 计算纷争前线连败奖励加成

使用 /pmalm 开始。

Punchline.Original: Record the maplinks in chat
Punchline.Translated: 记录聊天中的地图链接。

Description.Original: Automatically record the maplinks in chat and retrieval later.
Description.Translated: 自动记录聊天中的地图链接，方便之后找回。

Punchline.Original: Browse the market board from anywhere.
Punchline.Translated: 随时随地浏览市场布告板。

Description.Original: Browse the market board. /pmb to open.
Description.Translated: 浏览市场布告板。使用 /pmb 打开。

Punchline.Original: Useful for when you want to quickly export marketboard transaction history.
Punchline.Translated: 方便快速导出市场布告板成交历史。

Description.Original: Copies the marketboard transaction history into your clipboard with configurable options.
Description.Translated: 按可配置选项，将市场布告板成交历史复制到剪贴板。

Punchline.Original: A direct message manager made in fashion of WoW Instant Messenger.
Punchline.Translated: 仿照 WoW Instant Messenger 制作的私聊管理器。

Description.Original:
Features:
- Opes a direct message window when you message someone or they message you
- Each window contains your DM chat with certain person
- Open and cycle through recent chats with a hotkey
- Execute emote commands on a player from their DM window without needing to manually target them
- Automatically record your chat log in an easy to read text file
- Fully customizable styles
Description.Translated:
功能：
- 你私聊别人或别人私聊你时，打开独立私聊窗口
- 每个窗口保存与对应玩家的私聊
- 用快捷键打开并轮换最近会话
- 直接在私聊窗口中对该玩家执行情感动作，无需手动选中
- 自动将聊天记录保存为易读的文本文件
- 完全可自定义的外观样式

Punchline.Original: Automatically mimic the role you're looking for.
Punchline.Translated: 自动模拟你需要的职能。

Description.Original: Use /mimic to open up the menu and click on a role to mimic. You may also use d, h, or t in the command, e.g. /mimic d.
Description.Translated: 使用 /mimic 打开菜单，点击要模拟的职能。也可在命令后使用 d、h 或 t，例如 /mimic d。

Punchline.Original: Adds a button and a command to minimize your game into taskbar
Punchline.Translated: 添加将游戏最小化到任务栏的按钮和命令。

Description.Original: Additionally can minimize game to tray or create game's tray icon
Description.Translated: 还可将游戏最小化到系统托盘，或创建游戏托盘图标。

Punchline.Original: Shows the next best move in Mini Cactpot.
Punchline.Translated: 显示仙人微彩的最佳下一步。

Description.Original: Highlights recommended tiles in Mini Cactpot for your next move.
Description.Translated: 高亮仙人微彩下一步推荐刮开的格子。

Punchline.Original: Modify the magitude of your minimap's markers!
Punchline.Translated: 调整小地图标记的大小！

Description.Original: Changes the size of your minimap's icons.
Description.Translated: 改变小地图图标的大小。

Punchline.Original: Mo' actions no problems
Punchline.Translated: 更多技能操作，少些麻烦。

Description.Original: This plugin allows for macro-like use of actions without any macro delay. /pmoaction to open UI
Description.Translated: 以类似宏的方式使用技能，但没有宏延迟。使用 /pmoaction 打开界面。

Punchline.Original: Tracking assistant for Moogle Treasure Trove rewards
Punchline.Translated: 莫古莫古大收集奖励追踪助手。

Description.Original: MogMogCheck is a small plugin to assist you in tracking the rewards of the Moogle Treasure Trove event (called Mog Mog Kollektion in German, hence the name).
Description.Translated: MogMogCheck 帮助追踪莫古莫古大收集活动奖励。活动德文名为 Mog Mog Kollektion，插件也因此得名。

Punchline.Original: Check where you can obtain materials.
Punchline.Translated: 查看材料的获取地点。

Description.Original: Check where you can obtain a material from monsters, duties, crafting, gathering or where they can be bought from NPCs.
Description.Translated: 查看材料可从哪些怪物、副本、制作或采集中获得，以及可向哪些 NPC 购买。

Punchline.Original: A simple plugin that allows you to adjust your mount tilt.
Punchline.Translated: 调整坐骑倾斜效果的简单插件。

Description.Original: A simple plugin that allows you to apply a multiplier to your mount tilt angle and speed when in motion.
Description.Translated: 为移动中坐骑的倾斜角度和速度设置倍率的简单插件。

Punchline.Original: Mouselook without holding right-click.
Punchline.Translated: 无需按住右键，也能用鼠标控制视角。

Description.Original: MouseLock keeps FFXIV in mouselook until you actually need the cursor. It pauses for chat, bags, menus, and other UI, and can also turn LMB/RMB into configurable game inputs, hotbar actions, or MouseLock controls.
Description.Translated: MouseLock 让 FFXIV 保持鼠标视角控制，直到你确实需要光标。聊天、背包、菜单及其他界面操作时会暂停；还可将 LMB/RMB 映射为可配置的游戏输入、热键栏技能或 MouseLock 控制。

Punchline.Original: Split flytext into multiple flytext.
Punchline.Translated: 将一条飘字拆分成多条。

Description.Original: Papa asked me for this so here it is.
Description.Translated: Papa 想要这个功能，于是就有了它。

Punchline.Original: Enhanced camera distance control and first-person experience.
Punchline.Translated: 增强镜头距离控制与第一人称体验。

Description.Original:
Provides real first person view to see your character, and adjusts camera distance based on game conditions (e.g. close in camera when you begin crafting, maximum distance when combat begins or you enter an instanced area)

/mguide to open configuration window.
/mguide help for more commands.
Description.Translated:
提供能看到自身角色的真正第一人称视角，并根据游戏状态调整镜头距离，例如开始制作时拉近，进入战斗或副本时拉到最远。

/mguide 打开设置窗口。
/mguide help 查看更多命令。

Punchline.Original: Rename abilities and status effects.
Punchline.Translated: 重命名技能和状态效果。

Description.Original: Rename abilities and status effects.
Description.Translated: 重命名技能和状态效果。

Punchline.Original: A note-taking plugin.
Punchline.Translated: 记笔记的插件。

Description.Original: A note-taking plugin.
Description.Translated: 记笔记的插件。

Punchline.Original: Adds the message NICE to your damage flyout when you get a hit ending in 69.
Punchline.Translated: 伤害数字以 69 结尾时，在伤害飘字中添加 NICE。

Description.Original: Adds the message NICE to your damage flyout when you get a hit ending in 69. Also 67, optionally. Also, your own custom numbers now.
Description.Translated: 伤害数字以 69 结尾时，在伤害飘字中添加 NICE。也可选择支持 67，现在还能自定义数字。

Punchline.Original: Is this person Dew or Drew? I couldn't remember, so I made this plugin. Now I don't have to!
Punchline.Translated: 这人到底叫 Dew 还是 Drew？我记不住，所以做了这个插件。现在不用记了！

Description.Original:
Lets you add a nickname to players in chat so you remember who they actually are or any other information you want to remember about them.
Supports different customization per person or global customization.
Description.Translated:
为聊天中的玩家添加昵称，以便记住他们是谁，或记录其他想记住的信息。
支持逐人自定义或全局统一设置。

Punchline.Original: Don't kill game with lobby error.
Punchline.Translated: 避免游戏因大厅服务器错误而退出。

Description.Original: A simple plugin that prevent the game from killing itself with lobby error.
Description.Translated: 一款简单的插件，防止游戏在发生大厅服务器错误时自动退出。

Punchline.Original: Removes the Weeaboo Police
Punchline.Translated: 移除 Weeaboo Police。

Description.Original: Hides the Weeaboo Police
Description.Translated: 隐藏 Weeaboo Police。

Punchline.Original: Adblock for FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 广告拦截器。

Description.Original:
Customisable chat and Party Finder filtering. In addition to letting
you filter anything from chat and PF, it comes with built-in filters
for the following:

- RMT (both gil and content)
- FC ads
- RP ads
- Phishing messages
- Static recruitment
- Trade ads
- Community ads
- Any PF with an item level over the max
Description.Translated:
可自定义的聊天与队伍招募筛选工具。除了自行设置筛选内容，
还内置以下类别的过滤规则：

- 现实货币交易（金币和代打内容）
- 部队广告
- 角色扮演广告
- 钓鱼诈骗消息
- 固定队招募
- 交易广告
- 社区广告
- 装等要求超过游戏上限的队伍招募

Punchline.Original: Warns you when yourself or others are missing role-specific actions
Punchline.Translated: 当你或其他玩家遗漏职业相关技能状态时发出提醒。

Description.Original: Displays warnings when you or any party members are missing role specific actions such as partner buffs, pets, and tank stances.
Description.Translated: 当你或队友未设置搭档增益、未召唤宠物或未开启防护职业姿态等职业相关状态时显示警告。

Punchline.Original: Duty-specific notes!
Punchline.Translated: 为不同副本分别记录笔记！

Description.Original:
Lets you create notes that are linked to specific duties (they will only show during those duties).
You can also tie notes to certain jobs so they only appear when on the right job.
Description.Translated:
创建与特定副本关联的笔记，仅在对应副本中显示。
还可以将笔记限定为特定职业使用，仅在切换到相应职业时显示。

Punchline.Original: Currently supports notifications: chat messages, approaching map flag, duty found, ending of cutscenes, gp restoration, error during logging in, mob has been pulled.
Punchline.Translated: 目前支持以下通知：聊天消息、接近地图标记、任务匹配成功、过场动画结束、采集力恢复、登录出错以及怪物被开怪。

Description.Original: Notifies you about various events while your game is minimized.
Description.Translated: 游戏最小化时，为各种事件发送通知。

Punchline.Original: Tired of typing snae ling? Click instead!
Punchline.Translated: 不想再手打 snae ling？点一下就行！

Description.Original:
Adds a button on the duty list for /say quests like quest items and emotes have!
 Compatible with all languages and controllers.
Description.Translated:
在任务列表中为需要使用 /say 发言的任务添加按钮，就像任务道具和情感动作按钮一样！
兼容所有语言和手柄。

Punchline.Original: Display what is playing in your server bar, and play/pause/skip.
Punchline.Translated: 在服务器信息栏显示正在播放的内容，并控制播放、暂停和切歌。

Description.Original: Display what is playing in your server bar, and play/pause/skip. Great with macros!
Description.Translated: 在服务器信息栏显示正在播放的内容，并控制播放、暂停和切歌。与宏搭配使用更方便！

Punchline.Original: Control OBS by websocket
Punchline.Translated: 通过 WebSocket 控制 OBS。

Description.Original: A plugin to control OBS by WebSocket, streaming with any UI modification is not recommended.
Description.Translated: 通过 WebSocket 控制 OBS 的插件。不建议在直播时展示经过修改的游戏界面。

Punchline.Original: Comprehensive monster dex for DeepDungeons
Punchline.Translated: 深层迷宫综合怪物图鉴。

Description.Original:
Based loosely on DeepDungeonDex (by Strati), OfDungeonsDeep is an all-in-one tool for Deep Dungeon floor and mob information.
Data sourced with permission from https://www.ddcompendium.com/.
Description.Translated:
OfDungeonsDeep 参考了 Strati 制作的 DeepDungeonDex，是集深层迷宫楼层与怪物信息于一体的工具。
数据经授权取自 https://www.ddcompendium.com/。

Punchline.Original: Ever wanted to get notified when someone targets you or emotes at you? Now you can!
Punchline.Translated: 想在别人选中你或对你做情感动作时收到提醒？现在可以了！

Description.Original:
This plugin notifies you when someone targets you, or emotes at you.

Commands:
  /ohhey - Opens the main window
  /ohhey main - Opens the main window
  /ohhey [config|settings] - Opens the settings window
  /ohhey help - Displays the help message (will also display on invalid sub-commands)
Description.Translated:
有人选中你或对你使用情感动作时发送通知。

命令：
  /ohhey - 打开主窗口
  /ohhey main - 打开主窗口
  /ohhey [config|settings] - 打开设置窗口
  /ohhey help - 显示帮助信息（输入无效子命令时也会显示）

Punchline.Original: Play OOF! on fall and/or death. The Only Plugin You Need!
Punchline.Translated: 在坠落和／或死亡时播放 OOF！你唯一需要的插件！

Description.Original:
i love roblox!!! 
           
whimsical and magical features...
  - when other ppl die
  - custom mp3
  - instant access to the hour long documentary on oof by hbomberguy
Description.Translated:
我爱 Roblox！！！

充满奇思妙想的神奇功能……
  - 其他玩家死亡时播放音效
  - 自定义 MP3
  - 一键观看 hbomberguy 制作的长达一小时的 OOF 音效纪录片

Punchline.Original: Create, save, and practice your openers.
Punchline.Translated: 创建、保存并练习你的起手循环。

Description.Original: Create your opener and practice with a striking dummy. Provides basic analysis.
Description.Translated: 创建起手循环并对木人进行练习，提供基础分析。

Punchline.Original: Leave messages like in Souls games. Amazing chest ahead.
Punchline.Translated: 像魂系列游戏一样留下谏言。前有绝景。

Description.Original: Dark Souls-like messaging system.
Description.Translated: 类似《黑暗之魂》的谏言系统。

Punchline.Original: Adds a simple front-end for browsing and changing the in-game BGM.
Punchline.Translated: 提供简单的界面，用于浏览和切换游戏内背景音乐。

Description.Original: Adds a simple front-end for browsing and changing the in-game BGM.  /porch to open
Description.Translated: 提供简单的界面，用于浏览和切换游戏内背景音乐。输入 /porch 打开。

Punchline.Original: owo for your chat
Punchline.Translated: 让聊天内容变成 owo 卖萌风格。

Description.Original: This plugin uwu's your chat.
Description.Translated: 将你的聊天内容转换为 uwu 卖萌风格。

Punchline.Original: Browse community events sourced from partake.gg directly from your client!
Punchline.Translated: 直接在游戏客户端中浏览来自 partake.gg 的社区活动！

Description.Original: Browse community events sourced from partake.gg directly from your client!
Description.Translated: 直接在游戏客户端中浏览来自 partake.gg 的社区活动！

Punchline.Original: Pat counter
Punchline.Translated: 摸头计数器。

Description.Original: Did you ever wonder how many times your Lala gets a pat? Well, now you can count it!
Description.Translated: 想知道你的拉拉菲尔被摸过多少次头吗？现在可以统计了！

Punchline.Original: Copies 1 below the cheapest offer to your clipboard when you check marketboard prices
Punchline.Translated: 查看市场布告板价格时，将比最低售价低 1 吉尔的价格复制到剪贴板。

Description.Original: Copies 1 below the cheapest offer to your clipboard when you check marketboard prices. /penny help
Description.Translated: 查看市场布告板价格时，将比最低售价低 1 吉尔的价格复制到剪贴板。输入 /penny help 查看帮助。

Punchline.Original:
Give your minions, Carbuncles and Faeries cute nicknames
and share them with your friends.
Punchline.Translated:
给宠物、宝石兽和小仙女起个可爱的昵称，
并与好友分享。

Description.Original:
Give your minions, Carbuncles and Faeries cute nicknames
and share them with your friends.
Description.Translated:
给宠物、宝石兽和小仙女起个可爱的昵称，
并与好友分享。

Punchline.Original: Customize pet scale
Punchline.Translated: 自定义召唤兽大小。

Description.Original: Adjust the scale of your own pets and other player's pets, independent of each other.
Description.Translated: 分别调整自己与其他玩家的召唤兽大小，互不影响。

Punchline.Original: Lightweight job visibility in nameplates and chat.
Punchline.Translated: 以轻量方式在姓名板和聊天中显示职业信息。

Description.Original:
Lightweight job visibility in nameplates and chat. Create custom tags and add them to players with the context menu.

You want to contribute and help developing new features or want to extend existing? Feel free to open Fork and open a Pull Request!

This plugin was originally developed by r00telement but forked and continued by Pilzinsel64.
Description.Translated:
以轻量方式在姓名板和聊天中显示职业信息。可创建自定义标签，并通过右键菜单为玩家添加标签。

想参与开发新功能或扩展现有功能？欢迎 Fork 项目并提交 Pull Request！

本插件最初由 r00telement 开发，之后由 Pilzinsel64 建立分支并继续维护。

Punchline.Original: Never guess whether you'll make that positional again!
Punchline.Translated: 再也不用猜这一击能否打中身位！

Description.Original: If you have a hard time telling whether you're in the right spot for positional attacks, this plugin can draw guidelines on your screen to help you tell where you need to be.
Description.Translated: 如果你难以判断自己是否站在满足身位要求的位置，本插件可在屏幕上绘制辅助线，帮你找到正确站位。

Punchline.Original: Changes in-game dialogue to reference your desired gender and name.
Punchline.Translated: 让游戏对话使用你希望的性别称呼和姓名。

Description.Original: Changes in-game dialogue to your desired gender and name. /prefpro for the menu.
Description.Translated: 让游戏对话使用你希望的性别称呼和姓名。输入 /prefpro 打开菜单。

Punchline.Original: Quickly price check your items.
Punchline.Translated: 快速查询物品价格。

Description.Original: Quickly price check your items.
Description.Translated: 快速查询物品价格。

Punchline.Original: Mobile push notifications for the Party Finder.
Punchline.Translated: 为队员招募提供手机推送通知。

Description.Original: A plugin that uses Pushover (https://pushover.net), Discord, SimplePush (http://simplepush.io), or Ntfy (https://ntfy.sh) to send mobile push notifications when party members join or leave, or when a duty finder queue is initiated.
Description.Translated: 当队员加入或离开，或开始任务搜索器排队时，通过 Pushover（https://pushover.net）、Discord、SimplePush（http://simplepush.io）或 Ntfy（https://ntfy.sh）发送手机推送通知。

Punchline.Original: Do you want an announcer in your PvP matches, PvE duties, and fates? Metem and the Scions have offered their services!
Punchline.Translated: 想让 PvP 比赛、PvE 副本和临危受命也有解说员吗？Metem 和拂晓的伙伴们愿为你效劳！

Description.Original: This plugin will cause character voice lines to play upon specific conditions being met.
Description.Translated: 满足指定条件时，播放角色语音台词。

Punchline.Original: PvP match history and stats tracker.
Punchline.Translated: 记录 PvP 对战历史与统计数据。

Description.Original: Record, browse and filter your Crystalline Conflict, Frontline and Rival Wings match history, view match scoreboards and view aggregated statistics like win rate and average damage dealt per match.
Description.Translated: 记录、浏览和筛选水晶冲突、纷争前线及烈羽争锋的对战历史，查看每场比赛的计分板，以及胜率、场均造成伤害等汇总数据。

Punchline.Original: Removes unwanted icons from your map.
Punchline.Translated: 移除地图上不需要的图标。

Description.Original: Removes unwanted icons from your map.
Description.Translated: 移除地图上不需要的图标。

Punchline.Original: See details about quests that the FFXIV doesn't tell you.
Punchline.Translated: 查看 FFXIV 游戏内未展示的任务详情。

Description.Original: Quest Journal is a detailed quest tracker / viewer. Letting you see information about quest chains without using a wiki.
Description.Translated: Quest Journal 是详细的任务追踪与查看工具，无需查阅 Wiki 即可了解任务链信息。

Punchline.Original: Explore quests and their rewards.
Punchline.Translated: 探索任务及其奖励。

Description.Original:
Explore quests and their rewards.
- Search for quest names or their rewards, including instances,
  beast tribes, minions, etc.
- See an interactive map of quest requirements and unlocks.
- Open a quest info window even for quests you haven't completed.
- Open quest starting locations on the map or open quests in the journal.

Icons: treasure map by Anthony Ledoux from the Noun Project and
locked book by Anthony Ledoux from the Noun Project
Description.Translated:
探索任务及其奖励。
- 搜索任务名称或奖励，包括副本、友好部族、宠物等。
- 通过交互式关系图查看任务的前置条件及后续解锁内容。
- 即使尚未完成任务，也能打开其任务信息窗口。
- 在地图上查看任务起始地点，或在任务日志中打开任务。

图标署名：藏宝图与上锁的书籍图标均由 Anthony Ledoux 创作，来自 Noun Project。

Punchline.Original: Share your quest progress with others.
Punchline.Translated: 与他人分享你的任务进度。

Description.Original: Follow your friends on their questing journey by seeing their progress through a shared quest. Provides markers for quest destinations and (soon) teleporting features.
Description.Translated: 通过共享任务查看好友的进度，陪伴他们的任务旅程。提供任务目的地标记，并计划加入传送功能。

Punchline.Original: For the quest completionist
Punchline.Translated: 为任务全收集爱好者而生。

Description.Original: Easily track quest completion
Description.Translated: 轻松追踪任务完成情况。

Punchline.Original: Stop yer ears bleedin' in the Wolves' Den
Punchline.Translated: 让你的耳朵在狼狱停船厂歇一歇。

Description.Original: Auto-mute BGM while in the Wolves' Den, because I've had enough and it ends here.
Description.Translated: 在狼狱停船厂自动静音背景音乐——我受够了，就到此为止吧。

Punchline.Original: Can't decide what class to work on today? Let the plugin decide for you!
Punchline.Translated: 今天不知道练什么职业？让插件替你选！

Description.Original: Allows you to select a random class to do dailies/etc on.
Description.Translated: 随机选择一个职业，用来完成日常等活动。

Punchline.Original: Display the battery level of your wireless Razer and Logitech devices
Punchline.Translated: 显示 Razer 和 Logitech 无线设备的剩余电量。

Description.Original:
Automatically pull device battery levels and display them in a configurable number of ways!

Currently supported brands:
- Razer
- Logitech
Description.Translated:
自动获取设备电量，并以多种可配置的方式显示！

目前支持的品牌：
- Razer
- Logitech

Punchline.Original: Extends the game's built-in ready check.
Punchline.Translated: 增强游戏内置的准备确认功能。

Description.Original: Displays the names of the players that were not ready in chat following the completion of a ready check, and optionally adds ready check status icons over the party and alliance lists.
Description.Translated: 准备确认结束后，在聊天中显示尚未准备好的玩家姓名；还可选择在小队和团队列表中添加准备状态图标。

Punchline.Original: Set the world alight!
Punchline.Translated: 点亮整个世界！

Description.Original: Makes the torch accessory put out light.
Description.Translated: 让火把时尚配饰真正发出光亮。

Punchline.Original: Simple mouseover and ground-targeting action integration
Punchline.Translated: 简单整合鼠标指向施法与地面目标技能。

Description.Original: Easily change the targeting priority for spells and abilities. Queue macros and ground-targeted actions! Type /redirect to configure.
Description.Translated: 轻松调整魔法和能力的目标选择优先级，让宏与地面目标技能也能进入技能队列！输入 /redirect 进行设置。

Punchline.Original: Crowdsourced PF website (upload PF listings to xivpf.com)
Punchline.Translated: 由玩家共同提供数据的招募网站（将招募信息上传至 xivpf.com）。

Description.Original: Uploads the PF listings you retrieve to the crowdsourced Remote Party Finder website (https://xivpf.com/).
Description.Translated: 将你获取到的队员招募信息上传至由玩家共同提供数据的 Remote Party Finder 网站（https://xivpf.com/）。

Punchline.Original: Never forget to repair & extract materia again!
Punchline.Translated: 再也不会忘记修理装备和精制魔晶石！

Description.Original: Helps you notice when your gear needs to be repaired or has materia to be extracted. /repairme to config
Description.Translated: 提醒你哪些装备需要修理，或已可精制魔晶石。输入 /repairme 进行设置。

Punchline.Original: Improve your Island Sanctuary experience.
Punchline.Translated: 改善开拓无人岛体验。

Description.Original:
A plugin to improve Island Sanctuary. Features:

- Mark items to gather on the proper map
- Gathering & crafting todo-list, showing you what mats you require
- Widget for quick access to information

Icon from the Mutant Standard project.
Description.Translated:
改善开拓无人岛体验的插件，功能包括：

- 在相应地图上标记待采集物品
- 采集与制作待办清单，显示所需材料
- 快速查看信息的小组件

图标来自 Mutant Standard 项目。

Punchline.Original: Move and scale vanilla hud elements to your liking!
Punchline.Translated: 随心移动和缩放原生 HUD 元素！

Description.Original: Allows you to more freely and precisely scale and position HUD elements.
Description.Translated: 更加自由、精确地调整 HUD 元素的大小和位置。

Punchline.Original: A path logger with optional crowdsourcing functionality.
Punchline.Translated: 资源路径记录工具，可选择参与路径数据共享。

Description.Original:
ResLogger2 allows you to log paths that the game loads in a fast and convenient
window, with multiple options including only logging unique paths, path filters,
and uploading found paths. Information on the crowdsourced paths is available
at https://rl2.perchbird.dev.
Open the UI with /reslog.
Description.Translated:
ResLogger2 提供快捷便利的窗口，记录游戏加载的资源路径。
支持仅记录不重复路径、路径筛选及上传已发现路径等选项。
共享路径数据的相关信息见 https://rl2.perchbird.dev。
输入 /reslog 打开界面。

Punchline.Original: Utility for hosts in Forked Tower runs.
Punchline.Translated: 为 Forked Tower 攻略组织者提供辅助工具。

Description.Original: List various information about nearby players such as Phantom Job, Remaining Resurrection Stacks in Forked Towers, as well as Knowledge Level. Use /ressc [settings] to open the main or settings window.
Description.Translated: 列出附近玩家的辅助职业、Forked Tower 中剩余的复活次数、知见等级等信息。使用 /ressc [settings] 打开主窗口或设置窗口。

Punchline.Original: Reminds you about retainer ventures.
Punchline.Translated: 提醒雇员探险进度。

Description.Original: A simple plugin to remind you when your retainers are done with their ventures.
Description.Translated: 雇员完成探险时提醒你的简单插件。

Punchline.Original: See retainer sales quicker
Punchline.Translated: 更快查看雇员销售情况。

Description.Original: Quickly see which retainers have sold something while you were logged off.
Description.Translated: 快速查看离线期间哪些雇员售出了物品。

Punchline.Original: Lower 3D Resolution Scale
Punchline.Translated: 降低 3D 分辨率缩放比例。

Description.Original:
Ever wanted to render at lower resolution? Now you can!
Only works with AMD FSR graphics upscaler
Description.Translated:
想让游戏以更低分辨率渲染？现在可以了！
仅适用于 AMD FSR 画面升频模式。

Punchline.Original: Display profiles from Chaos Archives, Crystal Archives, and Central Archives in-game
Punchline.Translated: 在游戏内显示 Chaos Archives、Crystal Archives 和 Central Archives 的角色资料。

Description.Original: A plugin for roleplayers, displaying character profiles from Central Archives (centralarchives.org) and its regional RP portals, Chaos Archives (chaosarchives.org) and Crystal Archives (crystalarchives.org), for characters with the RP flag on.
Description.Translated: 面向角色扮演玩家的插件，为开启 RP 标识的角色显示来自 Central Archives（centralarchives.org）及其地区 RP 门户 Chaos Archives（chaosarchives.org）、Crystal Archives（crystalarchives.org）的角色资料。

Punchline.Original: A helper plugin for pre-populating hunt train scout tracker links
Punchline.Translated: 帮助预填狩猎车探路记录链接的辅助插件。

Description.Original: A helper for generating scout tracker links for a-rank hunt trains
Description.Translated: 帮助生成 A 级狩猎车探路记录链接。

Punchline.Original: Lets you use the mouse wheel to switch tabs (like LB/RB on controllers do).
Punchline.Translated: 使用鼠标滚轮切换标签页，就像手柄上的 LB/RB 一样。

Description.Original:
Lets you use the mouse wheel to switch tabs (like LB/RB on controllers do).

The following windows are supported and can be toggled individually:

- Aether Currents
- Armoury Chest
- Blue Magic Spellbook
- Character
- Character -> Classes/Jobs
- Character -> Reputation
- Chocobo Saddlebag
- Client List (via /timers)
- Companion
- Currency
- Facewear
- Fashion Accessories
- Field Records
- Fish Guide
- Glamour Dresser (scrolls pages, not tabs)
- Gold Saucer -> Card List
- Gold Saucer -> Decks -> Edit Deck
- Gold Saucer -> Lord of Verminion -> Minion Hotbar
- Icons
- Inventory
- Island Minion Guide
- Master's Bestiary
- Minions
- Mounts
- Retainer Inventory
- Shared FATE
- Sightseeing Log

The Command Panel already includes this functionality and instead has an option to disable its tab-scrolling sound effect.
Description.Translated:
使用鼠标滚轮切换标签页，就像手柄上的 LB/RB 一样。

支持以下窗口，各项可独立开关：

- 风脉泉
- 兵装库
- 青魔法书
- 角色
- 角色 → 战斗职业／特职
- 角色 → 声望
- 陆行鸟鞍囊
- 老主顾列表（通过 /timers 打开）
- 搭档
- 货币
- 面部配饰
- 时尚配饰
- 战果记录
- 钓鱼图鉴
- 投影台（滚动翻页，而非切换标签页）
- 金碟游乐场 → 卡片列表
- 金碟游乐场 → 卡组 → 编辑卡组
- 金碟游乐场 → 萌宠之王 → 宠物热键栏
- 图标
- 背包
- 无人岛宠物图鉴
- 驯兽图鉴
- 宠物
- 坐骑
- 雇员背包
- 危命任务完成度
- 探索笔记

指令面板已自带滚轮切换标签页功能，因此本插件为其提供的是关闭切换标签页音效的选项。

Punchline.Original: Get notified when someone enters or exits your mount!
Punchline.Translated: 有人上下你的坐骑时收到通知！

Description.Original: Adds chat or toast notifications whenever someone enters or exits your mount.
Description.Translated: 有人乘上或离开你的坐骑时，通过聊天消息或弹出提示发送通知。

Punchline.Original: Remember to check your posture!
Punchline.Translated: 记得检查一下坐姿！

Description.Original: Configurable reminders to hydrate and maintain a healthy posture.
Description.Translated: 可自定义的喝水与保持健康坐姿提醒。

Punchline.Original: Bringing Shananigans to Eorzea
Punchline.Translated: 给艾欧泽亚添点 Shan 式恶作剧。

Description.Original: Replaces the word 'Gil' with 'Shanbells' (or something else entirely!) in the Currency window and Tooltips.
Description.Translated: 将货币窗口与提示信息中的“吉尔”替换为“Shanbells”（也可以是任意其他名称！）。

Punchline.Original: Displays item icons instead of item category icons in shops.
Punchline.Translated: 商店中显示物品自身的图标，而非物品类别图标。

Description.Original:
Displays item icons instead of item category icons in shops.
      
Supported windows:

- Shops: Simple merchants that sell items for Gil.
- Item Exchange: Vendors that trade items for items, such as the Wolf Collar Exchange or Itinerant Moogles that exchange items for Irregular Tomestones during the Moogle Treasure Trove event.
- Item Exchange (categorized): Splendors Vendors, the Scrip Exchange or the Wolf Mark Exchange.
- Currency Exchange: Vendors that sell items for currency, such as all the societies vendors, or the Trophy Crystal Exchange.
- Grand Company Seal Exchange: Quartermasters of Grand Companies.
- Rewards: Vendors that provide job gear free of charge.
- Exchange: Calamity Salvager when exchanging old pigments for all-purpose pigments.
Description.Translated:
商店中显示物品自身的图标，而非物品类别图标。

支持的窗口：

- 商店：使用吉尔购买物品的普通商人。
- 物品交换：以物易物的商人，例如狼首项圈兑换，以及莫古莫古大收集活动中使用稀少神典石兑换物品的旅行莫古力。
- 物品交换（分类）：罗薇娜商会商人、票据兑换和狼印战绩兑换。
- 货币交换：使用特定货币购买物品的商人，例如各友好部族商人、奖杯水晶兑换。
- 军票交换：各大国防联军的补给负责人。
- 奖励：免费提供职业装备的商人。
- 交换：遗失物管理人在将旧染料兑换为通用染料时的窗口。

Punchline.Original: Shows you what items vendors won't sell you yet.
Punchline.Translated: 查看商人暂时还不肯卖给你的物品。

Description.Original: Opens a window when speaking with a supported vendor, showing items that are not unlocked and what their conditions are. It checks quests, achievements, and reputation requirements.
Description.Translated: 与支持的商人交谈时打开窗口，显示尚未解锁的物品及其解锁条件，并检查任务、成就和声望要求。

Punchline.Original: Automatically rename your screenshots with character and location info.
Punchline.Translated: 自动用角色和地点信息重命名截图。

Description.Original: Renames screenshots as they are created to include character name, map name, and coordinates. Monitors default, Reshade and GShade screenshots.
Description.Translated: 截图生成时自动重命名，在文件名中加入角色名、地图名和坐标。可监测游戏原生截图以及 ReShade、GShade 截图。

Punchline.Original: Make chat more fun with translations like pirate and urianger.
Punchline.Translated: 将聊天内容转换为海盗腔、于里昂热腔等风格，让聊天更有趣。

Description.Original: Make chat more fun with translations like pirate and urianger.
Description.Translated: 将聊天内容转换为海盗腔、于里昂热腔等风格，让聊天更有趣。

Punchline.Original: Simple item comparison
Punchline.Translated: 简单的物品对比工具。

Description.Original: Show simple item comparison when pressing SHIFT and hovering over item
Description.Translated: 按住 SHIFT 并将鼠标悬停在物品上，即可显示简明的物品对比。

Punchline.Original: Automatically keep track of treasure hunt maps within your party.
Punchline.Translated: 自动追踪小队成员的寻宝地图。

Description.Original: Utilizes an external server to share your current treasure hunt target with your party members.
Description.Translated: 借助外部服务器，与队友共享你当前的寻宝目标。

Punchline.Original: A simple and compact market board plugin for power users.
Punchline.Translated: 面向进阶用户的简洁紧凑型市场布告板插件。

Description.Original:
A niche plugin designed to be user-friendly and multi-functional with rich customisation options, for power users.

Highlights:
  - Compact UI and user theme
  - Customisable search options
  - Rich ways for plugin interaction

Check out the 'Introduction' on Config Window for documentation.
Description.Translated:
面向进阶用户的专门工具，兼顾易用性、多功能与丰富的自定义选项。

主要特点：
  - 紧凑界面与自定义主题
  - 可自定义的搜索选项
  - 丰富的插件交互方式

使用文档请查看设置窗口中的“介绍”页面。

Punchline.Original: A simple Todo List
Punchline.Translated: 简单的待办清单。

Description.Original:
/ptodo to open the Todo List
/ptodoconfig to open the Configuration
Description.Translated:
/ptodo 打开待办清单
/ptodoconfig 打开设置

Punchline.Original: This was supposed to be simple...
Punchline.Translated: 这本来应该很简单的……

Description.Original:
A collection of Quality of Life tweaks. Aiming to improve the experience without changing anything drastically.
All changes are toggleable, with everything disabled by default. Visit the Repo for a full list of tweaks. (Globe icon below)
Description.Translated:
一组便利性调整，旨在改善体验而不进行大幅改动。
所有调整均可开关，默认全部关闭。完整列表请访问仓库（点击下方地球图标）。

Punchline.Original: See chat messages from your current target in a separate window.
Punchline.Translated: 在独立窗口中查看当前目标发送的聊天消息。

Description.Original: Adds a /snooper command that shows a separate window that shows only messages from the player you're currently targeting. Useful for keeping track of different conversations during crowded RP events.
Description.Translated: 添加 /snooper 命令，用于打开独立窗口，仅显示当前选中的玩家发送的消息。在人多的 RP 活动中，便于跟进不同的对话。

Punchline.Original: Total customization of your inventory
Punchline.Translated: 全面自定义你的背包。

Description.Original: Sort your inventory however you want and keep it sorted
Description.Translated: 按你喜欢的方式整理背包，并持续保持有序。

Punchline.Original: Quiets the Gameplay Experience.
Punchline.Translated: 让游戏体验更安静。

Description.Original:
This plugin silences all text sound effects and quick chat.

For feedback, please contact .spider in the Dalamud discord.
Description.Translated:
静音所有文字音效和快捷聊天音效。

如需反馈，请在 Dalamud Discord 联系 .spider。

Punchline.Original: Filter any game sound.
Punchline.Translated: 过滤任意游戏声音。

Description.Original:
Filters any sound or set of sounds from the game.

- Remove a battle sound effect you don't like
- Remove specific emote sounds
- Remove specific background music
Description.Translated:
屏蔽游戏中的任意声音或一组声音。

- 移除不喜欢的战斗音效
- 移除指定情感动作的声音
- 移除指定背景音乐

Punchline.Original: A Dalamud plugin that allows volume control from anywhere, including gpose and cutscenes.
Punchline.Translated: 可在任何场景调整音量的 Dalamud 插件，包括集体动作模式和过场动画。

Description.Original: A Dalamud plugin that allows volume control from anywhere, including gpose and cutscenes.
Description.Translated: 可在任何场景调整音量的 Dalamud 插件，包括集体动作模式和过场动画。

Punchline.Original: Because multiplication is hard.
Punchline.Translated: 毕竟，乘法太难了。

Description.Original: Shows the vendor sell price for the full stack of an item on the tooltip
Description.Translated: 在物品提示中显示整组物品出售给商店时的总价。

Punchline.Original: Witty commentary to the brilliant things you do.
Punchline.Translated: 为你的“精彩操作”献上妙语点评。

Description.Original: Check /narrator for full options or use /narratorvolume to set volume manually.
Description.Translated: 输入 /narrator 查看全部选项，或使用 /narratorvolume 手动设置音量。

Punchline.Original: Add contrast to your status icons
Punchline.Translated: 提高状态图标的对比度。

Description.Original: You will finally be able to easily see the timer of your buffs/debuffs properly when the arena background is bright!
Description.Translated: 即使战斗场地背景很亮，也终于能轻松看清增益和减益的剩余时间了！

Punchline.Original: Before StatusTimers, my buffs/debuffs were a mystery. Now, it's a well-organized history!
Punchline.Translated: 用上 StatusTimers 之前，增益减益一团迷；用上之后，状态变化一目了然！

Description.Original: StatusTimers provides clear, customizable bars for tracking your crucial buffs and debuffs. It helps you keep an eye on active effects, their remaining durations, and stacks, allowing you to optimize your gameplay without constantly staring at your tiny icons.
Description.Translated: StatusTimers 使用清晰、可自定义的计时条追踪重要的增益和减益，帮助你掌握当前效果、剩余时间和层数，不必一直盯着小小的图标，也能优化战斗表现。

Punchline.Original: Like /focustarget, but with no overrides.
Punchline.Translated: 类似 /focustarget，但不会覆盖已有焦点目标。

Description.Original:
(PvE-only.) Adds the /stickyfocustarget command, which focuses your current
target, as long as you do not already have a focus target set.
  
Have you ever felt focusing was under-utilised? Wanted to use it without a
dedicated keybind? Do you not even know what focus targeting is?
You've come to the right place.
  
You can add this command to your Attack Nearest macro and ensure that the
first enemy you target will also become focused, and stay that way, until it dies.
With this, you can focus enemies without having to consciously press a keybind,
and ensure that, for instance, when a focused boss spawns an add and you target it,
the boss' focus will NOT get overriden.

This plugin does not change the behaviour of the stock /focustarget command,
and must be triggered either manually or by adding it to a macro.
Placeholders are supported.
Description.Translated:
仅限 PvE。添加 /stickyfocustarget 命令：仅在尚未设置焦点目标时，将当前目标设为焦点。

你是否觉得焦点目标功能没能充分利用？想不用专门的快捷键就能设置焦点？或者还不知道焦点目标是什么？
你来对地方了。

将这个命令加入“攻击最近目标”宏，即可让首次选中的敌人同时成为焦点，并一直保留到它死亡。
这样无需刻意按下单独的快捷键就能设置焦点。例如，已设为焦点的首领召唤小怪后，即使你切换目标攻击小怪，首领的焦点也不会被覆盖。

本插件不修改原生 /focustarget 命令的行为，必须手动调用，或将命令加入宏来触发。
支持目标占位符。

Punchline.Original: Gives the value of current targets health in Stormtalons from the dead game Wildstar.
Punchline.Translated: 以已停服游戏《WildStar》中的 Stormtalon 的生命值为单位，显示当前目标的生命值。

Description.Original: Gives the value of current targets health in Stormtalons from the dead game Wildstar.
Description.Translated: 以已停服游戏《WildStar》中的 Stormtalon 的生命值为单位，显示当前目标的生命值。

Punchline.Original: You do not talk about Fight Club, same for Submarines
Punchline.Translated: 不要谈论搏击俱乐部，潜水艇也是如此。

Description.Original:
+ Tracker for current builds, routes and times 
+ Builder to improve, solve builds and optimize EXP
+ Configurable notification for return and repairs 
+ Helpy filled useful information
+ Custom loot overview with history and export
+ Multiple overlays to help with daily tasks 
+ Supports multiple FCs
Description.Translated:
+ 追踪当前配装、航线和航行时间
+ 配装工具：改进和求解配装，优化经验收益
+ 可自定义的返航与修理通知
+ 通过 Helpy 提供丰富实用的信息
+ 自定义收益总览，支持历史记录与导出
+ 多种悬浮界面，辅助处理日常事务
+ 支持多个部队

Punchline.Original: Colorizes suit symbols ♥, ♠, ♣, ♦
Punchline.Translated: 为扑克牌花色符号 ♥、♠、♣、♦ 着色。

Description.Original: When enabled, suit symbols appear in distinct colors in chat.
Description.Translated: 启用后，聊天中的不同扑克牌花色符号将以不同颜色显示。

Punchline.Original: Never forget your NPC shop sales again!
Punchline.Translated: 再也不会忘记把物品卖给 NPC 商店！

Description.Original: Mark items for NPC sale and get reminded to sell them at NPC shops.
Description.Translated: 标记准备卖给 NPC 的物品，并在 NPC 商店提醒你出售。

Punchline.Original: Automatically copy ANY text on your screen by choice.
Punchline.Translated: 按你的选择，自动复制屏幕上的任意文字。

Description.Original:
Automatically copy ANY text on your screen.

There are two modes:
        -Normal Mode: Automatically copies a select number of text elements to your clipboard.
        -Text Copy Mode: This mode allows you to copy the text of ANY text element on the screen.

Default keybinds to toggle between the two modes are:
      [Left Control] [Left Shift] [Spacebar]
Description.Translated:
自动复制屏幕上的任意文字。

提供两种模式：
        - 普通模式：自动将选定类型的文字元素复制到剪贴板。
        - 文字复制模式：可复制屏幕上任意文字元素的内容。

两种模式间切换的默认快捷键为：
      [Left Control] [Left Shift] [Spacebar]

Punchline.Original: You can now select furnitures from the Housing Menu
Punchline.Translated: 现在可以从房屋菜单中选中家具。

Description.Original:
Currently, the only possible way to select a housing item is to click the furniture itself, and this can be a problem if you have multiple items close to each other.

This plugin adds a new option in the Housing Menu that targets the furniture for you
Description.Translated:
原本只能直接点击家具来选中它；多件家具摆放得很近时，这会很不方便。

本插件在房屋菜单中添加新选项，帮助你直接选中对应家具。

Punchline.Original: Customizable target lines
Punchline.Translated: 可自定义的目标连线。

Description.Original: Customizable target lines
