Description.Translated: 可自定义的目标连线。

Punchline.Original: Chat Commands for Teleporting
Punchline.Translated: 通过聊天命令进行传送。

Description.Original: Chat Commands for teleporting to Aetherytes. /tp for help
Description.Translated: 通过聊天命令传送至以太之光。输入 /tp 查看帮助。

Punchline.Original: Chat and game dialogue TTS plugin.
Punchline.Translated: 聊天与游戏对话文字转语音插件。

Description.Original: Chat TTS. Use /tttconfig to configure the enabled channels and triggers/exceptions.
Description.Translated: 朗读聊天消息。使用 /tttconfig 设置启用的频道、触发条件和例外规则。

Name.Original: Hit it, Joe! (Formerly TF2-ish Critical Hits Plugin)
Name.Translated: Hit it, Joe! (Formerly TF2-ish Critical Hits Plugin)

Punchline.Original: Configure sounds for critical and direct hits, plus some countdown music.
Punchline.Translated: 为暴击、直击设置音效，也可设置倒计时音乐。

Description.Original:
* Set sounds and flavor text to be played/shown whenever you deal direct or critical damage or heal.
* Set sounds to be played when a countdown is in progress.
* Use different configurations by job.
* Use the game's SFX or your own custom WAV or MP3 files.
Description.Translated:
* 为直击、暴击伤害或治疗设置播放的音效与显示的提示文字。
* 设置倒计时期间播放的音效。
* 为不同职业使用不同配置。
* 可使用游戏自带音效，或自定义 WAV、MP3 文件。

Punchline.Original: Set your character's title - now with Searchalin!
Punchline.Translated: 设置角色称号——现在还加入了 Searchalin 搜索妙方！

Description.Original:
The Heart of the Party is a remake of the in-game title picker, but it
supports searching. Note that it doesn't add a command to set your title; use
the built-in /title command instead.
Description.Translated:
The Heart of the Party 重新设计了游戏内的称号选择器，并加入搜索功能。
请注意，本插件不提供设置称号的命令；请使用游戏内置的 /title 命令。

Punchline.Original: Tracks the current tick for HP/MP/GP regen
Punchline.Translated: 追踪 HP、MP、采集力自然恢复的当前周期。

Description.Original: Customizable bars that indicate the tick progress of HP/MP/GP regen
Description.Translated: 使用可自定义的进度条显示 HP、MP、采集力自然恢复周期的进度。

Punchline.Original: Cut down FFXIV chat spam with per-message toggles and shorter system lines.
Punchline.Translated: 按消息类型开关显示，并精简系统提示，减少 FFXIV 聊天刷屏。

Description.Original:
Trim the messages FFXIV dumps into your chat log.

  - Master filters for System, Progress, Loot, Obtained, Crafting, and Gathering
  - Toggles for currencies, FC and retainer messages, level-ups, mount unlocks, orchestrion lines, deep dungeon pomanders, combat log categories, and more
  - Shorter rewrites for instance entry, commendations, Novice Network, and treasure dungeon text
  - Copies /say quest dialogue to your clipboard; can block emote spam from others
  - Player whitelist, chat history deduplication, per-tomestone hides, and debug logging
Description.Translated:
精简 FFXIV 写入聊天日志的消息。

  - 为系统、进度、战利品、获得物品、制作和采集提供分类总开关
  - 可单独开关货币、部队与雇员消息、升级、坐骑解锁、管弦乐琴提示、深层迷宫魔陶器、战斗日志分类等内容
  - 缩短进入副本、最优队员推荐、新人频道与寻宝迷宫的提示文字
  - 将任务要求的 /say 台词复制到剪贴板；可屏蔽其他玩家的情感动作刷屏
  - 玩家白名单、聊天历史去重、按神典石种类隐藏消息，以及调试日志

Punchline.Original: Tilt the camera, not yourself.
Punchline.Translated: 让镜头倾斜，不用你歪着身子。

Description.Original: Automatically adjusts the Third Person Camera Angle/Distance given certain conditions.
Description.Translated: 根据指定条件，自动调整第三人称镜头的角度和距离。

Punchline.Original: Tippy, your new FFXIV virtual assistant.
Punchline.Translated: Tippy，你的全新 FFXIV 虚拟助手。

Description.Original:
Developed by goat for April Fools 2021 and unnecessarily resurrected by kal and adopted by Critical-Impact.

Handcrafted by our finest code artisans with special AI, 
he will analyze your playstyle to give you useful tips to get your GAMING to the next level.

Some things he can do:
* He can give general tips about the game
* He can give tips about the job you're playing
* He can report on your battle performance
* He will respect your feelings
Description.Translated:
由 goat 为 2021 年愚人节开发，后来被 kal 多此一举地复活，再由 Critical-Impact 接手。

由我们最优秀的代码工匠精心打造，搭载特别的 AI，
它会分析你的游戏风格，提供实用建议，让你的游戏水平更上一层楼。

它能做的事包括：
* 提供游戏通用小贴士
* 提供当前职业的技巧建议
* 汇报你的战斗表现
* 照顾你的感受

Punchline.Original: Create, share, and shuffle custom title and character select screens for FFXIV.
Punchline.Translated: 为 FFXIV 创建、分享并随机切换自定义标题画面与角色选择画面。

Description.Original: Create, share, and shuffle custom title screens for FFXIV.
Description.Translated: 创建、分享并随机轮换 FFXIV 的自定义标题画面。

Punchline.Original: Pick titles you want in a title roulette.
Punchline.Translated: 挑选要加入随机轮换的称号。

Description.Original: Allows you to pick any number of titles, setting a random one each time you use "/ptitle" or "/ptitle groupName".
Description.Translated: 任意选择一组称号，每次使用“/ptitle”或“/ptitle groupName”时，从中随机设置一个。

Punchline.Original: Keep on top of new items.
Punchline.Translated: 及时掌握新获得的物品。

Description.Original: Displays new items, crystals, and gil as toasts.
Description.Translated: 通过弹出提示显示新获得的物品、水晶和吉尔。

Punchline.Original: Find cross-DC market opportunities.
Punchline.Translated: 寻找跨数据中心的市场商机。

Description.Original: Scans Universalis data to find market opportunities.
Description.Translated: 扫描 Universalis 数据，寻找市场商机。

Punchline.Original: Sums up all "skill" levels like that one classic MMORPG
Punchline.Translated: 像那款经典 MMORPG 一样，把所有“技能”等级加在一起。

Description.Original: Shows the total level of a Character in the Search Info panel
Description.Translated: 在搜索信息面板中显示角色的总等级。

Punchline.Original: Finish your sightseeing log.
Punchline.Translated: 完成你的探索笔记。

Description.Original:
Tourist adds a window to assist with the sightseeing log.

- Show when sightseeing log vistas are available
- Add markers for ARR vistas
- Open vista locations on your map
- Hide already completed or unavailable vistas
- Show the command needed for each vista
Description.Translated:
Tourist 添加一个辅助完成探索笔记的窗口。

- 显示探索点何时满足完成条件
- 为 ARR 探索点添加标记
- 在地图上打开探索点位置
- 隐藏已完成或当前不可完成的探索点
- 显示各探索点所需的命令

Punchline.Original: Tracking data is fun
Punchline.Translated: 记录数据，其乐无穷。

Description.Original:
### Normal Functions 
+ Track currency increase
+ Track teleport and npc repair costs
+ Track desynthesis results
+ Track retainer ventures

### Advanced  Functions
+ Track different coffer rewards
  - Venture Coffer
  - Materiel Container 3.0
  - Materiel Container 4.0
  - Sanctuary Materiel Container
+ Track Eureka bunny rewards
+ Track Eureka/Bozja lockboxes
Description.Translated:
### 基础功能
+ 记录货币增长
+ 记录传送与 NPC 修理费用
+ 记录分解结果
+ 记录雇员探险

### 进阶功能
+ 记录各类宝箱的奖励
  - 雇员探险获得的宝箱
  - 3.0 物资箱
  - 4.0 物资箱
  - 无人岛物资箱
+ 记录优雷卡幸福兔奖励
+ 记录优雷卡／博兹雅上锁的宝箱

Punchline.Original: Triple triad solver
Punchline.Translated: 九宫幻卡解题助手。

Description.Original:
Triple triad solver, NPC matches only.
- highlights next move during mini game
- evaluates all deck presets before match
- deck optimizer for NPC
- adds more details to card collection window
Description.Translated:
九宫幻卡解题助手，仅适用于与 NPC 对战。
- 在对局中高亮建议的下一步
- 对战前评估所有预设卡组
- 针对 NPC 优化卡组
- 为卡片收藏窗口补充更多详情

Punchline.Original: Sup y'all? It's ya boy, Twitch XIV, and today we're gonna be playing some final fantasy fourteen.
Punchline.Translated: 各位好啊！你们的老朋友 Twitch XIV 来了，今天咱们玩《最终幻想14》。

Description.Original: Allows you to join a Twitch chat and send messages and (optionally) have the twitch chat come through your chatbox.
Description.Translated: 加入 Twitch 聊天并发送消息，还可选择将 Twitch 聊天内容显示在游戏聊天框中。

Punchline.Original: A collection of various game modifications
Punchline.Translated: 多种游戏增强功能的集合。

Description.Original: This plugin is primarily focused on various UI adjustments, behavior adjustments, and adding new native elements to the game
Description.Translated: 主要提供各种界面调整、行为调整，并为游戏添加新的原生风格界面元素。

Punchline.Original: Bookmark the venues you visit. View and manage guests for venues.
Punchline.Translated: 收藏去过的场所，查看并管理场所访客。

Description.Original: Save and share venues you visit or own. Get updates and logs for visitors coming and going. Guest list management tools for venue owners to view and easily export it for use with other applications. Icon by Silv :)
Description.Translated: 保存并分享拜访过或自己经营的场所。接收访客进出更新与日志，提供经营者访客列表管理工具，可轻松导出供其他应用使用。图标由 Silv 制作 :)

Punchline.Original: Changes your VO language on a per-duty basis
Punchline.Translated: 为不同副本分别设置语音语言。

Description.Original: Changes your VO language by specifying a language and an instance, your language will revert to the default when you exit. Icon designed by Leremy from Flaticon
Description.Translated: 为指定副本设置语音语言，离开副本后恢复默认语言。图标由 Flaticon 的 Leremy 设计。

Punchline.Original: Set out for Dawntrail and make your queues a breeze. Waitingway provides crowdsourced FFXIV login queue times, now with Discord queue notification features.
Punchline.Translated: 踏上《金曦之遗辉》，轻松应对排队。Waitingway 提供由玩家共同收集的 FFXIV 登录排队时间，现在还支持 Discord 排队通知。

Description.Original:
Contributes and utilizes crowdsourced login, duty, and roulette queue information for the benefit of everyone.

Current features include queue time estimates and notifications via Discord, so you can know when you make it into the game, as well as anonymously collecting and reporting statistics about your queue times to crowdsource information about FFXIV server load and activity. Join our Discord for more information!

Discord URL: https://waiting.camora.dev/discord
Description.Translated:
贡献并利用众包的登录、任务和随机任务排队信息，让所有人受益。

现有功能包括预计排队时间和 Discord 通知，方便你获知何时进入游戏；还会匿名收集并上报你的排队时长，以汇总 FFXIV 服务器负载和活跃度信息。更多详情请加入我们的 Discord！

Discord 地址：https://waiting.camora.dev/discord

Punchline.Original: Never mess up your wave emoticon again!
Punchline.Translated: 再也不会打错挥手表情！

Description.Original: Literally all this plugin does is send "o/" in chat if you accidentally type "/o"
Description.Translated: 本插件唯一的功能：当你误输入“/o”时，替你在聊天中发送“o/”。

Punchline.Original: Allows precise control over time and weather per zone or globally.
Punchline.Translated: 按区域或全局精确控制时间与天气。

Description.Translated:
功能：
- 随心改变游戏显示的时间和天气；
- 可全局设置，也可分别设置各区域；
- 完全禁止出现不喜欢的天气。

本插件只改变视觉效果：区域背景音乐、探索点可用条件、特定物体的状态等与时间或天气有关的机制不会受影响。
仅对露天区域生效，目前尚未覆盖全部露天区域，仍在完善中。

Punchline.Original: Persistent NPC Flavor Text
Punchline.Translated: 留存 NPC 的气泡闲聊。

Description.Original: Prints NPC speech bubbles to the chat log.  Please check the plugin settings and your chat log filters to make sure that they are compatible with each other.
Description.Translated: 将 NPC 的对话气泡内容输出到聊天日志。请检查插件设置和聊天日志过滤设置，确保两者相互兼容。

Punchline.Original: Shows what zone/region/territory you are in next to the server info.
Punchline.Translated: 在服务器信息旁显示你所在的区域、地区或地域。

Description.Original: Shows what zone/region/territory you are in up in the corner next to the server and time info. Open config with /waia.
Description.Translated: 在屏幕角落的服务器和时间信息旁，显示你所在的区域、地区或地域。输入 /waia 打开设置。

Punchline.Original: Shows what mount another player is using. Includes a mount database, chat links, and trial totem tracking.
Punchline.Translated: 查看其他玩家使用的坐骑，提供坐骑数据库、聊天链接和讨伐歼灭战图腾统计。

Description.Original:
Shows information about mounts other players are using.

Features:
- 'Find Mount' in a player's context menu: shows their mount and how to get it.
- Mount name and unlock status in the target tooltip.
- Mount database with search, expansion filter and acquisition info.
- Trial mount tracks with totem counts (inventory, saddlebag, retainers).
- Chat links: click a mount or totem icon to link it in chat, jump back from any link via 'Open in WhichMount'.
Description.Translated:
查看其他玩家正在使用的坐骑信息。

功能：
- 玩家右键菜单中的“查找坐骑”：显示其坐骑及获取方法。
- 在目标提示中显示坐骑名称和解锁状态。
- 坐骑数据库，支持搜索、按资料片筛选和查看获取方式。
- 追踪讨伐歼灭战坐骑及对应图腾数量，统计背包、陆行鸟鞍囊和雇员中的数量。
- 聊天链接：点击坐骑或图腾图标即可在聊天中发送链接；通过“在 WhichMount 中打开”可从链接返回插件。

Punchline.Original: Quickly check the patch an item was released in!
Punchline.Translated: 快速查看物品是在哪个版本加入的！

Description.Original:
Whenever you mouseover an item, the tooltip will show you the patch the item was released in.
Never carry around old useless crafting materials again!
Description.Translated:
鼠标悬停在物品上时，提示信息会显示该物品最初加入的版本。
再也不用随身带着过时无用的制作材料！

Punchline.Original: Ever forget who you are? We can fix that!
Punchline.Translated: 忘了自己是谁？交给我们！

Description.Original: Shows who you are in the server info bar.
Description.Translated: 在服务器信息栏显示你的角色身份。

Punchline.Original: Actively logs healing, cleanses, buffs, and more. Finally figure out who rescued you.
Punchline.Translated: 实时记录治疗、驱散、增益等行为，终于能知道是谁把你救援过去了。

Description.Original:
This plugin can track the following actions:
- Rescues
- Healing actions
- Status/Buff Application
- Cleanses 
- Heals
- Mitigation
- Provoke
- Shirk

These will be logged in your chat when they are used on your character.
Description.Translated:
本插件可追踪以下行为：
- 救援
- 治疗技能
- 状态／增益施加
- 驱散
- 治疗效果
- 减伤
- 挑衅
- 退避

这些行为作用于你的角色时，会记录到聊天中。

Punchline.Original: Show nearby players in a stylish way, inspired by the "/who" command from World of Warcraft.
Punchline.Translated: 以美观的方式显示附近玩家，灵感来自《魔兽世界》的“/who”命令。

Description.Original:
Show nearby players in a stylish way, inspired by the "/who" command from World of Warcraft

Features:
- Minimalistic interface that can be scaled down to become part of your HUD.
- Player context menu items for examining, searching on the Lodestone and more.
- Customizable colours & behaviour.
- Random adventure plate command
- Display nearby player count in the server info bar

Please note this plugin will automatically disable functionality in PvP.
Description.Translated:
以美观的方式显示附近玩家，灵感来自《魔兽世界》的“/who”命令。

功能：
- 极简界面，可缩小后融入 HUD。
- 玩家右键菜单，支持查看装备、在 Lodestone 搜索等操作。
- 可自定义颜色与行为。
- 随机查看冒险者铭牌的命令。
- 在服务器信息栏显示附近玩家数量。

请注意，本插件会在 PvP 中自动禁用功能。

Punchline.Original: See Discord voice activity indicators directly on your party list.
Punchline.Translated: 直接在小队列表中查看 Discord 语音状态。

Description.Original:
Once installed, join a Discord voice channel and an XIV party, and have people put their character names in their Discord nicknames (or configure things manually in the plugin settings). You should get colourful outlines around the job icons on the party list: green for talking, blue for muted, red for deafened, and yellow for unknown name.

Note that you'll get a permission prompt mentioning "StreamKit Overlay" – this is expected.

Some icons by Google, Apache 2.0.
Description.Translated:
安装后，加入 Discord 语音频道和 FFXIV 小队，让成员在 Discord 昵称中填写游戏角色名，或在插件设置中手动配置。小队列表的职业图标周围便会出现彩色边框：绿色表示正在说话，蓝色表示麦克风静音，红色表示耳机静音，黄色表示无法识别姓名。

请注意，你会看到提及“StreamKit Overlay”的授权提示，这是正常现象。

部分图标由 Google 提供，使用 Apache 2.0 许可证。

Punchline.Original: FFXIV Wiki and Eorzea DB context menu integration
Punchline.Translated: 在右键菜单中整合 FFXIV Wiki 与官方艾欧泽亚数据库。

Description.Original: Never forget how to get an item again! Just right-click, and *gobbie-BOOM!* Integrates with any community wiki as well as the official Eorzea DB.
Description.Translated: 再也不会忘记物品的获取方法！右键一点，哥布林式“轰隆”一下就查到了！支持任意社区 Wiki 和官方艾欧泽亚数据库。

Punchline.Original: Change your game window titie
Punchline.Translated: 修改游戏窗口标题。

Description.Original: Allows you to change your game window title
Description.Translated: 允许你修改游戏窗口标题。

Punchline.Original: A roleplay thesaurus and scratch pad.
Punchline.Translated: 面向角色扮演的同义词库与草稿本。

Description.Original: Wordsmith is a text editor with roleplayers in mind. It automatically breaks your text up for easy copy/paste, has advanced features, spellcheck, and even a thesaurus.
Description.Translated: Wordsmith 是为角色扮演玩家设计的文本编辑器。它会自动分割文本，方便复制粘贴，还提供进阶编辑功能、拼写检查，甚至同义词词典。

Punchline.Original: Create custom map markers on the map/minimap! Like <flag> but permanent.
Punchline.Translated: 在地图和小地图上创建自定义标记！就像 <flag>，但能永久保留。

Description.Original:
Allows players to create and manage persistent custom map markers across Eorzea. Whether it's a favorite GPose spot, a venue you want to revisit, or any interesting location, WukLamark lets you drop a map marker that appears seamlessly on both your main map and minimap.

Features:
- Customizable game icons and shapes for map markers (with optional icon tinting).
- Custom map marker icons.
   > To add a custom icon, open the WukLamark window and click on 'Upload a new custom icon'.
- Per-marker icon/shape sizes.
- Organize map markers into groups (with map marker import/export).
- Cross-character sharing configurations.
- Crossworld markers.
- Add personal notes for context.
- Import/export one or multiple map markers with friends.
- Templates for quick map marker creation with predefined properties.

Think of it as dropping a flag on the map but persistent.
Description.Translated:
在艾欧泽亚各处创建和管理持久保存的自定义地图标记。无论是喜欢的集体动作拍照点、想再去一次的店铺，还是任何有趣的地点，WukLamark 都能添加标记，并自然地显示在主地图和小地图上。

功能：
- 使用可自定义的游戏图标和形状作为标记，并可为图标着色。
- 自定义地图标记图标。
   > 添加自定义图标时，打开 WukLamark 窗口，点击“上传新的自定义图标”。
- 单独设置各标记的图标或形状大小。
- 按组整理地图标记，并支持导入和导出。
- 跨角色共享配置。
- 跨服务器标记。
- 添加个人备注，说明标记用途。
- 导入或导出一个或多个标记，与好友分享。
- 使用预设属性模板快速创建地图标记。

可以把它理解为能够持久保存的地图旗标。

Punchline.Original: Use chat away from the game.
Punchline.Translated: 不在游戏前也能聊天。

Description.Original:
XIVChat is a suite of software allowing you to use FFXIV's chat from
different devices. This is the server component required to do so.

For information about clients to use with this server, see the website.
Description.Translated:
XIVChat 是一套让你在不同设备上使用 FFXIV 聊天功能的软件。
本插件是实现该功能所必需的服务端组件。

有关配套客户端的信息，请访问项目网站。

Punchline.Original: PvP, but in PvE!
Punchline.Translated: 在 PvE 中享受 PvP 式的连击按键！

Description.Original: This plugin condenses combos and mutually exclusive abilities onto a single button. /pcombo to open menu
Description.Translated: 将连击和互斥技能合并到一个按钮上。使用 /pcombo 打开菜单。

Punchline.Original: Toggle controller / mouse mode automatically or with commands.
Punchline.Translated: 自动或通过命令切换手柄／鼠标操作模式。

Description.Original: A simple tool to automatically switch between keyboard and controller hud's when pressing WASD or moving the left joystick. You can setup a macro to add the actions to your hotbar.
Description.Translated: 一个简单工具：按下 WASD 或推动左摇杆时，自动切换键盘与手柄 HUD。也可设置宏，将切换操作加入热键栏。

XIVControllerToggle.Author: Callum Carmicheal (with help from Aida Enna)

Punchline.Original: Turn your Elgato Stream Deck into a hotbar!
Punchline.Translated: 把 Elgato Stream Deck 变成热键栏！

Description.Original:
This plugin allows players to use an Elgato Stream Deck as a virtual utility hot bar. Actions are called directly, meaning there is no need to set up awkward keybinds, custom macros, or any other settings.

Note that the XIVDeck Stream Deck plugin must also be installed for this plugin to be useful. You can download the Stream Deck plugin from the linked GitHub repository, under the "Releases" section.

Please report all problems to KazWolfe#2896 in the Dalamud Support server or by opening an Issue on GitHub.
Description.Translated:
将 Elgato Stream Deck 用作虚拟辅助热键栏。操作会被直接调用，无需配置繁琐的快捷键、自定义宏或其他设置。

请注意，必须同时安装 XIVDeck 的 Stream Deck 插件才能使用。可从所链接的 GitHub 仓库“Releases”页面下载。

遇到问题，请在 Dalamud Support 服务器联系 KazWolfe#2896，或在 GitHub 提交 Issue。

Punchline.Original: Takes a screenshot upon death (and other events).
Punchline.Translated: 死亡等事件发生时自动截图。

Description.Original: Takes a screenshot upon death (and other events).
Description.Translated: 死亡等事件发生时自动截图。

Punchline.Original: A simple utility that allows easy export of your gearsets to xivgear.app.
Punchline.Translated: 将套装轻松导出到 xivgear.app 的简单工具。

Description.Original:
A plugin that allows easy export of your gearsets to xivgear.app in edit or view mode. Also includes the ability to export your gearsets from the gearset list.

Use /xivgearexport or /xge to export your current gear set.
Description.Translated:
轻松将套装导出到 xivgear.app，并以编辑或查看模式打开。还支持从套装列表直接导出。

使用 /xivgearexport 或 /xge 导出当前套装。

Punchline.Original: Save chat logs to your computer as text files or copy them!
Punchline.Translated: 将聊天日志保存为电脑上的文本文件，或直接复制！

Description.Original: Save chat logs as text files from when this is loaded. /xivlogger for settings, /savelog to save logs, /copylogs to copy logs.
Description.Translated: 将插件加载后的聊天日志保存为文本文件。/xivlogger 打开设置，/savelog 保存日志，/copylogs 复制日志。

Punchline.Original: Integrates NVIDIA Reflex Low Latency to reduce System Latency.
Punchline.Translated: 整合 NVIDIA Reflex 低延迟技术，降低系统延迟。

Description.Original:
NVIDIA Reflex Low Latency reduces system input lag by dynamically aligning the game's engine updates closer to the moment your GPU actually draws the frame on screen.

Requirements:

- NVIDIA GeForce 900 Series or newer
- NVIDIA Driver version 456.38 or newer
Description.Translated:
NVIDIA Reflex 低延迟技术会动态调整游戏引擎更新时机，使其更接近 GPU 实际在屏幕上绘制画面的时刻，从而降低系统输入延迟。

要求：

- NVIDIA GeForce 900 系列或更新的显卡
- NVIDIA 驱动版本 456.38 或更新版本

Punchline.Original: Splits combos into more button for more button bloating. Requires BLU spells.
Punchline.Translated: 把连击拆成更多按键，让按键更加膨胀。需要青魔法技能。

Description.Original: This plugin splits combos and mutually exclusive abilities onto several buttons. For example, a 1-1-1 combo would become 1-2-3.
Description.Translated: 将连击和互斥能力拆分到多个按键上。例如，把 1-1-1 连击变成 1-2-3。

Punchline.Original: Game window resizing plugin. Ever wanted to take 8K screenshots on 144p screen? Now you can.
Punchline.Translated: 调整游戏窗口大小的插件。想在 144p 屏幕上拍摄 8K 截图？现在可以了。

Description.Original:
Set your game window to arbitrary size not limited by your display resolution. Mostly useful for taking high-resolution screenshots without going fullscreen and using DSR/FSR.
Requires borderless or windowed mode.
Description.Translated:
将游戏窗口设为任意大小，不受显示器分辨率限制。主要用于无需切换全屏或使用 DSR／FSR 即可拍摄高分辨率截图。
需要使用无边框窗口或窗口模式。

Punchline.Original: Tracking assistant for Yo-kai Watch rewards
Punchline.Translated: 《妖怪手表》联动奖励追踪助手。

Description.Original: Yo-kai Check is a small plugin to assist you in tracking the rewards of the Yo-kai Watch event.
Description.Translated: Yo-kai Check 是帮助你追踪《妖怪手表》联动活动奖励的小插件。

Punchline.Original: ZeeDees, bring the Zs to your Ds!
Punchline.Translated: ZeeDees，给你的 Ds 加点 Z！

Description.Original: Show when cooldowns come off cooldown in an intuitive way!
Description.Translated: 直观地提示技能何时冷却完毕！

Punchline.Original: Complete your Zodiac relic with style.
Punchline.Translated: 漂亮地完成你的黄道武器。

Description.Original: This plugin attempts to help you complete your Zodiac weapon in various ways.
Description.Translated: 通过多种方式帮助你完成黄道武器。

Punchline.Original: A game to play when dead. A 2048 clone mini-game.
Punchline.Translated: 倒地时玩的小游戏：2048 仿制版。

Description.Original: Opens on death, or /a48. A 2048 clone mini-game. arrow keys or wasd
Description.Translated: 倒地时自动打开，也可使用 /a48 打开。2048 仿制小游戏，使用方向键或 WASD 操作。

Punchline.Original: Never think too hard about your bags again!
Punchline.Translated: 再也不用为背包操心！

Description.Original: This plugin replaces your inventory with it's own categorified inventory addon.
Description.Translated: 用插件自带的分类背包界面替换原生背包。

Punchline.Original: Listen to radio in Eorzea!
Punchline.Translated: 在艾欧泽亚收听电台！

Description.Original:
In-game radio streaming for Final Fantasy XIV. Enter a stream URL and listen to your favorite radio! Features external plugin integration for Umbra widgets and other plugins via reflection.

Note: AetherFM is only supported on Windows. Due to its reliance on the NAudio library, audio playback is not available on Linux or non-Windows versions of Dalamud.
Description.Translated:
在《最终幻想14》内播放网络电台。输入音频流 URL，即可收听喜爱的电台！支持通过反射与 Umbra 小组件及其他外部插件集成。

注意：AetherFM 仅支持 Windows。由于依赖 NAudio 库，Linux 或其他非 Windows 版 Dalamud 无法播放音频。

Punchline.Original: A game to play when dead. A super hexagon clone mini-game.
Punchline.Translated: 倒地时玩的小游戏：Super Hexagon 仿制版。

Description.Original: Opens on death, or /agon. A super hexagon clone mini-game.A/D or left right arrow
Description.Translated: 倒地时自动打开，也可使用 /agon 打开。Super Hexagon 仿制小游戏，使用 A/D 或左右方向键操作。

Punchline.Original: Client for the Archipelago Multiworld Randomizer.
Punchline.Translated: Archipelago 多世界随机化器客户端。

Description.Original: Key Item Randomizer for FFIXV
Description.Translated: 用于 FFXIV 的关键道具随机化器。

Punchline.Original: Find what to clean up across your dresser, bags and retainers using the 7.5 Armoire.
Punchline.Translated: 利用 7.5 版本的收藏柜，找出投影台、背包和雇员中可以清理的物品。

Description.Original: Scans the Glamour Dresser for items that can now be stored in the Armoire (per patch 7.5), finds partial and complete sets, and spots duplicates across the dresser, armoire, bags, armoury, saddlebag and retainers. Everything it finds gets highlighted right in the game's inventory windows, one color per intent, so you can see what to grab without hunting.
Description.Translated: 扫描投影台，找出在 7.5 版本中已可存入收藏柜的物品，识别不完整与完整的套装，并检查投影台、收藏柜、背包、兵装库、陆行鸟鞍囊和雇员中的重复物品。找到的物品会直接在游戏物品窗口中高亮显示，不同处理用途对应不同颜色，让你一眼知道该取出什么，无需四处翻找。

Punchline.Original: The realm, now with more realm in it
Punchline.Translated: 让这个世界更有世界的样子。

Description.Original: This plugin aims to give players the ability to add more flavor npcs to the common areas of the game.
Description.Translated: 让玩家可以在游戏公共区域添加更多烘托氛围的 NPC。

Punchline.Original: Provides an easy copy and pastable CSV format you can use for island sanctuary spreadsheets.
Punchline.Translated: 以方便复制粘贴的 CSV 格式导出开拓无人岛数据，供电子表格使用。

Description.Original: Provides an easy copy and pastable CSV format you can use for island sanctuary spreadsheets. Provides options to export the popularity, future popularity and the current cycle's demand and shift values. Both as words and as numbers on a scale of -2 to 2. This plugin does not provide any calculations for Island Sanctuary, merely an export option for your ingame data.
Description.Translated: 以方便复制粘贴的 CSV 格式导出开拓无人岛数据，供电子表格使用。可选择导出人气、预计人气以及当前周期的供需情况和需求变化，支持文字表示，也支持 -2 到 2 的数值表示。本插件不进行无人岛生产计算，仅提供游戏内数据导出功能。

Punchline.Original: Easily get general and role-specific hints in duties.
Punchline.Translated: 在副本中轻松获取通用提示及对应职能的建议。

Description.Original: No more frantic googling in duties. Use to get general and role-specific duty hints straight in the chat window.
Description.Translated: 不用再在副本中手忙脚乱地搜索攻略，直接在聊天窗口获取通用提示及对应职能的副本建议。

Punchline.Original: Guess the tune from FFXIV's orchestrion library
Punchline.Translated: 从 FFXIV 管弦乐琴曲库中猜出曲名。

Description.Original:
A music guessing game built on the game's own orchestrion library. Each round plays a split second of a random track: name it for six points, or stretch the clip until you know the tune.

ゲーム内のオーケストリオン譜のライブラリーを使った曲当てゲームです。各ラウンドではランダムな曲がほんの一瞬だけ流れます。曲名を当てれば6ポイント、分からなければ曲が分かるまで再生時間を延ばせます。

Ein Musikratespiel auf Basis der spieleigenen Orchestrion-Bibliothek. In jeder Runde erklingt nur ein Sekundenbruchteil eines zufälligen Stücks: Nenne es für sechs Punkte oder verlängere den Ausschnitt, bis du die Melodie erkennst.

Un jeu de devinettes musicales fondé sur la bibliothèque d'orchestrion du jeu. Chaque manche ne joue qu'une fraction de seconde d'un morceau au hasard : nommez-le pour six points, ou allongez l'extrait jusqu'à reconnaître la mélodie.
Description.Translated: 使用游戏自带管弦乐琴曲库的猜歌游戏。每轮随机播放一首曲子极短的片段，猜出曲名即可获得 6 分；如果猜不出，可以延长片段，直到听出旋律。

Punchline.Original: Determines the most profitable agenda for your Island Sanctuary workshop each cycle
Punchline.Translated: 计算开拓无人岛工坊每个周期收益最高的生产计划。

Description.Original:
This solver examines your Island Sanctuary data (including your Isleventory!) to provide recommendations to maximize your Seafarer's Cowrie earnings.

Made in collaboration with the Overseas Casuals.
Description.Translated:
分析你的开拓无人岛数据，包括无人岛背包库存，提供建议以最大化海岛蓝船币收益。

与 Overseas Casuals 合作开发。

Punchline.Original: Play blackjack in FFXIV!
Punchline.Translated: 在 FFXIV 中玩二十一点！

Description.Original:
A plugin to play blackjack just like in a real casino.
Enjoy an authentic casino experience directly in Final Fantasy XIV.
Description.Translated:
像在真实赌场一样玩二十一点的插件。
直接在《最终幻想14》中体验原汁原味的赌场玩法。

Punchline.Original: Recolors emote lines in chat.
Punchline.Translated: 为聊天中的情感动作消息重新着色。

Description.Original: A simple plugin that recolors emote chat lines depending on who is executing the emote and their target.
Description.Translated: 根据情感动作的执行者和目标，为对应聊天消息设置颜色的简单插件。

Punchline.Original:
No more cringe during hunt trains.
Temporarily filters away Shouts and Yells that don't contain a flag or an instance message.
Punchline.Translated:
狩猎车上不再被无关发言刷屏。
临时过滤不含地图旗标或副本分区信息的喊话与呼喊。

Description.Original: Clean Hunt Chat
Description.Review: 原文已更新，译文还停在旧版

Punchline.Original: Currency alerts and convenient teleports.
Punchline.Translated: 货币提醒与便捷传送。

Description.Original: Currency alerts and convenient teleports.
Description.Translated: 货币提醒与便捷传送。

Punchline.Original: Hey guys, Famous YouTuber here. Do you ever get Collector's Anxiety?
Punchline.Translated: 大家好，知名 YouTuber 又来了。你是否也有“收藏焦虑”？

Description.Original: Collector's Anxiety helps completionists or players with a hobby for collecting in-game things keep track of what they do or don't have in an easy-to-use checklist format. Data is loaded live from the game, so collection statuses are updated in real-time.
Description.Translated: Collector's Anxiety 使用简单易用的核对清单，帮助全收集爱好者与游戏收藏玩家记录已拥有和尚未拥有的内容。数据直接从游戏实时读取，收藏状态会即时更新。

Punchline.Original: RuneLite inspired drop-tracker
Punchline.Translated: 受 RuneLite 启发的掉落记录工具。

Description.Original: Tracks the contents and market value of items dropped while killing monsters. And drops from some other activities such as dungeons, raids, gathering, and maps.
Description.Translated: 记录击杀怪物时掉落的物品及其市场价值，也记录迷宫、团队任务、采集和寻宝等活动的收获。

Punchline.Original: Tweaks and options based on the charactor's state.
Punchline.Translated: 根据角色状态应用调整和设置。

Description.Original: Changes game settings based on character state.
Description.Translated: 根据角色状态更改游戏设置。

Punchline.Original: A simple plugin that displays how much progress and quality is remaining for your craft.
Punchline.Translated: 显示当前制作还差多少进展和品质的简单插件。

Description.Original: A simple plugin that displays how much progress and quality is remaining for your craft, without having to do the maths! Great to use in conjunction with Calculations or SimpleTweaks Improved Crafter Tooltips.
Description.Translated: 显示当前制作还差多少进展和品质，无需自己计算！适合搭配 Calculations，或 SimpleTweaks 的强化制作技能提示功能使用。

Punchline.Original: Speak to your Japanese friend!
Punchline.Translated: 和你的日本朋友聊起来！

Description.Original: Translate tools that allow you to communicate with foreign friend that you doesn't know what they're saying.
Description.Translated: 帮助你跨越语言障碍，与外国朋友沟通的翻译工具。

Punchline.Original: kugane striking dummy my beloved
Punchline.Translated: 黄金港木人，我的小宝贝。

Description.Original: a scene-manipulation plugin to reinstate my favorite little guy. adds an untargetable, no-collision dummy at the Kugane Aetheryte
Description.Translated: 通过场景修改，把我最喜欢的小家伙带回来：在黄金港以太之光旁添加一个不可选中、无碰撞的木人。

Punchline.Original: Add and control an unlimited number of custom additional hotbars.
Punchline.Translated: 添加和控制不限数量的额外自定义热键栏。

Description.Original: Create hotbars of any size, spacing, and keybinds, with functions to show and hide these bars dynamically.
Description.Translated: 创建任意大小、间距和快捷键设置的热键栏，并支持动态显示和隐藏。

Punchline.Original: For when you want to spend time fighting the boss, not fiddling with waymarks.
Punchline.Translated: 把时间花在打首领上，而不是摆场地标记上。

Description.Original: Fast waymarks with settings for common configurations. Rotate and resize with a handy preview window.
Description.Translated: 快速放置场地标记，提供常用布局设置，并可通过便捷的预览窗口旋转和缩放布局。

Punchline.Original: Browse FFXIV roleplay venues in-game with rich filters and schedules.
Punchline.Translated: 在游戏内浏览 FFXIV 角色扮演场所，提供丰富的筛选条件和营业时间。

Description.Original: Discover open FFXIV venues by region, data center, world, tags, and schedule. View detailed venue cards with addresses, banners, and external links directly in-game.
Description.Translated: 按地区、数据中心、服务器、标签和营业时间寻找营业中的 FFXIV 场所。直接在游戏内查看详细场所卡片，包括地址、横幅和外部链接。

Punchline.Original: Flash the game in taskbar when a cutscene ends and the game is unfocused.
Punchline.Translated: 过场动画结束且游戏不在前台时，闪烁任务栏中的游戏图标。

Description.Original: Flash the game in taskbar when a cutscene ends and the game is unfocused.
Description.Translated: 过场动画结束且游戏不在前台时，闪烁任务栏中的游戏图标。

Punchline.Original: Let's go gambling!
Punchline.Translated: 来赌一把！

Description.Original:
A simple plugin for casino dealers to easily manage all their player's bets and 
quickly getting the payout of each round to keep the gambing going.
Description.Translated: 帮助赌场荷官轻松管理所有玩家的下注，并快速计算每轮赔付，让赌局顺畅继续的简单插件。

Punchline.Original: Enhance and customize job gauges.
Punchline.Translated: 增强并自定义职业量谱。

Description.Original: Gauge-O-Matic allows you to customize your job gauges by adding extra counters, bars, and indicators in a variety of styles
Description.Translated: Gauge-O-Matic 可为职业量谱添加多种风格的额外计数器、进度条和指示器，打造自定义量谱。

Punchline.Original: Create vibration patterns for the controller and specify triggers to make it vibrate.
Punchline.Translated: 创建手柄振动模式，并指定触发振动的条件。

Description.Original:
Allows one to create vibration patterns for the controller and specify triggers for them.

You need to configure patterns and triggers before it will work.
Currently supported triggers are:
- Cooldowns
- Near Aether Current
Description.Translated:
创建手柄振动模式，并为其指定触发条件。

必须先设置振动模式和触发条件，功能才会生效。
当前支持的触发条件：
- 技能冷却
- 接近风脉泉

Punchline.Original: Tracks gil gained and spent during the session.
Punchline.Translated: 记录本次游戏期间获得和花费的吉尔。

Description.Original: Counts how much gil you gain or lose while playing.
Description.Translated: 统计游玩期间吉尔的收入与支出。

Punchline.Original: What it says on the tin.
Punchline.Translated: 功能就和名字说的一样。

Description.Original:
No settings needed, just add and forget.

Love linking plates to gearsets but hate all the chat spam when you swap? Here's your solution.
Description.Translated:
无需设置，装上就不用管了。

喜欢把投影模板关联到套装，却讨厌每次切换时聊天栏刷屏？这就是你要的解决办法。

Punchline.Original: Create wish lists of items you want to glamour
Punchline.Translated: 为想用于幻化的物品建立愿望清单。

Description.Original: Create and manage lists of items that you want to save for glamouring later. Right-click context menus on items can be used to quickly add an item to a list.
Description.Translated: 创建和管理想留作日后幻化的物品清单。通过物品右键菜单即可快速加入清单。

Punchline.Original: Open web pages, wikis, and Lodestone articles in your browser directly from your chat bar.
Punchline.Translated: 直接通过游戏聊天输入栏，在浏览器中打开网页、Wiki 和 Lodestone 文章。

Description.Original:
Inspired by the /wiki command from Guild Wars 2, Gubal lets you open web pages in your browser straight from the in-game chat bar. Named after the Great Gubal Library, just type a slash command followed by what you're looking for to jump directly to specific guides, item pages, and articles in your default browser.
            
            Commands and Examples:
            
            /wiki [query] - Search the FFXIV Console Games Wiki (opens in browser):
            - /wiki great gubal library (opens The Great Gubal Library dungeon guide)
            - /wiki sightseeing log (opens the Sightseeing Log guide)
            - /wiki relic weapons (opens the Relic Weapon progression guide)
            - /wiki blue mage spells (opens the Blue Mage spell list)
            
            /lodestone [query] - Search the official Lodestone (opens in browser):
            - /lodestone patch 7.56 (opens the Patch 7.56 notes directly)
            - /lodestone maintenance (opens latest server maintenance notices)
            - /lodestone eorzea database excalibur (opens official item details)
            - /lodestone community finder (opens the Community Finder)
            
            /gubal - Open the configuration window to add, edit, or customize search commands with the {text} placeholder.
Description.Translated:
Gubal 的灵感来自《激战2》的 /wiki 命令，让你直接通过游戏聊天输入栏在浏览器中打开网页。名称取自迦巴勒幻想图书馆：输入斜杠命令和搜索内容，即可在默认浏览器中直达攻略、物品页面和文章。

命令与示例：

/wiki [query] - 搜索 FFXIV Console Games Wiki（在浏览器中打开）：
- /wiki great gubal library（打开迦巴勒幻想图书馆副本攻略）
- /wiki sightseeing log（打开探索笔记指南）
- /wiki relic weapons（打开上古武器制作流程指南）
- /wiki blue mage spells（打开青魔法师技能列表）

/lodestone [query] - 搜索官方 Lodestone（在浏览器中打开）：
- /lodestone patch 7.56（直接打开 7.56 版本更新说明）
- /lodestone maintenance（打开最新服务器维护公告）
- /lodestone eorzea database excalibur（打开该物品的官方详情）
- /lodestone community finder（打开社群招募功能）

/gubal - 打开设置窗口，使用 {text} 占位符添加、编辑或自定义搜索命令。

Punchline.Original: Keeps your hotbars up to date
Punchline.Translated: 让热键栏始终保持最新。

Description.Original: Helps keep hotbars in sync with available actions. Particularly useful if you've lost your configuration, or transfer between platforms regularly.
Description.Translated: 帮助热键栏与当前可用技能保持同步，尤其适合配置丢失或经常切换游玩平台的情况。

Punchline.Original: Total control over where to put your hotbar slots.
Punchline.Translated: 完全自由地安排热键栏各格的位置。

Description.Original: Allows you to move each individual hotbar slot to wherever you want, however you want.
Description.Translated: 按你喜欢的方式，将热键栏中的每个格子单独移动到任意位置。

Punchline.Original: Automatic house bidding reminders!
Punchline.Translated: 自动提醒房屋抽签结果！

Description.Original: A Dalamud plugin for FFXIV that reminds the player when the results are in for the house they bid on
Description.Translated: 你参与抽签的房屋公布结果时，提醒你的 FFXIV Dalamud 插件。

Punchline.Original: Adds QoL features to the native HUD layout editor: Undo, Redo, Copy, Paste and alignment lines.
Punchline.Translated: 为原生 HUD 布局编辑器添加撤销、重做、复制、粘贴和对齐参考线等便利功能。

Description.Original:
Allows you to use keyboard shortcuts in the HUD Layout Editor, like Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V to copy and paste the position of individual HUD elements, and Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y to undo and redo changes. 

Can also display an overlay showing alignment to other elements with Ctrl+R.
Description.Translated:
在 HUD 布局编辑器中使用快捷键，例如用 Ctrl+C 和 Ctrl+V 复制、粘贴单个 HUD 元素的位置，用 Ctrl+Z 和 Ctrl+Y 撤销、重做修改。

还可使用 Ctrl+R 显示与其他元素对齐的辅助叠加层。

Punchline.Original: Works perfectly out of the box! Use /ii to configure.
Punchline.Translated: 开箱即用！使用 /ii 进行设置。

Description.Original: Display custom icons for items for easier inventory mangement.
Description.Translated: 为物品显示自定义图标，让背包管理更轻松。

Punchline.Original: If it's not 'big fat tacos', what ARE they singing?
Punchline.Translated: 如果唱的不是“又大又肥的塔可饼”，那他们到底在唱什么？

Description.Original: Shows the lyrics of what's currently playing, synced to the track time
Description.Translated: 显示当前播放曲目的歌词，并与播放进度同步。

Punchline.Original: A almost complete replacement of XIV's keybind system.
Punchline.Translated: 几乎完全替代 FFXIV 按键绑定系统。

Description.Original:
KeybindsPlus is a plugin that allows you to bind *almost* any key on your keyboard and mouse to XIV actions, custom macros/commands, and supported Dalamud plugins. Bind any key, including those not normally supported by the game (F13-F24) to *almost* anything as if it were an actual registered keybind!

Supported Keybinds:
- Custom Macros and Commands
- Supported Plugins
- Targeting*
- Shortcuts
- Chat*
- Hotbars

> * - Some features may be grayed out due to complexities or unavailability. Not all base game keybinds are in KeybindsPlus but may appear as updates progress.

(Thanks Miyabi)
Description.Translated:
KeybindsPlus 允许你将键盘和鼠标上几乎任意按键绑定到 FFXIV 操作、自定义宏或命令，以及受支持的 Dalamud 插件。包括游戏通常不支持的 F13–F24 在内，几乎任何键都能绑定到几乎任何操作，使用体验就像游戏原生快捷键！

支持的绑定类型：
- 自定义宏与命令
- 受支持的插件
- 选定目标*
- 快捷操作
- 聊天*
- 热键栏

> * 部分功能因实现复杂或当前不可用而呈灰色。KeybindsPlus 尚未覆盖全部原生按键绑定，但可能在后续更新中补充。

感谢 Miyabi。

Punchline.Original: The ultimate guidebook for in-game duties, great for sprouts & doing your daily roulettes!
Punchline.Translated: 游戏内副本全能指南，适合新人和每日随机任务！

Description.Original:
Comprehensive guides for duty content such as Dungeons, Trials and Alliance Raids.

Key features:
- Automatically open a guide when entering a duty
- Neat user interface that scales well at small sizes
- A short-text mode for easier reading & accessibility
- Anti-spoiler protections by default
- Built-in guide editor
- Integrations with your favourite plugins
& more to come!
Description.Translated:
为迷宫、讨伐歼灭战和大型团队任务等内容提供详尽攻略。

主要功能：
- 进入副本时自动打开对应攻略
- 整洁的界面，缩小后仍易于使用
- 简短文本模式，提升可读性与无障碍体验
- 默认开启防剧透保护
- 内置攻略编辑器
- 与常用插件集成
还有更多功能计划加入！

Punchline.Original: When level sync'd, make skills you don't have access to more transparent
Punchline.Translated: 等级同步时，提高当前无法使用的技能图标的透明度。

Punchline.Original: Get notified when a Limit Break is available
Punchline.Translated: 极限技可用时收到提醒。

Description.Original: When a Limit Break becomes available, shows a visual notification.
Description.Translated: 极限技变为可用时，显示醒目的通知。

Punchline.Original: A little less green.
Punchline.Translated: 少一点泛绿。

Description.Original: Tweak the game's colours, use GPose filters anywhere, and add optional depth of field or vignette.
Description.Translated: 调整游戏色彩，在任意场景使用集体动作滤镜，并可添加景深或暗角效果。

Punchline.Original: Keep track of all the current loot rolls
Punchline.Translated: 追踪当前所有战利品的掷点情况。

Description.Original: Ever wanted to see how who has already rolled on any loot you may want? Now you can!
Description.Translated: 想知道你想要的战利品已经有哪些人掷点了吗？现在可以了！

Punchline.Original: Don't miss any Maiden spawn anymore!
Punchline.Translated: 再也不会错过 Maiden 刷新！

Description.Original: Maidens will now emit audible notification, chat message and on-screen tracker!
Description.Translated: Maiden 出现时，提供声音提醒、聊天消息和屏幕追踪提示！

Punchline.Original: A Plugin to track gil earned from FATEs or Treasure Maps!
Punchline.Translated: 记录临危受命和寻宝所得吉尔的插件！

Description.Original:
This plugin aims to simplify gil tracking for FCs who use FATEs/Maps as fundraising events!
Simply install it, enable it, and it'll automatically track every chest or sack opened and calculate how much gil each person owes.
Description.Translated:
为通过临危受命或寻宝活动筹款的部队简化吉尔统计。
安装并启用后，自动记录每次打开的宝箱或钱袋，并计算每位成员应缴纳的吉尔。

Punchline.Original: Uploads market data to market.xivhub.org and other configurable aggregators.
Punchline.Translated: 将市场数据上传至 market.xivhub.org 及其他可配置的数据汇总站点。

Description.Original: Uploads market data to market.xivhub.org and other configurable aggregators.
Description.Translated: 将市场数据上传至 market.xivhub.org 及其他可配置的数据汇总站点。

Punchline.Original: Simple Waymark Management with Renaming Features
Punchline.Translated: 简单的场地标记管理工具，支持重命名。

Description.Original:
Ever forget which waymark slot holds your pre-fight positions? Which waymarks are for pugs and not your static?
Worry not! MemoryMarker has your back!

Loads and Saves waymarks when changing zones. Allows you to rename presets in the waymark window.
Description.Translated:
忘了开打前的站位存在哪个标记预设里？分不清哪些是野队标记、哪些是固定队标记？
别担心，MemoryMarker 来帮你！

切换区域时加载和保存场地标记，并允许在场地标记窗口中重命名预设。

Punchline.Original: Adds Moonbase Alpha TTS when in Cosmic Exploration. aeiou!
Punchline.Translated: 在宇宙探索中加入 Moonbase Alpha 风格的文字转语音。aeiou！

Description.Original: Plays chat messages sent in Cosmic Exploration via DECtalk (the TTS used in Moonbase Alpha).
Description.Translated: 使用 DECtalk（Moonbase Alpha 所用的文字转语音引擎）朗读宇宙探索中的聊天消息。

Punchline.Original: Bind one or multiple keys to one or multiple mounts!
Punchline.Translated: 将一个或多个按键绑定到一个或多个坐骑！

Description.Original: Use a keyboard key to call your mounts. This way, you don't waste precious hotbar slots!
Description.Translated: 直接使用键盘按键召唤坐骑，不占用宝贵的热键栏格子！

Punchline.Original: Plugin for track collected mounts
Punchline.Translated: 追踪坐骑收藏的插件。

Description.Original: A plugin allows you to track received mounts by character.
Description.Translated: 按角色追踪已经获得的坐骑。

Name.Translated: 坐骑电台/坐骑音乐播放器

Punchline.Original: URL music player for your mounts! Stream internet radio when on a mount or on foot.
Punchline.Translated: 坐骑专用的 URL 音乐播放器！骑乘或步行时都能收听网络电台。

Description.Original: /radiosettings, /radiotoggle, /radiovolume, /radioautostart, /radioautostop
Description.Review: 原文已更新，译文还停在旧版

Punchline.Original: Shows a tooltip with a little information for characters that the mouse is over.
Punchline.Translated: 鼠标指向角色时，显示包含简要信息的提示框。

Description.Original: A plugin that shows a tooltip for mouseover targets.
Description.Translated: 为鼠标指向的目标显示提示信息。

Punchline.Original: OverlayPlugin for Dalamud with built in HUD replacement
Punchline.Translated: 适用于 Dalamud 的 OverlayPlugin，内置 HUD 替代界面。

Description.Original: OverlayPlugin replacement for Dalamud, works similarly to BrowserHost with addition to having more options and built in websocket server.
Description.Translated: 适用于 Dalamud 的 OverlayPlugin 替代方案，工作方式类似 BrowserHost，但提供更多选项并内置 WebSocket 服务器。

Punchline.Original: Plugin to disable moving forward with LMB+RMB
Punchline.Translated: 禁用同时按住鼠标左键和右键前进的功能。

Description.Original: A plugin to disable moving forward using LMB+RMB, with separate toggles for walking and flying.
Description.Translated: 禁用通过 LMB+RMB 前进，可分别设置步行和飞行时是否禁用。

Punchline.Original: Mobile push notifications for the Party Finder. Alternative to PushyFinder without need for paid app or any hastle
Punchline.Translated: 队员招募手机推送通知。PushyFinder 的替代方案，无需付费应用或繁琐操作。

Description.Original: A plugin that uses Ntfy (https://ntfy.sh/) to send mobile push notifications when party members join or leave, or when a duty finder queue is initiated. Forked from PushyFinder.
Description.Translated: 当队员加入或离开，或开始任务搜索器排队时，使用 Ntfy（https://ntfy.sh/）发送手机推送通知。由 PushyFinder 分支开发。

Punchline.Original: Wake up baby, It's touch grass time
Punchline.Translated: 醒醒，宝贝，该出门呼吸新鲜空气了。

Description.Original: Automatically notifies about FATE, CE or Aurora Mirage in Occult Crescent related content.
Description.Translated: 自动通知新月岛相关内容中的危命任务（FATE）、临界遭遇战（CE）或蜃景（Aurora Mirage）。

Punchline.Original: Suggests bait for ocean fishing.
Punchline.Translated: 推荐出海垂钓所用鱼饵。

Description.Original:
Automatically recommends bait to use based on your ocean fishing route. 
You'll get suggestions for spectral fish, fisher's intuition buff, and missions.
Description.Translated:
根据出海垂钓航线自动推荐鱼饵。
提供幻海触发鱼、捕鱼人之识状态和垂钓任务相关建议。

Punchline.Original: oGCD helper
Punchline.Translated: 非公共冷却技能助手。

Description.Original:
OGCD assistant providing Text To Speech, (Custom) Sound Effects and unlimited extra bars to visualize and alert you for your OGCDs.

This is an early version and things might still break.
Description.Translated:
非公共冷却技能（oGCD）助手，提供文字转语音、自定义音效，以及不限数量的额外提示条，直观展示并提醒 oGCD 技能状态。

目前为早期版本，仍可能出现故障。

Punchline.Original: My Final Fantasy XIV says paggles right next to the time, what does this mean?
Punchline.Translated: 我的《最终幻想14》时间旁边写着 paggles，这是什么意思？

Description.Original: Changes the time in the Server Bar to use the system locale for AM/PM designation.
Description.Translated: 让服务器信息栏中的时间使用系统区域设置对应的上午／下午标识。

Punchline.Original: Parses Buffs to help understand what your party is doing.
Punchline.Translated: 分析增益状态，帮助了解队友正在做什么。

Description.Original: Adds Text and Icons next to the party list describing active buffs. Still missing some jobs - See github for progress. Please note the overlay goes to the left of your party list.
Description.Translated: 在小队列表旁添加文字和图标，说明当前生效的增益。部分职业尚未支持，进度请见 GitHub。请注意，叠加界面显示在小队列表左侧。

Punchline.Original: Customize the layout of the party list.
Punchline.Translated: 自定义小队列表布局。

Description.Original: Customize the layout of the party list.
Description.Translated: 自定义小队列表布局。

Punchline.Original: Never worry about sorting your party again!
Punchline.Translated: 再也不用为小队排序烦恼！

Description.Original: Sort your party list according to a series of rules built on top of the game's default system. Allowing you to specify based off Duty Instances and Jobs!
Description.Translated: 在游戏默认排序系统的基础上，通过一系列规则排列小队列表，可按副本与职业分别指定排序方式。

Punchline.Original: Visualizer for nearby model paths. Adds +5 to perception.
Punchline.Translated: 可视化查看附近模型的资源路径，让你的洞察力 +5。

Description.Original: A tool for visually locating any model path in the game world.
Description.Translated: 在游戏世界中直观定位任意模型资源路径的工具。

Punchline.Original: Find party finder groups easier.
Punchline.Translated: 更轻松地找到队员招募中的队伍。

Description.Original: A Party Finder plugin
Description.Translated: 队员招募插件。

Punchline.Original: Furniture selection that actually works properly
Punchline.Translated: 让家具选择真正顺手。

Description.Original: An improved housing experience. Furniture selection based on what you see, keybinds to switch modes and toggle counter and snap.
Description.Translated: 改善房屋装修体验：按画面中实际看到的家具进行选择，通过快捷键切换模式，以及开关台面放置和吸附功能。

Punchline.Original: Control what's playing on your computer within XIV!
Punchline.Translated: 在 FFXIV 内控制电脑正在播放的媒体！

Description.Original:
ProxyPlayer is a simple plugin that allows you to control your Windows or Linux* PC's media playback from within XIV.
> * - Linux support is only supported on official XIVLauncher Wine builds and certain Wine/Proton builds with "AF_UNIX" support.

Control your media player from within the game, without having to alt-tab or use a second monitor.
Features (depending on your media player):
- Play/Pause
- Next/Previous Track
- Stop
- Progress Bar
- Cover Art Display
- Metadata

ProxyPlayer comes with either a compact or portrait UI for displaying your media information.
Description.Translated:
ProxyPlayer 是一个简单的插件，允许你在 XIV 内控制你的 Windows 或 Linux* PC 的媒体播放。
> * - Linux 支持仅在官方 XIVLauncher Wine 构建以及某些支持“AF_UNIX”的 Wine/Proton 构建上受支持。

无需切换窗口或使用第二台显示器，即可在游戏内控制你的媒体播放器。
功能（取决于你的媒体播放器）：
- 播放/暂停
- 下一首/上一首
- 停止
- 进度条
- 封面图显示
- 元数据

ProxyPlayer 提供紧凑或竖版 UI 来显示你的媒体信息。

Punchline.Original: Give Mendingway and Vendingway the respect they deserve!
Punchline.Translated: 给 Mendingway 和 Vendingway 应有的尊重！

Description.Original: [English only] A plugin to give various loporrits their correct names.
Description.Translated: 【仅限英语客户端】为各种兔兔族 NPC 换上它们应有名字的插件。

Punchline.Original: Automated OBS recording manager for FFXIV encounters.
Punchline.Translated: 为 FFXIV 战斗自动管理 OBS 录制。

Description.Original: A Dalamud plugin that automatically controls OBS recording during FFXIV encounters. Captures replay buffer before pulls and full encounter recordings via OBS WebSocket v5. Supports quick-save hotkey for on-demand replay buffer clips. Use /pulltoobs or /pto to configure.
Description.Translated: 在 FFXIV 战斗期间自动控制 OBS 录制的 Dalamud 插件。通过 OBS WebSocket v5 保存开怪前的回放缓存和完整战斗录像，支持快捷保存键，随时保存回放缓存片段。使用 /pulltoobs 或 /pto 进行设置。

Punchline.Original: Simmer does the light before every login.
Punchline.Translated: 每次登录前，微光都在低低燃烧。

Description.Original: Displays a random dialogue, and/or the datacenter you'll be connecting to when you press GAME START.
Description.Translated: 按下“开始游戏”时，显示随机台词，以及／或者即将连接的数据中心。

Punchline.Original: Time your jumping puzzles!
Punchline.Translated: 为你的跳跳乐计时！

Description.Original: A simple plugin for timing, logging, and ranking player times for your jumping puzzles!
Description.Translated: 为跳跳乐玩家提供计时、成绩记录和排名的简单插件！

Punchline.Original: Recording activity indicator.
Punchline.Translated: 录制状态指示器。

Description.Original: A Dalamud plugin that monitors a configurable folder for recording file activity and shows an in-game [Rec] indicator when capture is likely active. Use /reccue to configure.
Description.Translated: 监测指定文件夹中的录像文件活动，并在可能正在录制时，在游戏内显示 [Rec] 标识。使用 /reccue 进行设置。

Punchline.Original: Dynamically adjust your object rendering settings.
Punchline.Translated: 动态调整对象渲染设置。

Description.Original: Allows you to dynamically adjust the in-game setting for rendered objects by FPS (and GPU Usage if you're on windows) and allows you to set a custom number of rendered objects manually. Uses GPU usage and FPS on Windows, and FPS only on Wine.
Description.Translated: 根据帧率动态调整游戏内渲染对象数量，Windows 下还可参考 GPU 使用率，也支持手动指定渲染对象数量。Windows 使用 GPU 使用率和帧率，Wine 下仅使用帧率。

Name.Translated: 自动奔跑时恢复相机轴心

Punchline.Original: Restore legacy camera pivot while auto-running.
Punchline.Translated: 自动奔跑时恢复传统模式的镜头自动转向。

Description.Original:
Temporarily restores legacy camera pivot while auto-running.
Only affects Legacy Type movement with Disable camera pivot enabled.
Description.Translated:
自动奔跑期间临时恢复传统模式的镜头自动转向。
仅对使用传统移动模式且启用了“禁用镜头自动转向”的情况生效。

Punchline.Original: Realtime RP bios
Punchline.Translated: 实时角色扮演简介。

Description.Original: Realtime Roleplay sheets
Description.Translated: 实时角色扮演资料卡。

Punchline.Original: Supporting your RP needs.
Punchline.Translated: 满足你的角色扮演需求。

Description.Original: A suite of features to support roleplay. /rputils
Description.Translated: 一套辅助角色扮演的功能。使用 /rputils。

Punchline.Original: Let people know when you r typing.
Punchline.Translated: 让别人知道你正在打字。

Description.Original: Allows other people using this plugin to see your typing status when in the same party.
Description.Translated: 让同一小队中也安装了本插件的玩家看到你的输入状态。

Punchline.Original: OBS automation based on game events via SAMMI webhooks
Punchline.Translated: 通过 SAMMI Webhook，根据游戏事件自动操作 OBS。

Description.Original:
Sends game data SAMMI via webhook, allowing users to automate OBS actions such as playing effects, transitions, sounds, etc. based on in-game events.
Requires SAMMI and OBS to function. See https://sammi.solutions or the plugin's readme on GitHub.
/psammi to configure.
Description.Translated:
通过 Webhook 将游戏数据发送至 SAMMI，让用户根据游戏内事件自动触发 OBS 特效、转场、声音等操作。
需要 SAMMI 和 OBS。详见 https://sammi.solutions 或 GitHub 上的插件说明。
输入 /psammi 进行设置。

Punchline.Original: Per-zone system and character configurations
Punchline.Translated: 按区域分别应用系统和角色设置。

Description.Original:
Settings Enhanced allows you to create zone-specific system and character configurations; For example, you could lower the amount of rendered players in Limsa, or mute other players sound effects while in stellar crafting zones. Your original configuration data is stored and automatically re-applies when entering an area with you have not created zone setting for, or when disabling the plugin/closing the game.

It is recommended that you create regular backups whilst using this plugin incase something does does break - upon install a check will be ran to see if at least one system/character configuration backup has been created; You will not be able to use the plugin if until you have created one.
Description.Translated:
Settings Enhanced 允许你为不同区域建立独立的系统和角色配置。例如，在利姆萨·罗敏萨减少显示的玩家数量，或在宇宙探索制作区域静音其他玩家的音效。插件会保存原始配置，在进入未设置专属配置的区域、禁用插件或关闭游戏时自动恢复。

建议使用期间定期备份，以防意外。安装时会检查是否至少存在一份系统／角色配置备份；创建备份之前无法使用本插件。

Punchline.Original: Shows your gear in the Fitting Room by default.
Punchline.Translated: 试穿窗口默认显示你身上的全部装备。

Description.Original:
Normally the Fitting Room defaults to showing you just the piece of gear you’re trying on. This plugin inverts that behaviour: when you launch the game, the Fitting Room (plus Item Dyeing and Glamour Plate Selection) will show all your gear by default.

NB: there are some oddities to how Item Dyeing and Glamour Plate Selection behave when this plugin is doing its thing. If you’d rather it not touch those windows at all, there’s an option for that (and more details about the problem) in the settings.

Icon adapted from OpenMoji, CC BY-SA 4.0.
Description.Translated:
试穿窗口通常默认只显示正在试穿的那件装备。本插件反转这一行为：启动游戏后，试穿窗口，以及物品染色和投影模板选择窗口，都会默认显示全身装备。

注意：插件生效时，物品染色和投影模板选择窗口的部分行为可能不太正常。如果不希望插件影响这些窗口，可在设置中关闭；设置中也提供了问题的详细说明。

图标改编自 OpenMoji，使用 CC BY-SA 4.0 许可证。

Punchline.Original: Shrinks characters based on their Health!
Punchline.Translated: 根据生命值缩小角色！

Description.Original:
This plugin will shrink and grow characters based on how much health they have, affects you and your party 

/shrinkage to open the config window.
Description.Translated:
根据剩余生命值让角色缩小或变大，对自己及队友生效。

输入 /shrinkage 打开设置窗口。

Punchline.Original: shows the current time in .beats
Punchline.Translated: 以 .beats 为单位显示当前时间。

Description.Original: a server info bar addon to display swatch internet time
Description.Translated: 在服务器信息栏显示 Swatch 互联网时间的插件。

Punchline.Original: Tataru Punch
Punchline.Translated: 塔塔露之拳。

Description.Original: Chat Translator
Description.Translated: 聊天翻译器。

Punchline.Original: An expanded and extremely customizable rewrite of the in-game term filter, this allows players to mask/hide/modify messages containing specific words.
Punchline.Translated: 重写并扩展游戏内的词语过滤功能，提供高度自定义的选项，可遮蔽、隐藏或修改包含特定词语的消息。

Description.Original:
I felt like the vanilla term filter was missing a lot of options, so I added them.
"If the term filter is so good, why didn't they make a term filter 2?"
Description.Translated:
我觉得原生词语过滤缺了太多选项，于是自己补上了。
“既然词语过滤这么好，为什么不出个词语过滤 2 呢？”

Punchline.Original:
[REQUIRES TF2 INSTALLED FOR MOST FEATURES] The Mann Brothers just found a deposit of gravel in Eorzea
and hired YOU, Mercenary of Light, to help them FIGHT for it.
Punchline.Translated:
【多数功能需要安装 TF2】Mann 兄弟刚在艾欧泽亚发现了一处砂砾矿藏，
于是雇用了你——光之雇佣兵——帮他们争夺它。

Description.Original:
* Show a Win Panel (with sounds!) when you clear or get wiped in a duty.
* Show a TF2-style timer while in a duty.
* Enable the "Voice Lines" module (via /tfconfig) to have voice lines play when certain conditions are met. What conditions, you ask? It's a surprise! (Unless you uncheck the "Surprise me!" box.)
* More features maybe soon?

Note: This plugin uses files from a local Team Fortress 2 installation.
It'll search for the game's installation folder in all configured Steam Library Folders automatically.

Without a TF2 install, the Timer and Win Panel will work with FF XIV fonts, and no voice line will work.
Description.Translated:
* 通关或团灭时显示结算面板，还带音效！
* 在副本中显示 TF2 风格计时器。
* 通过 /tfconfig 启用“语音台词”模块，满足特定条件时播放台词。你问是什么条件？这是惊喜！除非你取消勾选“给我惊喜！”选项。
* 也许很快会有更多功能？

注意：本插件使用本机安装的《军团要塞2》文件。
会自动在所有已配置的 Steam 库文件夹中查找游戏安装目录。

未安装 TF2 时，计时器和结算面板将使用 FFXIV 字体，所有语音台词均不可用。

Punchline.Original: A dot to mark players hitbox.
Punchline.Translated: 用一个圆点标记玩家的受击判定位置。

Description.Original: A dot to mark players hitbox
Description.Translated: 用一个圆点标记玩家的受击判定位置。

Punchline.Original: Unsure what to do? Forgot what you wanted to do? Nonsense! There's always things to do in Eorzea!
Punchline.Translated: 不知道做什么？忘了原本想做什么？别闹了，艾欧泽亚永远有事可做！

Description.Original:
Keep track of all your objectives and tasks in Eorzea. Whether it's collecting tomes/items/gear, completing dungeons/trials/raids, FATEs, or purely making a random list of things to do to keep yourself busy, keep yourself organized and on track with this plugin.

Features:
    - Create and manage a list of objectives and tasks.
    - Automatically track your progress on objectives and tasks.
    - View your objectives and tasks with a window inspired by the in-game Duty Log.
    - Automatic translation of objectives and tasks to your game client's language. (No need to write what you want to do. Just setup how you want to do it and the plugin will fill in the rest!)
    - Open creativity for just about anything that comes up to mine! (...What? You don't think making silly challenges like doing Endsinger's Aria - Extreme with MINE in under 12 minutes a good idea? Seriously, you can make that a task if you want)
       
Inspired by the idea of "DYOM" (Design Your Own Mission) and "TTDISA" (Things To Do In San Andreas) from GTA: San Andreas as well as Simple To-Do List and other similar plugins.
Description.Translated:
记录你在艾欧泽亚的所有目标与待办事项。无论是收集神典石、物品和装备，完成迷宫、讨伐歼灭战、团队任务或临危受命，还是随手列些事让自己忙起来，本插件都能帮助你有条理地推进。

功能：
    - 创建和管理目标与待办清单。
    - 自动追踪目标与待办事项的进度。
    - 通过借鉴游戏任务日志设计的窗口查看清单。
    - 自动将目标与待办事项转换为游戏客户端语言。无需亲自编写任务描述，只要设定完成方式，插件会填好其余内容！
    - 自由发挥，设定几乎任何想得到的挑战！什么，你觉得在 12 分钟内以最低品级、无超越之力条件完成终极之战不值得一试？真的，想这么做的话，也可以设成任务。

灵感来自《侠盗猎车手：圣安地列斯》的“DYOM”（设计自己的任务）与“TTDISA”（圣安地列斯待办事项），以及 Simple To-Do List 等同类插件。

Punchline.Original: Ever wanted to know how many levels you have across all your jobs?
Punchline.Translated: 想知道所有职业的等级加起来有多少吗？

Description.Original: Adds numbers to the Classes/Jobs panel showing the sum of the levels of all your jobs.
Description.Translated: 在战斗职业／特职面板中添加数值，显示所有职业等级的总和。

Punchline.Original: Hunt train helper to make it easier to track where it's heading.
Punchline.Translated: 狩猎车助手，让你更容易跟上车队的目的地。

Description.Original: See just the conductor's messages so you don't miss flags, instance messages, or other instructions.
Description.Translated: 只查看狩猎车车头的消息，不错过地图旗标、副本分区信息或其他指示。

Punchline.Original: A simple tool to record players' used names and nickname
Punchline.Translated: 记录玩家曾用名和昵称的简单工具。

Description.Original: A simple tool to record players' used names and nickname base on SocialList. Right click on the target to add/sub/check the used names and nickname.
Description.Translated: 基于 SocialList 记录玩家曾用名和昵称的简单工具。右键点击目标即可添加、删除或查看曾用名与昵称。

Punchline.Original: Save and load actions into hotbars without taking up extra job hotbars.
Punchline.Translated: 保存和加载热键栏技能，无需占用其他职业的热键栏。

Description.Original: Allows you to use commands to save the actions in a hotbar and then load them into any other hotbar. Like the vanilla "/hotbar copy" command, but unlimited, without taking up other hotbars to save the actions.
Description.Translated: 通过命令保存热键栏中的技能，再加载到任意其他热键栏。类似原生“/hotbar copy”命令，但数量不限，也无需占用其他热键栏来存放备份。

Punchline.Original: Tag items as important, highlighting them visually. Now with sound!
Punchline.Translated: 将物品标为重要并高亮显示，现在还支持声音提醒！

Description.Original: Adding and removing items to and from the list of very important items can be done in the plugin's configuration window and by right-clicking items in the game. Very important items get their name highlighted in the tooltip, and a sound effect plays in addition to that to ensure you've seen its presence.
Description.Translated: 可在插件设置窗口中，或通过游戏内物品右键菜单，添加和移除重要物品。重要物品的名称会在提示信息中高亮，并播放音效，确保你注意到它。

Punchline.Original: Allows you to not lose track of your mouse on the screen
Punchline.Translated: 让你不再找不到屏幕上的鼠标指针。

Description.Original:
Add UI element on top of the mouse like circle to keep track of your mouse location during gameplay.
Open settings with /wmm
Description.Translated:
在鼠标指针上方添加圆圈等界面元素，帮助你在游戏中辨认指针位置。
使用 /wmm 打开设置。

Punchline.Original: Fixes SquareEnix' botched antialiasing implementation
Punchline.Translated: 修复 Square Enix 有问题的抗锯齿实现。

Description.Original:
With the release of 7.0 SquareEnix has implemented several temporal antialiasing solutions. However they all have a severe bug that affects image quality significantly.
This plugin will restore using jitter when talking to NPCs or in cutscenes and gpose. Jitter (not noticeable micromovements of the camera) is necessary for temporal antialiasing solutions (DLSS, DLAA, TSCMAA+jitter) to work properly.
For some reason, SquareEnix decided we don't need jitter during the time where the game benefits from using it the most.
Description.Translated:
7.0 版本中，Square Enix 加入了多种时域抗锯齿方案，但它们都存在一个会明显影响画质的严重问题。
本插件会在与 NPC 对话、过场动画和集体动作模式中恢复采样抖动。采样抖动是难以察觉的镜头微小位移，也是 DLSS、DLAA、TSCMAA+jitter 等时域抗锯齿方案正常工作所必需的。
不知为何，Square Enix 偏偏在最能从中受益的场景关闭了它。

Punchline.Original: Mod to allow VR
Punchline.Translated: 让游戏支持 VR 的模组。

Description.Original:
Mod to allow vr. Requires SteamVR Not the steam version of the game
** Requires SteamVR **
Please click the globe icon for detailed instructions.
Chat/FAQ: flat2vr.com
Description.Translated:
让游戏支持 VR 的模组。需要 SteamVR，不要求使用 Steam 版游戏。
**需要 SteamVR**
请点击地球图标查看详细说明。
交流与常见问题：flat2vr.com

Punchline.Original: Testing prerelease: refit Penumbra outfits between compatible body meshes.
Punchline.Translated: 测试预发行版：在兼容的身体网格间重新适配 Penumbra 服装。

Description.Original: Choose a source body, an outfit and one or more destination bodies to create a new mod with their body and size choices. Automatically matches labelled source sizes, keeps other outfit styles and previews the combined options. Advanced manual references remain available for one destination body. Processing runs in a separate worker. Open with /outfitstudio. Experimental: review converted outfits in game.
Description.Translated: 选择来源身体、服装及一个或多个目标身体，即可创建包含相应身体与尺码选项的新模组。自动匹配已标注的来源尺码，保留服装的其他样式，并预览合并后的选项。针对单个目标身体，仍可使用高级手动参考功能。处理过程由独立工作进程执行。输入 /outfitstudio 打开。实验性功能：请在游戏中检查转换后的服装。

Punchline.Original: Smoother frame times by cutting engine overhead.
Punchline.Translated: 减少引擎开销，让帧时间更平稳。

Description.Original:
Cuts per-frame engine overhead that causes stutter and low FPS, most noticeable in crowded areas.
Skips idle GPU resource notifiers, chains job worker wake-ups, drops repeated skeleton pose syncs, trims the culling visibility clear and shortens the graphics allocator lock.
Each fix can be toggled via /crowdfix
Description.Translated:
削减每帧引擎开销，缓解卡顿与低帧率，效果在人群密集区域尤为明显。
包括跳过空闲 GPU 资源通知器、链式唤醒任务工作线程、消除重复骨骼姿态同步、精简剔除可见性清理，以及缩短图形分配器锁的持有时间。
各项修复均可通过 /crowdfix 独立开关。

Punchline.Original: FSR 3.1 upscaling and anti-aliasing on any GPU.
Punchline.Translated: 在任意 GPU 上使用 FSR 3.1 升频与抗锯齿。

Description.Original:
Runs AMD FSR 3.1 temporal upscaling and anti-aliasing through the game's own DLSS path, on any GPU.
Supports the FSR quality presets and Native AA.
Open the settings with /upscalebuddy
Description.Translated:
通过游戏自身的 DLSS 通道，在任意 GPU 上运行 AMD FSR 3.1 时域升频与抗锯齿。
支持 FSR 画质预设和原生分辨率抗锯齿。
使用 /upscalebuddy 打开设置。

Punchline.Original: Replay and analyze raid pulls from your ACT network logs.
Punchline.Translated: 从 ACT 网络日志重放并分析团队战斗。

Description.Original:
Reconstructs every pull from ACT network logs: arena map, waymarks, player positions and facing, boss casts and AoE telegraphs, towers, tethers, head markers and deaths, with a scrubbable timeline. Watches the live log and explains each wipe right after it happens: root cause, who was where, and where they should have been.

Alpha: requires ACT with the FFXIV plugin writing network logs (default folder %USERPROFILE%\AppData\Roaming\Advanced Combat Tracker\FFXIVLogs). /aar opens the after-action report, /raidreplay the replay window.
Description.Translated:
从 ACT 网络日志重建每次战斗，呈现场地地图、场地标记、玩家位置与朝向、首领读条与范围攻击预警、塔、连线、头顶标记和死亡事件，并提供可拖动的时间轴。监测实时日志，在团灭后立即分析根本原因、各玩家当时的位置以及应处的位置。

Alpha 版本：需要 ACT 的 FFXIV 插件启用网络日志记录，默认目录为 %USERPROFILE%\AppData\Roaming\Advanced Combat Tracker\FFXIVLogs。/aar 打开战后报告，/raidreplay 打开回放窗口。

Punchline.Original: Scan a residential district's wards and list every plot you can buy.
Punchline.Translated: 扫描住宅区的各分区，列出所有可购买的地皮。

Description.Original:
Open the "Go to specified ward" menu at a residential aetheryte, run /ahs, and press Scan.
AHS steps through all 30 wards, then reports every unowned plot with ward, plot number, size, price,
purchase method (lottery / first come first served), FC/individual restriction and lottery phase.
Filter the report by small, medium and large plots.
Description.Translated:
在住宅区以太之光处打开“移动到指定小区”菜单，输入 /ahs，然后点击扫描。
AHS 会依次检查全部 30 个小区，列出所有无主地皮的所在小区、地号、大小、价格、
购买方式（抽签／先到先得）、部队／个人购买限制和抽签阶段。
可按小型、中型和大型地皮筛选结果。

Punchline.Original: Lost in a deep dungeon with nothing but dry bread and water?
Punchline.Translated: 迷失在深层迷宫里，身边只剩干面包和水？

Description.Original:
Palantir is a spiritual successor to PalacePal, the popular deep dungeon trap ESP plugin created by Liza Carvelli. It reveals the locations of previously recorded traps and Accursed Hoards from a crowdsourced database.

Plugin from https://puni.sh/api/plugins
Description.Translated:
Palantir 是 PalacePal 的精神续作。PalacePal 是由 Liza Carvelli 制作的热门深层迷宫陷阱透视插件。Palantir 使用玩家共同收集的数据库，显示此前记录过的陷阱与埋藏的宝藏位置。

插件来源：https://puni.sh/api/plugins

Punchline.Original: Combines the glamour dresser and armoire into one easy-to-use window.
Punchline.Translated: 将投影台和收藏柜整合到一个易用的窗口。

Description.Original:
Enables a more convenient glamour plate making experience by displaying all available items in one window.
Filter and sort the items, as you'd normally do with the dresser, along with additional features.
Description.Translated:
在同一窗口显示所有可用物品，让投影模板制作更方便。
可像使用投影台一样筛选、排序物品，还提供额外功能。

Punchline.Original: Local inventory, gil and market history dashboard
Punchline.Translated: 本地库存、吉尔和市场交易历史面板。

Description.Original: Requires Allagan Tools for inventory/gil; AllaganMarket for sales; Gil Ledger (MarketLedger) for purchases. Source plugins must record data. Settings show installed/running status. Includes purchase totals and character filters, CSV exports with saved column presets, and seven interface languages. Starts the local website when loaded; open from settings or /allaganlocal.
Description.Translated: 库存和吉尔数据需要 Allagan Tools，销售数据需要 AllaganMarket，购买数据需要 Gil Ledger（MarketLedger）。这些来源插件必须先记录数据。设置页会显示它们的安装和运行状态。支持采购总额、角色筛选、可保存列预设的 CSV 导出，以及七种界面语言。加载后自动启动本地网站，可从设置或通过 /allaganlocal 打开。

Punchline.Original: 保存単価での連続出品と、出品アイテムの一括回収を補助
Punchline.Translated: 辅助按已保存的单价连续上架物品，并批量取回在售物品。

Description.Original: 右Alt＋右クリックで、ログイン中に記憶した最終出品単価を使って同種アイテムを連続出品。所持品・アーマリーチェストの検索、NQ/HQ共通の価格履歴、Marketbuddyの数量設定参照、操作キー・ディレイ設定に対応。販売リスト左下のプレイヤー・リテイナー向け一括回収も利用できます。設定: /retainerlisting。実機検証待ち。
Description.Translated: 按右 Alt＋鼠标右键，使用本次登录期间记住的最近一次上架单价，连续上架同类物品。支持搜索背包和兵装库、NQ／HQ 共用价格历史、读取 Marketbuddy 的数量设置，以及自定义操作键和延迟。也可通过出售列表左下方的功能，将在售物品批量取回到玩家或雇员背包。设置命令：/retainerlisting。尚待实际环境验证。

Punchline.Original: Blur game UI on stream, not on your screen.
Punchline.Translated: 只模糊直播画面中的游戏界面，不影响你自己的屏幕。

Description.Original:
A streamer's best friend: becomes OBS's Game Capture source and sends the game without UI, with nameplates only, or with all game UI, with nameplates and chosen windows blurred. Your own screen is never changed.
Open the settings with /blurbuddy
Description.Translated:
主播的好帮手：作为 OBS 的游戏捕获来源，可输出不含界面的游戏画面、仅保留姓名板的画面，或完整游戏界面，并模糊姓名板和选定窗口。你自己的屏幕始终不受影响。
使用 /blurbuddy 打开设置。

Punchline.Original: 対象ルールと戦闘操作を、日本語で自分好みに。
Punchline.Translated: 通过日语界面，按自己的喜好设置目标规则与战斗操作。

Description.Original: 日本語の設定画面で、ジョブ別の対象ルール・先行入力・地面設置・操作補助を設定できます。/moaで開きます。ReActionを基にした派生版です。
Description.Translated: 通过日语设置界面，配置各职业的目标规则、技能预输入、地面技能放置和操作辅助。使用 /moa 打开。基于 ReAction 的衍生版本。

Punchline.Original: Your DoTs and debuffs on the target, shown wherever you want.
Punchline.Translated: 将你施加在目标身上的持续伤害和减益显示在任意位置。

Description.Original: Displays the statuses you apply to your current target in a separate overlay that can be dragged anywhere and locked in place. Use /tdebuffs to open settings.
Description.Translated: 在独立叠加层中显示你施加于当前目标的状态，支持拖动到任意位置并锁定。使用 /tdebuffs 打开设置。

Punchline.Original: A configurable visual alert for Marksman's Spite in PvP.
Punchline.Translated: 为 PvP 中的魔弹射手提供可自定义的视觉警报。

Description.Original:
Tired of not knowing you're being targeted by Marksman's Spite in PvP because you're using limited Battle Effects? Me too.

Adds a configurable visual alert for Marksman's Spite.
Description.Translated:
在 PvP 中使用简化战斗特效，导致自己被魔弹射手瞄准都不知道？我也一样。

本插件为魔弹射手添加可自定义的视觉警报。

Description.Original: 在游戏内直接导入 VMD(MMD 动作)并驱动角色骨骼播放,无需 Blender;可导入本地音乐同步播放,支持快捷键与原生声音屏蔽。仅限摄影(GPose)用途。/ Import VMD (MMD motion) files and play them on characters in-game, no Blender needed; local music playback with hotkeys and game audio muting.
Description.Translated: 在游戏内直接导入 VMD（MMD 动作）并驱动角色骨骼播放，无需 Blender；可导入本地音乐同步播放，支持快捷键与原生声音屏蔽。仅限摄影（GPose）用途。

Description.Original: 运行时替换 FF14 全局球面贴图(切片导入/仓库/方案),支持与 Penumbra mod 绑定、Glamourer 切幻化自动切换。不修改游戏文件。/ Replace the game's global spheremap textures at runtime with Penumbra mod binding and Glamourer auto-switching. No game file modification.
Description.Translated: 运行时替换 FF14 全局球面贴图，提供切片导入、仓库和方案功能，支持与 Penumbra 模组绑定，以及在 Glamourer 切换幻化时自动切换。不修改游戏文件。

Punchline.Original: A simple editor for the game's camera settings
Punchline.Translated: 简单的游戏镜头设置编辑器

Description.Original:
A simple camera editor to change various game defaults such as zoom and fov.
This is a zoom hack, if you aren't comfortable with that fact, don't install it.
Description.Translated:
简单的镜头编辑器，可修改缩放距离、视野范围等游戏默认设置。
这是修改镜头距离的作弊工具；如果你无法接受这一点，请不要安装。

Punchline.Original: Fish, Hunt
Punchline.Translated: 钓鱼与狩猎。

Description.Original:
Fish, Hunt

Plugin from https://puni.sh/api/repository/wah
Description.Translated:
钓鱼与狩猎。

插件来源：https://puni.sh/api/repository/wah

Punchline.Original: One-click bookmarks for Penumbra emote mods.
Punchline.Translated: 一键收藏 Penumbra 情感动作模组。

Description.Original: Browse Penumbra emote mods, choose variants, and pin favorites to an icon panel. Supports ground-sit and standing-idle poses. Experimental pair launch includes required alignment and needs Lightless Sync with your partner. Technical error reports are mandatory after accepting the first-use notice; collection cannot be disabled while using the plugin. Open with /es or /eshelf. Solo playback requires only Penumbra.
Description.Translated: 浏览 Penumbra 情感动作模组、选择变体，并将常用动作固定到图标面板。支持席地而坐与站立待机姿势。实验性双人播放包含必要的位置对齐，并要求双方使用 Lightless Sync。接受首次使用提示后，必须允许技术错误报告收集，使用插件期间无法关闭。通过 /es 或 /eshelf 打开。单人播放仅需 Penumbra。

Punchline.Original: Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.
Punchline.Translated: 逐帧分析战斗信息，找出最佳技能。

Description.Original:
Analyses combat information every frame and finds the best action.

Duncan's fork: adds automatic mechanic dodging driven by BossModReborn's radar (moves out of AoEs via vnavmesh, pauses actions while dodging). Based on Rotation Solver Reborn by The Combat Reborn Team.
Description.Translated:
逐帧分析战斗信息，找出最合适的技能。

Duncan 分支：增加由 BossModReborn 雷达驱动的自动机制躲避，通过 vnavmesh 移出范围攻击，躲避时暂停技能操作。基于 The Combat Reborn Team 制作的 Rotation Solver Reborn。

Punchline.Original: Increases the render resolution of in-game character preview windows.
Punchline.Translated: 提高游戏内角色预览窗口的渲染分辨率。

Description.Original: Allows you to customize the render resolution used by Character, Try On, Inspect, Glamour, Adventurer Plate, and similar preview windows so they look sharper.
Description.Translated: 自定义角色、试穿、查看装备、幻化、冒险者铭牌等预览窗口的渲染分辨率，使画面更加清晰。

Punchline.Original: Cut down visual noise from other players' VFX.
Punchline.Translated: 减少其他玩家特效带来的视觉干扰。

Description.Original: Helps trim down the visual noise in venues or in heavily sync'd areas. Useful for large shells or if you have that one friend with an annoying dote.
Description.Translated: 减少店铺或大量玩家同步模组的区域中的视觉干扰。适合大型场景模组，或某位朋友的示爱特效实在太烦人的情况。

Punchline.Original: プラグイン通知をタブ分け可能な専用オーバーレイウィンドウに分離します。
Punchline.Translated: 将插件通知分离到支持多标签页的专用悬浮窗口中。

Description.Original:
プラグイン通知をタブ分け可能な専用オーバーレイウィンドウに分離します。
分離は初期OFFです。
Description.Translated:
将插件通知分离到支持多标签页的专用悬浮窗口中。
分离功能默认关闭。

Punchline.Original: AnoMech fork: FFXIV ultimate mechanics simulator. Go to an inn and start practice.
Punchline.Translated: AnoMech 分支：FFXIV 绝境战机制模拟器，前往旅馆即可开始练习。

Description.Original: A fork of AnoMech by Anomek. Spawns fake party members and bosses client-side so you can practice raid mechanics without a full party. Adds the modified D>S>A (double tethers) strat for Dancing Mad P3 Black Hole.
Description.Translated: 由 Anomek 制作的 AnoMech 的分支。在本地客户端生成模拟队友与首领，无需组满队伍即可练习团队机制。增加了妖星乱舞绝境战 P3 黑洞的改版 D>S>A（双连线）打法。

Punchline.Original: A modern friend list with live online status.
Punchline.Translated: 带实时在线状态的现代化好友列表。

Description.Original: Replaces the vanilla friend list. Online status is refreshed as soon as the window opens (no more sync button), with the game's status icons, location and job. Friend groups, how long you have been friends, when you last saw each friend online, personal notes, and one-click tell, party invite, adventurer plate and teleport to their estates.
Description.Translated: 替换原生好友列表。打开窗口后立即刷新在线状态，无需再点同步按钮，并显示游戏状态图标、所在地点和职业。支持好友分组、结为好友的时长、上次见其在线的时间、个人备注，以及一键悄悄话、邀请入队、查看冒险者铭牌和传送至其房屋。

Punchline.Original: Nearby players and who is targeting you, in one window.
Punchline.Translated: 在一个窗口中查看附近玩家，以及谁正在选中你。

Description.Original: Merges Nearby Players (Wholist) and Peeping Tom. Lists nearby players with their world and Free Company tag, colored by party, friend list and Player Sync / Lightless Sync status, and shows who is targeting you with the same click shortcuts as Peeping Tom.
Description.Translated: 整合 Nearby Players（Wholist）与 Peeping Tom。列出附近玩家的服务器和部队简称，根据是否同队、好友关系及 Player Sync／Lightless Sync 状态着色；同时显示谁正在选中你，并保留 Peeping Tom 的点击快捷操作。

Punchline.Original: Avoid double-syncing players across Lightless Sync and Player Sync.
Punchline.Translated: 避免 Lightless Sync 与 Player Sync 对同一玩家重复同步。

Description.Original: Finds players handled by both Lightless Sync and Player Sync and keeps only Lightless active for them.
Description.Translated: 找出同时被 Lightless Sync 和 Player Sync 处理的玩家，并仅保留 Lightless 对他们的同步。

Punchline.Original: A faster, searchable teleport menu.
Punchline.Translated: 更快捷、支持搜索的传送菜单。

Description.Original: Replaces the vanilla teleport menu with a searchable window: English and French search, favorites with labels, recent destinations, housing shortcuts, custom aliases and /wp <name> to teleport from chat.
Description.Translated: 用支持搜索的窗口替换原生传送菜单。提供英语与法语搜索、带标签的收藏、最近目的地、房屋快捷入口和自定义别名，也可使用 /wp <name> 直接从聊天栏传送。

Punchline.Original: See other players in their job's artifact gear, so glamours don't break the story.
Punchline.Translated: 让其他玩家显示为身穿对应职业的专属装备，避免幻化破坏剧情氛围。

Description.Original:
Story Mode changes how other players look on your screen only. Players with a job stone appear in that job's artifact gear for their level bracket, and players without one appear in a starter outfit for their class.

Choose who it applies to (everyone, or everyone except your party, alliance, friends or free company) and when (always, or only in cutscenes and duties). Nothing is sent to the server, and other players see no change.
Description.Translated:
Story Mode 仅改变其他玩家在你屏幕上的外观。装备职业水晶的玩家会显示为身穿对应等级段的职业专属装备，未装备职业水晶的玩家则显示为对应基础职业的初始装束。

可选择适用对象：所有人，或排除小队、团队、好友、部队成员；也可选择生效时机：始终生效，或仅在过场动画和副本中生效。不会向服务器发送任何变更，其他玩家看不到变化。

Punchline.Original: Recieve updates of your current location
Punchline.Translated: 接收当前位置的更新信息。

Description.Original: Connects to the Eorzea Mapper local server to send updates of your current location for display in the webapp
Description.Translated: 连接 Eorzea Mapper 本地服务器，发送当前位置更新，以便在网页应用中显示。

Punchline.Original: Show your actions in real-time.
Punchline.Translated: 实时显示你使用的技能。

Description.Original: Configurable timeline display of all the actions you use.
Description.Translated: 以可配置的时间轴显示你使用的所有技能。

Punchline.Original: Help you to solve the quests!
Punchline.Translated: 帮助你完成任务！

Description.Original:
Help you to solve the quests. It is still working in progress! I am lazy, you know!
vnavmesh required!
Description.Translated:
帮助你完成任务。目前仍在开发中，你懂的，我比较懒！
需要 vnavmesh！

Description.Original: Create and edit animations and cutscenes
Description.Translated: 创建和编辑动画与过场演出。

Description.Original: Fallback in-game IME to system IME.
Description.Translated: 让游戏内输入法回退为系统输入法。

Description.Original: Smart Vote the Mvp in player commendation for you.
Description.Translated: 智能替你投出最优队员推荐票。

Description.Original: A simple plugin that lock the positions of specified windows. /windowlocker to open.
Description.Translated: 锁定指定窗口位置的简单插件，使用 /windowlocker 打开。

Punchline.Original: Now you too can be annoyed to death by a mammet that spews quotes at you.
Punchline.Translated: 现在，你也能被一个不停对你念台词的魔法人偶烦个够了。

Description.Original:
Neevie Auto-Mammet Emote Generator accepts a series of quotes provided by you, the user.
A random quote is selected and inserted into the emote, and the emote is split into chunks if the string is too long to fit in a single emote.

Special thanks to Infi's BetterPlaytime and Lady Defile's Wordsmith, from whose code I took a lot of ... inspiration ...
Description.Translated:
Neevie Auto-Mammet 情感动作生成器接受用户提供的一组台词。
随机抽取一句并插入情感动作文本；如果文本过长，无法放入单条情感动作消息，则会自动拆分。

特别感谢 Infi 的 BetterPlaytime 和 Lady Defile 的 Wordsmith，我从它们的代码中汲取了很多……灵感……

Description.Original: Displays accurate player hitbox and positional outlines.
Description.Translated: 准确显示玩家受击判定位置与身位边界。

Punchline.Original: Developer/debugging/RE tool and experiment workbench.
Punchline.Translated: 开发、调试与逆向工程工具，以及实验工作台。

Description.Original: This plugin contains various tools to help reverse engineering the game through dynamic analysis, and prototyping things.
Description.Translated: 包含多种工具，帮助通过动态分析对游戏进行逆向研究，以及制作原型。

Punchline.Original:
自动记录每日随机任务，包括指导者随机任务。

Auto record your daily roulettes including mentor roulettes.
Punchline.Translated: 自动记录每日随机任务，包括指导者随机任务。

Description.Original:
帮助你记录每日随机任务、导出报告，并实时同步到 DungeonLogger。

Help you to record your daily roulettes, export reports, and sync with DungeonLogger in real time.
Description.Translated: 帮助你记录每日随机任务、导出报告，并实时同步到 DungeonLogger。

Punchline.Original: Simple, pixel-precise tweaks to your HUD and flying text, right from the HUD layout editor.
Punchline.Translated: 直接在 HUD 布局编辑器中，以像素级精度简单调整 HUD 和飞行文本。

Description.Original:
Adds "Flying Text" frames to the HUD layout editor: drag them to choose where the text about your character appears (healing received, status effects and damage taken), and set its size or hide it.
In the same editor, shows where each HUD element is and lets you set the selected one to the pixel.
Available in English and French. Command: /simplehud
Description.Translated:
为 HUD 布局编辑器添加“飞行文本”框：拖动即可选择与角色相关文字的显示位置，包括受到的治疗、状态效果和受到的伤害，并可调整大小或将其隐藏。
同一编辑器中还会显示各 HUD 元素的位置，并可精确到像素设置选中元素。
支持英语和法语。命令：/simplehud

Punchline.Original: Developer/debugging/RE tool and experiment workbench.
Punchline.Translated: 开发、调试与逆向工程工具，以及实验工作台。

Description.Original: This plugin contains various tools to help reverse engineering the game through dynamic analysis, and prototyping things.
Description.Translated: 包含多种工具，帮助通过动态分析对游戏进行逆向研究，以及制作原型。

Punchline.Original: Automatically save & load furniture layouts in your house.
Punchline.Translated: 自动保存和加载房屋中的家具布局。

Description.Original: Automatically save & load the positions of house furniture. Import/export layouts from the MakePlace program.
Description.Translated: 自动保存和加载房屋家具位置，支持与 MakePlace 程序导入、导出布局。
