Punchline.Original: Multi-boxer tool kit
Punchline.Translated: 多开工具包。

Description.Original:
A bunch of utilities to simplify multi-boxing, and a IPC broadcaster

Plugin from https://puni.sh/api/repository/herc
Description.Translated:
一组简化多开操作的实用工具，以及 IPC 广播器。

插件来源：https://puni.sh/api/repository/herc

Punchline.Original: sort your inventory a little faster
Punchline.Translated: 更快一点地整理背包。

Description.Original: description
Description.Translated: 说明。

Punchline.Original: Pikachu1 Condenses combos and mutually exclusive abilities onto a single button - and then some.
Punchline.Translated: Pikachu1 将连击和互斥能力合并到一个按键上，并提供更多功能。

Description.Original: Condenses combos and mutually exclusive abilities onto a single button - and then some.
Description.Translated: 将连击和互斥技能合并到一个按钮上，还不止于此。

Description.Original: Shows the current countdown time.
Description.Translated: 显示当前倒计时。

Punchline.Original: Change Visor and Stance based on State and Job.
Punchline.Translated: 根据状态与职业切换面罩和姿势。

Description.Original: Automatically change visor, headslot hiding, and weapon hiding status for different player states, as well as default CPose-stances per job.
Description.Translated: 根据玩家所处状态，自动切换面罩、头部装备显示和武器显示，并为每个职业设置默认的 CPose 姿势。

Description.Original:
Dalamud plugin for in-game browser rendering. Think OverlayPlugin, but it's in the game itself.
Use the settings button below or the '/bh config' command to configure.
Description.Translated:
在游戏内渲染浏览器内容的 Dalamud 插件。可以理解为直接嵌入游戏的 OverlayPlugin。
使用下方设置按钮，或输入“/bh config”进行设置。

Description.Original: Enables in-game chat bubbles.
Description.Translated: 启用游戏内聊天气泡。

Description.Original: This plugin adds functionality to FFXIV in-game chat.
Description.Translated: 扩展 FFXIV 游戏内聊天功能。

Description.Original: Enables in-game chat translation.
Description.Translated: 启用游戏内聊天翻译。

Punchline.Original: Automatically translates chat messages into the language of your choice.
Punchline.Translated: 自动将聊天消息翻译为你选择的语言。

Description.Original:
The intelligent voice assistant for your FFXIV experience - teleport to places, open other plugins, the possibilities are limitless!
Just say "Hey Dalamud, help me!" to learn more.
Description.Translated:
为 FFXIV 提供智能语音助手：传送到各处、打开其他插件，可能性无限！
说出“Hey Dalamud, help me!”即可了解更多。

Punchline.Original: Spotify Interface Powered by Aethernet.
Punchline.Translated: 由 Aethernet 驱动的 Spotify 控制界面。

Description.Original:
Control Spotify playback from within FFX|V
Use the button below to open settings or use the '/pfp settings' command.
Description.Translated:
在 FFXIV 内控制 Spotify 播放。
使用下方按钮或“/pfp settings”命令打开设置。

Description.Original:
Adds an indicator in item tooltips to show whether you have acquired that item.

This indicator is in the item's description near the bottom and only appears for
items that are unlockable, such as orchestrion rolls, minions, etc.
Description.Translated:
在物品提示中添加标识，显示你是否已获得该物品对应的解锁内容。

标识位于物品说明靠近底部的位置，仅对管弦乐琴乐谱、宠物等可解锁物品显示。

Description.Original: Notifies you when your GP recovers to certain amount as gatherer, takes potion into account as well.
Description.Translated: 采集职业的采集力恢复到指定数值时发送通知，也会考虑恢复药的影响。

Description.Original: Names are dumb, use icons instead.
Description.Translated: 名字太麻烦，换成图标吧。

Description.Original: Track your loot.
Description.Translated: 追踪你的战利品。

Description.Original: Allows macros to continue into the next macro
Description.Translated: 让宏执行完后继续执行下一个宏。

Description.Original:
Turn everyone around you into Lalafells (or other races)!

Use /poal to open settings.
Description.Translated:
把周围所有人变成拉拉菲尔，或其他种族！

使用 /poal 打开设置。

Description.Original:
Explore quests and their rewards.
- Search for quest names or their rewards, including instances,
  beast tribes, minions, etc.
- See an interactive map of quest requirements and unlocks.
- Open a quest info window even for quests you haven't completed.
- Open quest starting locations on the map or open quests in the journal.
Description.Translated:
探索任务及其奖励。
- 搜索任务名称或奖励，包括副本、友好部族、宠物等。
- 通过交互式关系图查看任务的前置条件及后续解锁内容。
- 即使尚未完成任务，也能打开其任务信息窗口。
- 在地图上查看任务起始地点，或在任务日志中打开任务。

Description.Original: Cooldown and Status tracking.
Description.Translated: 追踪技能冷却与状态。

Description.Original: Adds an indicator of when it's safe to move while casting
Description.Translated: 添加指示器，提示施法期间何时可以移动而不中断施法。

Description.Original: Allows replacing every text box with the background of your choice.
Description.Translated: 将所有文本框的背景替换为你喜欢的样式。

Description.Original:
Add separators to various numbers.

- Damage/healing numbers (not DoTs or other players' numbers)
- Party list HP
- Ability costs on hotbars
- Ability costs in tooltips
Description.Translated:
为各种数值添加分位分隔符。

- 伤害与治疗数值，不包括持续伤害和其他玩家的数值
- 小队列表中的 HP
- 热键栏上的技能消耗
- 技能提示中的技能消耗

Description.Original: Completely removes chosen players from your game.
Description.Translated: 在你的游戏客户端中彻底隐藏指定玩家。

Description.Original: Text overlay of current location name.
Description.Translated: 通过文字叠加层显示当前地点名称。

Description.Original: Prefixes all chatbox messages with their chat types.
Description.Translated: 在所有聊天消息前添加其频道类型。

Description.Original: Simple MP timer status bar for black mages. Shows the time until your next MP tick, and optionally shows a marker indicating when it is safe to cast Fire III without losing an MP tick.

Punchline.Translated: 角色扮演工具箱——Kitsune 版本。

RP'ers toolbox - Kitsune Release

Punchline.Original: Allows penumbra/glamourer/gearset assignment via chat command.
Punchline.Translated: 通过聊天命令配置 Penumbra、Glamourer 与套装的搭配。

Description.Original: Easy outfit changing if you know the name with penumbra/glamourer and gearset support.
Description.Translated: 只要知道名称就能轻松换装，支持 Penumbra、Glamourer 和套装。

Punchline.Original: Compasses that detect and mark certain nearby objects/NPCs
Punchline.Translated: 探测并标记附近特定物体或 NPC 的罗盘工具。

Description.Original:
[Important!] Please disable AND uninstall any non-preview version if you'd like to install this version.

This plugin detects certain objects/NPCs such as Aether Currents nearby and shows where they are by various ways, e.g. pointing to their locations on screen and notifying you in Chat.

Currently detects:
	- Aether Currents
	- Eureka Elementals (by apetih)
	- Mob Hunt Elite Marks
	- Gathering Points
	- [Experimental] Island Sanctuary Gathering Objects and Animals
	- [Experimental] Quest-related NPCs/Objects
	- [Experimental] Eureka Elementals (by apetih) 

Note: Because most objects/NPCs are not loaded when they are too faraway or when there are too many entities nearby (such as too many player characters), they will not be detected in this case.

Icon by Lumas Arkfrost
Description.Translated:
【重要】安装此预览版之前，请先禁用并卸载所有非预览版本。

探测附近的风脉泉等特定物体或 NPC，并通过屏幕指示、聊天通知等方式显示其位置。

目前支持探测：
	- 风脉泉
	- 优雷卡元素，由 apetih 提供
	- 狩猎精英怪物
	- 采集点
	- 【实验性】开拓无人岛采集物与动物
	- 【实验性】任务相关 NPC 和物体
	- 【实验性】优雷卡元素，由 apetih 提供

注意：多数物体或 NPC 在距离过远，或附近实体过多，例如玩家过多时不会被游戏加载，因此这些情况下无法探测。

图标由 Lumas Arkfrost 制作。

Punchline.Original: Check out my new title! ... Uhmm, renamed, I mean.
Punchline.Translated: 看看我的新称号！……呃，我是说，改了名字的称号。

Description.Original:
Rename a title displayed on the nameplate to something else.
Optionally, hide a specific title.
Description.Translated:
将姓名板上显示的称号改为其他文字。
也可选择隐藏指定称号。

Punchline.Original: Can't escape from crossing Michigan! The lazy Susan of fate is turning! Third fish! Eviscerate!
Punchline.Translated: 无法逃离横穿密歇根！命运的餐桌转盘正在转动！第三条鱼！开膛！

Description.Original: Generates a random Arc Sys countdown message on /rcd <time>. Time must be between 5 and 30 seconds.
Description.Translated: 使用 /rcd <time> 生成随机的 Arc System Works 格斗游戏风格倒计时台词。时间必须为 5 到 30 秒。

Punchline.Original: YEAAAAAAAAHT
Punchline.Translated: 耶——啊啊啊啊！

Description.Original: YEAAAAAAAAHT
Description.Translated: 耶——啊啊啊啊！

Punchline.Original: Automatic estate stages.
Punchline.Translated: 自动加载房屋场景。

Description.Original: Automatically join a configured estate's syncshell and load its stages. Authenticate in PlayerSync or Lightless first. Use /autostage for status.
Description.Translated: 自动加入已配置房屋的同步组并加载其场景。请先在 PlayerSync 或 Lightless 中完成认证。使用 /autostage 查看状态。

Description.Original: Fit a club staff headset with saved X, Y and Z adjustments. Requires Penumbra.
Description.Translated: 通过保存的 X、Y、Z 位置调整，让店员耳麦贴合角色。需要 Penumbra。

Punchline.Original: Stop accidental jumps during RP, posing, and social events.
Punchline.Translated: 防止在角色扮演、摆姿势和社交活动中误跳。

Description.Original:
Disables the jump key on demand, or automatically inside houses, apartments, FC rooms, or zones you choose.
Toggle it from the window, with /jumplock, or let it switch on by itself when you walk into a venue.
Description.Translated:
按需禁用跳跃键，也可在房屋、公寓、部队个人房间或指定区域中自动禁用。
可从窗口或通过 /jumplock 切换，也可在走进活动场所时自动启用。

Punchline.Original: Roleplay scratch pad with inline spell-check highlighting.
Punchline.Translated: 支持实时拼写错误高亮的角色扮演草稿本。

Description.Original: Write long posts in a resizable editor, see misspelled words highlighted right where you type, and copy them to chat in correctly-headed chunks.
Description.Translated: 在可调整大小的编辑器中编写长文，输入时直接高亮拼写错误，再将文本拆成带有正确消息前缀的片段，复制到聊天中。

Punchline.Original: Set-and-forget Unbroken eXecutor: queue the Crucible of the Unbroken boards, step away, come back to a report.
Punchline.Translated: 设好就不用管的斗兽奇弈执行器：排好棋局队列，暂时离开，回来查看报告。

Description.Original:
Crucible SUX (Set-and-forget Unbroken eXecutor) tracks your Beastmaster's Crucible of the Unbroken progress: boards, degrees, Apex and Legendary scores, beasts befriended and their ranks.
It checks whether you can clear the remaining boards in one sitting and suggests a team per board.
Its session queue runs boards through AutoDuty (erdelf's build), watches every run, stops a stuck one and reports back. Its opt-in journey does the Beastmaster job quests, collects the beasts and levels the job to 50, each part off by default. Unattended automation is against the game's terms of service: use it at your own risk.
Description.Translated:
Crucible SUX（设好就不用管的斗兽奇弈执行器）追踪驯兽师斗兽奇弈进度，包括棋局、难度等级、Apex 与 Legendary 评分、结交的野兽及其级别。
检查剩余棋局是否能一口气完成，并为各棋局推荐队伍。
本次会话队列通过 AutoDuty（erdelf 版本）执行棋局，监控每次运行，遇到卡住的场次会停止并报告。可选的成长流程会完成驯兽师职业任务、收集野兽并将职业升到 50 级，各部分默认关闭。无人值守自动化违反游戏服务条款，请自行承担使用风险。

Punchline.Original: See who is targeting your friends.
Punchline.Translated: 查看谁正在选中你的好友。

Description.Original: Keep a watchlist of players and see who is targeting them, PeepingTom style. Alerts you in chat, with a sound, when someone keeps a watched friend (or the player you are targeting) targeted for longer than a threshold. Party, alliance, friends and free company members are ignored by default.
Description.Translated: 维护玩家关注列表，以类似 PeepingTom 的方式查看谁正在选中他们。有人持续选中被关注的好友，或你当前选中的玩家，超过设定时间时，会通过聊天和声音提醒。默认忽略小队、团队、好友和部队成员。

Punchline.Original: Cum layering system for your paired partners.
Punchline.Translated: 为已配对伙伴提供精液叠加图层系统。

Description.Original:
Pair with someone over tells, then right-click them to layer cum onto a body part. Layers stack on top of their own current skin (Bibo body), are published through Penumbra so sync plugins show them to everyone, and stay until cleaned or dried off.
Requires Penumbra. 18+ content.
Description.Translated:
通过悄悄话与对方配对后，右键点击对方便可在身体部位叠加精液效果。图层叠加在对方当前的皮肤上，适用于 Bibo 身体，通过 Penumbra 发布以供同步插件向其他人展示，并持续保留直到被清理或自然干燥。
需要 Penumbra。仅限 18 岁以上的成人内容。

Punchline.Original: Track what you want and find the next step.
Punchline.Translated: 追踪你的目标，找出下一步该做什么。

Description.Original: Tracks FFXIV acquisition, unlock, and progression targets and helps determine what to do next.
Description.Translated: 追踪 FFXIV 中的获取、解锁和养成目标，帮助确定下一步行动。

Punchline.Original: Spot the bait you need for Auto-Gather.
Punchline.Translated: 快速找到自动采集所需的鱼饵。

Description.Original: Select a saved GatherBuddy Reborn Auto-Gather list and highlight its required fishing bait in supported inventory windows. Mooch routes and source fish bait are included, and spearfishing items are skipped. Overall and per-window highlighting switches. Reads the saved list without modifying it. Seven UI languages. In-game overlay placement is pending verification.
Description.Translated: 选择已保存的 GatherBuddy Reborn 自动采集清单，在支持的物品窗口中高亮所需鱼饵。包含以小钓大路线和前置鱼所需鱼饵，跳过刺鱼项目。提供总开关和各窗口独立的高亮开关。只读取保存的清单，不会修改它。支持七种界面语言。游戏内叠加层位置尚待验证。

Punchline.Original: Put the camera on anyone — right-click them and pick Zoom In.
Punchline.Translated: 把镜头对准任何人——右键点击对方，选择“放大”。

Description.Original:
Right-click any character in the world, on the party list or in chat and pick Zoom In. The camera swings around to face them and moves in close, and it stays on them as they move.

• Nearby list: everyone around you with job icons, distance and a name search. Double-click to zoom, right-click for options.
• Framing pad: drag to slide the view around them to set up the shot.
• Mirror: look at yourself from the front to check your glam or expression.
• Player Sync / Lightless: filter the list to synced people, with PS / LL badges.
• Top bar button to open it, showing who you're zoomed on.

When you stop, the camera returns behind you at your old zoom. It stops on its own if they leave, you zone, a cutscene starts or you enter combat — all adjustable in settings.
Description.Translated:
右键点击场景、小队列表或聊天中的任意角色，并选择“放大”。镜头会转到对方面前并拉近，在其移动时继续跟随。

• 附近玩家列表：显示职业图标、距离，支持按姓名搜索。双击放大，右键查看更多选项。
• 构图面板：拖动以调整围绕目标的视角，安排构图。
• 镜子：从正面查看自己，检查幻化或表情。
• Player Sync／Lightless：按同步关系筛选列表，显示 PS／LL 标识。
• 顶栏按钮：点击打开，并显示当前镜头锁定的对象。

停止后，镜头恢复到你身后及原来的缩放距离。目标离开、切换区域、开始过场动画或进入战斗时会自动停止，这些行为均可调整。

Punchline.Original: A Doman Mahjong tutor: hand analysis, reviews and hints that never play for you.
Punchline.Translated: 多玛方城战教学助手：分析手牌、复盘和提示，但绝不代你出牌。

Description.Original:
Ukeire watches your Doman Mahjong table and helps you learn Riichi strategy.
It shows shanten and tile acceptance, reviews each discard after you make it, warns about dangerous tiles when an opponent is in riichi, and points out yaku you can aim for.
Hints come in tiers (nudge, pointer, answer) and only appear when you ask. The plugin never clicks, discards or calls for you, and it only reads what you can already see at the table.
Description.Translated:
Ukeire 观察多玛方城战牌桌，帮助你学习立直麻将策略。
显示向听数和进张，在每次出牌后进行评估，对手立直时提醒危险牌，并指出可争取的役种。
提示分为启发、指引和答案三个层级，仅在你主动请求时显示。插件不会代你点击、出牌或鸣牌，只读取你在牌桌上本就能看到的信息。

Punchline.Original: Phone notification when your Party Finder party fills, or members join or leave.
Punchline.Translated: 招募队伍满员，或成员加入、离开时发送手机通知。

Description.Original:
Watches your party and sends a notification to your phone through a self-hosted ntfy server when it reaches full size, and optionally when members join or leave, so you can step away while recruiting.
Read-only: it only observes your own client and never sends anything to the game servers.
Needs an ntfy topic and access token; set them with /pfnotify. Alpha, for FC members; not intended for the official repository.
Description.Translated:
监测你的小队，满员时通过自建 ntfy 服务器向手机发送通知，也可选择在成员加入或离开时通知，方便你招募期间暂时离开。
只读运行：仅观察本地客户端，不向游戏服务器发送任何内容。
需要 ntfy 主题和访问令牌，通过 /pfnotify 设置。面向部队成员的 Alpha 版本，不打算加入官方插件仓库。

Punchline.Original: Find the most profitable items to craft, flip or gather.
Punchline.Translated: 找出制作、转卖或采集收益最高的物品。

Description.Original: Track craftable items and compare flipping, crafting and gathering profit using Universalis market data.
Description.Translated: 追踪可制作物品，使用 Universalis 市场数据比较转卖、制作和采集的利润。

Punchline.Original: Keeps the armoury chest to the gear your jobs need.
Punchline.Translated: 让兵装库只保留各职业需要的装备。

Description.Original: Looks at every job you have and every piece you can wear. A piece is obsolete when every job that wears it already has something better; what stays is the best from now on (same item level: the lower level; same level: the higher item level). A preview shows each piece's verdict and why; right-click an item to make it an exception that is never obsolete.
Description.Translated: 检查你已解锁的每个职业及可穿戴的所有装备。若能穿某件装备的所有职业都已有更好的替代品，则将其判为过时；保留从当前等级起最有用的装备，同品级优先需求等级较低者，同需求等级优先品级较高者。预览中显示每件装备的判定和理由；右键物品可将其设为例外，永不判为过时。

Punchline.Original: All-in-one Eureka suite: aggro radars, live tracker sync, bunny helpers and Logos & Loot errands.
Punchline.Translated: 优雷卡全能套件：仇恨雷达、实时追踪器同步、幸福兔助手，以及文理与战利品相关杂务辅助。

Description.Original: All-in-one quality-of-life suite for Eureka (Anemos, Pagos, Pyros, Hydatos). Features lethal aggro radar visualizers (sleeping dragon sound aggro, low HP blood aggro, sprite magic aggro, vision cones, combat cast alerts), real-time ffxiv-eureka.com Phoenix WebSocket tracker synchronization, bunny FATE timer and coffer markers, and Logos & Loot errands. Bunny FATE automation is unlocked by a privately granted access package.
Description.Translated: 覆盖优雷卡常风、恒冰、涌火和丰水之地的一体化便利工具。提供高危仇恨范围雷达，包括睡龙的声音感知、低生命值触发的生命感知、元素精灵的魔法感知、视线锥形范围与战斗读条警报；通过 Phoenix WebSocket 实时同步 ffxiv-eureka.com 追踪器；提供幸福兔临危受命计时、宝箱标记，以及文理与战利品相关杂务辅助。幸福兔临危受命自动化功能需要私下授予的访问授权包才能解锁。

Punchline.Original: Changes your outfit (equipment only) from Glamourer designs or Penumbra mods when you change zones or enter duties.
Punchline.Translated: 切换区域或进入副本时，使用 Glamourer 设计或 Penumbra 模组更换穿搭，仅修改装备。

Description.Original: Applies the equipment portion of your saved Glamourer designs to your own character after zone changes, teleports and duty entry. Hair, face, skin, body, identity and visual effects are never changed. Can also pick a random enabled Penumbra mod and wear the armor it changes. Requires Glamourer; Penumbra is needed for mod outfits.
Description.Translated: 切换区域、传送或进入副本后，将已保存 Glamourer 设计中的装备部分应用到自己的角色。绝不修改头发、面部、肤色、身体、身份或视觉特效。也可随机选取已启用的 Penumbra 模组，并穿上其替换的装备。需要 Glamourer，模组穿搭另需 Penumbra。

Punchline.Original: Marks your missing aether currents on the map
Punchline.Translated: 在地图上标记尚未交感的风脉泉。

Description.Original: Draws a marker on the map at every aether current you haven't unlocked in the current zone, and on the quest giver of every available quest that rewards one. Markers are drawn as an overlay: the plugin never places in-game map markers and leaves those from the game or other plugins alone. Both marker icons are configurable.
Description.Translated: 在地图上标记当前区域尚未交感的风脉泉，以及所有当前可接取、奖励风脉泉的任务发布者。标记以叠加层绘制，不会放置游戏内地图标记，也不干扰游戏或其他插件的标记。两类标记图标均可自定义。

Punchline.Original: ツールチップの追加情報を見やすく表示
Punchline.Translated: 清晰展示提示框中的额外信息。

Description.Original: アイテム・アクションの追加情報を専用パネルに表示します。価格情報の分離、収納状態・衣装セット、追加パッチの表示に対応。
Description.Translated: 在专用面板中显示物品与技能的补充信息。支持分离价格信息，以及显示收纳状态、套装和加入版本。

Punchline.Original: Chain Quick Synthesis beyond 99 crafts.
Punchline.Translated: 连续执行简易制作，突破 99 次上限。

Description.Original: Automatic Quick Synthesis chaining beyond 99 crafts, NQ-only crafting, material and progress tracking, and configurable equipped-gear self-repair.
Description.Translated: 自动衔接简易制作，突破 99 次上限；支持仅制作 NQ、材料与进度追踪，以及可配置的已装备物品自行修理。

Punchline.Original: A reference board inside the game: drop images, zoom, move them around.
Punchline.Translated: 游戏内参考图板：放入图片，自由缩放和移动。

Description.Original:
A reference board in a game window: drag images from the Windows explorer or paste them, zoom with the mouse wheel, move, resize and crop them. Several boards, which you can share with other players as a single file, a locked mode where only the images stay and clicks go to the game, customizable keyboard shortcuts, and automatic hiding in cutscenes, gpose, combat or loading screens.
Available in English and French. Command: /refboard
Description.Translated:
游戏窗口内的参考图板：从 Windows 文件资源管理器拖入或粘贴图片，用鼠标滚轮缩放，并可移动、调整大小和裁剪。支持多个图板，可导出为单个文件与其他玩家分享；锁定模式仅保留图片显示，鼠标点击穿透到游戏；支持自定义快捷键，以及在过场动画、集体动作、战斗或加载画面中自动隐藏。
支持英语和法语。命令：/refboard

Punchline.Original: Favorite friends, purge the rest.
Punchline.Translated: 收藏重要好友，清理其余好友。

Description.Original:
Pin favorite friends to the top of a cleaner friend list, and bulk-remove everyone else.
Open with /flqol.
Description.Translated:
将收藏的好友固定在更简洁的好友列表顶部，并批量移除其他人。
使用 /flqol 打开。

Punchline.Original: All of creation, in the palm of your hand!
Punchline.Translated: 万物创造，尽在掌中！

Description.Original:
Design layouts with extra scene objects in the game world. Perfect for decorating venues, immersive RP, or gposing backdrops! 
Use /stagehand to get started.
Description.Translated:
在游戏世界中添加额外场景物体并设计布局，适合装饰活动场所、沉浸式角色扮演或集体动作拍照背景！
使用 /stagehand 开始。

Punchline.Original: Map-based Aetheryte and Aethernet navigation.
Punchline.Translated: 基于地图的以太之光和都市传送网导航。

Description.Original: Click supported Aetherytes or Aethernet shards on the map to travel automatically. AethernetAssist handles teleports and walking to nearby crystals when needed. It also provides a compact interface for city and residential Aethernet, housing ward travel, Cosmic Exploration, and same-data-center World Visit.
Description.Translated: 点击地图上受支持的以太之光或都市传送网节点，即可自动前往。AethernetAssist 会处理传送，并在必要时步行至附近水晶。还为城市及住宅区传送网、住宅小区移动、宇宙探索和同数据中心跨服访问提供紧凑界面。

Punchline.Original: Layer Glamourer, Penumbra, Honorific and Moodles into virtual designs applied with a single redraw.
Punchline.Translated: 将 Glamourer、Penumbra、Honorific 和 Moodles 叠加成虚拟设计，一次重绘即可应用。

Description.Original:
Lamina takes appearance automation further with virtual designs: layer multiple Glamourer designs, Penumbra mod states, Honorific titles and Moodles statuses through rulesets, then apply the resolved look in one pass with a single redraw.

• Virtual designs combine rulesets into one final Glamourer, Penumbra, Honorific and Moodles state.
• Switch between characters and situations in one click without flicker.
• Works with Vitrine (separate, optional plugin): use its designs as layers in your passes.
Description.Translated:
Lamina 通过虚拟设计增强外观自动化：使用规则集叠加多个 Glamourer 设计、Penumbra 模组状态、Honorific 称号和 Moodles 状态，再通过一次重绘统一应用最终外观。

• 虚拟设计将规则集合成为最终的 Glamourer、Penumbra、Honorific 和 Moodles 状态。
• 一键切换不同角色和场景方案，无闪烁。
• 可与独立的可选插件 Vitrine 配合，将其设计用作叠加层。

Punchline.Original: Browse, organise and try on your Penumbra mods without touching Penumbra.
Punchline.Translated: 无需操作 Penumbra，即可浏览、整理并试穿其中的模组。

Description.Original:
Vitrine catalogues every Penumbra mod by what it changes, shows it as a card with its display photo, and lets you preview it on your character: the mod is enabled, a full set of its gear is equipped through Glamourer and replaced emotes are played.

• Mods organised by category (outfits, hair, faces, animations, VFX, ...) with search and filters.
• Display photos pulled from the mod folder or the mod's page.
• Baseline settings and variants per mod, previewable in one click.
• Read-only overview of your collections and who uses them.
• Exposes its designs over IPC so Lamina can layer them into virtual designs.
Description.Translated:
Vitrine 按模组修改的内容整理所有 Penumbra 模组，以带预览照片的卡片展示，并支持在角色上预览：启用模组，通过 Glamourer 穿上其对应的整套装备，并播放被替换的情感动作。

• 按服装、头发、面部、动画、视觉特效等类别整理模组，支持搜索和筛选。
• 从模组文件夹或模组页面获取展示照片。
• 为每个模组设置基础配置和变体，一键预览。
• 只读查看模组集合及其使用者。
• 通过 IPC 提供设计，供 Lamina 叠加为虚拟设计。

Punchline.Original: Batch materia transmutation with Mutamix.
Punchline.Translated: 在缪塔米克斯处批量合成魔晶石。

Description.Original: Select and transmute materia with Mutamix using configurable inventory rules.
Description.Translated: 根据可配置的库存规则，选择魔晶石并在缪塔米克斯处进行合成。

Punchline.Original: Hide plugin windows from your stream (OBS and other capture software) while you keep seeing them.
Punchline.Translated: 在 OBS 等录制软件的画面中隐藏插件窗口，而你自己的屏幕仍能看到。

Description.Original:
Choose what your stream sees: hide a whole plugin, or only its main window, its settings or some of its windows, from OBS and other capture software (game, window and display capture). They stay visible on your screen. Texts that plugins add inside game windows (for example Character Panel Refined in the Character window) can be hidden too.
Requires Dalamud's "Enable multi-monitor windows" setting, the game in windowed or borderless window mode, and more than one monitor.
Available in English and French. Command: /offstream
Description.Translated:
决定直播观众能看到什么：在 OBS 等捕获软件的游戏、窗口和显示器捕获中，隐藏整个插件，或只隐藏主窗口、设置窗口及部分指定窗口；这些内容在你自己的屏幕上仍然可见。插件添加到游戏窗口内的文字也可隐藏，例如 Character Panel Refined 在角色窗口中添加的信息。
需要启用 Dalamud 的“启用多显示器窗口”设置，使用窗口或无边框窗口模式，并拥有不止一台显示器。
支持英语和法语。命令：/offstream

Punchline.Original: FFXIV en español latino: tooltips de combate e historia principal.
Punchline.Translated: 将 FFXIV 的战斗提示与主线剧情翻译为拉丁美洲西班牙语。

Description.Original: Traduce al español latino los tooltips de habilidades, rasgos y estados (buffs y debuffs) y la historia principal: diálogos, cinemáticas, Journal y Duty List. La historia está traducida desde el inicio en las tres ciudades y, en Gridania, hasta The Gridanian Envoy. También las misiones de clase de Lancer (nivel 1 a 30). Los nombres propios se mantienen en inglés.
Description.Translated: 将技能、特性和状态（增益与减益）提示，以及主线剧情中的对话、过场动画、任务日志和任务列表翻译为拉丁美洲西班牙语。覆盖三座初始城市的开篇剧情，其中格里达尼亚路线已翻译到“格里达尼亚的使者”任务；还包含枪术师 1 至 30 级的职业任务。专有名称保留英文。

Punchline.Original: 製作計画と素材を、ひとつのリストに。
Punchline.Translated: 将制作计划与所需材料整合到同一份清单。

Description.Original: 製作アイテムの検索、製作リストの保存、素材合算、所持品とリテイナー記録の照合。
Description.Translated: 搜索可制作物品、保存制作清单、汇总材料，并与背包及雇员记录核对。

Punchline.Original: Find, run and copy commands grouped by active plugin.
Punchline.Translated: 按已启用插件分组，查找、执行和复制命令。

Description.Original: Browse active plugin names, icons and descriptions. Run or copy commands, edit arguments and add subcommands. Optional Japanese description translation via Google without an API key. Seven UI languages. Open with /commandatlas.
Description.Translated: 浏览已启用插件的名称、图标和说明，执行或复制命令、编辑参数并添加子命令。可选择通过 Google 将说明翻译成日语，无需 API 密钥。支持七种界面语言。使用 /commandatlas 打开。

Punchline.Original: Ctrl-right-click to move items.
Punchline.Translated: 按住 Ctrl 并右键点击来移动物品。

Description.Original: Hold Ctrl and right-click to transfer items between your inventory and open storage.
Description.Translated: 按住 Ctrl 并右键点击，即可在背包和当前打开的储物空间之间转移物品。

Punchline.Original: Two extra tabs inside the original chat window.
Punchline.Translated: 在原生聊天窗口中添加两个额外标签页。

Description.Original: Global client testing plugin. Adds a rounded pair of native tabs after the original chat controls, preserving the native add, settings and close buttons. Each extra tab selects its message types in /nct; the fourth native log panel remains the rendering slot.
Description.Translated: 面向国际服客户端的测试插件。在原生聊天控件后添加两个圆角原生标签页，保留原有的添加、设置和关闭按钮。可通过 /nct 为每个额外标签选择消息类型；仍使用第四个原生日志面板作为渲染位置。

Punchline.Original: Grand Company supply and provisioning, delivered for you.
Punchline.Translated: 替你完成大国防联军的筹备任务。

Description.Original:
Delivers your Grand Company supply and provisioning requests for you: reads the day's requests, buys what is missing through Auto Shopper, then travels to your Personnel Officer and hands in the ones you chose, confirming every delivery.

Plugin from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeldarAlz/DalamudPlugins/main/repo.json
Description.Translated:
自动完成大国防联军的军需品与补给品筹备：读取当日需求，通过 Auto Shopper 购买缺少的物品，再前往人事负责人处交付你选定的项目，并确认每次交付。

插件来源：https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeldarAlz/DalamudPlugins/main/repo.json

Punchline.Original: Housing lotteries, entered for you.
Punchline.Translated: 替你参加房屋抽签。

Description.Original:
Enters housing lotteries for you: pick an empty plot on the map or build a shortlist, and the plugin travels there, enters the lottery, then checks the result and collects your refund or claims your house.

Plugin from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeldarAlz/DalamudPlugins/main/repo.json
Description.Translated:
替你参加房屋抽签：在地图上选择空地，或建立候选清单，插件会自动前往、登记抽签，再检查结果并领取退款或房屋。

插件来源：https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeldarAlz/DalamudPlugins/main/repo.json

Punchline.Original: Your retainer listings, sold for you.
Punchline.Translated: 替你通过雇员上架出售物品。

Description.Original:
Sells through your retainers for you: set what to sell and the lowest price you accept, and the plugin visits each retainer at a summoning bell, compares market prices, reprices and lists your items without ever going below that price, and records every sale.

Plugin from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeldarAlz/DalamudPlugins/main/repo.json
Description.Translated:
替你通过雇员出售物品：设置出售清单及最低接受价格后，插件会在传唤铃处依次召唤雇员，比较市场价格，调整售价并上架，绝不低于设定底价，同时记录每笔销售。

插件来源：https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeldarAlz/DalamudPlugins/main/repo.json

Punchline.Original: Your market board shopping list, bought for you.
Punchline.Translated: 替你买齐市场布告板购物清单。

Description.Original:
Buys your market board shopping list for you: plans the cheapest route through Universalis prices across the worlds you allow, travels between them with Lifestream, walks to the market board, buys whole listings within your price caps, and confirms every purchase.

Plugin from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeldarAlz/DalamudPlugins/main/repo.json
Description.Translated:
替你完成市场布告板购物清单：根据 Universalis 价格，在你允许的服务器中规划最便宜的采购路线，使用 Lifestream 跨服，步行至市场布告板，在价格上限内整组购买在售物品，并确认每笔购买。

插件来源：https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeldarAlz/DalamudPlugins/main/repo.json

Punchline.Original: 日本語で使える、高度にカスタマイズ可能なHUD置き換えプラグイン。
Punchline.Translated: 支持日语的高度可自定义 HUD 替换插件。

Description.Original: DelvUIをベースに、設定画面・コマンド案内を日本語化したHUD置き換えプラグインです。プレイヤー・ターゲット・パーティ・ジョブHUDなどを自由に配置できます。
Description.Translated: 基于 DelvUI，将设置界面和命令说明日语化的 HUD 替换插件。可自由布置玩家、目标、小队和职业 HUD 等元素。

Punchline.Original: FF14の便利な機能を日本語で設定できます。
Punchline.Translated: 通过日语界面设置 FF14 的各种便利功能。

Description.Original:
Simple Tweaksの機能名、説明、設定画面、更新履歴を日本語にした派生版です。
本家とは別InternalNameで配布するため、プラグイン一覧で本家に隠されません。
/tweaksコマンドが共通のため、本家と同時に有効にしないでください。
原作者：CaraxiおよびSimpleTweaksPluginの貢献者。AGPL-3.0。
Description.Translated:
将 Simple Tweaks 的功能名称、说明、设置界面和更新日志翻译为日语的衍生版本。
使用与原版不同的 InternalName 发布，因此不会在插件列表中被原版覆盖隐藏。
由于共用 /tweaks 命令，请勿与原版同时启用。
原作者：Caraxi 及 SimpleTweaksPlugin 贡献者。采用 AGPL-3.0 许可证。

Punchline.Original: One-shot gil-vendor shopping with permanent lists and automation status.
Punchline.Translated: 一次性执行吉尔商店采购，提供持久保存的清单和自动化状态。

Description.Original: Persistent currency lists, right-click item adding, native commands, mounted-flight vendor navigation and verified one-shot purchases. Beast Tribe / Allied Society vendors are excluded, including their gil shops. Development build; live testing required.
Description.Translated: 提供持久保存的货币采购清单、右键添加物品、原生命令、骑乘飞行前往商人的导航，以及带结果核验的单次购买。排除友好部族商人，包括其吉尔商店。开发版本，仍需实机测试。

Punchline.Original: Auto-tracks your weekly Eureka challenge log kills.
Punchline.Translated: 自动追踪每周优雷卡攻略笔记的击杀进度。

Description.Original:
Alpha.

Tracks the Eureka elemental challenge log while you play.

When you kill an enemy in Eureka that you get credit for, the plugin works out what it was - fire, ice, wind, earth, lightning or water aspected, a sprite, or an ashkin - and adds 1 to the matching counter, so your progress toward the weekly Elemental challenge log is always one banished glance away.

Every counter row also has a Track button. Switch it on and the plugin draws a line in the 3D view from your hitbox to every enemy that row would count, so you can find your ashkin or your fire aspected without having to target anything first. Element rows accept mobs up to two levels below you, sprites and ashkin must be your level or higher, exactly as the challenge log itself counts them.

Starting numbers: set them once in the window to match the current in-game log, use the +/- buttons, and hit the reset button when the week rolls over.

Enemy elements come from a bundled map of the four zones' enemies, and the aspect the game shows on a nameplate is picked up automatically. An enemy the plugin cannot place is not counted.
Description.Translated:
Alpha 版本。

在游玩期间追踪优雷卡元素攻略笔记。

击杀优雷卡中可计入进度的敌人时，插件会判断它属于火、冰、风、土、雷、水中的哪种属性，或是否为元素精灵、亡灵，并为相应计数加 1，让每周攻略笔记的进度一目了然。

每行计数都有追踪按钮。开启后，插件会在 3D 场景中从你的受击判定位置向所有符合该行条件的敌人画线，无需先选中目标，也能找到亡灵或火属性敌人。元素属性条目接受比你低至多 2 级的怪物；元素精灵和亡灵必须与你同级或更高，与攻略笔记的实际规则一致。

初始数值：在窗口中手动设为当前游戏内笔记的进度，使用 +/- 按钮调整，每周更新后点击重置。

敌人属性来自内置的四张区域敌人数据表，也会自动读取游戏姓名板显示的属性。无法识别的敌人不会计数。

Punchline.Original: Reduces the effects of lag on weaving and statuses, with a ping you choose.
Punchline.Translated: 减轻网络延迟对技能穿插和状态的影响，并可自行选择模拟延迟。

Description.Original:
Alpha.

A fork of UnknownX's NoClippy. Reduces the effects of lag on certain aspects of the game, such as weaving and statuses, and can show GCD clips. Pick the ping the animation lock simulates (0 to 100 ms, 8 ms by default) from the Overview tab; logging, dry run and encounter stats live under Settings.

/xclip opens the window. Turn off NoClippy while you use it: both change the same animation lock.
Description.Translated:
Alpha 版本。

UnknownX 的 NoClippy 分支，减轻网络延迟对技能穿插、状态等机制的影响，并可显示公共冷却延误。在总览页选择动作锁模拟的延迟，范围 0 至 100 毫秒，默认为 8 毫秒；日志、试运行和战斗统计位于设置页。

使用 /xclip 打开窗口。使用时请关闭 NoClippy，因为两者会修改同一套动作锁。

Punchline.Original: Automatic submarine management, from the comfort of your bed.
Punchline.Translated: 舒舒服服躺在床上，也能自动管理潜水艇。

Description.Original:
Alpha.

Submarine-focused fork of AutoRetainer. Manages unlocking, levelling and profit routes for your submersibles across characters, sells submarine salvage at the Limsa vendor (needs Lifestream and vnavmesh), runs Salvage Mode on the MultiMode loop, and sends gil from your alts to a host character that runs OrangeJuice Host.
Description.Translated:
Alpha 版本。

专注潜水艇的 AutoRetainer 分支。跨角色管理潜水艇的解锁、升级和收益航线；在利姆萨·罗敏萨商人处出售潜水艇打捞品，需要 Lifestream 和 vnavmesh；在 MultiMode 循环中执行打捞模式；并将小号的吉尔转交给运行 OrangeJuice Host 的收款角色。

Punchline.Original: Receives gil from OrangeJuice alts.
Punchline.Translated: 接收 OrangeJuice 小号转来的吉尔。

Description.Original:
Alpha.

Runs on the client of the character that collects gil. Pairs with OrangeJuice, reports where it is standing, and accepts only the trades OrangeJuice announced. /ojh opens it, /ojh pair prints the pairing code in chat.
Description.Translated:
Alpha 版本。

运行于收款角色的客户端，与 OrangeJuice 配对，报告自身站位，并仅接受 OrangeJuice 预告过的交易。/ojh 打开窗口，/ojh pair 在聊天中显示配对码。

Punchline.Original: TEA phase 2: tells you who to swap Judgment Nisi with on passes 3 and 4.
Punchline.Translated: 亚历山大绝境战二阶段：提示第 3、4 次非最终审判传递时应与谁交换。

Description.Original:
Overlay for The Epic of Alexander (Ultimate), Brute Justice / Cruise Chaser phase.
Shows, for the 3rd and 4th Nisi pass, which Nisi to pass or collect, who to swap with,
a countdown for the pass window, and the remaining time on your own Nisi.
Logic and timings are derived from the Cactbot TEA triggers/timeline.
Description.Translated:
用于亚历山大绝境战残暴正义号／巡航驱逐者阶段的叠加提示。
显示第 3、4 次非最终审判传递时需要交出或接取的类型、交换对象、
传递窗口倒计时，以及自己状态的剩余时间。
逻辑与时序来自 Cactbot 的亚历山大绝境战触发器和时间轴。

Punchline.Original: AnoMech with an LPDU Party Synergy strat and a pause. Go to an inn and start practice.
Punchline.Translated: 加入 LPDU 协作程序PT 打法和暂停功能的 AnoMech，前往旅馆即可开始练习。

Description.Original: A modified version of AnoMech by Anomek (https://github.com/anomek/AnoMech) that adds an EU LPDU strat for TOP P2 Party Synergy and a pause for studying mechanics mid-run. Spawns fake party members and bosses client-side so you can practice raid mechanics without a full party. Disable AnoMech while using NoirMech. Source: https://github.com/NoirYamato/DalamudPlugins
Description.Translated: 基于 Anomek 的 AnoMech（https://github.com/anomek/AnoMech）修改，加入欧服 LPDU 的欧米茄绝境验证战 P2 协作程序PT 打法，以及中途暂停研究机制的功能。在本地客户端生成模拟队友与首领，无需组满队伍即可练习团队机制。使用 NoirMech 时请禁用 AnoMech。源码：https://github.com/NoirYamato/DalamudPlugins

Punchline.Original: A searchable achievement log.
Punchline.Translated: 支持搜索的成就日志。

Description.Original: Replaces the vanilla achievement log with a searchable window: the game's categories, search across names, descriptions, categories and rewards (in the game's language and English), filters (status, rewards, sort), progress, recently completed, and controller support.
Description.Translated: 用可搜索窗口替换原生成就日志。保留游戏分类，可使用客户端语言或英语搜索名称、说明、类别和奖励，支持状态、奖励和排序筛选、进度显示、最近完成记录，以及手柄操作。

Punchline.Original: Mutes ambient sound when it gets crowded.
Punchline.Translated: 人多时自动静音环境音。

Description.Original: Counts nearby players and sets the Ambient Sounds volume to 0 when the count passes a threshold, then restores your volume when the area clears. Settings: /crowdmute
Description.Translated: 统计附近玩家数量，超过阈值时将环境音音量设为 0，人群散去后恢复原音量。设置命令：/crowdmute。

Punchline.Original: Local collection snapshots and sharing.
Punchline.Translated: 本地收藏快照与共享。

Description.Original: Exportaramus conjures your FFXIV collections into portable data. It captures and keeps track of everything from mounts, minions, outfits, and orchestrion rolls to achievements, quests, Triple Triad cards, relics, and more—across 25 collection types. Keep your collection snapshot up to date automatically or with a guided refresh, then share it with other plugins and services, or export it as ready-to-use JSON.
Description.Translated: Exportaramus 将你的 FFXIV 收藏变为可携带的数据，记录坐骑、宠物、服装、管弦乐琴乐谱、成就、任务、九宫幻卡、成长武器等共 25 类收藏。可自动更新快照，或按引导刷新，再与其他插件和服务共享，或导出为可直接使用的 JSON。

Punchline.Original: 모집글 조회·수동 갱신과 소개말·허용 직업 수정 및 목적 선택 진단
Punchline.Translated: 查看与手动刷新招募，修改介绍和允许职业，并诊断目的选择。

Description.Original: 한섭 파티원·모집글 조회와 내 모집글 수동 갱신. /pvkr에서 확인하고 버튼으로 현재 조건의 모집글을 한 번 재등록합니다.
Description.Translated: 查看韩服队员和招募信息，并手动刷新自己的招募。使用 /pvkr 查看，再点击按钮按当前条件重新发布一次招募。

Punchline.Original: Roulettes and Wondrous Tails for your party.
Punchline.Translated: 与你的小队协调随机任务与天书奇谈。

Description.Original: Compare daily roulettes and Wondrous Tails with your party, and get advice on your journal.
Description.Translated: 与队友比较每日随机任务和天书奇谈进度，并获取天书完成建议。

Punchline.Original: Show small cast bars above party members.
Punchline.Translated: 在队友头顶显示小型咏唱条。

Description.Original: Displays the skill name and casting progress above other party members. Instant actions are hidden. Size, position and player scope are configurable.
Description.Translated: 在其他队友头顶显示技能名称和咏唱进度，不显示瞬发技能。可配置大小、位置和适用玩家范围。

Punchline.Original: Track team scores from FFXIV /random rolls.
Punchline.Translated: 根据 FFXIV 的 /random 掷点记录队伍得分。

Description.Original: Track Tug of War scores from /random 100 rolls and import current party members into teams.
Description.Translated: 根据 /random 100 的掷点记录拔河比赛分数，并可将当前队员导入各队。

Punchline.Original: Builds the best Blue Mage spell set from the spells you have learned.
Punchline.Translated: 从已学会的青魔法中构建最合适的技能组合。

Description.Original: Reads which Blue Mage spells you have learned and builds a 24-spell active set for the content you pick: solo and FATE leveling, dungeons, trials and raids, tanking or healing. Shows why each spell made the cut, lists the spells worth learning next and where to get them, and applies the set with one click when you are out of combat.
Description.Translated: 读取你已学会的青魔法，根据所选内容生成包含 24 个技能的装备方案，适用于单人、临危受命练级、迷宫、讨伐歼灭战、团队任务，以及防护或治疗职责。说明每个技能的入选理由，列出下一步值得学习的技能及获取地点，并可在脱战时一键应用。

Punchline.Original: Automate treasure hunts for you.
Punchline.Translated: 自动为你寻宝。

Description.Original: Automate treasure hunts for you. Requires some setup.
Description.Translated: 自动为你寻宝，需要进行一些设置。

Punchline.Original: Make AutoDuty farm Allagan Tomestones of Mathematics.
Punchline.Translated: 让 AutoDuty 自动刷取亚拉戈数理神典石。

Description.Original: Loops a chosen duty through AutoDuty and stops when your Mathematics target or run limit is reached. Tracks tomestones/hour per duty. Requires AutoDuty.
Description.Translated: 通过 AutoDuty 循环指定副本，达到数理神典石目标或运行次数上限后停止，并按副本统计每小时获得的神典石。需要 AutoDuty。

Punchline.Original: Doman Mahjong, solved for you.
Punchline.Translated: 替你打好多玛方城战。

Description.Original: Reads Doman Mahjong, computes the best discard and call, shows a suggestion overlay, and can play for you.
Description.Translated: 读取多玛方城战牌局，计算最佳出牌与鸣牌，显示建议叠加层，也可代你操作。

Punchline.Original: Treasure maps, dug up for you.
Punchline.Translated: 替你挖掘藏宝图。

Description.Original:
Works through your timeworn maps for you: deciphers each map in your bags, travels to the dig spot, digs up the coffer, fights off its guards and opens it, then moves on to the next map. When your bags run dry it can gather the daily timeworn map as a Miner or Botanist and buy more on the market board under your price caps and gil budget.

Plugin from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeldarAlz/DalamudPlugins/main/repo.json
Description.Translated:
自动处理背包中的陈旧地图：逐张解读，前往藏宝地点，挖出宝箱，击败守卫并开启，然后继续下一张。地图用完后，可使用采矿工或园艺工采集每日陈旧地图，也可在你设定的单价上限和吉尔预算内从市场布告板补购。

插件来源：https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeldarAlz/DalamudPlugins/main/repo.json

Punchline.Original: Make sense of the Gamba floor.
Punchline.Translated: 看懂 Gamba 赌局中的状况。

Description.Original: Modular Aetherphone Gamba companion with live rewards, Barkeep automation, guarded batches, profit tracking and theme matching.
Description.Translated: 模块化的 Aetherphone Gamba 配套工具，提供实时奖励、Barkeep 自动化、带保护条件的批量执行、收益追踪和主题匹配。

Punchline.Original: Optional Sentinel ecosystem control center.
Punchline.Translated: 可选的 Sentinel 生态控制中心。

Description.Original: Sentinel ecosystem control center with health/dependency checks, sanitized diagnostics, compatibility protection, passive player inspection and collections and recent activity. Other Sentinel plugins remain independent.
Description.Translated: Sentinel 生态控制中心，提供健康与依赖检查、脱敏诊断、兼容性保护、被动玩家信息查看、收藏和最近活动。其他 Sentinel 插件仍可独立运行。

Punchline.Original: Expose FFXIV game memory to AI agents over MCP.
Punchline.Translated: 通过 MCP 向 AI 智能体开放 FFXIV 游戏内存读取。

Description.Original: Hosts a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server on a local port so that agents can read FINAL FANTASY XIV game memory via Dalamud and FFXIVClientStructs.
Description.Translated: 在本地端口运行模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器，使智能体可通过 Dalamud 和 FFXIVClientStructs 读取《最终幻想14》的游戏内存。

Punchline.Original: Recolour or remove the flash when you target something.
Punchline.Translated: 修改或移除选中目标时的闪光。

Description.Original:
Changes the brightness flash the game plays on a character or NPC model when you target it. Turn it off, keep the game's flash, or replace it with your own colour, intensity and fade, with an option to hold the colour for as long as the object stays targeted.

This changes the target flash, not the coloured outline highlight. Purely cosmetic and client-side.

Commands: /targethighlight (settings), /targethighlight none|default|custom|preview

The plugin icon was created with AI assistance.
Description.Translated:
修改游戏在选中角色或 NPC 模型时播放的亮度闪光。可关闭、保留原版，或自定义颜色、强度和淡出效果，也可让颜色在目标被持续选中期间一直保留。

修改的是选中时的闪光，而非彩色轮廓高亮。仅影响本地客户端的视觉效果。

命令：/targethighlight（设置）、/targethighlight none|default|custom|preview

插件图标使用 AI 辅助制作。

Punchline.Original: Counts /slap followed by /hug combos, shown via your Honorific title.
Punchline.Translated: 统计先 /slap 再 /hug 的连招次数，并显示在 Honorific 称号中。

Description.Original: Counts how many times you /slap then /hug right after, and shows the count in your Honorific title.
Description.Translated: 统计你先使用 /slap、随即使用 /hug 的次数，并将计数显示在 Honorific 称号中。

Name.Original: 収集品一括納品 / Collectable Turn In
Name.Translated: 収集品一括納品 / Collectable Turn In

Punchline.Original: 収集品の一括納品とスクリップ交換NPCへの切り替え
Punchline.Translated: 批量交付收藏品，并切换至票据交易 NPC。

Description.Original: 収集品の連続納品・停止・近くのスクリップ取引窓口への切り替え。API 15向けローカル試作版。ゲーム内動作は未検証です。/cti で操作画面を表示。
Description.Translated: 连续交付收藏品、停止交付，并切换到附近的票据交易窗口。面向 API 15 的本地原型版，尚未验证游戏内行为。使用 /cti 打开操作界面。

CollectableTurnIn.Author: Local custom build (based on AtmoOmen / Daily Routines)

Punchline.Original: Here to help manage your EMPIAH!
Punchline.Translated: 帮你管理你的庞大帝国！

Description.Original: Got a massive fleet of submarines? Always struggling to see which ones need upgrades? Wanna see your multi-account fleet at a glance? Give this a try!
Description.Translated: 拥有庞大的潜水艇舰队？总是弄不清哪些需要升级？想一眼查看多个账号的舰队？试试这个！

Punchline.Original: Discard advice and optional auto-play for Doman Mahjong.
Punchline.Translated: 多玛方城战出牌建议与可选的自动对局功能。

Description.Original: Reads your Doman Mahjong hand, discards, dora, scores and called melds, then ranks each discard by hand speed against deal-in risk. Auto-play and file logging are on by default in this build: sit at a casual table and it plays, then /mjadv bundle packages the logs for support. /mjadv stop or the Automation tab returns to manual suggestions instantly. Discard piles and meld strips are found automatically; the node tools are only a fallback.
Description.Translated: 读取多玛方城战的手牌、弃牌、宝牌、分数和副露，综合和牌速度与放铳风险对各出牌方案排序。此版本默认启用自动对局和文件日志：坐到休闲牌桌后便会自动操作；之后可使用 /mjadv bundle 打包日志以便获取支持。使用 /mjadv stop 或自动化标签页可立即切回手动建议模式。自动识别弃牌区和副露区，节点工具仅作备用方案。

Punchline.Original: Track X-Fight Club fights, rolls and brackets in-game.
Punchline.Translated: 在游戏内追踪 X-Fight Club 对战、掷点和赛程。

Description.Original:
Runs X-Fight Club match types inside FFXIV: Basic Rules, Russian Roulette, Battle Royale, Gauntlet, Iron Crown, Tag Team, Power Bottom Extravaganza and more.

Tracks rolls read from chat, damage, eliminations, lives and brackets, and keeps a match history you can export.
Description.Translated:
在 FFXIV 中运行 X-Fight Club 的多种比赛模式，包括基础规则、俄罗斯轮盘、大逃杀、车轮战、铁王冠、组队战、Power Bottom 狂欢等。

读取聊天中的掷点，追踪伤害、淘汰、剩余生命和对阵表，并保存可导出的比赛历史。

Punchline.Original: Your Azeron keypad on screen, labelled with what each button actually does.
Punchline.Translated: 在屏幕上显示 Azeron 单手键盘，并标注每个按键的实际功能。

Description.Original:
Draws your Azeron keypad over the game in the same layout as the Azeron configurator, with every button labelled by what it does in FFXIV.

Buttons bound to a hotbar slot show the real action icon and name, with its cooldown, charges, MP cost, a highlight when a proc is up, and dimming when it can't be used or the target is out of range. Buttons bound to anything else show the keybind's name, so movement, targeting and UI keys are labelled too. The thumbstick is drawn as a stick and its knob follows your thumb.

It reads the profile straight out of Azeron Software, so your binds and your own button labels come across automatically, and edits show up within a couple of seconds. The keypad does not need to be plugged in.

Hidden by default; toggle it with /azeronhud. Size, colours, and what each button shows are all adjustable, and there is a compact mode that shows only your abilities.

Supports the Azeron Cyborg II.
Description.Translated:
按照 Azeron 配置软件中的布局，在游戏画面上绘制 Azeron 单手键盘，并为每个按键标注其在 FFXIV 中的功能。

绑定热键栏格子的按钮会显示实际技能图标和名称、冷却、充能次数及 MP 消耗，触发效果生效时高亮，技能不可用或目标超出距离时变暗。其他按钮显示所绑定操作的名称，因此移动、选定目标和界面快捷键也会有标签。拇指摇杆以摇杆图形显示，摇杆帽会跟随实际输入移动。

直接读取 Azeron Software 配置，因此按键绑定和自定义标签会自动同步，修改后通常几秒内反映出来。无需插入实体键盘。

默认隐藏，使用 /azeronhud 切换显示。大小、颜色和按钮显示内容均可调整，还提供只显示技能的紧凑模式。

支持 Azeron Cyborg II。

Punchline.Original: Colour-code inventory items by where they come from.
Punchline.Translated: 按获取来源为背包物品标色。

Description.Original: When toggled on, draws coloured borders around inventory, retainer, saddlebag and company chest items that are sold for gil or Poetics, gatherable, sold for Grand Company seals, craftable, or storable in the armoire. /vendorhl to toggle, /vendorhl config for settings.
Description.Translated: 启用后，在背包、雇员、陆行鸟鞍囊和部队储物柜中，为可用吉尔或诗学购买、可采集、可用军票兑换、可制作或可存入收藏柜的物品绘制彩色边框。/vendorhl 切换开关，/vendorhl config 打开设置。

Punchline.Original: FATE and CE tool for Bozja and Zadnor
Punchline.Translated: 博兹雅与扎杜诺尔高原的遭遇战和紧急遭遇战工具。

Description.Original: Automate fate travel, CE joining, opening chests and fragements, turn in Field notes and MORE!
Description.Translated: 自动前往遭遇战、加入紧急遭遇战、开启宝箱和鉴定碎晶、交付战果记录，还有更多功能！

Punchline.Original: Let Duckbill guide your next catch.
Punchline.Translated: 让 Duckbill 指引你的下一次收获。

Description.Original:
Let Duckbill guide your next catch.
A fishing companion for FFXIV Korea.

• Browse fish with collection, region and availability filters.
• Choose your next fish by availability and preparation requirements.
• Plan spawns with a timeline and monthly calendar.
• Check baits, mooch chains and time/weather conditions.
• Prepare baits for favorites or filtered fish, with inventory counts.
• Find owned baits with page markers and in-game UI highlights.
• Open fishing spots directly on the map.
• Get local alerts for favorites and uncaught trophy fish at the current hole, with optional sounds.
• See fish available now or soon in the quick list.
• Follow casts with a timer and personal fishing records.

Open: /dbfs or /duckbillfisher. /dbfs cl: compact list; /dbfs ct: casting timer.
UI: English / Korean. Game names follow your client.

Verified on the supported Korean client and Dalamud build only.
Does not automate fishing.
Description.Translated:
让 Duckbill 指引你的下一次垂钓。
FFXIV 韩服的钓鱼伴侣。

• 按收藏、区域和可用性筛选浏览鱼类。
• 根据可用性和准备要求选择下一条鱼。
• 通过时间线和月历规划刷新。
• 查看鱼饵、藏饵链以及时间/天气条件。
• 为收藏或筛选的鱼准备鱼饵，并显示库存数量。
• 通过页面标记和游戏内 UI 高亮找到已拥有的鱼饵。
• 直接在地图上打开钓鱼点。
• 在当前钓场为收藏和未捕获的奖杯鱼获取本地提醒，可选声音。
• 在快速列表中查看现在或即将可用的鱼。
• 通过计时器和个人钓鱼记录跟踪抛竿。

打开：/dbfs 或 /duckbillfisher。/dbfs cl：紧凑列表；/dbfs ct：抛竿计时器。
UI：英语 / 韩语。游戏名称跟随你的客户端。

仅在受支持的韩服客户端和 Dalamud 构建上验证。
不会自动钓鱼。

Name.Original: 服装骨架工作台 (Clothing Skeleton Workshop)

Punchline.Original: Preview an Eorzea Collection glamour and apply it through Glamourer.
Punchline.Translated: 预览 Eorzea Collection 的幻化搭配，并通过 Glamourer 应用。

Description.Original: Preview an Eorzea Collection glamour and apply it through Glamourer.
Description.Translated: 预览 Eorzea Collection 的幻化搭配，并通过 Glamourer 应用。

Punchline.Original: Navigate to known Beastmaster recruit enemies.
Punchline.Translated: 导航至已知可供驯兽师结交的敌人。

Description.Original: Navigate to known Beastmaster recruit enemies from Beast Log data.
Description.Translated: 根据野兽图鉴数据，导航至已知可供驯兽师结交的敌人。

Punchline.Original: PT募集のスパム除去・高機能フィルター・募集主DC表示
Punchline.Translated: 过滤队员招募垃圾信息，提供高级筛选，并显示招募者的数据中心。

Description.Original: リージョン内フリーマッチングで増えたパーティ募集から、検索妨害のような募集を非表示にし、AND/OR/正規表現のルールで絞り込み、募集主のホームDCを表示します。
Description.Translated: 针对同地区自由匹配后增加的队员招募信息，隐藏干扰搜索的招募，支持 AND／OR／正则表达式规则筛选，并显示招募者所属的主数据中心。

Punchline.Original: リプレイでギミック回避を練習
Punchline.Translated: 通过回放练习躲避机制。

Description.Original: A Realm Recorded のリプレイ再生中に、好きなキャラを自分で動かしてギミックの回避を練習します。敵の技が発動した瞬間に、そのキャラが範囲内にいたかを判定します。
Description.Translated: 播放 A Realm Recorded 回放时，可以亲自控制任意角色，练习机制躲避。在敌方技能发动的瞬间，判断该角色是否处于攻击范围内。

Punchline.Original: PvPの対象選択・崩し・生存支援・戦績記録。
Punchline.Translated: PvP 目标选择、崩破提示、生存辅助与战绩记录。

Description.Original: 旧Kuzushi Beacon。ジョブ連動/距離指定の最低HP・最寄り・味方選択、崩し/斬鉄剣、攻撃機会・生存・味方の表示と通知、K/D/A・キルログ・履歴・CSVを統合。個別オンオフ、ジャンル別タブ、通知音量と検証モード。/pvpsupporter で設定。内部ID・既存設定・旧コマンド維持。公開プレビュー：実ゲームでの検知・操作・負荷は未検証です。
Description.Translated: 原名 Kuzushi Beacon。整合按职业或距离设置的最低 HP、最近目标与队友选择，崩破／斩铁剑提示，进攻机会、生存和队友相关显示与通知，以及 K/D/A、击杀日志、历史记录和 CSV。支持各项独立开关、分类标签页、通知音量与验证模式。使用 /pvpsupporter 设置。保留内部 ID、既有设置和旧命令。公开预览版：实际游戏中的检测、操作和性能开销尚未验证。

Punchline.Original: Track market and NPC purchases, gil spending, sellers and taxes.
Punchline.Translated: 记录市场与 NPC 采购、吉尔支出、卖家和税费。

Description.Original: Gil Ledger (formerly Market Ledger) records confirmed market and ordinary gil-shop purchases per character. Filter by source, character, dates, item, seller, quality and amount; chart spending and export CSV. Unclassified gil decreases and observed transfers are kept separately and excluded from purchase totals by default. Preserves Market Ledger history and settings. /gilledger (also /marketledger). Public preview: live-game acceptance remains unverified.
Description.Translated: Gil Ledger（原 Market Ledger）按角色记录已确认的市场和普通吉尔商店采购。支持按来源、角色、日期、物品、卖家、品质和金额筛选，绘制支出图表并导出 CSV。未分类的吉尔减少和观测到的转账单独保存，默认不计入采购总额。保留 Market Ledger 的历史记录和设置。命令：/gilledger，也支持 /marketledger。公开预览版：尚未完成实际游戏验收。

Punchline.Original: A quiet personal PvP overlay and match journal.
Punchline.Translated: 安静不打扰的个人 PvP 悬浮界面与对战日志。

Description.Original: Public preview: observed live kills/deaths, personal kill feed, optional Frontline Battle High assist ranges, official final K/D/A, local history, CSV and optional Discord results. Native in-game integration is not yet verified. Open with /pvpledger. Seven UI languages.
Description.Translated: 公开预览版：记录实时观测到的击杀和死亡，提供个人击杀播报、可选的纷争前线斗志昂扬助攻范围、官方最终 K/D/A、本地历史、CSV，以及可选的 Discord 战果通知。原生游戏内集成尚未验证。使用 /pvpledger 打开。支持七种界面语言。

Punchline.Original: Bringing FFXIV roleplay venues and communities together.
Punchline.Translated: 连接 FFXIV 角色扮演场所与社群。

Description.Original:
Amor RP brings roleplay venues and communities together with group inventories, fictional currency, potion crafting, books, letters, notes, and trading.

/amorrp → Main Menu
Description.Translated:
Amor RP 通过群组库存、虚构货币、药剂制作、书籍、信件、笔记与交易，将角色扮演场所和社群连接起来。

/amorrp → 主菜单

Punchline.Original: Automatic proximity voice
Punchline.Translated: 自动近距离语音。

Description.Original: Automatic world/map proximity voice. /yakin opens the panel. Requires original ProximityVoiceChat local service settings.
Description.Translated: 自动按服务器和地图提供近距离语音。/yakin 打开面板。需要原版 ProximityVoiceChat 的本地服务设置。

Punchline.Original: Keeps a log of who you trade with and how much.
Punchline.Translated: 记录你与谁交易，以及交易了多少。

Description.Original: Records every completed player-to-player trade: the other player, their world, gil given and received, and the items that changed hands. Open the log with /trades to see per-person totals and full history.
Description.Translated: 记录每笔已完成的玩家间交易，包括对方姓名、服务器、付出与收到的吉尔，以及交换的物品。使用 /trades 打开日志，查看按玩家汇总的数据和完整历史。

Punchline.Original: Hop into any plugin from the server info bar.
Punchline.Translated: 从服务器信息栏快速打开任意插件。

Description.Original: Pin any plugin or chat command to the server info bar as a small icon. Click to open it, right-click for its settings. Pick from the game's flat or coloured icons, recolour them, or use your own images.
Description.Translated: 将任意插件或聊天命令以小图标固定到服务器信息栏。点击打开，右键进入设置。可选择游戏的扁平或彩色图标并重新着色，也可使用自己的图片。

Punchline.Original: See who emoted at you, and send it back in one click.
Punchline.Translated: 看看谁对你用了情感动作，一键回礼。

Description.Original:
A small box listing everyone who has recently emoted at you (/dote, /hug, /pet and more), even when they use motion-only emotes or chat messages are hidden.
Emotes you haven't returned stay highlighted. Click "Return" to target that person and send the same emote back.
Description.Translated:
通过小窗口列出最近对你使用情感动作的所有人，包括 /dote、/hug、/pet 等；即使对方只播放动作或隐藏了聊天消息，也能记录。
尚未回礼的动作会持续高亮。点击“回礼”即可选中对方，并回以相同的情感动作。

Punchline.Original: Named presets and notes for the Sanctum VFX Penumbra mod.
Punchline.Translated: 为 Penumbra 的 Sanctum VFX 模组提供命名预设与备注。

Description.Original: Pick effects for each Sanctum VFX slot with searchable dropdowns, save setups as named presets, switch looks with one click or /sanctum <preset>, and keep notes linked to effects and presets that export to a .txt file. Requires Penumbra and the Sanctum VFX 4-Slot mod.
Description.Translated: 通过可搜索的下拉列表为 Sanctum VFX 各槽位选择特效，保存为命名预设，一键或通过 /sanctum <preset> 切换外观；还可为特效和预设关联备注，并导出为 .txt 文件。需要 Penumbra 和 Sanctum VFX 4-Slot 模组。

Punchline.Original: The game's lock-on, without the backpedalling.
Punchline.Translated: 保留游戏的目标锁定，却不用慢慢倒退。

Description.Original:
Use the game's own lock-on camera exactly as normal, but move like you aren't locked on: run and turn in any direction at full speed instead of being forced to face the target, strafe and slowly backpedal.

Only your movement changes. The lock-on camera, framing and target switching are the game's own.

Commands: /targetlock (settings), /targetlock on|off
Description.Translated:
照常使用游戏原生的目标锁定镜头，同时像未锁定时一样移动：可向任意方向全速奔跑和转向，不再被迫面向目标、横移或缓慢倒退。

仅改变移动方式，锁定镜头、构图和目标切换仍由游戏原生功能处理。

命令：/targetlock（设置）、/targetlock on|off

Punchline.Original: translate FFXIV chat with ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini, and filter Party Finder.
Punchline.Translated: 使用 ChatGPT、Claude 或 Gemini 翻译 FFXIV 聊天，并筛选队员招募。

Description.Original: Translates incoming chat into your language and lets you write messages in your own language, translated before sending. Works with your ChatGPT subscription (via Codex CLI login) or an OpenAI, Claude or Gemini API key.
Description.Translated: 将收到的聊天翻译为你的语言，也可用母语编写消息，在发送前自动翻译。支持通过 Codex CLI 登录使用 ChatGPT 订阅，或使用 OpenAI、Claude、Gemini 的 API 密钥。

Punchline.Original: Automatically translates chat messages into the language of your choice.
Punchline.Translated: 自动将聊天消息翻译为你选择的语言。

Description.Original: Detects the language of every chat message and replaces it with a translation in the language you choose (French, English, German, Japanese and more). Click the language tag to see the original message. The settings window follows your game language (English, French, German or Japanese). Message text is sent to Google Translate or DeepL for translation. Use /htranslate to open the settings.
Description.Translated: 识别每条聊天消息的语言，并替换为所选语言的译文，支持法语、英语、德语、日语等。点击语言标签可查看原文。设置窗口随游戏语言显示，支持英语、法语、德语和日语。消息文本会发送给 Google 翻译或 DeepL 处理。使用 /htranslate 打开设置。

Punchline.Original: Reviewed intent settings and matching hotbars.
Punchline.Translated: 经过审核的操作意图设置与配套热键栏。

Description.Original: Configures the compatible Wrathful Combo engine through its settings API and manages static/live hotbars. Includes compact PvE/PvP layouts, three-bar manual logout fallback with login restoration, and automatic Sprint conversion on active hotbars. Development preview.
Description.Translated: 通过设置 API 配置兼容的 Wrathful Combo 引擎，并管理静态或实时热键栏。提供紧凑的 PvE／PvP 布局、手动登出时回退到三栏并在登录后恢复，以及在当前热键栏自动转换冲刺技能。开发预览版。

Punchline.Original: Small improvements, individually yours.
Punchline.Translated: 点滴改进，按你所需。

Description.Original: A modular collection of Final Fantasy XIV tweaks and quality-of-life tools. Every feature can be enabled or disabled independently.
Description.Translated: 模块化的《最终幻想14》调整与便利工具合集，每项功能都可独立启用或禁用。

Punchline.Original: Lodestone event reminders and deadlines.
Punchline.Translated: Lodestone 活动提醒与截止日期。

Description.Original: Lodestone event dates, illustrated event guides, automatic quest completion and character reward tracking.
Description.Translated: 提供 Lodestone 活动日期、图文活动指南、自动完成任务，以及按角色追踪活动奖励。

Punchline.Original: ホットバーの指定した1マスだけを、任意のマクロへ。
Punchline.Translated: 只替换热键栏中指定的一格，放入任意宏。

Description.Original: 指定したホットバーの1スロットだけを、個人または共通マクロへ差し替える小型プラグインです。/mslot personal|shared <マクロ番号> <ホットバー番号> <スロット番号> で操作します。
Description.Translated: 将指定热键栏的单个格子替换为个人宏或共通宏的轻量插件。使用 /mslot personal|shared <マクロ番号> <ホットバー番号> <スロット番号> 操作，三个参数依次为宏编号、热键栏编号和格子编号。

Punchline.Original: Route driver for The Merchant's Tale variant dungeon.
Punchline.Translated: The Merchant's Tale 多变迷宫的路线指引工具。

Description.Original: Tracks all 13 Corvosi Folklore Records step by step. Pick a record, follow the highlighted step, tick it off. Includes boss mechanics and reward reference. Purely informational - it does not move or fight for you.
Description.Translated: 逐步追踪全部 13 篇科尔沃民俗记录。选择记录，按高亮步骤操作，再勾选完成。包含首领机制和奖励参考。仅提供信息，不会代你移动或战斗。

Punchline.Original: Track what your character owns and how to get what is missing.
Punchline.Translated: 追踪角色已有收藏，并查找缺少内容的获取方式。

Description.Original: Collection tracker for the logged-in character: mounts, minions, orchestrion and Armoire with in-game unlock info, an outfit planner, a gear advisor and a daily/weekly checklist. Information and UI only. No automation.
Description.Translated: 为当前登录角色追踪坐骑、宠物、管弦乐琴和收藏柜，提供游戏内解锁信息、穿搭规划、装备建议，以及每日／每周清单。仅提供信息与界面，无自动化功能。

Punchline.Original: 自动挖宝图，解放双手。

Description.Original: 自动处理背包里的陈旧地图：逐张解读、前往挖宝点、挖出宝箱、击退守卫并开箱，然后继续下一张，运行中可预约「本图后停止」，挖完当前这张（含宝物库）再停；背包里没图时，可以用采矿工或园艺工采集每日地图，并在价格上限和金币预算内从市场板购买。可以去大区内最便宜的服务器买图（需要 Lifestream）。实验性：挖出传送魔纹后可单人自动进入并攻略加加财富天坑和巡梦金库。坦克职业会在敌人对自己读死刑时第一时间开减伤。宝物库内可优先攻击奖励怪物、按顺序击杀蔓德拉战队，巡梦金库的捡袋子回合由插件自己捡（躲开金库羊的冲撞，并把每次回合录下来）；历史页提供逐张挖宝日志（含每张耗时）。组队模式（本服组队自动启用）：两个号都开插件，队长挖宝并在小队频道发坐标，队员自己赶到宝藏点、一起战斗和Roll点；队长可带队进宝物库，队员在库内跟随、战斗和捡袋子。治疗、召唤、赤魔在战斗中会用即刻复活倒地队友；队长可设置在战斗结束后切换到复活职业拉起队友；倒地时自动接受复活。基于 XeldarAlz 的 Auto Treasure Maps（https://github.com/XeldarAlz/FFXIV-AutoTreasureMaps）修改的国服维护版，并非原作者发布，问题请反馈到 blackappleD/FFXIV-AutoTreasureMaps。可选：按宝图统计稀有物品并按市场价估值；自动丢弃不在白名单里的战利品（默认关闭，只清理挖宝获得的物品；稀有品默认保留，可按宝图和宝库逐个选择）；神典石（诗学、数理、记忆）各自达到阈值时，通过 GatherBuddy Reborn 购买该神典石清单里设置的物品。需要 vnavmesh 和 BossMod。

Punchline.Original: Summarize Free Company chest history by item and player.
Punchline.Translated: 按物品和玩家汇总部队储物柜历史记录。

Description.Original:
ChestDiff reads the visible Free Company chest history, filters rows after a configured date/time, and summarizes deposits and withdrawals by item and player. It only processes rows available from the in-game Free Company Chest Log.

Commands:
/chestdiff - Open ChestDiff.
/chestdiff export - Export a summary CSV.
/chestdiff dump - Export diagnostic raw chest log text to CSV.
/chestdiff help - Show command help.
Description.Translated:
ChestDiff 读取可见的部队储物柜历史，筛选指定日期和时间之后的条目，并按物品和玩家汇总存入与取出。只处理游戏内部队储物柜日志中可获取的记录。

命令：
/chestdiff - 打开 ChestDiff。
/chestdiff export - 导出汇总 CSV。
/chestdiff dump - 将用于诊断的原始储物柜日志文本导出为 CSV。
/chestdiff help - 显示命令帮助。

Description.Original: Sorts glamour-able gear from your inventory into the Glamour Dresser as outfit glamours â€” including seasonal sets, with the Store as Outfit Glamour checkbox dialog automated. Completes existing outfit sets instead of creating duplicates, and leaves true duplicates in your bags to sell. Open your Glamour Dresser, run /gsort, review the preview, then store.
Description.Translated: 将背包中可用于幻化的装备按套装投影存入投影台，包括节日套装，并自动处理“作为套装投影保存”的勾选对话框。优先补齐已有套装，避免重复创建；真正重复的物品留在背包中以供出售。打开投影台，输入 /gsort，检查预览后再存入。

Punchline.Original: Mechanic calls for high-end raids, one fight at a time.
Punchline.Translated: 为高难度团队战斗逐场提供机制提示。

Description.Original:
Shows a compact helper window with live mechanic calls for supported fights.

Dancing Mad (Ultimate): P1 rings, gazes, rocks and cleaves; P2 Forsaken and Trine; P3 Black Hole and hand attacks; P4 debuffs; P5 Chaotic Flood.

The Epic of Alexander (Ultimate): P2 nisi lineup; P3 Wormhole; P4 Fate Calibration Alpha and Beta.
Description.Translated:
通过紧凑的辅助窗口，为受支持的战斗实时提示机制。

妖星乱舞绝境战：P1 圆环、视线、岩石和顺劈；P2 遗弃末世与三角攻击；P3 黑洞与手部攻击；P4 减益；P5 混沌洪流。

亚历山大绝境战：P2 非最终审判站位；P3 虫洞；P4 未来观测α与β。

Punchline.Original: Plan your next Market Board run.
Punchline.Translated: 规划下一次市场布告板采购。

Description.Original: Import materials, manage shopping lists and track required quantities. Universalis price optimization and guided purchasing are planned.
Description.Translated: 导入材料、管理购物清单并追踪所需数量。计划加入 Universalis 价格优化与引导式购买。

Punchline.Original: Spin a wheel, play the job it picks.
Punchline.Translated: 转动转盘，玩它选中的职业。

Description.Original: Spin a wheel of jobs. The wheel picks one, switches you to its gearset, and removes it from the wheel once you finish a duty on it.
Description.Translated: 转动职业转盘，随机选出一个职业并切换到对应套装；使用该职业完成一次副本后，会将其从转盘中移除。

Punchline.Original: Track item value plus gil.
Punchline.Translated: 统计物品价值与吉尔总额。

Description.Original: Tracks how much your selected items are worth to a vendor, adds it to your gil balance, and shows submarine return timers.
Description.Translated: 统计指定物品出售给商店时的价值，加上当前吉尔余额，并显示潜水艇返航倒计时。

Punchline.Original: Town, battle and boss music from the Final Fantasies you choose.
Punchline.Translated: 从你选择的《最终幻想》作品中播放城镇、战斗和首领音乐。

Description.Original: Plays music from the original Final Fantasy I to XVI soundtracks (YouTube, shown in a small video window) and switches it by what you are doing in game: town, field, dungeon, battle, boss. It can mute the game's own music and take over. On first start it downloads a Chromium based player (about 160 MB).
Description.Translated: 播放《最终幻想 I》至《最终幻想 XVI》的原声音乐，来自 YouTube 并显示于小视频窗口中；根据你在游戏中的活动切换城镇、野外、迷宫、战斗或首领曲目。可静音游戏自带音乐并接管播放。首次启动会下载基于 Chromium 的播放器，约 160 MB。

Punchline.Original: Market research and whole-stack profit estimates.
Punchline.Translated: 市场调研与整组转卖利润估算。

Description.Original: In-game market research using Universalis. Profitable cross-world flips with home-world sell prices, exact-stack plans, budget baskets and a bounded purchase journal.
Description.Translated: 使用 Universalis 在游戏内开展市场调研。以本服售价为依据寻找跨服转卖机会，提供精确整组采购方案、预算购物篮，以及有容量限制的采购日志。

TextToTalkCN.Author: ctdlb（汉化重构）· 原作者 karashiiro

Punchline.Original: See every snap before it happens.
Punchline.Translated: 提前看清每一次家具吸附。

Description.Original: Housing placement toolkit for FFXIV. See the snap before you place: floor distance measured from the item's own collision data, item-to-item ranges from each item's SphereCastRange, wall attachment from the receiver's own snap walls (partitions, stage panels, house walls), and tabletop surfaces from TableTop collision. Full position/rotation control on top, inherited from BDTH by LeonBlade. Open with /hu. ⚠ Under active testing — not a fully working product yet; features may be incomplete or behave unexpectedly.
Description.Translated: FFXIV 房屋摆放工具包。在放置前预见吸附：地板距离根据物品自身的碰撞数据测量，物品间距根据每个物品的 SphereCastRange 测量，墙壁附着根据接收者自身的吸附墙（隔墙、舞台面板、房屋墙壁）测量，桌面表面根据 TableTop 碰撞测量。在此基础上提供完整的位置/旋转控制，继承自 LeonBlade 的 BDTH。使用 /hu 打开。⚠ 正在积极测试中——尚非完全可用的产品；功能可能不完整或行为异常。

Description.Original: Personal dealer-hosted gil roulette: provably-fair control spins, live web players, chat announcements and a dealer console worth watching. Whitelisted to authorized dealers only.
Description.Translated: 由个人荷官主持的吉尔轮盘：提供可证明公平的受控转盘、网页玩家实时参与、聊天播报，以及值得围观的荷官控制台。仅对白名单中的授权荷官开放。

Punchline.Original: Don't carry your old stuff around
Punchline.Translated: 别再随身带着旧装备。

Description.Original:
Wiht ThrowCrapOut (/tco) you can sort, clear out and free your Space in your Armoury. It allows you to sort your Armoury and pull out Gear not assigned to a Gearset.


Features:
- Sort = Just sorts your Gear in your Armoury by Item Level descending.
- Split = Basically like Sort, but moving Non-Gearset Gear to the end Slots of each Category.
- Clear = Pulls out your Non-Gearset Gear out of your Armoury to your Inventory.

Allows to clear out one category by another (default) or just taking the highest Item Level of Non-Gearset Gear one after another across the Categories to your Inventory.


Define a limit of free Inventory Space to keep, if you have way too much old gear stuff in your Armoury.


Define, which Categories should be handled, and which not.


Visual feedback for the sorting. Never guess anymore, how unsorted and chaotic your Armoury maybe looks like. TCO will take care of it.


Commands:


- /tco
- /tco settings
- /tco sort
- /tco split
- /tco clear


Language support for the 4 main Languages.
Description.Translated:
ThrowCrapOut（/tco）可整理、清理兵装库并释放空间，将未关联任何套装的装备取出。

功能：
- 排序：仅按物品品级降序整理兵装库装备。
- 分离：类似排序，但将未关联套装的装备移到各类别的末尾。
- 清理：将未关联套装的装备从兵装库移至背包。

默认按类别逐一清理，也可跨类别按品级从高到低，依次将未关联套装的装备移至背包。

若兵装库中旧装备太多，可以设置背包必须保留的空格数量。

可选择需要处理和无需处理的类别。

提供直观的排序反馈，不用再猜兵装库有多乱，交给 TCO 处理。

命令：
- /tco
- /tco settings
- /tco sort
- /tco split
- /tco clear

支持国际服的四种主要语言。

Punchline.Original: Island Sanctuary automation: workshop, gathering, pasture, cropland, granary and exports.
Punchline.Translated: 开拓无人岛自动化：工坊、采集、牧场、农田、探索工房和出口。

Description.Original: Runs your Island Sanctuary unattended: workshop agenda solver, gathering, pasture, cropland, granary and exports, gated on island rank. Part of the Daedalus suite.
Description.Translated: 无人值守管理开拓无人岛：生产工坊排程求解、采集、牧场、农田、探索工房和出口，按岛屿等级限制可用功能。属于 Daedalus 套件。

Punchline.Original: Choose your reported client language.
Punchline.Translated: 选择向他人显示的客户端语言。

Description.Original: Change the client language shown to other players without changing the game's text language. Use /clientlang to choose a language or turn the override off.
Description.Translated: 改变其他玩家看到的客户端语言标记，不修改游戏文本语言。使用 /clientlang 选择语言或关闭覆盖。

Punchline.Original: Automatically change your title based on job, gearset, zone, or duty.
Punchline.Translated: 根据职业、套装、区域或副本自动切换称号。

Description.Original: Set a default title plus rules that switch it when you change job or role, swap gearsets, enter a zone, or queue into a specific duty. Alts can have their own rules.
Description.Translated: 设置默认称号，以及在更换职业或职能、切换套装、进入区域或排入指定副本时切换称号的规则。其他角色可使用各自的规则。

Punchline.Original: Achat-revente entre mondes : quoi acheter, où, et à quel prix revendre.
Punchline.Translated: 跨服倒买倒卖：买什么、去哪买、以什么价格卖出。

Description.Original: Scanne le marketboard de ton data center via Universalis et recommande les objets à acheter sur les autres mondes pour les revendre sur ton monde d'origine, taxes, vitesse de vente et fiabilité des données comprises.
Description.Translated: 通过 Universalis 扫描所在数据中心的市场布告板，推荐在其他服务器购买并带回本服转卖的物品，同时考虑税费、销售速度和数据可靠性。

Punchline.Original: Find players without a Free Company and send them a tell.
Punchline.Translated: 寻找未加入部队的玩家，并向他们发送悄悄话。

Description.Original: Collects players without an FC tag from the in-game Player Search results and from players around you, then lets you send each one a templated /tell with a single click.
Description.Translated: 从游戏内玩家搜索结果和附近玩家中收集没有部队标签的人，并可一键向每人发送模板化的 /tell 消息。

Punchline.Original: Reduce nearby crafting sounds
Punchline.Translated: 减少附近的制作音效。

Description.Original: Automatically filters mapped crafting sound effects classified as Other, while leaving Player-category sounds alone. Uses version-sensitive game hooks; review the project README and custom-repository source before installing.
Description.Translated: 自动过滤已映射且归类为“其他”的制作音效，不影响“玩家”类别的声音。使用对游戏版本敏感的 Hook，安装前请阅读项目 README，并核查自定义仓库来源。

Punchline.Original: Add and control an unlimited number of custom additional hotbars.
Punchline.Translated: 添加和控制不限数量的额外自定义热键栏。

Description.Original: Create hotbars of any size, spacing, and keybinds, with functions to show and hide these bars dynamically.
Description.Translated: 创建任意大小、间距和快捷键设置的热键栏，并支持动态显示和隐藏。

Punchline.Original: Remember why you keep items. Make an explained cleanup plan.
Punchline.Translated: 记住保留物品的理由，制定有依据的清理计划。

Description.Original: Understand item purposes, acquisition sources, crafting and exchange links, quest requirements and access blockers. Wiki links, NPC maps, Leve reservations, explained rewards and collection ownership. Auto-updating item database. English / Русский. Open /bagsense.
Description.Translated: 了解物品用途、获取来源、制作与兑换关系、任务要求和解锁障碍。提供 Wiki 链接、NPC 地图、理符任务物品预留、奖励说明和收藏拥有情况。物品数据库自动更新。支持英语／俄语。使用 /bagsense 打开。

Punchline.Original: Track your progress and collect society and exploration rewards.
Punchline.Translated: 追踪进度，收集友好部族与探索内容的奖励。

Description.Original: Progress journal with 220 quest chains and a collectible atlas. Society and exploration vendors, currencies and prices, purchase requirements, automatic collection tracking, source filters, quest rewards and NPC map links.
Description.Translated: 包含 220 条任务链和收藏图鉴的进度日志。提供友好部族与探索商人、货币与价格、购买要求、自动收藏追踪、来源筛选、任务奖励，以及 NPC 地图链接。

Punchline.Original: Find suitable FATEs, travel to them and earn EXP.
Punchline.Translated: 寻找适合等级的临危受命，自动前往并获取经验。

Description.Original: Finds level-appropriate FATEs, travels using unlocked aetherytes and navigates with ZizNav/vnavmesh. Selects combat targets for a configured combat plugin. Optional leveling-plan features integrate job quests, duties and equipment management. Requires Windows x64, .NET 10 and Dalamud/ZizLoader API 15. Review inventory cleanup settings before using shopping automation: cleanup can discard items. Open with /autofate; use /autofate start, stop or status.
Description.Translated: 寻找与等级相符的临危受命，使用已交感的以太之光移动，并通过 ZizNav／vnavmesh 导航。为配置的战斗插件选择战斗目标。可选的练级计划还整合职业任务、副本与装备管理。需要 Windows x64、.NET 10 和 Dalamud／ZizLoader API 15。使用自动购物前请检查背包清理设置，因为清理可能会丢弃物品。使用 /autofate 打开，使用 /autofate start、stop 或 status 控制运行或查看状态。

Punchline.Original: Beastmaster autopilot: find and capture missing beasts.
Punchline.Translated: 驯兽师自动助手：寻找并捕获尚未收集的野兽。

Description.Original: Tracks your Beastmaster collection, reads existing pacts from the game and plans missing creatures. Travels using unlocked aetherytes and ZizNav/vnavmesh, then uses Capture with its own single-target rotation. Duty routes use ZizDuty. Requires Windows x64, .NET 10 and Dalamud API 15. Preview: runtime behavior has not been validated. Open with /zizbest.
Description.Translated: 追踪驯兽师收藏，从游戏读取已缔结契约的野兽，并规划缺少的目标。使用已交感的以太之光与 ZizNav／vnavmesh 前往，再通过自身单体技能循环使用捕获。副本路线使用 ZizDuty。需要 Windows x64、.NET 10 和 Dalamud API 15。预览版：运行时行为尚未验证。使用 /zizbest 打开。

Punchline.Original: Automatically switches HUD layouts by game window resolution.
Punchline.Translated: 根据游戏窗口分辨率自动切换 HUD 布局。

Description.Original: Maps exact game client-area resolutions to native HUD layout slots 1-4, with configurable rules.
Description.Translated: 通过可配置规则，将精确的游戏客户区分辨率映射到原生 HUD 布局槽位 1–4。

Punchline.Original: Light-Wiki-Kalender mit Adresskopie und optionaler Lifestream-Reisehilfe.
Punchline.Translated: Light Wiki 日历，支持复制地址及可选的 Lifestream 出行辅助。

Description.Original: Light-Wiki-Kalender mit Adresskopie, externen Links und drei Teleport-Modi. Standard: Kommando kopieren. Optional Bezirksreise über Lifestream 2.5.4.4 nach zwei oder einem Klick. Öffnen mit /lightkalender.
Description.Translated: Light Wiki 日历，支持复制地址、打开外部链接和三种传送模式。默认只复制命令；可选择通过 Lifestream 2.5.4.4，在两次或一次点击后前往目标住宅小区。使用 /lightkalender 打开。

Punchline.Original: Party potion tracking by pull.
Punchline.Translated: 按每次战斗记录全队爆发药使用情况。

Description.Original: Track party potion usage per pull in Savage, Ultimate and Extreme duties. View results with /potions.
Description.Translated: 在零式、绝境战和极难度副本中，按每次战斗追踪队友使用爆发药的情况。使用 /potions 查看结果。

Punchline.Original: Your existing phone interface with your Discord friends.
Punchline.Translated: 用熟悉的手机界面与 Discord 好友交流。

Description.Original: Private local edition based on Aetherphone. Uses official Discord authorization for contacts and text chat. Aethernet services and unchecked native media/browser playback are disabled.
Description.Translated: 基于 Aetherphone 的私人本地版本，使用 Discord 官方授权访问联系人和文字聊天。已禁用 Aethernet 服务，以及未经核查的原生媒体／浏览器播放功能。

Punchline.Original: Enhanced camera distance control and first-person experience.
Punchline.Translated: 增强镜头距离控制与第一人称体验。

Description.Original: Local camera R8: steady first-person eye, per-mount seat offsets and optional physical head tracking. NearFace 0.2.5 provides one webcam for facial expressions and head pose; optional OpenTrack loopback input. Use /mguide; turn MouseLock off for head tracking. Existing settings and the R7 near-fog correction are retained. Update and fully restart FFXIV. Experimental preview; physical webcam and native game acceptance remain pending.
Description.Translated: 本地镜头 R8：稳定的第一人称视点、按坐骑分别设置的座位偏移，以及可选的真实头部追踪。NearFace 0.2.5 用一台摄像头提供面部表情和头部姿态，也可选择 OpenTrack 本机回环输入。使用 /mguide；头部追踪时请关闭 MouseLock。保留已有设置和 R7 的近距离雾效修正。更新后需完全重启 FFXIV。实验性预览版，真实摄像头和原生游戏内验收仍待完成。

Punchline.Original: Local face controls and read-only bone inventory for the matching C+ fork.
Punchline.Translated: 为配套 Customize+ 分支提供本地面部控制与只读骨骼清单。

Description.Original: NearFace 0.2.5: one explicitly started webcam supplies local facial coefficients and head pose for Musical Guide R8. Fit checks, bounded filtering, fresh ordered input and explicit loss/reacquisition improve stability. /nearface opens controls; /mguide can start both webcam and camera tracking. Nothing opens the webcam automatically. Facial components remain opt-in and need sculpt calibration. Local numeric data only; no image recording or other-player synchronization.
Description.Translated: NearFace 0.2.5：由用户明确启动的一台摄像头，为 Musical Guide R8 提供本地面部系数和头部姿态。通过适配检查、有界滤波、及时有序的输入，以及明确的追踪丢失／重新获取处理提升稳定性。/nearface 打开控制面板，/mguide 可同时启动摄像头与镜头追踪。任何功能都不会自动打开摄像头。面部组件仍需主动启用，并针对雕模进行校准。只处理本地数值数据，不录制图像，也不与其他玩家同步。

Description.Original: Unofficial Chinese-client adaptation of FFXIV-CombatReborn/ZodiacBuddyReborn 7.5.6.1 (4913f31ab829c21f6ae5289568f14cd182233bbc). Not affiliated with or endorsed by the upstream project. Animus leve issuers match CN NPC data ids. Battlecraft acquire selects the Addon label 佣兵任务. Support target: CN client 2026.10.06.0000.0000, Dalamud API 15. Turn-in has not been confirmed in a live session.
Description.Translated: FFXIV-CombatReborn/ZodiacBuddyReborn 7.5.6.1（4913f31ab829c21f6ae5289568f14cd182233bbc）的非官方国服适配版，与上游项目无关联，也未获其认可。黄道十二文书的理符任务发布者已对应国服 NPC 数据 ID；领取战斗理符时选择界面标签“佣兵任务”。支持目标：国服客户端 2026.10.06.0000.0000、Dalamud API 15。任务交付尚未在实际游戏会话中确认。

Punchline.Original: One window for Penumbra mods and Glamourer looks.
Punchline.Translated: 在一个窗口中管理 Penumbra 模组与 Glamourer 外观。

Description.Original: Shows what you are wearing and which Penumbra mods fit each slot. Hover to preview on your own character, click to pin, then apply through Penumbra and Glamourer. Also edits mod colours and emission, shows which mod wins each file, and lists your Glamourer designs.
Description.Translated: 显示当前穿戴内容，以及适配各部位的 Penumbra 模组。悬停即可在自己角色上预览，点击固定后通过 Penumbra 和 Glamourer 应用。还可编辑模组颜色与自发光，显示各文件最终由哪个模组生效，并列出 Glamourer 设计。

Punchline.Original: Triple Triad: ain't nobody got time fo dat
Punchline.Translated: 九宫幻卡？谁有空折腾那个啊。

Description.Original: Reads Triple Triad matches from the game, enumerates the NPC's possible hands, solves every one exactly and plays the move that keeps the best guaranteed result while exploiting how NPCs play. Private tool; not for the official repository.
Description.Translated: 读取游戏中的九宫幻卡对局，枚举 NPC 可能的手牌并逐一精确求解，在利用 NPC 出牌习惯的同时，选择能保证最佳保底结果的落子。私人工具，不用于官方仓库。

Punchline.Original: Blackjack play and budgeted betting.
Punchline.Translated: 二十一点自动对局与预算内下注。

Description.Original: Opt-in blackjack play and automatic gil or practice bets for Aetherphone Gamba. Sit at a table, then enable with /blackjackpilot. Reads table rules automatically.
Description.Translated: 为 Aetherphone Gamba 提供需主动启用的二十一点对局，以及自动吉尔下注或练习下注。入座后使用 /blackjackpilot 启用，自动读取牌桌规则。

Punchline.Original: 跨客户端官方配音与口型 / Cross-client voices and lip sync
Punchline.Translated: 跨客户端官方配音与口型。

Description.Original: 国服用官方英文，国际服用官方中文：配音与口型随开关切换，界面保留原语言。需要本地生成的 Penumbra 资源包。/ Official English on CN, official Chinese on Global; retain the interface language. Requires locally generated Penumbra resources. /languagebridge
Description.Translated: 国服使用官方英语配音，国际服使用官方中文配音：配音与口型随开关切换，界面保留原语言。需要本地生成的 Penumbra 资源包。使用 /languagebridge。

Punchline.Original: A clean, modern and modular HUD replacement.
Punchline.Translated: 简洁、现代且模块化的 HUD 替换方案。

Description.Original: LucentUI replaces the default HUD with clean, flat unit frames, cast bars, auras and party frames. Everything can be moved in Unlock Mode, styled from one place, and saved into profiles that switch automatically per job. Inspired by EllesmereUI for World of Warcraft.
Description.Translated: LucentUI 使用简洁扁平的单位框体、咏唱条、状态提示和小队框体替换默认 HUD。所有元素均可在解锁模式中移动，在统一位置调整样式，并保存为按职业自动切换的配置。灵感来自《魔兽世界》的 EllesmereUI。

Punchline.Original: A smartphone for the Traditional Chinese client.
Punchline.Translated: 繁体中文客户端专用的智能手机。

Description.Original: An in-game smartphone for the Traditional Chinese client. Unofficial fork of Aetherphone by XeldarAlz (AGPL-3.0-or-later); it is not affiliated with Aetherphone and never connects to the official Aethernet service.
Description.Translated: 面向繁体中文客户端的游戏内智能手机。由 XeldarAlz 制作的 Aetherphone 的非官方分支，使用 AGPL-3.0-or-later 许可证；与 Aetherphone 无关联，且绝不会连接官方 Aethernet 服务。

Punchline.Original: 購入リストに沿ってリムサからワールドを巡回
Punchline.Translated: 按购物清单从利姆萨·罗敏萨出发，跨服巡回采购。

Description.Original: Universalis quotes, Lifestream world travel, vnavmesh marketboard approaches, and guided live stack purchases with price limits and inventory/gil verification.
Description.Translated: 结合 Universalis 报价、Lifestream 跨服、vnavmesh 前往市场布告板，以及引导式实际整组购买，并提供价格限制和背包／吉尔核验。

Punchline.Original: Highlight profitable NPC resale listings, including purchase tax.
Punchline.Translated: 高亮可转卖给 NPC 获利的市场挂单，并计入购买税费。

Description.Original: Highlight profitable market listings and show total NPC resale profit beside each row, including purchase tax and HQ value. Seven UI languages. /gilbeacon. Public preview: live-game row mapping, scrolling and sale totals remain unverified.
Description.Translated: 高亮有利润的市场挂单，在每行旁显示转卖给 NPC 的总利润，计入购买税费和 HQ 价值。支持七种界面语言。命令：/gilbeacon。公开预览版：游戏内列表行对应、滚动和销售总额仍未验证。

Punchline.Original: Your everyday toolkit for XIV.
Punchline.Translated: 你的 FFXIV 日常工具箱。

Description.Original: Preview 0.1.0.0007 (2fac1db) by Zero. Minimal search, configurable target types, styled target HUD, animated frame companions, optional AI connections, gathering gear, voice shortcuts and Umbra integration.
Description.Translated: 由 Zero 制作的预览版 0.1.0.0007（2fac1db）。提供极简搜索、可配置目标类型、带样式的目标 HUD、动态边框伙伴、可选 AI 连接、采集装备、语音快捷操作和 Umbra 集成。

Punchline.Original: Avisos de las Fêtes de Ishgardian Restoration.
Punchline.Translated: 伊修加德重建天穹同庆活动提醒。

Description.Original: Lee el indicador de la Skyrise Celebration (Restauración de Ishgardiense) y avisa antes de que empiecen las Fêtes y cuando están activas.
Description.Translated: 读取伊修加德重建的天穹同庆指示信息，在活动即将开始和正在进行时发送提醒。

Punchline.Original: Your characters, looks, outfits and screenshots in one place.
Punchline.Translated: 集中管理角色、外观、穿搭与截图。

Description.Original: My Character Manager: your Penumbra mods, Glamourer look, Customize+ and G-pose tools in one place. Character cards, profiles with body and look mods, outfits sized for your body, priority bands, Brio poses and ReShade shader controls. Open with /mcm (/mcm lite for the classic window).
Description.Translated: My Character Manager 将 Penumbra 模组、Glamourer 外观、Customize+ 和集体动作工具集中在一处。提供角色卡、包含身体与外观模组的配置、适配身体尺寸的服装、优先级分组、Brio 姿势和 ReShade 着色器控制。使用 /mcm 打开，/mcm lite 打开经典窗口。

Punchline.Original: Encounter modules and AethertekUI for BossModReborn
Punchline.Translated: 为 BossModReborn 提供战斗模块与 AethertekUI。
