Description.Original: Encounter additions, Praetorium timelines and bundled cooldown plans, with AethertekUI appearance for BMR settings, autorotation and AI. BossModReborn must be installed and enabled.
Description.Translated: 提供额外战斗支持、天幕魔导城时间轴及内置冷却计划，并为 BMR 设置、自动循环和 AI 界面应用 AethertekUI 外观。必须安装并启用 BossModReborn。

Punchline.Original: Leave instances automatically as soon as the duty is complete.
Punchline.Translated: 副本完成后尽快自动退出。

Description.Original:
I Can't Be Here leaves the duty for you the moment it is completed, after a grace period you choose.

• Toggle it from the server info bar (left click), open settings with right click or /icantbehere.
• Configurable grace period, so there is time to roll on loot or say goodbye.
• Waits for cutscenes and combat to end before leaving.
• The countdown shows in the server info bar; click it to stay this time.
Description.Translated:
I Can't Be Here 会在副本完成后，等待你设定的宽限时间，再自动退出。

• 左键点击服务器信息栏中的入口切换开关，右键或使用 /icantbehere 打开设置。
• 可自定义宽限时间，留出掷点或道别的时间。
• 等待过场动画和战斗结束后再退出。
• 服务器信息栏会显示倒计时，点击即可取消本次退出。

Punchline.Original: Sculpt your character with character-creator sliders, then save it as a Customize+ template.
Punchline.Translated: 用角色创建式滑块雕琢角色，再保存为 Customize+ 模板。

Description.Original:
Adjust your character's face and body proportions with simple, named sliders
(eye size, jaw width, shoulder width, leg length...) instead of editing individual bones.
Requires Customize+. Changes are applied as a temporary Customize+ profile and can be saved as presets.
Description.Translated:
通过命名清晰的简单滑块调整角色面部与身体比例，
例如眼睛大小、下颌宽度、肩宽、腿长，无需逐根编辑骨骼。
需要 Customize+。修改通过临时 Customize+ 配置应用，并可保存为预设。

Punchline.Original: 从照片或插画识别姿势，一键摆到 GPose 角色身上 / Photo or illustration to Brio pose
Punchline.Translated: 从照片或插画识别姿势，通过 Brio 一键应用到集体动作模式中的角色身上。

Description.Original: 用本地 AI 后端（SAM 3D Body）识别照片或插画里的人物姿势，重定向到你的种族骨架后通过 Brio 应用到 GPose 角色。支持复刻照片镜头、调整滑杆、导出 .pose，中英文界面。需要 Brio 与 Posegraph 后端一键包（见项目主页）。目前只适配男性骨架。

Punchline.Original: Find friends who have stopped playing, so you can make room on a full friend list.
Punchline.Translated: 找出可能已不再游玩的好友，为已满的好友列表腾出空间。

Description.Original:
Checks each friend's public Lodestone page and flags who has probably stopped playing, with the reason.
Remove friends straight from the list when you agree. Open with /flc.
Description.Translated:
检查每位好友的公开 Lodestone 页面，标出可能已不再游玩的人并说明理由。
确认后可直接从列表中删除好友。使用 /flc 打开。

Punchline.Original: WrathCombo用ホットバーの表示を分離し、操作可能な疑似ホットバーを表示します。
Punchline.Translated: 分离 WrathCombo 热键栏显示，并提供可操作的模拟热键栏。

Description.Original:
WrathComboのスキル置き換えを指定したホットバーに限定し、ほかのホットバーの標準表示・実行を維持します。

疑似ホットバーはリキャスト・チャージ・消費MPなどのリソースコスト表示、長押し連打、純正効果音と発光の同期に対応。NPC会話・カットシーン・ムービー・イベント中は自動で非表示にできます。

※キーボード・マウス専用（ゲームパッド非対応）。
※配信・画面共有で疑似ホットバーを隠す場合、別途キャプチャ除外に対応した環境が必要です。
Description.Translated:
将 WrathCombo 的技能替换限制在指定热键栏，其他热键栏保持原生显示与执行方式。

模拟热键栏支持显示冷却、充能和 MP 等资源消耗，支持长按连发，并同步原生音效与发光提示。可在 NPC 对话、过场动画、影片和事件期间自动隐藏。

※ 仅支持键盘和鼠标，不支持手柄。
※ 若要在直播或屏幕共享时隐藏模拟热键栏，需要另行配置支持捕获排除的环境。

ZhuangAssist.Author: Local reconstruction; original plugin by Karlin

Punchline.Original: Local chat callout for UCoB Nael divebomb bait spots.
Punchline.Translated: 通过仅自己可见的聊天消息，提示巴哈姆特绝境战奈尔阶段的爆破俯冲引导位置。

Description.Original: Reads the five dragon positions during UCoB Nael and prints, in a chat message only you can see, where each divebomb should be baited. Use /naeldive to recompute or /naeldive test N S SW W NW to try a pattern.
Description.Translated: 读取巴哈姆特绝境战奈尔阶段五条龙的位置，并在仅自己可见的聊天消息中提示每次爆破俯冲的引导点。使用 /naeldive 重新计算，或使用 /naeldive test N S SW W NW 测试一组位置。

Punchline.Original: Collect what matters. Sell the surplus.
Punchline.Translated: 留下值得收藏的，卖掉多余的。

Description.Original: Collection-aware inventory decisions and market rules coordinated with the AutoRetainer integration fork. Starts in dry-run mode.
Description.Translated: 结合收藏拥有情况制定背包处理与市场规则，并与 AutoRetainer 集成分支协调。默认以试运行模式启动。

Punchline.Original: Automatic local crafting and gathering profession profiles.
Punchline.Translated: 自动生成本地制作与采集职业档案。

Description.Original: Exports profession levels, equipped and saved gearsets with materia, observed stats and buffs, specialist assignments, master books, recipe gates, action unlocks and loaded inventory to local JSON. No network or gameplay automation. English / Русский. Open /craftprofile.
Description.Translated: 将职业等级、当前装备和已保存套装及其魔晶石、观测到的属性与增益、专家职业分配、秘籍、配方解锁条件、技能解锁情况和已加载背包导出为本地 JSON。不联网，也不自动操作游戏。支持英语／俄语。使用 /craftprofile 打开。

Punchline.Original: Market Board → NPC: прибыль после налога и подсветка лотов.
Punchline.Translated: 市场布告板买入、NPC 卖出：计算税后利润并高亮挂单。

Description.Original: Find market-board stacks worth reselling to NPCs. Shows whole-stack profit after buyer tax, current-world Universalis candidates and native-row highlights and quick cached discovery. No automatic purchases. /vendorprofit
Description.Translated: 寻找值得买入后转卖给 NPC 的市场整组挂单，显示扣除购买税后的整组利润、本服 Universalis 候选物品、原生列表行高亮，以及快速缓存检索。不自动购买。命令：/vendorprofit。

Punchline.Original: Plays a sound when a hit crits, direct hits, or does both.
Punchline.Translated: 暴击、直击或暴击直击时播放音效。

Description.Original:
Audio feedback for combat: plays a separate sound for critical hits, direct hits, and critical direct hits.

Everything is configurable in /critsound: which triggers are active, the sound file, the volume, and the minimum gap between sounds. Drop your own .wav files into the plugin's sounds folder and pick them from the list.
Description.Translated:
战斗音效反馈：为暴击、直击和暴击直击分别播放不同声音。

所有设置均可在 /critsound 中调整，包括启用哪些触发条件、声音文件、音量和两次音效之间的最小间隔。将自己的 .wav 文件放入插件的 sounds 文件夹，即可从列表中选择。

Punchline.Original: Tracks what your desynths actually yield and what it is worth.
Punchline.Translated: 记录分解实际产出了什么，以及这些产物的价值。

Description.Original:
Records what each desynthesis actually gives you and what those items are worth.

The desynthesis window shows the real result, so the plugin reads it from the game rather than guessing from a datamined table - those tables do not exist in a reliable form. Each item then keeps a small ledger: how often you desynthesised it, the average and best value of the yield, and the last result.
Description.Translated:
记录每次分解的实际产物及其价值。

分解窗口会显示真实结果，因此插件直接从游戏读取，不靠数据挖掘表猜测，因为目前并不存在可靠的此类产物表。每种被分解的物品都有一份小账本，记录分解次数、平均和最高产出价值，以及最近一次结果。

Punchline.Original: A scorecard for every duty: deaths, wipes, and how cursed it was.
Punchline.Translated: 为每次副本打分：死亡、团灭，还有这趟到底有多离谱。

Description.Original: Summarises each duty the moment it ends: who died and how often, how many wipes, the run's duration, and a grade with a dry comment. Tracks a personal best per duty and copies a one-line recap into party chat when you want to share the damage.
Description.Translated: 副本结束时立即汇总：谁死了、死了几次、团灭次数、总用时，以及评分和一句冷幽默点评。记录各副本的个人最佳成绩，并可在你想分享时，将一行总结复制到小队聊天。

Punchline.Original: Shows a cast bar for every enemy in the enemy list.
Punchline.Translated: 为敌对列表中的每个敌人显示咏唱条。

Description.Original: Draws a progress bar and the cast name directly onto each row of the game's enemy list, so you can see every enemy cast without targeting them. Interruptible casts are highlighted in a different colour.
Description.Translated: 直接在游戏敌对列表的每行绘制进度条与技能名称，无需选中目标即可查看所有敌人的读条。可打断的咏唱会以不同颜色高亮。

Punchline.Original: A running ledger of where your gil comes from and goes.
Punchline.Translated: 持续记录吉尔从哪里来、花到哪里去。

Description.Original: Records every change to the gil in your pocket while the plugin is running: market purchases, repairs, venture fees, vendoring, and whatever the game does not explain. Every change is reconciled against your actual balance so the totals stay honest even when the client never says why the number moved.
Description.Translated: 插件运行期间记录身上吉尔的每次变化，包括市场采购、修理、雇员探险费用、商店交易，以及游戏未说明原因的变动。每次变化都会与实际余额核对，即使客户端不解释数字为何变化，汇总金额也能准确对应。

Punchline.Original: One window for the debuffs that actually resolve a mechanic.
Punchline.Translated: 集中查看真正影响机制处理的减益。

Description.Original:
A party-wide grid of the statuses you choose to care about. Rows are watched statuses, columns are party members, and each cell shows the time left and stack count.

The watchlist is built by capture: press Capture during a mechanic and every status currently on the party is added, so there is no fight database to rot. Right-click a name to remove it.

No mechanic prediction and no timeline - this only shows what is on the party right now.
Description.Translated:
以全队网格显示你关心的状态：每行对应一个受关注状态，每列对应一名队员，单元格显示剩余时间与层数。

关注列表通过捕获创建：在机制期间点击捕获，即可加入队伍当前拥有的所有状态，不必维护容易过期的战斗数据库。右键状态名称可移除。

不预测机制，也不提供时间轴，只显示队伍此刻已有的状态。

Punchline.Original: A bingo card for whatever the duty finder throws at you.
Punchline.Translated: 为任务搜索器安排给你的各种状况准备一张宾果卡。

Description.Original:
A 5x5 bingo card generated for every duty you enter, filled with the small disasters and rituals of Final Fantasy XIV party content.

Click squares as they happen. The plugin auto-detects a few of them - deaths, wipes, vuln stacks, the chat classics - and leaves the rest to your honour and your memory. Get five in a row, copy the run report to your clipboard, and share cards with friends.

Every card is seeded, so the same seed always produces the same card. Copy a card code, send it to a friend, and they can play the exact same board.
Description.Translated:
每次进入副本时生成一张 5×5 宾果卡，填满《最终幻想14》组队内容中常见的小灾难和惯例。

事件发生时点击对应格子。插件会自动识别部分事件，例如死亡、团灭、易伤层数和经典聊天台词，其余则靠你的诚实与记忆。凑成连续五格后，可将本次报告复制到剪贴板，也可与好友分享卡片。

每张卡都有随机种子，相同种子总会生成同一张卡。复制卡片代码发给好友，双方就能玩完全相同的棋盘。

Punchline.Original: Tells you what your retainer slots should actually be selling.
Punchline.Translated: 告诉你，雇员的出售栏位真正应该卖什么。

Description.Original:
Your retainer slots are a portfolio, not a shelf. Slot Yield scans the market board through Universalis, models how much of each item's daily sales you can actually capture given the competition, and then solves the assignment problem: which N items, within your capital budget, earn the most gil per slot per day.

Every number is explainable - velocity, sellers at your price, expected share, days to clear a stack, tax. It also keeps your own listings in view, alerts when you are undercut, plans crafts from your bags, and can reprice or list for you when you ask it to.
Description.Translated:
你的雇员出售栏位是一份投资组合，而不只是货架。Slot Yield 通过 Universalis 扫描市场布告板，结合竞争情况估算你实际能占到各物品每日销量的多少，再求解分配问题：在现有资金预算内，选哪 N 种物品，才能让每个栏位的日均吉尔收益最高。

每个数字都有解释，包括销售速度、同价卖家数量、预计份额、卖完一组的天数和税费。还会关注你自己的挂单、提醒被压价、根据背包材料规划制作，并可在你要求时替你改价或上架。

Punchline.Original: Hide selected Server Info Bar entries with one command.
Punchline.Translated: 用一个命令隐藏选定的服务器信息栏条目。

Description.Original: Choose entries with /infobar, then use /infobar toggle to hide or restore them together. Plugins keep running. Entry names and aliases are detected automatically.
Description.Translated: 通过 /infobar 选择条目，再用 /infobar toggle 一起隐藏或恢复。插件本身继续运行，条目名称和别名会自动识别。

Punchline.Original: リプレイをプルごとに切り出し、古いリプレイを変換
Punchline.Translated: 按每次战斗拆分回放，并转换旧版回放。

Description.Original: コンテンツリプレイ（A Realm Recorded）のファイルを、プルごとに切り出して共有しやすくします。パッチで再生できなくなった古いリプレイを、今のバージョンで再生できるように変換します。
Description.Translated: 将 A Realm Recorded 的副本回放文件按每次战斗切分，方便分享。还可转换因游戏更新而无法播放的旧回放，使其能在当前版本中播放。

Punchline.Original: Move forward or backward briefly from a macro.
Punchline.Translated: 通过宏短暂向前或向后移动。

Description.Original: Commands /forwardslide and /backslide send a short W/S key pulse (0.05 to 0.99 seconds), automatically releasing the key. /slidestop cancels it.
Description.Translated: /forwardslide 和 /backslide 命令会发送持续 0.05 至 0.99 秒的 W／S 按键输入，并自动松开。/slidestop 可取消。

Punchline.Original: Glamour-Raster mit gerenderten Charakter-Kacheln.
Punchline.Translated: 以角色渲染缩略图构成的幻化网格。

Description.Original: Zeigt alle ausruestbaren Items als Seiten-Raster mit gerenderten Bildern des eigenen Charakters, filterbar, mit Besitzstatus und Fundort pro Item.
Description.Translated: 将所有可装备物品以分页网格展示，每格渲染自己的角色试穿图，支持筛选，并显示物品拥有情况和获取地点。

Description.Original: SGT Production Box  FF14 嵥滮Խ嵥չ䷽鿴ÿɼһ NPC 򣬻󣬲񽻸 Artisan
Description.Translated: SGT Production Box 是 FF14 的生产清单规划插件：可以建立多个生产清单，展开配方树查看每个材料属于制作、采集、兑换还是 NPC 购买，汇总总需求，并把制作任务交给 Artisan。
Description.Review: 原文已更新，译文还停在旧版

Punchline.Original: Compact Samurai and Sage HUD with combo, resource and cooldown panels.
Punchline.Translated: 紧凑的武士与贤者 HUD，提供连击、资源和冷却面板。

Description.Original: Shows Samurai's native PvE combo branches and Sage's core spells using actions placed on the current keyboard or controller hotbars. Ready cooldown reminders appear before the first use and outside combat. A separate resource/proc area shows eligible Samurai Kenki, Sen, Meditation and follow-up actions, plus Sage Addersgall and Addersting spenders. Real hotbar key labels appear below icons. The overlay has no background cards or section headings during play; each area moves and resizes independently and remains visible with the game HUD hidden. Interrupted combo transitions continue from their visible positions, and finishers have no false link back to the starter. Use /itsupcombo for settings or /itsupcombo move to arrange the three areas. This plugin only displays information and never executes actions. Core and resource areas currently support Samurai and Sage; other jobs retain configurable cooldown reminders.
Description.Translated: 根据当前键盘或手柄热键栏中的技能，显示武士原生 PvE 连击分支与贤者核心魔法。首次使用技能前和脱战时，也会显示技能就绪提醒。独立的资源与触发区域显示符合条件的武士剑气、闪、剑压和后续技能，以及贤者消耗蛇胆和蛇刺的技能。图标下方显示实际热键栏键位标签。游玩期间，叠加界面不显示卡片背景或分区标题，各区域可独立移动和缩放，即使隐藏游戏 HUD 仍会保留。被打断的连击过渡会从当前可见位置继续，终结技能不会错误地连回起手技能。使用 /itsupcombo 打开设置，或 /itsupcombo move 调整三个区域。本插件仅显示信息，绝不执行技能。目前核心与资源区域支持武士和贤者，其他职业仍可使用可配置的冷却提醒。

ItsUpCombo.Author: SmolShar; original It's Up by Juan Medina

Punchline.Original: Your Pandora stations inside FFXIV: play, skip, thumbs, new stations.
Punchline.Translated: 在 FFXIV 中使用 Pandora 电台：播放、切歌、点赞和创建新电台。

Description.Original: XivPiano is a Pandora radio player inside FINAL FANTASY XIV, in the tradition of pianobar and Pithos. Sign in with your Pandora account and play your stations, skip, thumbs up or down, shelve a song you are tired of, bookmark it, ask why it was picked, and make new stations from an artist, a song or a genre. The song shows in the server info bar; /piano next and friends work from chat and macros, and other plugins can control it over IPC. It can mute the game's music while it plays and pause itself during cutscenes. Pandora is only available in the United States. Not affiliated with Pandora or Sirius XM. Optional Spaceghost Scrobbles keeps a private listening history, with export, deletion and user-controlled forwarding to ListenBrainz or Last.fm. Your Pandora account and stream URLs are never sent to the scrobbling service.
Description.Translated: XivPiano 是《最终幻想14》内的 Pandora 电台播放器，沿袭 pianobar 和 Pithos 的理念。登录 Pandora 账号后，可以播放自己的电台、切歌、点赞或点踩、暂时搁置听腻的歌曲、添加书签、询问推荐原因，并按歌手、歌曲或流派创建新电台。服务器信息栏显示当前歌曲，/piano next 等命令可用于聊天与宏，其他插件也可通过 IPC 控制。播放时可静音游戏音乐，并在过场动画中自动暂停。Pandora 仅在美国可用。本项目与 Pandora 或 Sirius XM 无关联。可选的 Spaceghost Scrobbles 提供私人收听历史，支持导出、删除，以及由用户控制转发至 ListenBrainz 或 Last.fm。Pandora 账号和音频流 URL 绝不会发送至收听记录服务。

Punchline.Original: Группа для синхронного запуска эмоций.
Punchline.Translated: 组队同步播放情感动作。

Description.Original: Создайте эмоциональную группу до восьми игроков, пригласите друзей и запустите доступную всем эмоцию после общего обратного отсчёта. Обмен идёт через личные сообщения FFXIV; отдельный сервер и настройка сети не нужны. Всем участникам необходимы плагин и доступный /tell.
Description.Translated: 创建最多八人的情感动作小组，邀请好友，在共同倒计时后同步播放所有人都已解锁的动作。通过 FFXIV 悄悄话交换信息，无需独立服务器或网络配置。所有参与者都需要安装插件，并能使用 /tell。

Punchline.Original: Дружеская пощёчина при встрече.
Punchline.Translated: 见面时来一记友好的耳光。

Description.Original: Выберите друзей или добавьте имена персонажей. Когда вы рядом, персонаж выполняет /slap на выбранного игрока. У каждого игрока свой интервал повтора в минутах. Настраиваемая дистанция, простой интерфейс и отключаемая иллюстрация. Сервер и установка плагина у друзей не требуются.
Description.Translated: 选择好友或添加角色名，靠近时自动对指定玩家使用 /slap。可为每人分别设置以分钟计的重复间隔。支持自定义距离、简洁界面及可关闭的插图。无需服务器，也不要求好友安装插件。

Punchline.Original: A flat, minimal, quality-of-life-packed map.
Punchline.Translated: 扁平、极简且充满便利功能的地图。

Description.Original: Replaces the in-game map with a flat, minimal ImGui map: search, lenses, filters, travel offers, window presets and dozens of small QoL tweaks. Based on Mappy by MidoriKami and harbingerftw. Open with /gratis.
Description.Translated: 以扁平极简的 ImGui 地图替换原生地图，提供搜索、视图模式、筛选、出行建议、窗口预设和数十项小型便利改进。基于 MidoriKami 与 harbingerftw 的 Mappy。使用 /gratis 打开。

Gratis.Author: t3sco (based on Mappy by MidoriKami, harbingerftw)

Punchline.Original: Customizable enemy job markers in Frontline.
Punchline.Translated: 纷争前线中可自定义的敌方职业标记。

Description.Original: Automatic native target markers in Frontline with configurable jobs, markers, order, timing, distance and job-change cleanup.
Description.Translated: 在纷争前线中自动添加原生目标标记，可设置职业、标记类型、顺序、时机、距离，以及换职后的标记清理。

Punchline.Original: Intelligent MIDI player, arranger, and auto-converter for FFXIV Bard Performance.
Punchline.Translated: 用于 FFXIV 吟游诗人演奏的智能 MIDI 播放器、编曲器和自动转换工具。

Description.Original: Intelligent MIDI player, arranger, and auto-converter for FFXIV Bard Performance. Converts raw, unedited MIDIs into playable FFXIV tracks for solo bards or multi-bard ensembles without manual DAW editing.
Description.Translated: 用于 FFXIV 吟游诗人演奏的智能 MIDI 播放器、编曲器和自动转换工具。可将未经编辑的原始 MIDI 转为适合 FFXIV 的演奏曲目，支持独奏与多诗人合奏，无需在数字音频工作站中手动编辑。

Punchline.Original: Dodges BossmodReborn AOEs with vnavmesh and runs Wrath Combo's Auto-Rotation.
Punchline.Translated: 使用 vnavmesh 躲避 BossmodReborn 提示的范围攻击，并运行 Wrath Combo 自动循环。

Description.Original: Play4ME reads BossmodReborn's AOE telegraphs, moves your character to the nearest safe spot with vnavmesh, walks you back into range of your target, and turns on Wrath Combo's Auto-Rotation while enabled. Requires BossmodReborn and vnavmesh; Wrath Combo is optional. Toggle with /play4me.
Description.Translated: Play4ME 读取 BossmodReborn 的范围攻击预警，通过 vnavmesh 将角色移到最近安全位置，再走回目标攻击范围内；启用期间会开启 Wrath Combo 的自动循环。需要 BossmodReborn 和 vnavmesh，Wrath Combo 为可选依赖。使用 /play4me 切换开关。

Punchline.Original: Multiboxing and IPC passthru, powered by cats.
Punchline.Translated: 由猫咪驱动的多开与 IPC 透传工具。

Description.Original:
MeowNET operates as a virtual party/lobby system to orchestrate many Dalamud plugins together and provide a platform for multiboxers.

Plugin from https://puni.sh/api/repository/kawaii
Description.Translated:
MeowNET 作为虚拟小队／大厅系统，协调多个 Dalamud 插件共同工作，并为多开玩家提供平台。

插件来源：https://puni.sh/api/repository/kawaii

Punchline.Original: 以职业名替换名牌及常用面板姓名 / Job names across nameplates and UI
Punchline.Translated: 以职业名替换姓名板及常用面板中的姓名。

Description.Original: Player Tags СӡŶӡɫ塢ĿĿĿ滻ְҵǩ֣PvP 滻 / Extends Player Tags with job names in party/alliance lists, the Character window, focus target and target of target. PvP is excluded. /playertagsplus
Description.Translated: 在 Player Tags 基础上，增加小队、团队、角色面板、焦点目标和目标的目标中的姓名替换，沿用职业标签文字。PvP 中不进行替换。使用 /playertagsplus。
Description.Review: 原文已更新，译文还停在旧版

Punchline.Original: Plan housing layout swaps from MakePlace files.
Punchline.Translated: 根据 MakePlace 文件规划房屋布局切换。

Description.Original: Load a MakePlace layout and see exactly which furnishings to keep, which to store, and which to pull from your inventory, retainers, house storerooms and FC chest.
Description.Translated: 加载 MakePlace 布局，准确了解哪些家具应保留、哪些应收纳，以及哪些需要从背包、雇员、房屋储物间和部队储物柜中取出。

Punchline.Original: Custom display names for you and yours.
Punchline.Translated: 为你和你的朋友设置自定义显示名。

Description.Original:
Give characters a custom display name that replaces their name on overhead nameplates and the examine window, with solid colours or Honorific's gradients (including animated Wave and Pulse) on the letters or the outline. Custom names can also be shared with paired players through PlayerSync's existing Honorific support. Changes are local to your client only; nobody else sees them and the game still uses the original names.

Adapted, with permission, from Honorific by Caraxi. Not an official Honorific release.
Description.Translated:
为角色设置自定义显示名，替换头顶姓名板和查看装备窗口中的姓名。可为文字或轮廓使用纯色，或 Honorific 渐变，包括动态波浪和脉冲。也可借助 PlayerSync 已有的 Honorific 支持，与配对玩家共享自定义姓名。修改只作用于本地客户端；未同步的其他人看不到变化，游戏内部仍使用原始姓名。

经许可改编自 Caraxi 的 Honorific，并非 Honorific 官方版本。

Name.Original: Aihana PVP · 职业辅助与雷达

Punchline.Original: Preview, copy and move hotbar slots and bars.
Punchline.Translated: 预览、复制和移动热键栏格子或整条热键栏。

Description.Original: 通常・クロスホットバーの共通／ジョブ／PvPプレビューから1枠・バー全体をコピー・移動。複数先への一括コピー、適用前プレビュー、変更履歴からの復元。可能な操作はゲーム内コマンド、その他はローカルデータ編集。独自パケット送信なし。/hotbarstudio。公開プレビュー：ゲーム実機での保存・再ログイン後の保持は未検証。 PvE⇔PvP間のローカル転送に対応。
Description.Translated: 从普通及十字热键栏的共通、职业和 PvP 预览中，复制或移动单格或整栏。支持批量复制到多个目标、应用前预览，以及从修改历史恢复。能通过游戏命令完成的操作使用原生命令，其余通过编辑本地数据实现，不发送自定义数据包。命令：/hotbarstudio。公开预览版：实际游戏中的保存及重新登录后的持久保留尚未验证。支持 PvE 与 PvP 热键栏之间的本地转移。

Punchline.Original: Mount anywhere, stay in style — cosmetic RP mounts with Moodles sync.
Punchline.Translated: 随处骑乘，保持风格——带 Moodles 同步的外观 RP 坐骑。

Description.Original: Turn your favorite mounts into a roleplay accessory, even indoors and in cities. Use familiar FFXIV hotbars, browse mount icons, create macros and share cosmetic mounts with friends through Moodles and compatible sync services. Supports FR/EN and modded appearances. Visual only: no extra speed, flight or movement abilities. Experimental native state modifications; use at your own risk.
Description.Translated: 将你最喜欢的坐骑变成角色扮演配件，即使在室内和城市中也能使用。使用熟悉的 FFXIV 热键栏，浏览坐骑图标，创建宏，并通过 Moodles 和兼容的同步服务与朋友分享外观坐骑。支持法语/英语和模组外观。仅视觉：没有额外速度、飞行或移动能力。实验性原生状态修改；使用风险自负。

Punchline.Original: Pick the glamour you want, press start, and let your other plugins farm it.
Punchline.Translated: 选择你想要的幻化，按下开始，让你的其他插件去刷取。

Description.Original: Finds the duties that drop the items you select and has AutoDuty run them one at a time until each item is in your inventory. Tells AutoDuty which rotation plugin to use, rolls Need on the items you are after in groups, keeps a farming history, and installs missing dependencies. Requires AutoDuty and a rotation plugin (Boss Mod, Wrath Combo or Rotation Solver Reborn). Drop data from LuminaSupplemental.
Description.Translated: 找出掉落你所选物品的任务，并让 AutoDuty 逐个运行它们，直到每件物品都进入你的背包。告诉 AutoDuty 使用哪个循环插件，在组队时对你想要的物品选择需求，保留刷取历史，并安装缺失的依赖项。需要 AutoDuty 和一个循环插件（Boss Mod、Wrath Combo 或 Rotation Solver Reborn）。掉落数据来自 LuminaSupplemental。

Punchline.Original: Camera-directed interaction and quiet quest controls.
Punchline.Translated: 镜头指向交互与安静的任务控制。

Description.Original: SoftInteractHUD: camera targeting, interaction key, quest actions and gathering outfits.
Description.Translated: SoftInteractHUD：镜头目标选择、交互键、任务操作和采集套装。

Punchline.Original: Your XIV companion.
Punchline.Translated: 你的 XIV 伙伴。

Description.Original: The Blob (TheBlob): thirteen animated companions, local sayings, optional voice input and explicitly requested AI chat. Standalone preview by Zero. Use /theblob to open.
Description.Translated: The Blob (TheBlob)：十三个动画伙伴、本地语音、可选语音输入和明确请求的 AI 聊天。由 Zero 制作的独立预览版。使用 /theblob 打开。

Punchline.Original: Names the plugin that throws right before a crash.
Punchline.Translated: 在崩溃前一刻指出抛出异常的插件名称。

Description.Original: Logs every first-chance managed exception with its live stack, so the last entry in dalamud.log before a crash identifies the plugin responsible. Diagnostic only: it draws nothing, makes no hooks and changes no game state. Leave it enabled while chasing a crash, then disable it.
Description.Translated: 记录每个首次机会的托管异常及其实时堆栈，因此崩溃前 dalamud.log 中的最后一条记录即可确定责任插件。仅用于诊断：不绘制任何内容、不进行任何挂钩、不更改任何游戏状态。追查崩溃时保持启用，之后禁用。

Punchline.Original: Share crafting lists with your team and assign items to members.
Punchline.Translated: 与团队共享制作清单并将物品分配给成员。

Description.Original: Avalon Crafting Assistance lets the Avalon team work on Teamcraft lists in game: assign items to crafters, mark progress, and check North America market prices on Universalis.
Description.Translated: Avalon Crafting Assistance 让 Avalon 团队在游戏内处理 Teamcraft 清单：将物品分配给制作人员、标记进度，并在 Universalis 上查看北美市场价格。

Punchline.Original: Change Emotes in Penumbra Mods.
Punchline.Translated: 更改 Penumbra 模组中的情感动作。

Description.Original: Change Emotes in Penumbra Mods.
Description.Translated: 更改 Penumbra 模组中的情感动作。

Punchline.Original: ミニオン「タビスズメ」を本物のスズメらしく動かし、鳴かせます。 / Makes the sparrow minion move and call like a real sparrow.
Punchline.Translated: 让宠物「旅雀」像真正的麻雀一样活动和鸣叫。 / Makes the sparrow minion move and call like a real sparrow.

Description.Original:
【日本語】
タビスズメが、両足ホップ・キョロキョロ・ついばみ・波状飛行で動き、行動に合わせて鳴きます。
/suzume で設定画面を開きます。

[English]
Your sparrow minion hops with both feet, looks around, pecks and flies in bounding waves, calling to match what it does.
/suzume opens the settings.

[Deutsch]
Dein Spatz-Begleiter hüpft beidbeinig, schaut sich um, pickt und fliegt in Wellen, mit passenden Rufen.
/suzume öffnet die Einstellungen.

[Français]
Votre mascotte moineau sautille à pieds joints, regarde autour d'elle, picore et vole en ondulant, avec des cris adaptés.
/suzume ouvre les paramètres.

Punchline.Original: GPose posing with drag-and-drop bone handles, bone scaling, body shaping and soft-body physics.
Punchline.Translated: 在 GPose 中通过拖拽骨骼手柄摆姿势，支持骨骼缩放、身体塑形和软体物理。

Description.Original:
Pose characters by dragging handles on their bones, on top of whatever pose they already have.
- Posing: drag hands, feet, elbows, knees, head, chest and hips; pin bones in place; rotation gizmo; finger presets; undo / redo
- Attach: hold a bone on to another character (hands on shoulders, holding hands...)
- Bone scale: make any bone bigger or smaller, choosing per bone whether the bones below it grow and move with it
- Move character: move, turn and resize a whole character, on top of other plugins such as Brio
- Body physics: one click sets up soft, jiggling chest and butt from the body mod you use (IVCS / YAS skeletons; adult bodies only)
- Body shape: sliders for the body's shape, live or built into your models
- Props and colliders the body can touch and press against
- Koikatsu link: mirror Koikatsu characters' pose, face and animation live (needs the Limber Koikatsu plugin from the GitHub release)
Everything happens on your PC and your screen only. Start on the Getting started page (/limber).
Description.Translated:
在角色已有姿势的基础上，通过拖拽骨骼上的手柄来摆姿势。
- 摆姿势：拖拽手、脚、肘、膝、头、胸和髋部；固定骨骼位置；旋转控件；手指预设；撤销 / 重做
- 附着：将一根骨骼固定到另一个角色身上（手放肩上、牵手……）
- 骨骼缩放：放大或缩小任意骨骼，可逐骨骼选择其下方的骨骼是否随之生长和移动
- 移动角色：整体移动、旋转和缩放角色，可叠加在 Brio 等其他插件之上
- 身体物理：一键根据你使用的身体模组设置柔软、晃动的胸部和臀部（IVCS / YAS 骨架；仅限成年体型）
- 身体塑形：身体形状滑块，可实时生效或烘焙进你的模型
- 道具和碰撞体，身体可以接触和挤压
- Koikatsu 联动：实时镜像 Koikatsu 角色的姿势、面部和动画（需要 GitHub 发布页的 Limber Koikatsu 插件）
一切仅在你的电脑和屏幕上进行。从入门页面开始（/limber）。

Punchline.Original: Export the locally cached mod files of a PlayerSync pair's appearance, with permission.
Punchline.Translated: 在获得许可的情况下，导出 PlayerSync 配对角色外观的本地缓存模组文件。

Description.Original: Select a visible PlayerSync pair, review which of their synchronized mod files are available in your local PlayerSync cache, confirm you have permission, and export them as a Penumbra mod package (.pmp) with an integrity manifest.
Description.Translated: 选择一个可见的 PlayerSync 配对，查看他们的同步模组文件中有哪些存在于你的本地 PlayerSync 缓存中，确认你已获得许可，然后将它们导出为带完整性清单的 Penumbra 模组包（.pmp）。

Punchline.Original: This plugin replaces your inventory with it's own categorified inventory addon.
Punchline.Translated: 此插件用其自有的分类背包插件替换你的背包。

Description.Original: I have made some optimizations that I believe are worthwhile. Please take a look at the original repository.
Description.Translated: 我做了一些我认为值得的优化。请查看原始仓库。

Description.Original: I have made some optimizations that I believe are worthwhile. Please take a look at the original repository.
Description.Translated: 我做了一些我认为值得的优化。请查看原始仓库。

Punchline.Original:
A plugin designed to provide a simple, customizable and always available interface for chat commands
or other plugins to alleviate the need for using macros and hotbar space to achieve similar results.

The plugin should initially appear as a small box on the bottom center of the game window.
Punchline.Translated:
一个旨在为聊天命令或其他插件提供简单、可自定义且始终可用的界面的插件，以减少使用宏和热键栏空间来实现类似结果的需求。

该插件最初应显示为游戏窗口底部中央的一个小框。

Description.Original: I have made some optimizations that I believe are worthwhile. Please take a look at the original repository.
Description.Translated: 我做了一些我认为值得的优化。请查看原始仓库。

Punchline.Original: Consolidates common UI elements and actions into a single uniform interface in the form of a set of highly customizable toolbars.
Punchline.Translated: 将常见 UI 元素和操作整合为一组高度可自定义的工具栏形式的统一界面。

Description.Original: I have made some optimizations that I believe are worthwhile. Please take a look at the original repository.
Description.Translated: 我做了一些我认为值得的优化。请查看原始仓库。

Punchline.Original: When working for MGP is too much effort.
Punchline.Translated: 当为MGP打工太费劲时。

Description.Original: Automates certain Gold Saucer mini-games. Enhanced with XIVcardsharp Triple Triad AI engine.
Description.Translated: 自动完成金碟游乐场的特定小游戏。由XIVcardsharp九宫幻卡AI引擎增强。

Punchline.Original: When thinking through Triple Triad is too much effort.
Punchline.Translated: 当思考九宫幻卡太费劲时。

Description.Original: High-performance Triple Triad solver with Adversarial Minimax, PIMC imperfect information hand sampling, and Open Tournament Draft evaluator.
Description.Translated: 高性能九宫幻卡求解器，具备对抗性极小化极大算法、PIMC不完全信息手牌采样以及公开赛选秀评估器。

Name.Original: 【测试版】Aihana Tuner 战斗调节器

Punchline.Original: Let's go walking!
Punchline.Translated: 一起去散步吧！

Description.Original: Get your daily steps in with your Warrior of Light.
Description.Translated: 与你的光之战士一起完成每日步数。

Punchline.Original: Clock spot coordination and controller-based clock spot targeting.
Punchline.Translated: 时钟站位协调与基于控制器的时钟站位目标选择。

Description.Original: Seats your party into clock spot positions to support controller radial clockspot targeting.
Description.Translated: 将你的队伍安排到时钟站位位置，以支持控制器径向时钟站位目标选择。

Punchline.Original: Support for Turkish characters in chat.
Punchline.Translated: 在聊天中支持土耳其字符。

Description.Original: Support for Turkish characters in chat. The game font can't show five Turkish letters and draws them as =, so this plugin turns them into plain g, G, s, i and I as you type and send. It also fixes messages and speech bubbles from other Turkish players on your screen.
Description.Translated: 在聊天中支持土耳其字符。游戏字体无法显示五个土耳其字母，会将它们绘制为 =，因此此插件会在你输入和发送时将它们转换为普通的 g、G、s、i 和 I。它还会修复你屏幕上其他土耳其玩家发送的消息和对话气泡。

Punchline.Original: Cap weekly tomestones with AutoDuty, or play the main story with Questionable, on every character.
Punchline.Translated: 用 AutoDuty 刷满每周神典石，或用 Questionable 在每个角色上推进主线剧情。

Description.Original:
Keeps a list of your characters and works through them one at a time, logging in to each with Lifestream.

Cap tomes: checks this week's limited tomestones and runs the dungeon paying the most of them that the character can enter, with AutoDuty in Duty Support or Trust, until the weekly cap is reached.

Run main story: runs Questionable on each character until it stops, usually at a duty it can't do.

Each character can be switched to a chosen job, in its best gear set. When every character is done it can log out, close the game or run your own commands.

Needs Lifestream, plus AutoDuty for tomes or Questionable for the main story. AutoRetainer is optional.
Description.Translated:
维护你的角色列表，并逐个处理，使用 Lifestream 登录每个角色。

刷神典石：检查本周的有限神典石，并使用 AutoDuty 在剧情辅助器或亲信战友中，运行该角色能进入且产出最多神典石的地下城，直到达到每周上限。

推进主线：在每个角色上运行 Questionable，直到它停止，通常是在它无法完成的任务处。

每个角色都可以切换到选定的职业，并穿上其最佳装备套装。当所有角色都完成后，它可以登出、关闭游戏或运行你自己的命令。

需要 Lifestream，以及用于神典石的 AutoDuty 或用于主线的 Questionable。AutoRetainer 为可选。

Punchline.Original: Browse model groups, compare variants and preview gear with dyes.
Punchline.Translated: 浏览模型组、比较变体并预览带染色的装备。

Description.Original:
Browse equipment by slot, move through model groups with Up/Down and compare variants with Left/Right. Save favourites, preview dyes and restore remembered pieces displaced by sets. Open with /glamourbrowse.

Visual trait classification and ring-side restoration are not included. The logo is AI-generated.
Description.Translated:
按部位浏览装备，使用上/下键在模型组之间移动，使用左/右键比较变体。保存收藏、预览染色，并恢复被套装替换的已记忆部件。使用 /glamourbrowse 打开。

不包含视觉特征分类和戒指侧恢复功能。标志由 AI 生成。

Punchline.Original: Find the right party and see who's playing.
Punchline.Translated: 找到合适的队伍，看看谁在玩。

Description.Original: Find Party Finder groups that match your goals, see their members and progress, and spot friends. Get alerts or opt in to automatic party switching.
Description.Translated: 查找符合你目标的招募板队伍，查看其成员和进度，并发现好友。获取提醒或选择加入自动切换队伍。

Punchline.Original: Quest markers and estimated Free Company MSQ progress.
Punchline.Translated: 任务标记和部队主线任务进度估算。

Description.Original: Tracks Free Company story clues using world observations and paced public Lodestone profile checks, with saved last-seen points and quest-chain previews. The logo is AI-generated.
Description.Translated: 通过世界观测和定速的公开 Lodestone 个人资料检查来追踪部队剧情线索，并保存最后所见进度点和任务链预览。标志为 AI 生成。

Punchline.Original: Exports relic weapon material counts.
Punchline.Translated: 导出 relic weapon 材料数量。

Description.Original: Counts relic weapon materials on the character and exports them to an external destination. Needs to be paired with an external destination to track the character's progress.
Description.Translated: 统计角色身上的 relic weapon 材料并导出到外部目标。需要与外部目标配对以追踪角色进度。

Punchline.Original: Shop collection filters, currency planning and loot results for FFXIV Korea.
Punchline.Translated: FFXIV 韩服的商店收藏筛选、货币规划和战利品结果。

Description.Original:
Small conveniences in the game's own UI, for FFXIV Korea.

• Filter owned equipment and collectibles, or focus shop lists on collection items.
• Calculate the current shop's currency requirements and shortages, with linked storage records.
• Right-click loot items to view participant choices and publicly received roll results.
• Enable PvP chat bubbles using your game's chat bubble settings.

Open settings: /dbtw or /duckbilltweak. Each feature starts disabled.
Release history: Settings → 업데이트 내역, or /dbtw changelog.

Korean client and inspected Dalamud API 15 bindings only. Loot numbers appear when the game publishes results. Stored inventory records may be incomplete or out of date.
Description.Translated:
游戏自带 UI 中的小便利功能，适用于 FFXIV 韩服。

• 筛选已拥有的装备和收藏品，或将商店列表聚焦于收藏品。
• 计算当前商店的货币需求和短缺，并关联存储记录。
• 右键点击战利品以查看参与者选择和公开收到的掷骰结果。
• 使用游戏的聊天气泡设置启用 PvP 聊天气泡。

打开设置：/dbtw 或 /duckbilltweak。每项功能初始为禁用。
发布历史：设置 → 업데이트 내역，或 /dbtw changelog。

仅限韩服客户端和经检查的 Dalamud API 15 绑定。战利品数字在游戏发布结果时出现。存储的库存记录可能不完整或过时。

Punchline.Original: Timers and sound alerts for Bard songs and job DoTs.
Punchline.Translated: 吟游诗人歌曲和职业持续伤害的计时器与声音提醒。

Description.Original: Tracks Bard songs and damage-over-time effects from tanks, healers, and DPS. Shows an overlay timer and plays a sound when they are about to expire. Each skill can be enabled per job.
Description.Translated: 追踪吟游诗人歌曲以及坦克、治疗和 DPS 的持续伤害效果。显示叠加计时器，并在即将到期时播放声音。每个技能可按职业启用。

Punchline.Original: Shows one player's ability order from an FFLogs ultimate pull.
Punchline.Translated: 显示某位玩家在 FFLogs 绝境战记录中的技能顺序。

Description.Original: Loads one job's public FFLogs rDPS parses for an ultimate, grouped by percentile, and shows that player's ability order. In the selected ultimate, the guide starts at the pull and follows the fight, and it resets if you leave or wipe. Automatic rotation is off until you enable it. It then presses each due step for you and skips a step that cannot be used.
Description.Translated: 加载某个职业在绝境战中的公开 FFLogs rDPS 记录，按百分位分组，并显示该玩家的技能顺序。在选定的绝境战中，指南从开怪开始并跟随战斗进程，离开或团灭时会重置。在你启用之前自动循环处于关闭状态。启用后它会为你按下每个到期的步骤，并跳过无法使用的步骤。

Name.Original: 魔光键影助手（个人环境兼容版）

KeyboundBrawlerLocal.Author: NiGuangOwO（原作者） / Aihana（个人环境兼容）

Punchline.Original: Human-like typing for Keybound Brawler.
Punchline.Translated: 为魔光键影提供类人打字。

Description.Original: typing for Keybound Brawler. Open with /keybound.
Description.Translated: 为魔光键影打字。使用 /keybound 打开。

Punchline.Original: キーバウンド・ブロウラーの自動入力と指定回数の周回。
Punchline.Translated: 魔光键影的自动输入与指定次数循环。

Description.Original: キーバウンド・ブロウラーの出題を読み取り、キーボード操作で回答するプラグインです。バリア強化・詠唱中の敵を優先し、入力禁止時は待機します。/keyboundpilot で画面を開き、設定で入力間隔を指定してください。通常は再生ボタンで開始。周回はスクウェアで回数を指定し、循環矢印ボタンで申請から開始します。一時停止・停止もボタンで操作できます。診断ログは設定で切り替え、初期値はオフです。
Description.Translated: 读取魔光键影的题目，并通过键盘操作作答的插件。优先处理强化屏障和咏唱中的敌人，禁止输入时等待。/keyboundpilot 打开界面，在设置中指定输入间隔。通常用播放按钮开始。循环用方块指定次数，用循环箭头按钮从申请开始。暂停和停止也可通过按钮操作。诊断日志在设置中切换，初始值为关闭。
